to help readers choose by the ambition they start with
to help readers choose by the obstacle they will meet
to help readers choose by the cost they can afford
to help readers choose by the season they begin in

qs.evidence: The honest advice is to choose according to the obstacle rather than the ambition.
qs.answer: to help readers choose by the obstacle they will meet
qs.why: Nasihat jujurnya “to choose according to the obstacle rather than the ambition”, jadi patokannya hambatan di bulan keempat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya patokan yang masuk akal buat milih cara olahraga, tapi teks ngeblok: frasa “rather than the ambition” persis nolak ambisi sebagai patokan; harga cuma jadi penentu kalau tujuanmu rutinitas (“the cheaper option is usually the stronger one”), bukan aturan umum; dan Januari serta Oktober cuma penanda daya tahan kebiasaan, bukan dasar pemilihan.

qs: Taken together, what does the article identify as the weak point of a gym membership?
the absence of anyone to correct your movement
the journey members have to make each time
the poor condition of its indoor machines
the effect of heavy rain on its opening hours

qs.evidence: In exchange it charges a monthly fee and demands a journey, which is the point at which most memberships quietly die.
qs.answer: the journey members have to make each time
qs.why: Teks nyebut gym menuntut biaya bulanan dan sebuah perjalanan, dan di titik perjalanan itulah keanggotaan biasanya mati diam-diam.
qs.whyOthersFail: Justru gym yang punya instruktur pembenar gerakan; kondisi mesinnya nggak pernah dikeluhkan; dan cuaca buruk disebut nggak relevan di dalam ruangan, itu masalah lari di taman.

qs: How do the two options compare on building a lasting habit?
the outdoor route is the easier one for building strength
the indoor route is the easier one on both counts
the outdoor route is the easier one to keep going
the indoor route is the easier one on a tired evening

qs.evidence: Neither arrangement guarantees continued attendance beyond the initial enthusiasm. Strength is easier to build indoors, whereas the habit itself is easier to build outdoors, because the barrier is lower on a tired evening.
qs.answer: the outdoor route is the easier one to keep going
qs.why: Teks bilang “Strength is easier to build indoors, whereas the habit itself is easier to build outdoors, because the barrier is lower on a tired evening”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya pembagian menang-kalah yang masuk akal antara gym dan taman, tapi kalimat itu ngeblok semuanya: kekuatan justru pos unggul dalam ruangan, jadi bukan taman; gym menang di kekuatan tapi kalah di kebiasaan, jadi bukan dua-duanya; dan “the barrier is lower” di malam yang lelah berlaku buat lari di taman, bukan buat gym.

qs: What does the writer imply about somebody recovering from an injury?
paying for guidance is a waste for them at first
running outdoors is the safer first step for them
paying for guidance is worth the fee for them
building the habit outdoors should come before any fee

qs.evidence: If your aim is muscle, or you need supervision after an injury, the fee purchases something real.
qs.answer: paying for guidance is worth the fee for them
qs.why: Teks nyebut kalau “you need supervision after an injury, the fee purchases something real”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya saran yang masuk akal buat orang yang baru sembuh, tapi frasa “the fee purchases something real” ngeblok semuanya: iurannya justru dibilang membeli sesuatu yang nyata, bukan pemborosan; keunggulan taman di teks soal kebiasaan, bukan keamanan setelah cedera; dan urutan kebiasaan-dulu ditujukan ke orang yang mau rutin di Oktober, bukan ke orang yang butuh pengawasan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Running in the park needs no payment for instruction."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Running in the park needs no payment for instruction.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Park running costs almost nothing and starts at the front door, yet it provides no instruction, punishes poor shoes, and disappears in heavy rain.
qs.why: Teks nyebut lari di taman hampir nggak ada biaya dan nggak nyediain instruksi, jadi klaim ini parafrasa dua sifat yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” salah karena nggak ada proposisi yang dibalik; “Not stated” salah karena soal biaya dan instruksi disebut langsung.

author: a sports and fitness writer
setting: a health feature comparing two exercise habits

title: Letter: A Question About Our Loyalty Card Data
text:
Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the loyalty card issued in my name last spring. Last week your company sent a letter to my home. The letter offered baby products at a substantial discount. My household has never purchased such items in your shops, and I should therefore like to establish how that particular offer was selected.
Two related matters concern me, and both involve the same missing information. First, the conditions of the card state that purchase records are used to improve the shopping experience. That wording does not reveal whether the records are shared with other firms. Second, a member of your staff informed me by telephone that offers are constructed from similar households, a phrase that appears nowhere in those conditions. If my address is being grouped with other addresses, that arrangement should have been declared plainly at the moment I signed. A vague sentence about experience is not consent. Transparency of that kind is a legal obligation rather than a courtesy.
I should therefore like to request three things, none of which ought to be difficult. Please send me a copy of the data held under my card number, and please state which companies receive it. Please also confirm whether I may keep the card while refusing the grouping. Comparable requests are routinely granted elsewhere in the industry. I have remained a customer for nine years and should prefer to continue. Your response will determine whether I renew the arrangement when the card expires. I look forward to a written reply within fourteen days, as the regulations require. Yours faithfully, Anwar Salim.
qs: Why has this letter been written?
to ask how the writer's records produced that particular offer
to ask the shop to stop sharing records with other firms
to ask the shop to withdraw the discount on baby products
to ask the shop to rewrite the card conditions for everyone

qs.evidence: My household has never purchased such items in your shops, and I should therefore like to establish how that particular offer was selected.
qs.answer: to ask how the writer's records produced that particular offer
qs.why: Penulis nyatain rumahnya “has never purchased such items in your shops” dan pengin tahu bagaimana tawaran itu dipilih buat dia.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya permintaan yang wajar dari pelanggan yang kesal, tapi surat ngeblok: tiga permintaannya cuma salinan data, daftar perusahaan penerima, dan izin menyimpan kartu tanpa pengelompokan — bukan perintah berhenti membagi data; harga produk bayi nggak pernah dipersoalkan; dan dia nuntut penjelasan buat kasusnya sendiri, bukan penulisan ulang syarat buat semua pelanggan.

qs: Taken together, what does the letter say the member of staff explained by telephone?
offers are chosen by the manager of each shop
offers go only to customers of nine years' standing
offers are built from groups of comparable homes
offers follow the records of a single household

qs.evidence: Second, a member of your staff informed me by telephone that offers are constructed from similar households, a phrase that appears nowhere in those conditions.
qs.answer: offers are built from groups of comparable homes
qs.why: Staf lewat telepon bilang tawaran disusun dari rumah tangga yang serupa — frasa yang justru nggak ada di syarat kartu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Manajer tiap toko nggak pernah disebut sebagai pemilih tawaran; sembilan tahun itu lama penulis jadi pelanggan, bukan syarat penerima tawaran; dan penjelasan stafnya bicara soal kelompok rumah tangga, bukan catatan satu rumah saja.

qs: Which point best supports the writer's claim that the card's conditions are unclear?
the letter offered baby products at a substantial discount
the wording says nothing about sharing records with other firms
the writer has held the card since last spring
a reply is required in writing within fourteen days

qs.evidence: That wording does not reveal whether the records are shared with other firms.
qs.answer: the wording says nothing about sharing records with other firms
qs.why: Syarat kartu cuma nyebut catatan pembelian dipakai buat memperbaiki pengalaman belanja, dan “That wording does not reveal whether the records are shared with other firms”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya beneran ada di surat dan kedengaran mendukung, tapi nggak nyentuh kaburnya syarat: tawaran diskon produk bayi itu peristiwa yang memicu surat; tanggal penerbitan kartu cuma latar; dan batas balasan empat belas hari itu aturan prosedur, bukan bukti syaratnya bisu soal pembagian data.

qs: Which statement best restates the writer's view of the card's wording?
a vague phrase is enough once the staff explain it
a vague phrase is acceptable if the records stay inside
a vague phrase is a courtesy rather than a duty
a vague phrase cannot count as genuine permission

qs.evidence: A vague sentence about experience is not consent. Transparency of that kind is a legal obligation rather than a courtesy.
qs.answer: a vague phrase cannot count as genuine permission
qs.why: Kalimat “A vague sentence about experience is not consent” nunjukin pandangannya: frasa umum nggak bisa dihitung sebagai izin sungguhan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya sikap yang masuk akal soal syarat dan ketentuan, tapi surat ngeblok: frasa staf disebut “appears nowhere in those conditions”, jadi penjelasan telepon nggak menutup lubangnya; pengelompokan alamat “should have been declared plainly at the moment I signed” walau datanya nggak keluar; dan “a legal obligation rather than a courtesy” persis ngebalik opsi soal kesopanan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer asks the company to cancel the loyalty card immediately."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer asks the company to cancel the loyalty card immediately.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I have remained a customer for nine years and should prefer to continue.
qs.why: Penulis justru minta tetap bisa pegang kartunya sambil nolak pengelompokan, jadi klaim soal minta kartunya dibatalkan itu kebalikannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” salah karena surat ini nggak minta pembatalan; “Not stated” salah karena keinginan tetap jadi pelanggan ditulis jelas.

author: a long-standing customer
setting: a letter of complaint to a supermarket chain

title: School Sport Should Not Be Marked Like Maths
text:
Every July our pupils receive a grade for physical education, and every July a few of them conclude that their bodies are a subject they have failed. I have taught the lesson for twelve years, and I no longer believe the grade achieves anything. The argument for marking it is respectable, which is precisely why it deserves an answer. Colleagues elsewhere have reached an identical conclusion independently.
Defenders of the grade insist that sport is a subject like any other, and that without marks it will be treated as a break. They also argue that a mark rewards effort from pupils who will never be quick. Against this stands a simpler fact. The child who is graded lowest is usually the child who most needs the habit. Maths does not lose you friends in the playground, whereas a low mark for running certainly can. Humiliation is a poor instrument of motivation. Comparing sport with an academic subject ignores how public the performance is.
There is a middle path. Replace the grade with a record of participation, personal progress, and one skill of the pupil's own choosing. Retain assessment for those who take sport as an examination subject, where a mark is expected and useful. If the aim of school sport is an adult who still moves at forty, then measuring speed at fifteen is beside the point. Such a record would still demand effort and honesty from pupils. I would rather produce a person who enjoys walking than one who remembers a number.
qs: Taken together, what change does this column argue for in school sport?
a written record should stand in place of the sport mark
a written record should stand in place of every school mark
the sport mark should remain but be shown only privately
the sport mark should reward effort instead of raw speed

qs.evidence: Replace the grade with a record of participation, personal progress, and one skill of the pupil's own choosing.
qs.answer: a written record should stand in place of the sport mark
qs.why: Usulannya persis: “Replace the grade with a record of participation, personal progress, and one skill of the pupil's own choosing”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya reformasi penilaian yang masuk akal, tapi teks ngeblok: penulis cuma bicara soal nilai olahraga dan malah nyebut “Maths does not lose you friends in the playground”, jadi bukan semua mata pelajaran; dia mau nilainya diganti, bukan dirahasiakan; dan hadiah buat usaha itu justru argumen para pembela nilai, bukan usulannya.

qs: Taken together, what do defenders of the sport grade claim would happen without it?
the quickest pupils will lose their reward
the lesson will be treated as free time
teachers will refuse to plan the lesson
pupils will stop attending it in July

qs.evidence: Defenders of the grade insist that sport is a subject like any other, and that without marks it will be treated as a break.
qs.answer: the lesson will be treated as free time
qs.why: Pembela nilai bilang tanpa nilai, pelajaran olahraga bakal dianggap jam istirahat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Hadiah buat murid cepat nggak pernah jadi kekhawatiran mereka — yang mereka sebut justru hadiah buat usaha murid yang nggak akan pernah cepat; sikap guru soal perencanaan nggak dibahas; dan Juli itu bulan nilai keluar, bukan bulan murid berhenti hadir.

qs: How does the writer contrast sport with an academic subject?
a weak result in sport is seen by everyone watching
a weak result in maths is harder to recover from
a weak result in sport is marked more strictly than maths
a weak result in maths costs a pupil more friends

qs.evidence: Maths does not lose you friends in the playground, whereas a low mark for running certainly can.
qs.answer: a weak result in sport is seen by everyone watching
qs.why: Teks nyebut “Maths does not lose you friends in the playground, whereas a low mark for running certainly can”, plus “how public the performance is”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya perbandingan yang masuk akal antara olahraga dan pelajaran akademik, tapi teks ngeblok: kalimat soal lapangan justru bilang matematika nggak bikin kehilangan teman, jadi arah opsi terakhir kebalik; pemulihan dari nilai jelek nggak pernah dibandingkan; dan ketatnya penilaian juga nggak dibahas, yang dibahas seberapa terbuka penampilannya.

qs: What does the writer imply about the purpose of school sport?
it should find the fastest pupils in each year group
it should aim at movement that lasts into later life
it should prepare every pupil for an examination subject
it should be judged by the marks that pupils receive

qs.evidence: If the aim of school sport is an adult who still moves at forty, then measuring speed at fifteen is beside the point.
qs.answer: it should aim at movement that lasts into later life
qs.why: Teks bilang kalau “the aim of school sport is an adult who still moves at forty”, ngukur kecepatan di umur lima belas jadi nggak relevan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya tujuan yang masuk akal buat olahraga sekolah, tapi teks ngeblok: “measuring speed at fifteen is beside the point” nolak pencarian murid tercepat; penilaian ujian dipertahankan cuma “for those who take sport as an examination subject”, bukan buat semua murid; dan nilai adalah hal yang penulis mau ganti dengan catatan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer would keep marks for pupils taking sport as an exam subject."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer would keep marks for pupils taking sport as an exam subject.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Retain assessment for those who take sport as an examination subject, where a mark is expected and useful.
qs.why: Teks nyebut penilaian tetap dipertahankan buat yang ambil olahraga sebagai mata ujian, jadi klaim ini parafrasa langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” salah karena pengecualian itu memang ditulis; “Not stated” salah karena kalimatnya ada di paragraf terakhir.

author: a physical education teacher
setting: an opinion column by a physical education teacher

title: What a Price Label Does to a Shopping Basket
text:
A supermarket chain permitted researchers to alter the labels on its shelves for eleven weeks, and the results were larger than anyone expected. Nothing else was changed: the same products, the same prices, the same positions. Only the manner in which the cost was printed on the label was different.
During the first period the shelves displayed the price per packet alone. In the second, the price per hundred grams appeared beside it in the same size. Sales of the cheapest option per gram rose by 14 per cent. Sales of the large family packets declined, because many of them were not in fact cheaper by weight. Shoppers had not suddenly grown wiser; they were simply able to compare without arithmetic in the aisle. The clearest effect appeared among customers shopping in a hurry, whose baskets altered most of all.
The study raises an awkward question for retailers. If clearer labels move money towards better value, the current design is not an accident but a choice. The researchers stop short of blaming anyone, noting that label rules differ between regions and that some chains had already begun the change. Their recommendation is narrow and testable. Print the unit price in the same size as the packet price, and allow shoppers to do the rest.
qs: Taken together, what does this shop study establish about printed prices?
the way a price is printed changes what shops charge
the way a price is printed changes how long people shop
the way a price is printed changes what people buy
It reports that the shop's total takings rose after the change

qs.evidence: Only the manner in which the cost was printed on the label was different.
qs.answer: the way a price is printed changes what people buy
qs.why: Cuma “the manner in which the cost was printed on the label” yang diubah, dan pola belanjanya tetap bergeser.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya akibat yang masuk akal dari percobaan label, tapi teks ngeblok: percobaannya nyebut “the same products, the same prices, the same positions”, jadi harga toko dan rak yang laku nggak berubah; dan lama waktu berbelanja nggak pernah diukur — yang diukur isi keranjang, termasuk keranjang pembeli yang tergesa-gesa.

qs: Taken together, what do the label changes show was added in the second period?
a warning about the largest family packets
the price of the same item in other shops
the cost for each hundred grams of product
a note about the position on the shelf

qs.evidence: In the second, the price per hundred grams appeared beside it in the same size.
qs.answer: the cost for each hundred grams of product
qs.why: Pada periode kedua, harga per seratus gram muncul di samping harga paket dengan ukuran huruf yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Nggak ada peringatan apa pun yang ditempel di label; harga di toko lain nggak pernah dicetak; dan posisi rak justru bagian yang sengaja dibiarkan sama persis.

qs: Which point best supports the claim that the new labels made comparison possible?
buying shifted towards the cheapest option by weight
the study ran for eleven weeks in a single chain
label rules differ between one region and another
some chains had already started making the change

qs.evidence: Sales of the cheapest option per gram rose by 14 per cent.
qs.answer: buying shifted towards the cheapest option by weight
qs.why: Penjualan pilihan termurah per gram naik 14 persen, jadi orang benar-benar bisa membandingkan tanpa berhitung di lorong rak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya beneran ada di laporan dan kedengaran mendukung, tapi nggak nunjukin perbandingan terjadi: sebelas pekan di satu jaringan itu ukuran metode; beda aturan label antar wilayah dipakai peneliti buat nggak menyalahkan siapa pun; dan jaringan yang udah mulai berubah itu latar, bukan hasil.

qs: Which statement best restates the awkward question for shops?
an unhelpful label may be an accident the shops can correct
an unhelpful label may be a rule imposed by the region
an unhelpful label may be a habit shoppers accept quietly
an unhelpful label may be a choice rather than an accident

qs.evidence: If clearer labels move money towards better value, the current design is not an accident but a choice.
qs.answer: an unhelpful label may be a choice rather than an accident
qs.why: Teks bilang kalau label yang jelas mengalihkan uang ke nilai lebih baik, “the current design is not an accident but a choice”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya bacaan yang masuk akal soal desain label, tapi teks ngeblok: frasa “not an accident but a choice” persis nolak opsi kecelakaan; aturan wilayah cuma disebut sebagai alasan peneliti menahan tuduhan, bukan sumber desainnya; dan “Shoppers had not suddenly grown wiser” nunjukin masalahnya bukan kebiasaan pembeli.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The chain earned less money overall during the second period."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The chain earned less money overall during the second period.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Sales of the large family packets declined, because many of them were not in fact cheaper by weight.
qs.why: Teks cuma nyebut pergeseran penjualan antar produk, bukan total pendapatan toko; angka untung-rugi keseluruhan nggak pernah dilaporin.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” salah karena total pendapatan nggak ada di teks; “False” salah karena teks juga nggak nyatain kebalikannya, cuma diam.

author: a consumer research writer
setting: an eleven-week experiment in a supermarket chain

title: An Online Careers Course, Reviewed Honestly
text:
I spent six weeks on a heavily advertised online course promising to prepare school leavers for a first job. I finished with mixed feelings, and with a clear view of where the money goes. The teaching is considerably better than the marketing implies, and the marketing is the worst feature of the product. Anyone paying the full fee deserves to know which sections earn their money.
The strongest section is the third week, which concerns written applications and their revision. You produce four genuine documents, receive comments from a human reviewer within two days, and then rewrite them. The interview week, by contrast, is remarkably thin. It contains two videos, a quiz, and a list of questions available free elsewhere. Nothing in the programme addresses salary, contracts, or resigning from a position honourably. The discussion forum is silent, and the promised mentor proved to be a monthly group call with ninety participants.
Would I recommend it? At the reduced price, certainly, and chiefly for the application week, which is genuinely useful and difficult to find elsewhere. At the full price it represents poor value, because half the material repeats what schools already supply without charge. The verdict is three marks out of five, weighted almost entirely by one week. The certificate at the end carries no recognized value with employers. Purchase it when it is cheap, work through the third week twice, and ignore the remainder without guilt.
qs: Taken together, what judgement does this review reach about the online course?
one week earns the fee and the rest does not
the interview week is two videos, a quiz and a free list
the promised mentor was a monthly call with ninety people
the certificate carries no recognized value with employers

qs.evidence: At the reduced price, certainly, and chiefly for the application week, which is genuinely useful and difficult to find elsewhere.
qs.answer: one week earns the fee and the rest does not
qs.why: Nilai tiga dari lima disebut “weighted almost entirely by one week”, yaitu pekan lamaran yang dianggap benar-benar berguna.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh benar-benar tercantum dalam ulasan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu keluhan terperinci, bukan putusan pokoknya. Isi pekan wawancara adalah contoh bagian yang tipis. Mentor yang ternyata panggilan bulanan adalah keluhan tambahan. Sertifikat tanpa nilai pengakuan adalah catatan penutup. Putusan pokoknya dinyatakan sebagai "three marks out of five, weighted almost entirely by one week" bersama "chiefly for the application week".

qs: Taken together, what does the review say the course's third week provides?
a set of videos followed by a short quiz
a monthly telephone call with ninety learners
written work with comments from a real person
a list of interview questions found free online

qs.evidence: You produce four genuine documents, receive comments from a human reviewer within two days, and then rewrite them.
qs.answer: written work with comments from a real person
qs.why: Pekan ketiga bikin kamu menghasilkan empat dokumen sungguhan, dapat komentar dari peninjau manusia dalam dua hari, lalu menulisnya ulang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Video dan kuis serta daftar pertanyaan gratis adalah isi pekan wawancara yang dinilai tipis; dan panggilan bulanan sembilan puluh peserta itu wujud “mentor” yang dijanjikan, bukan isi pekan ketiga.

qs: How does the interview week compare with the application week?
it offers more practice than any other week does
it offers the same written comments from a reviewer
it offers deeper coverage of pay and contracts
it offers little that a learner cannot find free

qs.evidence: It contains two videos, a quiz, and a list of questions available free elsewhere.
qs.answer: it offers little that a learner cannot find free
qs.why: Pekan wawancara cuma berisi “two videos, a quiz, and a list of questions available free elsewhere”, jadi isinya nyaris bisa dicari sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya perbandingan yang masuk akal antar pekan kursus, tapi teks ngeblok: pekan wawancara disebut “remarkably thin”, jadi bukan yang paling banyak latihan; komentar peninjau manusia cuma ada di pekan ketiga; dan “Nothing in the programme addresses salary, contracts” nutup opsi soal upah dan kontrak.

qs: What does the reviewer imply about the advertised mentor?
the mentor answered messages within two days each time
the mentor cost an extra fee on top of the course
the mentoring was not the personal support that was advertised
the mentor was the strongest part of the whole course

qs.evidence: The discussion forum is silent, and the promised mentor proved to be a monthly group call with ninety participants.
qs.answer: the mentoring was not the personal support that was advertised
qs.why: Mentor yang dijanjikan “proved to be a monthly group call with ninety participants”, jauh dari pendampingan pribadi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya dugaan yang masuk akal soal mentor kursus daring, tapi teks ngeblok: balasan dua hari datang dari “a human reviewer” di pekan ketiga, bukan dari mentor; nggak ada biaya bulanan tambahan yang disebut; dan “The strongest section is the third week”, jadi mentornya bukan bagian terkuat.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Some of the course material is available from schools at no cost."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Some of the course material is available from schools at no cost.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: At the full price it represents poor value, because half the material repeats what schools already supply without charge.
qs.why: “without charge” di teks sama artinya sama “at no cost”, dan teks nyebut separuh materinya cuma ngulang yang sekolah kasih gratis.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” salah karena nggak ada yang dibalik; “Not stated” salah karena pengulangan materi sekolah disebut langsung.

author: a reviewer who took the course
setting: a review of a six-week online course

title: Free Mail or Paid Mail: What Are You Trading?
text:
Most people use a free mail service, and a growing number now pay a small annual fee for one instead. The two look almost identical on the screen, which is why the choice is usually settled by habit. The genuine difference sits behind the window, in what each company requires from you in order to survive.
A free service earns its living from attention. Its notice permits the scanning of messages to construct interest groups, and its storage is generous because the mail itself is the product. A paid service earns from the fee, so its notice can promise no scanning and no advertising partners. Against that, paid services are smaller. They offer fewer tools, weaker protection against junk mail, and a real risk that the company closes and your address disappears. Free services also win on recovery, since a forgotten password is easier to resolve when millions share the same system.
Neither answer suits everybody. If your mail carries medical letters, contracts, or a business, the annual fee is cheap insurance and the shorter feature list is bearable. If you mainly receive receipts and messages from friends, paying to hide them from an advertiser may not be worth the expense. What matters is deciding deliberately. A service you never chose is still a service you are paying for, in one currency or another.
qs: What is the writer's purpose in this comparison?
to show which service protects a business inbox best
to show how each service recovers a lost password
to show what each service needs from its users
to show that the two services now differ very little

qs.evidence: The genuine difference sits behind the window, in what each company requires from you in order to survive.
qs.answer: to show what each service needs from its users
qs.why: Teks nyebut “The genuine difference sits behind the window, in what each company requires from you in order to survive”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya tujuan yang masuk akal buat artikel banding layanan surel, tapi teks ngeblok: “Neither answer suits everybody” nolak penunjukan satu layanan terbaik buat urusan bisnis; pemulihan kata sandi cuma satu rincian keunggulan layanan gratis; dan kalimat soal beda di balik jendela nolak simpulan keduanya nyaris sama.

qs: Taken together, what does the article say a free service does with messages?
it reads them to sort users into interest groups
it deletes them once the storage limit is reached
it hides them from every advertising partner
it copies them to a second company for safety

qs.evidence: Its notice permits the scanning of messages to construct interest groups, and its storage is generous because the mail itself is the product.
qs.answer: it reads them to sort users into interest groups
qs.why: Notis layanan gratis mengizinkan pemindaian pesan buat menyusun kelompok minat, karena surelnya sendiri yang jadi produk.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penyimpanannya justru disebut longgar karena surelnya yang jadi produk, jadi bukan dihapus begitu batas tercapai; menyembunyikan pesan dari mitra iklan adalah janji layanan berbayar; dan penyalinan ke perusahaan kedua nggak pernah disebut di teks.

qs: How do paid services compare with free ones on practical strength?
they win on tools, junk mail and long-term safety
they lose on tools, junk mail and long-term safety
they match free services on junk mail and storage
they lose on scanning but win on storage space

qs.evidence: They offer fewer tools, weaker protection against junk mail, and a real risk that the company closes and your address disappears.
qs.answer: they lose on tools, junk mail and long-term safety
qs.why: Layanan berbayar disebut “fewer tools, weaker protection against junk mail, and a real risk that the company closes”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya neraca yang masuk akal buat layanan berbayar, tapi kalimat itu ngeblok semuanya: alat lebih sedikit dan perlindungan lebih lemah nolak opsi menang maupun setara; dan penyimpanan longgar justru milik layanan gratis (“its storage is generous”), sementara pemindaian pesan adalah yang layanan berbayar janjikan nggak dilakukan.

qs: Which statement best restates the writer's conclusion?
every option costs you something, so choose it knowingly
the free option costs you no money, so choose it quickly
the paid option costs you least, so choose it deliberately
habit costs you little, so let it decide for you

qs.evidence: A service you never chose is still a service you are paying for, in one currency or another.
qs.answer: every option costs you something, so choose it knowingly
qs.why: Kalimat penutup bilang “A service you never chose is still a service you are paying for, in one currency or another”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya simpulan yang masuk akal dari perbandingan ini, tapi teks ngeblok: layanan gratis dibayar dengan pemindaian pesan, jadi bukan tanpa biaya; buat penerima kuitansi dan pesan kawan, “paying to hide them from an advertiser may not be worth the expense”, jadi yang berbayar nggak selalu paling murah; dan kebiasaan disebut sebagai yang biasanya memutuskan, padahal “What matters is deciding deliberately”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Recovering a lost password is harder on a free service than a paid one."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Recovering a lost password is harder on a free service than a paid one.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Free services also win on recovery, since a forgotten password is easier to resolve when millions share the same system.
qs.why: Teks nyebut layanan gratis justru menang di soal pemulihan password, jadi klaim ini ngebalik arah perbandingannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” salah karena arahnya berlawanan sama teks; “Not stated” salah karena soal pemulihan password dibahas jelas.

author: a technology writer
setting: a comparison article on email providers

title: Unpaid Internships Choose the Wrong People
text:
Every summer, offices fill with capable young people working for nothing. Every autumn we wonder why the same families keep appearing in the same professions. The two facts are connected, and the connection is hardly a mystery. An unpaid position does not select the strongest candidate; it selects the candidate who can afford to be unpaid.
Follow the chain. A three-month placement in a large city costs a student rent, travel, and food, which together exceed what many families earn in that period. The applicants who remain are therefore those with a spare room in the city or a parent able to send money. Employers then report, honestly enough, that their interns were excellent, and they recruit from that group. The outcome is a profession which resembles a family album, and a set of employers convinced that they chose on merit.
The remedy is not to abolish placements but to pay for them. Where the law has required a minimum wage for interns, the number of positions fell slightly and the range of applicants widened sharply. That exchange seems worth making. I would go further and invite any organization unable to pay an intern to ask whether it truly needs one. Work that deserves to be done is work that deserves to be paid.
qs: Taken together, what argument does this column build about unpaid places?
three months in a large city costs more than many families earn
a required wage widened the field and cut places only slightly
employers report quite honestly that their interns were excellent
unpaid places select by family money, not by ability

qs.evidence: An unpaid position does not select the strongest candidate; it selects the candidate who can afford to be unpaid.
qs.answer: unpaid places select by family money, not by ability
qs.why: Teks nyebut “An unpaid position does not select the strongest candidate; it selects the candidate who can afford to be unpaid”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah klaim nyata dari paragraf lain kolom ini, tetapi masing-masing langkah dalam rantai atau bagian obat, bukan hujahnya. Biaya tiga bulan di kota besar adalah mata rantai pertama. Pengalaman upah minimum adalah usul penyelesaian, bukan tesis. Laporan pemberi kerja tentang intern yang cemerlang adalah bagian dari sebab mereka salah menyimpulkan merit. Hujahnya ada pada "An unpaid position does not select the strongest candidate; it selects the candidate who can afford to be unpaid".

qs: Which supporting detail explains why unpaid places narrow the field of applicants?
three months of rent, travel and food exceed what many families earn
three months of unpaid work costs less than the wage an employer saves
three months in a large city costs about a month of an intern's travel
three months of unpaid work is repaid by employers at the end of summer

qs.evidence: A three-month placement in a large city costs a student rent, travel, and food, which together exceed what many families earn in that period.
qs.answer: three months of rent, travel and food exceed what many families earn
qs.why: Detail biaya inilah yang menyambung rantai argumen: kalau tiga bulan sewa, transpor, dan makan melebihi penghasilan banyak keluarga, pelamar yang sanggup tinggal mereka yang punya kamar cadangan atau orang tua pengirim uang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Upah yang dihemat pemberi kerja nggak pernah dihitung di teks. Sebulan biaya transpor jauh dari angka yang disebut, yang menggabungkan sewa, transpor, dan makan selama tiga bulan. Dan nggak ada pembayaran balik di akhir musim panas — posisi itu memang tanpa bayaran.

qs: Which evidence does the writer use to defend paying interns?
the same families keep appearing in the same professions
employers reported honestly that their interns were excellent
a legal wage widened the field and cut few places
rent, travel and food exceed what many families earn

qs.evidence: Where the law has required a minimum wage for interns, the number of positions fell slightly and the range of applicants widened sharply.
qs.answer: a legal wage widened the field and cut few places
qs.why: Di tempat upah minimum diwajibkan, “the number of positions fell slightly and the range of applicants widened sharply” — pertukaran yang penulis anggap layak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya beneran ada di kolom ini, tapi nggak satu pun membela pengupahan: keluarga yang sama muncul terus dan biaya sewa-transpor-makan itu gambaran masalahnya; dan laporan jujur pemberi kerja soal mutu intern justru bagian dari lingkaran yang dikritik.

qs: What does the writer imply about employers who praise their interns?
they knowingly mislead the public about their unpaid places
they mistake a narrow selection for a fair one
they usually recruit from outside that intern group
they know the placement excluded students who lacked money

qs.evidence: Employers then report, honestly enough, that their interns were excellent, and they recruit from that group.
qs.answer: they mistake a narrow selection for a fair one
qs.why: Pemberi kerja melapor “honestly enough” bahwa intern mereka bagus lalu merekrut dari kelompok itu, jadi mereka nyangka seleksi yang sempit itu adil.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya dugaan yang masuk akal soal pemberi kerja, tapi teks ngeblok: frasa “honestly enough” nolak tuduhan sengaja menyesatkan; “they recruit from that group” nolak opsi merekrut dari luar; dan “convinced that they chose on merit” nunjukin mereka justru nggak sadar siapa yang tersingkir.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "An employer who cannot pay an intern should question whether it needs one."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: An employer who cannot pay an intern should question whether it needs one.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I would go further and invite any organization unable to pay an intern to ask whether it truly needs one.
qs.why: Kalimat penutupnya persis minta organisasi yang nggak mampu bayar buat nanya apa mereka benar-benar butuh intern, jadi klaim ini parafrasa langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” salah karena saran itu nggak dibalik; “Not stated” salah karena ajakan itu ditulis jelas di paragraf ketiga.

author: a columnist on work and education
setting: an opinion column on entry into the professions

title: The Night Bus Problem Nobody Measured
text:
Why do so few women use the final bus of the evening? A city university devoted a year to the question and discovered that the answer had almost nothing to do with the bus itself. Researchers rode 240 late services, counted passengers, and interviewed 500 residents who had decided not to travel.
The refusals gathered around two points that no timetable mentions. The first was the walk from the stop to the door, which averaged nine minutes and crossed unlit ground in most districts. The second obstacle was the period of waiting itself, particularly at isolated stops. A stop without other people felt unsafe long before any incident occurred. Nine of every ten interviewees described precisely the same anxiety, independently of each other. Reported offences along the routes remained low, and the passengers already using them felt entirely secure. The problem therefore sat at the edges of the journey rather than inside the vehicle.
Their conclusion challenges an assumption embedded in most transport planning. That finding points towards remedies of remarkably modest expense. The team recommends lighting the final streets rather than the main road. It also proposes publishing accurate arrival times so that nobody waits in the dark, and permitting passengers to leave the bus between stops after ten o'clock. None of these measures demands a fresh route or an additional vehicle. Where two of the three were attempted on one line, the number of women travelling late rose by a third within four months. The authors describe the result as encouraging rather than conclusive.
qs: Taken together, what does this report conclude about the risk of late travel?
the walk home from the stop averages nine unlit minutes
reported offences along these routes have remained low
the risk sits around the journey, not inside the bus
women's late travel rose by a third on one altered line

qs.evidence: The problem therefore sat at the edges of the journey rather than inside the vehicle.
qs.answer: the risk sits around the journey, not inside the bus
qs.why: Laporan nyimpulin “The problem therefore sat at the edges of the journey rather than inside the vehicle”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh betul-betul dilaporkan dalam kajian ini, tetapi masing-masing satu temuan bagian atau satu hasil percobaan, bukan pokoknya. Sembilan menit berjalan tanpa lampu hanya satu dari dua titik penolakan; yang kedua adalah menunggu di perhentian terpencil. Angka kejahatan yang tetap rendah adalah pembanding, bukan kesimpulan. Kenaikan sepertiga pada satu jalur adalah uji coba yang disebut "encouraging rather than conclusive". Pokoknya berbunyi "The problem therefore sat at the edges of the journey rather than inside the vehicle".

qs: Taken together, what do the interviews show about the walk from the stop to the door?
roughly nine minutes on foot
about ten minutes on foot
close to four minutes on foot
roughly fourteen minutes on foot

qs.evidence: The first was the walk from the stop to the door, which averaged nine minutes and crossed unlit ground in most districts.
qs.answer: roughly nine minutes on foot
qs.why: Jalan dari pemberhentian ke pintu rumah rata-rata sembilan menit dan melewati tanah tanpa lampu di sebagian besar distrik.
qs.whyOthersFail: Sepuluh menit, empat menit, dan empat belas menit nggak ada di laporan; jalan dari pemberhentian ke pintu rumah rata-rata sembilan menit.

qs: Which finding best supports the claim that fear was not caused by crime?
nine in ten interviewees described exactly the same anxiety
the walk from the stop averaged nine unlit minutes
offences stayed low and regular riders felt safe
women travelling late rose by a third on one line

qs.evidence: Reported offences along the routes remained low, and the passengers already using them felt entirely secure.
qs.answer: offences stayed low and regular riders felt safe
qs.why: “Reported offences along the routes remained low, and the passengers already using them felt entirely secure” — jadi rasa takutnya bukan buah angka kejahatan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya temuan asli laporan ini, tapi nggak satu pun nyingkirin kejahatan sebagai sebab: sembilan dari sepuluh yang cemas cuma ngukur seberapa luas rasa takutnya; sembilan menit jalan tanpa lampu nunjukin di mana rasa takutnya muncul; dan kenaikan sepertiga penumpang perempuan itu hasil percobaan perbaikan.

qs: Which conclusion about the cost of the recommended measures follows from the report's own list?
they can be introduced without buying anything large
they would cost more than the city can currently afford
they depend on placing staff at the isolated stops
they require one extra vehicle on every late line

qs.evidence: None of these measures demands a fresh route or an additional vehicle.
qs.answer: they can be introduced without buying anything large
qs.why: Tiga usulannya lampu jalan, jadwal kedatangan yang akurat, dan izin turun di antara pemberhentian; teks nutup daftar itu dengan “None of these measures demands a fresh route or an additional vehicle”, sejalan dengan “remedies of remarkably modest expense”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Frasa “remarkably modest expense” nolak simpulan bahwa biayanya di luar jangkauan kota. Petugas di pemberhentian terpencil nggak pernah masuk tiga usulan itu. Dan “or an additional vehicle” persis nutup opsi tambah kendaraan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Passengers waiting in pairs reported the same anxiety as those alone."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Passengers waiting in pairs reported the same anxiety as those alone.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Nine of every ten interviewees described precisely the same anxiety, independently of each other.
qs.why: Teks cuma nyebut sembilan dari sepuluh orang yang diwawancara ngerasain kecemasan yang sama; yang nunggu berdua dan yang nunggu sendirian nggak pernah dipisah jadi dua kelompok.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” salah karena perbandingan antara penumpang berdua dan penumpang sendirian nggak ada datanya di teks; “False” juga salah karena teks nggak nyatain kelompok berdua ngerasa berbeda — soal itu dia memang diam.

author: an urban research writer
setting: a year-long university study of late bus services

title: A Fitness Band That Solves the Wrong Problem
text:
The band I have worn for a month costs as much as a decent pair of running shoes. It promises to solve a genuine difficulty, since most people abandon exercise in the fourth week. Its answer is constant measurement. After thirty days I am fitter, better informed, and slightly less persuaded by the promise.
As equipment it is excellent. The battery survives nine days, the strap tolerates rain and a swimming pool, and the step count matched a careful manual count within two per cent. Heart rate during steady running was close to a chest monitor, although it drifted badly during sudden efforts. The sleep score, however, is the weak point. On two nights when I slept badly the band awarded me a high score, and on one restful night it reported broken sleep.
The deeper difficulty is what the app does with all this information. It sends four notifications a day, sets targets I never chose, and converts a missed walk into a broken record. Anyone who already worries about exercise will find that pressure unhelpful, and the switch that silences it lies three menus deep. Purchase the band for its honest numbers, then spend ten minutes disabling the encouragement. Three and a half marks out of five: a reliable instrument wrapped in a nagging coach.
qs: Taken together, what is the reviewer's central criticism of the fitness band?
the band's numbers are less reliable than its advice
the software gives the wearer too little guidance
the software hides its best features three menus deep
the software pushes the wearer harder than it should

qs.evidence: It sends four notifications a day, sets targets I never chose, and converts a missed walk into a broken record.
qs.answer: the software pushes the wearer harder than it should
qs.why: Keluhan utamanya soal aplikasi: “It sends four notifications a day, sets targets I never chose, and converts a missed walk into a broken record”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya keluhan yang masuk akal buat gelang kebugaran, tapi teks ngeblok: “Purchase the band for its honest numbers” nunjukin angkanya justru bagian yang dipuji; keluhannya bukan tuntunan yang kurang tapi dorongan yang berlebihan; dan yang tersembunyi tiga menu itu “the switch that silences it”, bukan fitur terbaiknya.

qs: Taken together, what does the review say about the band's heart rate readings?
they were out by about two per cent all day
they held up except during sudden changes of effort
they matched a chest monitor during sudden efforts
they were the strongest feature of the band

qs.evidence: Heart rate during steady running was close to a chest monitor, although it drifted badly during sudden efforts.
qs.answer: they held up except during sudden changes of effort
qs.why: Denyut saat lari stabil mendekati monitor dada, tapi melenceng jauh ketika usahanya berubah mendadak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Selisih dua persen itu soal hitungan langkah; kecocokan dengan monitor dada berlaku saat lari stabil, justru melenceng ketika usahanya berubah mendadak; dan bagian terkuat perangkat ini bukan denyutnya.

qs: Which example best supports the reviewer's doubts about the sleep score?
a bad night scored well and a restful one badly
the step count matched a manual count within two per cent
heart rate drifted badly during sudden bursts of effort
the strap survived rain and a swimming pool

qs.evidence: On two nights when I slept badly the band awarded me a high score, and on one restful night it reported broken sleep.
qs.answer: a bad night scored well and a restful one badly
qs.why: Dua malam tidur buruk malah dikasih skor tinggi sementara satu malam nyaman dilaporkan sebagai tidur terputus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya beneran ada di ulasan, tapi nggak satu pun soal skor tidur: hitungan langkah dan tali antiair justru bagian yang dipuji sebagai perangkat, dan melencengnya denyut itu kelemahan pengukuran usaha mendadak — bukan bukti skor tidurnya keliru.

qs: What does the reviewer imply about anxious exercisers?
they may do better ignoring the numbers the band gives
they may gain most from the four daily messages
the reminders may do them more harm than good
they might prefer a chest monitor to this band

qs.evidence: Anyone who already worries about exercise will find that pressure unhelpful, and the switch that silences it lies three menus deep.
qs.answer: the reminders may do them more harm than good
qs.why: Teks bilang “Anyone who already worries about exercise will find that pressure unhelpful”, dan tombol pematinya susah dicari.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya saran yang masuk akal buat orang yang cemas soal olahraga, tapi teks ngeblok: angkanya justru direkomendasikan (“Purchase the band for its honest numbers”); empat notifikasi sehari adalah sumber tekanan itu, bukan manfaatnya; dan monitor dada cuma dipakai sebagai pembanding ketepatan, bukan sebagai saran beli.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The band costs far less than a good pair of running shoes."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The band costs far less than a good pair of running shoes.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The band I have worn for a month costs as much as a decent pair of running shoes.
qs.why: Teks nyebut harganya setara sepatu lari yang bagus, jadi klaim “far less” ngebalik perbandingan harganya.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” salah karena harganya setara, bukan jauh lebih murah; “Not stated” salah karena pembandingan harga itu ada di kalimat pertama.

author: a fitness equipment reviewer
setting: a review of a wrist fitness band

title: Letter: Request to Adjust the School Bus Timetable
text:
Dear Ms Wijaya, I am writing as chair of the parents' committee about route 14, which serves our school gate each morning. Since the timetable changed at the start of term, the bus has been timed to reach the gate at 7:41, nine minutes before the first lesson. We are grateful for the additional service, yet the new arrangement is producing daily difficulty. Reliable timing of this kind is an administrative necessity rather than a preference.
The difficulty is the distance between the published plan and the actual road. Between the market and the school the bus crosses two junctions which hold traffic for several minutes. Our observations across six weeks indicate an average arrival at 7:52. On eleven separate mornings the bus reached the gate considerably after eight o'clock. Pupils then enter the lesson late, are recorded as absent, and the office spends its first hour correcting the register. The drivers are not at fault; the timetable simply does not match the street.
We should like to suggest two possible changes, either of which would assist. The simplest is to move the departure from the terminus five minutes earlier, which our figures suggest would remove most late arrivals. Alternatively, the route could turn before the second junction and stop at the corner, a walk of two minutes for the children. Similar adjustments have apparently succeeded on neighbouring routes. Our committee is happy to supply the full record of arrival times and to meet at your convenience. Yours sincerely, Bima Setiawan, committee chair.
qs: Why was this letter sent?
to ask for two changes that would end the late arrivals
to ask that late pupils stop being recorded as absent
to ask for an extra bus on route 14 each morning
to ask that the first lesson start ten minutes later

qs.evidence: We should like to suggest two possible changes, either of which would assist.
qs.answer: to ask for two changes that would end the late arrivals
qs.why: Surat nyatain “We should like to suggest two possible changes, either of which would assist” — berangkat lima menit lebih awal atau berhenti di tikungan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya permintaan yang wajar dari komite orang tua, tapi surat ngeblok: daftar hadir yang kacau disebut sebagai akibat, dan yang diminta perbaikan jadwalnya; “We are grateful for the additional service” nunjukin layanan tambahan bukan yang diminta; dan jam pelajaran nggak pernah diusulkan digeser — yang dibahas keberangkatan bus dan titik berhentinya.

qs: Taken together, what do six weeks of observations show about the bus's arrival at the gate?
an average arrival well before half past seven
about eleven minutes later than planned
five minutes earlier than the timetable
exactly at the minute that was published

qs.evidence: Our observations across six weeks indicate an average arrival at 7:52.
qs.answer: about eleven minutes later than planned
qs.why: Jadwal menaruh bus di gerbang pukul 7:41, sementara pengamatan enam pekan nunjukin rata-rata kedatangan 7:52 — sebelas menit lebih lambat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kedatangan sebelum setengah delapan nggak didukung angka mana pun; lima menit lebih awal itu usulan perubahan keberangkatan; dan ketepatan persis dibantah rata-rata 7:52.

qs: Which detail best supports the claim that the delay affects the school as well?
the bus is timed to reach the gate at 7:41
on eleven mornings the bus arrived after eight o'clock
two junctions hold traffic for several minutes each
staff lose the first hour of the day fixing attendance

qs.evidence: Pupils then enter the lesson late, are recorded as absent, and the office spends its first hour correcting the register.
qs.answer: staff lose the first hour of the day fixing attendance
qs.why: Kalimat “the office spends its first hour correcting the register” nunjukin keterlambatan itu nyeret sekolah ikut kena.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya beneran ada di surat, tapi nggak nunjukin sekolahnya yang ikut menanggung: 7:41 itu rencana di atas kertas; sebelas pagi setelah jam delapan ngukur seberapa parah telatnya; dan dua persimpangan yang menahan lalu lintas nerangin sebabnya di jalan.

qs: What does the letter imply about the cause of the late arrivals?
the drivers leave the terminus later than the plan says
the timetable was drawn up without the real road in mind
the pupils reach the stop after the bus has gone
the school moved its first lesson earlier this term

qs.evidence: The drivers are not at fault; the timetable simply does not match the street.
qs.answer: the timetable was drawn up without the real road in mind
qs.why: Surat nyebut “The drivers are not at fault; the timetable simply does not match the street”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya sebab keterlambatan yang masuk akal, tapi surat ngeblok: “The drivers are not at fault” nolak tuduhan ke keberangkatan pengemudi; nggak ada satu kalimat pun soal murid ketinggalan bus; dan yang berubah di awal term adalah jadwal busnya, bukan jam pelajaran.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The committee offers to share its arrival records with the office."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The committee offers to share its arrival records with the office.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Similar adjustments have apparently succeeded on neighbouring routes. Our committee is happy to supply the full record of arrival times and to meet at your convenience.
qs.why: “supply the full record” sama artinya sama nawarin bagi datanya, jadi klaim ini parafrasa dari kalimat penutup surat.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” salah karena tawaran itu nggak dibalik; “Not stated” salah karena kesediaan berbagi catatan ditulis jelas.

author: the chair of a parents' committee
setting: a letter to a city transport office

title: Walking or Cycling to School: An Even Contest
text:
Ask two parents how a child should reach school and you will receive two confident answers. Walking is safer; cycling is quicker. Neither option is universally superior, whatever confident parents assert. Both statements are accurate, and neither settles the question, because the two journeys suit different distances and different streets.
Walking wins on cost and on independence at an early age. It demands no equipment, no lock, and no repair, and a nine-year-old can manage it alone in most neighbourhoods. Beyond about two kilometres, however, walking consumes an hour of the day and delivers wet shoes. Cycling covers four kilometres in the time walking covers one, and it produces the stronger training effect for the heart. The price is a bicycle, a lock, a dry place to keep it, and a route where a child is not obliged to share a lane with lorries.
Local circumstances therefore determine the appropriate arrangement. The sensible test is the map rather than the principle. Under two kilometres on quiet pavements, walking is difficult to beat and demands nothing from anybody. Beyond that distance, cycling repays its cost where a safe route exists, and is a poor idea where none does. Where neither option works, the answer is a bus for part of the way and feet for the remainder. What matters is that the journey happens without a car, whichever pair of legs performs the work.
qs: What is the writer's purpose in this feature?
to show that walking is the safer choice for children
to show that cycling repays its cost for most families
to show that distance and streets decide the answer
to show that the child's own fitness decides the answer

qs.evidence: Neither option is universally superior, whatever confident parents assert. Both statements are accurate, and neither settles the question, because the two journeys suit different distances and different streets.
qs.answer: to show that distance and streets decide the answer
qs.why: Teks nyebut “Neither option is universally superior” karena “the two journeys suit different distances and different streets”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya simpulan yang masuk akal buat perbandingan antar-jalan, tapi teks ngeblok: keamanan jalan kaki diakui benar tapi “neither settles the question”; bersepeda cuma membayar biayanya “where a safe route exists”, bukan buat sebagian besar keluarga; dan patokan yang disebut adalah “The sensible test is the map rather than the principle”, bukan kebugaran anaknya.

qs: Taken together, what does the article say a young child needs in order to walk to school?
a lock and a dry place to keep it
nothing beyond the shoes already worn
a route that avoids the quiet pavements
a companion for the first two kilometres

qs.evidence: It demands no equipment, no lock, and no repair, and a nine-year-old can manage it alone in most neighbourhoods.
qs.answer: nothing beyond the shoes already worn
qs.why: Jalan kaki disebut nggak menuntut perlengkapan, kunci, atau perbaikan apa pun, dan anak sembilan tahun bisa menempuhnya sendiri di sebagian besar lingkungan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kunci dan tempat penyimpanan kering adalah harga bersepeda; trotoar yang sepi justru kondisi terbaik buat jalan kaki, bukan yang dihindari; dan pendamping nggak pernah disebut sebagai syarat.

qs: How does cycling compare with walking over the same period of time?
it gets twice as far in the same period
it gets four times as far in the same period
it gets about as far but trains the heart less
it gets less far but keeps a child's shoes dry

qs.evidence: Cycling covers four kilometres in the time walking covers one, and it produces the stronger training effect for the heart.
qs.answer: it gets four times as far in the same period
qs.why: Teks nyebut “Cycling covers four kilometres in the time walking covers one”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya perbandingan yang masuk akal antara sepeda dan kaki, tapi angka dan arah teksnya lain: empat kilometer lawan satu bukan dua kali; “the stronger training effect for the heart” nolak opsi latihan yang lebih lemah; dan “wet shoes” justru risiko jalan kaki di atas dua kilometer.

qs: What does the writer imply about a long journey on a road used by lorries?
walking becomes the quicker option along that road
a child should cycle there only with an adult
the family should buy a stronger lock for that route
cycling is the wrong choice under those conditions

qs.evidence: Beyond that distance, cycling repays its cost where a safe route exists, and is a poor idea where none does.
qs.answer: cycling is the wrong choice under those conditions
qs.why: Teks bilang di luar dua kilometer bersepeda membayar biayanya “where a safe route exists, and is a poor idea where none does”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya jalan keluar yang masuk akal buat jalan yang dipakai lorry, tapi teks ngeblok: jalan kaki di atas dua kilometer disebut memakan sejam sehari, jadi bukan yang lebih cepat; pendampingan orang dewasa nggak pernah diusulkan; dan kunci cuma bagian dari harga bersepeda, bukan jawaban buat lajur yang dibagi dengan lorry.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer recommends a car for journeys longer than two kilometres."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer recommends a car for journeys longer than two kilometres.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: What matters is that the journey happens without a car, whichever pair of legs performs the work.
qs.why: Teks justru nekenin perjalanan mesti tanpa mobil, jadi klaim yang nyaranin mobil itu kebalikan langsung dari kalimat penutup.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” salah karena penulis nolak mobil; “Not stated” salah karena sikap soal mobil ditulis jelas.

topic: ways for children to travel to school
author: a family health writer
setting: a comparison feature on school journeys

title: Mend It First: Why Replacement Wins Unfairly
text:
My kettle failed in May, and replacing it would have cost less than mending it. That single sentence explains most of what has gone wrong with the way we buy things. The market has made repair resemble a hobby for the patient, and that impression is neither natural nor permanent.
Defenders of replacement have arguments worth hearing. New appliances consume less electricity, arrive with a guarantee, and are built in factories where safety can be inspected. A mended kettle may fail again next winter, and nobody guarantees it. Yet the comparison is usually made with the wrong figures. It counts the electricity of the new machine and ignores the metal, the plastic, and the shipping behind it. Recycling arrives far too late in the process to repair that particular arithmetic. It also ignores the small workshops which disappear when nobody brings anything to be mended.
None of this difficulty is solved by lecturing individual shoppers about their choices. Manufacturers should be obliged to sell spare parts at a fair price for ten years. Repair should also carry the lower rate of tax that new goods already enjoy through scale. Where such rules exist, small workshops have reopened and the price gap has narrowed. I would rather live in a street containing somebody who can mend a kettle. Mending is not nostalgia; it is simply arithmetic performed honestly and in full.
qs: Taken together, what remedy does this column argue for in the repair market?
new appliances use less electricity and carry a guarantee
recycling arrives too late to repair that arithmetic
rules, not shoppers, should make mending cheaper again
spare parts should be sold fairly for ten years

qs.evidence: None of this difficulty is solved by lecturing individual shoppers about their choices.
qs.answer: rules, not shoppers, should make mending cheaper again
qs.why: Teks nyebut “None of this difficulty is solved by lecturing individual shoppers about their choices”, lalu ngusulin kewajiban suku cadang dan tarif pajak lebih rendah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah klaim nyata dari paragraf lain kolom ini, tetapi masing-masing hujah pihak lain, satu bantahan, atau satu usul, bukan tesisnya. Listrik yang lebih hemat dan garansi adalah "arguments worth hearing" dari pembela penggantian. Daur ulang yang datang terlambat adalah satu bantahan atas hitungan itu. Suku cadang sepuluh tahun adalah satu dari tiga usul aturan. Tesisnya ada pada "None of this difficulty is solved by lecturing individual shoppers about their choices" yang diikuti daftar kewajiban bagi pabrik.

qs: Taken together, what does the writer accept about newly made appliances?
they are cheaper to mend than older machines
they support the small workshops in each street
they are built from recycled metal and plastic
they use less power and are checked for safety

qs.evidence: New appliances consume less electricity, arrive with a guarantee, and are built in factories where safety can be inspected.
qs.answer: they use less power and are checked for safety
qs.why: Penulis mengakui alat baru memakai listrik lebih sedikit, datang dengan garansi, dan dibuat di pabrik yang keselamatannya bisa diperiksa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Biaya perbaikan alat baru nggak pernah dibandingkan; bengkel kecil justru menghilang kalau semua orang beli baru; dan bahan daur ulang nggak disebut — daur ulang malah dibilang datang terlalu telat dalam prosesnya.

qs: Which point best supports the claim that the usual comparison is unfair?
a mended kettle may fail again the following winter
a new machine arrives with a guarantee that repairs lack
new machines are built in factories that inspect safety
the materials and transport behind a new one go uncounted

qs.evidence: It counts the electricity of the new machine and ignores the metal, the plastic, and the shipping behind it.
qs.answer: the materials and transport behind a new one go uncounted
qs.why: Perbandingan yang biasa “counts the electricity of the new machine and ignores the metal, the plastic, and the shipping behind it”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya beneran ada di kolom ini, tapi ketiganya justru argumen pihak pengganti, bukan bukti hitungannya timpang: ketel perbaikan yang bisa rusak lagi, garansi barang baru, dan pabrik yang keselamatannya bisa diperiksa semuanya disebut sebagai “arguments worth hearing”.

qs: Which statement best restates the writer's proposal?
makers should be made to cut the price of new goods
makers should be made to mend the goods they sold
makers should be made to sell cheap parts for a decade
makers should be made to pay the higher rate of tax

qs.evidence: Manufacturers should be obliged to sell spare parts at a fair price for ten years.
qs.answer: makers should be made to sell cheap parts for a decade
qs.why: Usulan intinya “Manufacturers should be obliged to sell spare parts at a fair price for ten years”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya kewajiban yang masuk akal buat produsen, tapi teks ngeblok: yang diminta suku cadang murah selama sepuluh tahun, bukan penurunan harga barang baru; nggak ada usulan produsen sendiri yang memperbaiki; dan soal pajak yang diminta adalah “the lower rate of tax” buat perbaikan, bukan tarif lebih tinggi buat pabrik.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Where such rules have been introduced, the cost difference has shrunk."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Where such rules have been introduced, the cost difference has shrunk.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Where such rules exist, small workshops have reopened and the price gap has narrowed.
qs.why: “the price gap has narrowed” sama artinya sama selisih biaya yang menyempit, jadi klaim ini parafrasa langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” salah karena arah perubahannya nggak dibalik; “Not stated” salah karena efek aturan itu disebut jelas.

author: a consumer affairs columnist
setting: an opinion column on consumer goods

title: One Roof, One Year
text:
Every dry season our school pays an electricity bill that nobody wants to read aloud. The fans run all day, the computer lab hums until the last bell, and the charge quietly eats money that could have bought books. That is the problem, and it will not be solved by asking pupils to switch off the lights more politely. The solution sits above our heads, on the flat roof of the school hall.

Teachers in the staff room raise a fair objection: solar panels are expensive, and thick cloud covers this town for weeks. Yet that objection only measures the first year. Prices have dropped sharply since the district grant scheme opened, and installers now compete for small orders. A modest set of panels on the hall roof would still supply about a third of our daytime demand. Having compared three quotations myself, I am convinced the equipment would pay for itself within seven years.

The wider gain, though, is not financial. A school that makes its own power teaches energy in the most honest way, which is by measuring it. Pupils could check the display each morning, draw the curve and argue about the figures instead of copying them out of a textbook. I therefore favour a small, reversible first step: one roof, one year, one public report. Another dry season of complaining about the bill would teach nobody anything.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this column?
To urge one trial roof for a year, with the figures published.
To urge panels on every school roof in the district this year.
To urge the district office to pay for the whole hall roof.
To urge pupils to read the meter each morning during lessons.

qs.evidence: I therefore favour a small, reversible first step: one roof, one year, one public report.
qs.answer: To urge one trial roof for a year, with the figures published.
qs.why: Penutup teks menyebut langkahnya secara harfiah: satu atap, satu tahun, satu laporan terbuka. Jadi tujuan kolom ini adalah uji coba kecil yang hasilnya dibuka, bukan pemasangan besar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi sama-sama mendukung panel, jadi pemblokirnya ada di kata penulis sendiri: “a small, reversible first step: one roof” menutup usul seluruh distrik. Penulis meminta sekolahnya bertindak dan nggak pernah meminta kantor distrik membayar; skema hibah hanya disebut sebagai sebab “prices have dropped sharply”. Pembacaan meter oleh murid muncul sebagai “the wider gain” setelah panel ada, bukan sebagai permintaan kolom ini.

qs: Taken together, what has changed since the district grant scheme opened?
Grant money now covers most of the cost of a school installation.
Installers have grown less interested in orders as small as a school's.
Panel costs fell and firms now bid against each other for small jobs.
Panel prices have held steady while installation charges have risen.

qs.evidence: Prices have dropped sharply since the district grant scheme opened, and installers now compete for small orders.
qs.answer: Panel costs fell and firms now bid against each other for small jobs.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menyebut dua akibat sejak skema hibah dibuka: harga turun tajam dan pemasang bersaing untuk pesanan kecil. Kunci menyatakan hal sama dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks hanya bilang skema hibah dibuka, bukan bahwa hibah menanggung sebagian besar biaya. Pemasang justru disebut bersaing untuk pesanan kecil, jadi dua opsi lain membalik arah kalimat itu: minat pemasang naik, dan harga panel turun tajam.

qs: Which piece of evidence does the writer use to support the claim about paying for itself?
His own reading of the school bills across several dry seasons.
A district estimate of the daytime demand a hall roof meets.
An installer's promise that prices will fall further next year.
His own comparison of three separate price offers for the work.

qs.evidence: Having compared three quotations myself, I am convinced the equipment would pay for itself within seven years.
qs.answer: His own comparison of three separate price offers for the work.
qs.why: Klaim tujuh tahun berdiri di satu kalimat: “Having compared three quotations myself, I am convinced the equipment would pay for itself within seven years.” Dasarnya tiga penawaran harga yang ia bandingkan sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi terdengar seperti bukti yang wajar untuk klaim biaya, jadi pemblokirnya harus dikutip. Tagihan sekolah memang dibahas, tapi sebagai gambaran masalah di paragraf pertama, bukan hitungan pengembalian. Angka sepertiga permintaan siang hari adalah klaim penulis soal pasokan, bukan estimasi distrik, dan menyangkut daya, bukan waktu balik modal. Janji pemasang soal harga tahun depan nggak ada; teks hanya menyatakan harga udah turun.

qs: What does the writer imply about the teachers who object to the panels?
Their objection rests on the cloud rather than on any cost figure.
Their objection counts the first year and then stops counting.
Their objection is fair, so the plan should wait one more season.
Their objection shows doubt about the roof rather than the price.

qs.evidence: Yet that objection only measures the first year.
qs.answer: Their objection counts the first year and then stops counting.
qs.why: Penulis menjawab keberatan guru dengan satu kalimat penentu: “Yet that objection only measures the first year.” Artinya hitungan guru berhenti terlalu awal dan melewatkan penghematan sesudahnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Semua opsi menempatkan penulis di seberang guru, jadi yang memilih adalah kata “only measures the first year”. Keberatan guru memuat dua hal — “solar panels are expensive, and thick cloud” — sehingga nggak bisa disebut hanya soal awan, dan bukan pula keraguan pada atapnya. Penulis memang menyebutnya “a fair objection”, tapi konsesi itu bukan posisinya: “Another dry season of complaining about the bill would teach nobody anything” menolak menunda.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Roof panels above the hall could meet roughly a third of the school's daytime electricity needs."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Roof panels above the hall could meet roughly a third of the school's daytime electricity needs.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A modest set of panels on the hall roof would still supply about a third of our daytime demand.
qs.why: Ini parafrasa penuh: “supply about a third of our daytime demand” sama artinya dengan memenuhi kira-kira sepertiga kebutuhan listrik siang hari. Jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada proposisi yang dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena angkanya jelas tertulis di paragraf kedua.

topic: rooftop solar power for a school
author: opinion column by a school science teacher
setting: a secondary school in a dry upland town

title: What a Famous Waterfall Does to a Village
text:
A small research team spent last year counting visitors in four highland villages, and the findings have just been published. The question was simple. What happens to a village when its waterfall becomes famous online? The team interviewed 240 households and recorded arrivals at every gate. Because the four villages lie within an hour of one another, the comparison is unusually fair.

The chain of cause and effect shows up clearly in the figures. Once photographs of the upper falls spread across social media, weekend arrivals in the nearest village rose fivefold. That rise pushed up rents along the main lane. Several families therefore moved their food stalls to cheaper ground behind the car park. As a result, the money earned from visitors was shared far less evenly than the team had expected. In the two villages that kept a daily booking limit, income grew more slowly but stayed with local owners.

The report avoids easy conclusions, yet its authors do state one opinion plainly. They argue that a district which counts only arrivals is measuring the wrong thing. The figure they recommend instead is the share of visitor spending still held in the village after three months. I find that suggestion convincing, because it turns a boast into a test. Without such a test, a famous waterfall may enrich a district while leaving its neighbours poorer.
qs: Taken together, what does this report establish about a village that becomes famous?
Photographs online multiplied weekend arrivals in the nearest village.
Higher rents moved several food stalls behind the village car park.
A booking limit protects local owners at the cost of faster growth.
Sudden fame changes who keeps the money a village earns.

qs.evidence: As a result, the money earned from visitors was shared far less evenly than the team had expected.
qs.answer: Sudden fame changes who keeps the money a village earns.
qs.why: Rantai sebab-akibat laporan berakhir di satu temuan: “the money earned from visitors was shared far less evenly than the team had expected.” Yang berubah karena ketenaran adalah siapa yang memegang uangnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah temuan nyata dari paragraf kedua laporan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu mata rantai, bukan penekanannya. Kenaikan lima kali lipat adalah pemicu di awal rantai. Kepindahan warung ke belakang tempat parkir adalah akibat kenaikan sewa. Dua desa dengan batas pemesanan harian adalah pembanding. Penekanannya dinyatakan sendiri: "the money earned from visitors was shared far less evenly than the team had expected". Opsi ketiga juga berbentuk rangkuman, tetapi batas pemesanan hanyalah pembanding dua desa di dalam rantai itu, bukan temuan yang dibawa laporan ini.

qs: Taken together, how did the team gather the data behind this report?
By talking to 240 households and logging arrivals at each entrance.
By counting weekend visitors at the upper falls for a single season.
By comparing rent records kept by the four village offices.
By asking stall owners to keep a diary of their weekend takings.

qs.evidence: The team interviewed 240 households and recorded arrivals at every gate.
qs.answer: By talking to 240 households and logging arrivals at each entrance.
qs.why: Metodenya dua hal: wawancara 240 rumah tangga dan pencatatan kedatangan di setiap gerbang. Kunci menyebut keduanya dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pencatatan dilakukan setahun dan di setiap gerbang desa, bukan satu musim di air terjun atasnya. Kenaikan sewa adalah temuan, bukan sumber data, dan nggak ada buku harian pemilik warung dalam metode tim ini.
