qs: How did the villages with a daily booking limit differ from the nearest village?
Their takings rose less steeply, but remained in village hands.
Their takings rose less steeply, and their lane rents climbed too.
Their takings rose just as steeply, but remained in village hands.
Their takings rose less steeply, so their stalls shifted behind the park.

qs.evidence: In the two villages that kept a daily booking limit, income grew more slowly but stayed with local owners.
qs.answer: Their takings rose less steeply, but remained in village hands.
qs.why: Satu kalimat mengatur perbandingan ini: di dua desa berbatas pemesanan, pendapatan naik lebih lambat tapi tetap di tangan pemilik setempat. Dua unsurnya, laju dan pemiliknya, harus benar keduanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Semua opsi memakai pembuka “their takings rose”, jadi pemblokirnya adalah pemilik gejala. Kenaikan sewa dan pindahnya warung ke tanah lebih murah terjadi di desa terdekat yang ramai — “rents along the main lane” — bukan di dua desa berbatas. Dan “grew more slowly” menutup opsi yang menyamakan lajunya dengan desa terdekat.

qs: Why do the authors prefer their recommended figure to a count of arrivals?
Because it makes a district show how many visitors each gate records.
Because it makes a district show how fast rents on a lane rise.
Because it makes a district show which villages cap their bookings.
Because it makes a district show where the visitor money settles.

qs.evidence: I find that suggestion convincing, because it turns a boast into a test.
qs.answer: Because it makes a district show where the visitor money settles.
qs.why: Penulis menyebut alasannya sendiri: angka baru itu “turns a boast into a test”, dan angka yang dianjurkan adalah pangsa belanja yang masih tertahan di desa setelah tiga bulan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk “makes a district show”, jadi isi angkanya yang menentukan. Hitungan kedatangan justru yang ditolak: “a district which counts only arrivals is measuring the wrong thing”. Kenaikan sewa muncul sebagai mata rantai akibat, bukan angka yang dianjurkan, dan batas pemesanan adalah aturan desa, bukan ukuran yang diusulkan laporan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The four villages studied lie more than a day's journey apart."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The four villages studied lie more than a day's journey apart.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Because the four villages lie within an hour of one another, the comparison is unusually fair.
qs.why: Teks bilang keempat desa berjarak dalam satu jam perjalanan, jadi klaim "lebih dari sehari" bertentangan langsung. Kuncinya False.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena angka jaraknya dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena jarak antar desa disebut jelas di paragraf pertama.

author: popular science report by a tourism research team
setting: four neighbouring villages in a highland district

title: The Screen at Home and the Screen in Town
text:
Two habits of film-watching now exist side by side in this district, and they satisfy quite different appetites. A streaming subscription costs less than two cinema tickets a month, and it never closes its doors. The old cinema on the square opens at four, seats 180 people and shows one title at a time. On price and sheer convenience the contest appears settled.

The counter-argument concerns attention rather than expense. At home a film competes with messages, cooking and a doorbell, so many viewers finish it in three sittings. In the cinema the lights fade and the audience surrenders two uninterrupted hours together. Streaming also hides its choices: the catalogue changes quietly, and titles vanish without warning. The cinema publishes a printed programme a fortnight ahead, which lets a school or a family plan properly. Against that advantage, its range remains narrow, and a viewer unimpressed by the single title must wait a week.

My own view is that the two are not rivals but different goods, and the town needs both. Streaming wins on breadth and cost, while the cinema wins on undivided attention and shared reaction. The mistake would be to judge the cinema by the measure that suits its competitor. If the hall on the square survives, it will not be because it is cheaper. It will be because ninety strangers laughing at once is something no subscription can deliver.
qs: Taken together, what point does this article make about watching at home and in town?
Each habit meets a separate appetite, so neither should be dropped.
A subscription costs less each month than two cinema tickets.
The cinema prints its programme a fortnight before showing it.
At home a film competes with messages, cooking and a doorbell.

qs.evidence: My own view is that the two are not rivals but different goods, and the town needs both.
qs.answer: Each habit meets a separate appetite, so neither should be dropped.
qs.why: Penulis menyatakan pendiriannya lugas: keduanya bukan pesaing melainkan barang yang berbeda, dan kota membutuhkan dua-duanya. Kesimpulannya menahan dua-duanya, bukan memilih.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh betul-betul dinyatakan di paragraf lain artikel ini, tetapi masing-masing satu butir perbandingan, bukan pokoknya. Harga langganan adalah keunggulan biaya. Program cetak dua pekan sebelumnya adalah keunggulan bioskop dalam perencanaan. Gangguan di rumah adalah bukti untuk hujah perhatian. Pokoknya berbunyi "the two are not rivals but different goods, and the town needs both".

qs: Taken together, what does the article say about the cinema on the square?
It opens at midday and shows two titles on its 180 seats.
It seats about ninety people and changes its film each fortnight.
It opens in the afternoon and runs a single film for its 180 seats.
It shows one title a week and sells a monthly pass to regulars.

qs.evidence: The old cinema on the square opens at four, seats 180 people and shows one title at a time.
qs.answer: It opens in the afternoon and runs a single film for its 180 seats.
qs.why: Tiga detailnya: buka jam empat, 180 tempat duduk, satu film sekali tayang. Kunci menyatukan ketiganya dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Bioskop itu buka jam empat, bukan tengah hari, dan hanya satu film sekali tayang. Angka sembilan puluh adalah jumlah penonton yang tertawa bersama di kalimat penutup, sementara paket bulanan adalah ciri layanan streaming.

qs: Which difference does the article stress when it discusses planning ahead?
The cinema announces its titles a fortnight ahead, while catalogues change unannounced.
The cinema announces its titles a fortnight ahead, while catalogues grow each fortnight.
Streaming announces its titles a fortnight ahead, while the cinema decides late.
The cinema announces its titles a fortnight ahead, while streaming warns before removals.

qs.evidence: The cinema publishes a printed programme a fortnight ahead, which lets a school or a family plan properly.
qs.answer: The cinema announces its titles a fortnight ahead, while catalogues change unannounced.
qs.why: Paragraf dua memasangkan dua hal: bioskop “publishes a printed programme a fortnight ahead”, sementara katalog streaming “changes quietly, and titles vanish without warning”. Perencanaan itulah bedanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk kontras dua-arah yang sama, jadi pemblokirnya frasa teks. Katalog disebut berubah diam-diam dan judul hilang, bukan bertambah tiap dua minggu, dan kata “without warning” menutup opsi yang menyebut peringatan sebelum judul dicabut. Pelakunya juga nggak boleh ditukar: yang mencetak program dua minggu lebih dulu adalah bioskop.

qs: What does the article suggest about watching a film at home?
Watching at home tends to suit shorter films than a hall does.
Watching at home tends to break one film into separate sittings.
Watching at home tends to hold a viewer's attention more closely.
Watching at home tends to stop once a title leaves the catalogue.

qs.evidence: At home a film competes with messages, cooking and a doorbell, so many viewers finish it in three sittings.
qs.answer: Watching at home tends to break one film into separate sittings.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menyebut sebab dan akibat sekaligus: film “competes with messages, cooking and a doorbell, so many viewers finish it in three sittings.” Gangguan memecah satu film menjadi beberapa duduk.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pola “watching at home tends to”, jadi sinyal teks yang memilih. Panjang film nggak pernah dibahas; yang disebut adalah tiga kali duduk untuk film yang sama. Perhatian di rumah justru dinyatakan terbagi, sehingga “more closely” melawan kalimat itu. Judul yang hilang dari katalog dipakai untuk soal perencanaan, bukan untuk kebiasaan menonton di rumah.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The cinema on the square receives a yearly grant from the district council."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The cinema on the square receives a yearly grant from the district council.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: If the hall on the square survives, it will not be because it is cheaper.
qs.why: Teks membahas bertahannya bioskop tapi nggak pernah menyebut sumber dananya, apalagi hibah tahunan dari pemerintah distrik. Atribusi seperti itu nggak ada, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh pernyataan soal hibah yang nggak ada. "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal adanya bantuan; ia cuma diam soal itu.

topic: comparison of streaming services and a small local cinema
author: comparison feature for a regional culture magazine
setting: a district town with one surviving cinema

title: Wax, Cloth and a Loud Room
text:
The travelling batik exhibition that opened last Friday is worth an hour of anyone's Saturday, though not for the reason the posters suggest. The posters promise treasures. What the show actually delivers is process. Its strongest room holds no finished cloth at all, only copper stamps, cracked wax bowls and a bench where two makers work in front of you.

The weakness is the labelling. Each piece carries a long paragraph about trade routes, yet almost nothing about the hands that made it. One indigo panel from the north coast is dated to within a decade, but its maker is described merely as a workshop. That silence matters, because the exhibition's own argument is that batik is a craft of individuals. The curators contradict themselves in small print, and a visitor who reads carefully will notice.

Even so, I would send every school in the city here before the show moves on in October. Children who watch the wax being drawn understand in five minutes what a textbook cannot teach in a term. The demonstration bench is free, the guides answer questions without hurrying, and the noise in that room is a good sign. My advice is to walk through the galleries backwards, starting with the makers and ending with the treasures. Seen in that order, the cloth on the far wall stops being decoration and becomes evidence.
qs: Taken together, what judgement does the reviewer reach on the batik exhibition?
The strongest room holds no finished cloth, only tools and a bench.
Worth an hour for its live craft, despite labels that omit makers.
An indigo panel is dated closely, yet its maker is called a workshop.
Visitors should walk the galleries backwards, makers before treasures.

qs.evidence: The travelling batik exhibition that opened last Friday is worth an hour of anyone's Saturday, though not for the reason the posters suggest.
qs.answer: Worth an hour for its live craft, despite labels that omit makers.
qs.why: Penulis memuji apa yang dikerjakan di depan pengunjung — “what the show actually delivers is process” — dan menyebut satu cacat: “The weakness is the labelling.”
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah pernyataan nyata dari paragraf lain ulasan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu bukti atau satu saran, bukan putusan menyeluruhnya. Ruang terkuat tanpa kain jadi adalah bukti bahwa yang disuguhkan proses. Panel indigo yang penciptanya disebut bengkel adalah contoh kelemahan pelabelan. Anjuran berjalan mundur adalah saran praktis di penutup. Putusannya berbunyi "worth an hour of anyone's Saturday, though not for the reason the posters suggest".

qs: Taken together, what does the reviewer say is held in the exhibition's strongest room?
The oldest finished cloths, hung together along one long wall.
A printed timeline of the trade routes that carried the cloth.
Tools, wax bowls and two makers working in view of visitors.
A bench where visitors may try drawing the wax themselves.

qs.evidence: Its strongest room holds no finished cloth at all, only copper stamps, cracked wax bowls and a bench where two makers work in front of you.
qs.answer: Tools, wax bowls and two makers working in view of visitors.
qs.why: Ruang terbaik justru tanpa kain jadi: ada cap tembaga, mangkuk lilin yang pecah, dan dua perajin bekerja di depan pengunjung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ruang terkuat itu justru nggak memuat kain jadi sama sekali. Jalur dagang hanya muncul di paragraf label tiap benda, dan bangku di ruang itu dipakai dua perajin yang bekerja, bukan pengunjung yang mencoba menggambar.

qs: Which example does the reviewer give to show that the labels fail the makers?
A long trade-route label beside a cloth with no date given.
A copper stamp shown with no note of the shop behind it.
A panel pinned to one decade whose weaver goes unnamed.
A poster promising treasures beside cloth the galleries never show.

qs.evidence: One indigo panel from the north coast is dated to within a decade, but its maker is described merely as a workshop.
qs.answer: A panel pinned to one decade whose weaver goes unnamed.
qs.why: Contohnya satu benda: panel indigo dari pantai utara bertanggal sampai ke rentang sepuluh tahun, tapi pembuatnya hanya disebut sebagai sebuah workshop. Tanggalnya rapi, orangnya hilang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk benda-pameran-plus-cacat, jadi teks yang memutuskan. Panel itu justru “dated to within a decade”, sehingga contoh tanpa tanggal melawan teks. Cap tembaga muncul di ruang terkuat sebagai kekuatan pameran, bukan sebagai label buruk, dan poster “promise treasures” dipakai di pembuka untuk soal harapan pengunjung — galeri memang memamerkan kain di dinding jauh.

qs: Which sentence best restates the reviewer's advice about how to see the show?
Start with the makers at work and finish with the display cloth.
Start with the display cloth and finish with the makers at work.
Start with the trade-route labels and finish with the makers at work.
Start with the makers at work and finish with the trade-route labels.

qs.evidence: My advice is to walk through the galleries backwards, starting with the makers and ending with the treasures.
qs.answer: Start with the makers at work and finish with the display cloth.
qs.why: Nasihatnya harfiah: “walk through the galleries backwards, starting with the makers and ending with the treasures.” Mulai dari perajin, berakhir di kain yang dipamerkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “start with … and finish with …” yang sama, jadi arah dan unsurnya yang menentukan. Membuka dengan kain pamer membalik urutan yang ia sebut “backwards”. Label jalur dagang nggak pernah jadi titik mula maupun titik akhir yang ia anjurkan; yang ia sebut sebagai akhir adalah “the treasures”, yaitu kain di dinding jauh.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Visitors pay nothing extra to watch the demonstration at the bench."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Visitors pay nothing extra to watch the demonstration at the bench.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The demonstration bench is free, the guides answer questions without hurrying, and the noise in that room is a good sign.
qs.why: "The demonstration bench is free" sama artinya dengan pengunjung nggak perlu bayar tambahan untuk menontonnya. Jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada yang dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena teks menyebut gratis secara terang.

topic: review of a batik exhibition in a city museum
author: exhibition review for a weekend arts page
setting: a city museum hosting a travelling batik exhibition

title: Letter to the District Office: The River Clean-Up
text:
I write on behalf of the sixty volunteers who have cleared the riverbank on the first Sunday of every month since March. Our purpose is not to complain about the district office, which has always answered our letters promptly. Nor do we seek additional funding. It is to describe a problem we can no longer solve with goodwill alone, and to propose a remedy that costs little.

The problem is what happens after the work is finished. Each Sunday we fill forty or fifty sacks and haul them to the market lane corner, since no collection point exists. That corner is unguarded. By Tuesday the sacks have usually been torn open by animals, so a part of the rubbish returns to the water. Volunteers who spent four hours on the bank watch that happen, and several have stopped coming. The proper measure of our effort, in other words, is not sacks filled but rubbish permanently kept out of the water.

We therefore submit two requests. First, a locked container at the market lane corner, emptied every Monday morning. Second, permission to display the monthly weight on the noticeboard outside your office. The second request may seem minor, yet in our view a public figure would keep both sides accountable. We would gladly accompany your staff along the bank on any Sunday, to demonstrate why the present arrangement wastes the effort it receives.
qs: Why has the group written to the district office?
To describe what happens after clean-ups and ask for extra funding.
To describe what happens after clean-ups and object to the office's delays.
To describe what happens after clean-ups and ask for two cheap measures.
To describe what happens after clean-ups and warn that volunteers will stop.

qs.evidence: It is to describe a problem we can no longer solve with goodwill alone, and to propose a remedy that costs little.
qs.answer: To describe what happens after clean-ups and ask for two cheap measures.
qs.why: Suratnya menyebut maksudnya sendiri: “to describe a problem we can no longer solve with goodwill alone, and to propose a remedy that costs little”, lalu “we therefore submit two requests.”
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka yang sama, jadi bagian keduanya yang diuji. Dana tambahan ditolak sendiri oleh surat: “Nor do we seek additional funding.” Keluhan atas kantor juga dibantah: kantor “has always answered our letters promptly”. Ancaman berhenti nggak ada; teks hanya melaporkan “several have stopped coming” sebagai kerugian yang udah terjadi.

qs: Taken together, what does the letter say happens to the filled sacks at present?
Animals open them at the lane corner before anyone collects them.
They wait at the market lane corner until a lorry empties them on Monday.
Volunteers carry them to the district office at the end of each Sunday.
They are weighed and the total is written up on the office noticeboard.

qs.evidence: By Tuesday the sacks have usually been torn open by animals, so a part of the rubbish returns to the water.
qs.answer: Animals open them at the lane corner before anyone collects them.
qs.why: Karung ditinggal di sudut jalan pasar, lalu sebelum diangkut udah dirobek binatang, sehingga sampah balik ke sungai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pengangkutan hari Senin dan penimbangan di papan pengumuman baru diusulkan di paragraf tiga, jadi belum terjadi. Karung dibawa ke sudut jalan pasar, bukan ke kantor distrik; di situlah binatang merobeknya sebelum ada yang mengangkut.

qs: Which fact does the letter offer as proof that the present arrangement discourages helpers?
Several helpers stopped coming after watching four hours' work undone.
Forty or fifty sacks are filled and hauled on a single Sunday.
Sixty volunteers have kept the first Sunday free since March.
Part of the rubbish is back in the water by every Tuesday.

qs.evidence: Volunteers who spent four hours on the bank watch that happen, and several have stopped coming.
qs.answer: Several helpers stopped coming after watching four hours' work undone.
qs.why: Buktinya satu kalimat: “Volunteers who spent four hours on the bank watch that happen, and several have stopped coming.” Itu satu-satunya angka yang menunjukkan relawan jadi enggan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah fakta yang benar-benar ada di surat, jadi pemblokirnya adalah fungsi tiap fakta. Jumlah karung dan jumlah relawan mengukur besarnya kerja, bukan surutnya semangat. Sampah yang kembali ke air adalah kerusakan yang dilihat relawan — sebabnya, bukan buktinya; yang menunjukkan efek pada relawan adalah “several have stopped coming”.

qs: Why does the group ask to publish the monthly weight?
So that a public number shows which lanes need clearing next.
So that a public number replaces the letters the office answers.
So that a public number persuades the sixty volunteers to stay on.
So that a public number holds both sides to their promise.

qs.evidence: The second request may seem minor, yet in our view a public figure would keep both sides accountable.
qs.answer: So that a public number holds both sides to their promise.
qs.why: Alasannya tertulis: “a public figure would keep both sides accountable.” Angka bulanan di papan pengumuman mengikat kelompok dan kantor sekaligus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai kerangka “so that a public number …”, jadi alasan mana yang ditulis surat itulah pembedanya. Pemilihan lokasi kerja nggak pernah dibahas; jadwalnya udah tetap tiap Minggu pertama. Surat-menyurat justru berjalan baik, jadi angka itu bukan pengganti. Dan yang disebut sebagai manfaatnya adalah pertanggungjawaban dua pihak, bukan bujukan bagi relawan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The volunteers clear the riverbank once a week throughout the year."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The volunteers clear the riverbank once a week throughout the year.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I write on behalf of the sixty volunteers who have cleared the riverbank on the first Sunday of every month since March.
qs.why: Teks bilang kerja bakti tiap Sunday pertama dalam sebulan, jadi "sekali sepekan" bertentangan dengan frekuensi yang tertulis.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena frekuensinya diubah. "Not stated" salah karena jadwalnya disebut jelas di kalimat pembuka.

topic: formal request from volunteers about river clean-up support
author: formal letter from a volunteer group secretary
setting: a riverside neighbourhood organizing monthly clean-ups

title: Dance Belongs in the Timetable
text:
Our district has spent four years treating traditional dance as a performance for guests, and that is the wrong place for it. Twice a year the best twenty pupils rehearse for a visiting delegation, while everybody else watches from plastic chairs. The dances survive on the stage and disappear from the corridors. A tradition kept only for visitors is a tradition already halfway lost.

The obstacle is not indifference but the absence of ordinary time. When I questioned a Year 9 class, thirty of thirty-four said they enjoyed the movements, yet only six had ever practised outside a rehearsal for guests. Their difficulty was practical: no timetable slot, no space after four o'clock, no teacher paid for it. Enthusiasm cannot compete with a locked hall. Nor can a single annual audition replace a weekly habit.

The remedy costs one period a fortnight. Give every class forty minutes with a local dancer, mark it on the timetable, and abandon the selection of twenty. Performance would then grow out of a habit instead of replacing it. I accept that examinations crowd the week and that heads of department guard their hours jealously. Even so, a district which finds time for two spectacles a year can surely find time for something quieter and far more durable.
qs: Taken together, what argument does this column build about traditional dance?
Thirty of thirty-four pupils enjoyed the movements they were shown.
Only six pupils had ever practised outside a rehearsal for guests.
Dance needs an ordinary timetable slot, not only two annual shows.
Forty minutes a fortnight with a local dancer would cost very little.

qs.evidence: A tradition kept only for visitors is a tradition already halfway lost.
qs.answer: Dance needs an ordinary timetable slot, not only two annual shows.
qs.why: Tesisnya di kalimat pembuka dan penutup: menyimpan tari hanya untuk tamu adalah “a tradition already halfway lost”, dan obatnya “one period a fortnight” di jadwal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah angka atau usul nyata dari paragraf lain kolom ini, tetapi masing-masing bahan pendukung, bukan hujah pusatnya. Tiga puluh dari tiga puluh empat murid yang menikmati gerakannya justru dipakai untuk menyingkirkan ketidakpedulian sebagai sebab. Enam murid yang pernah berlatih di luar gladi adalah ukuran masalahnya. Empat puluh menit setiap dua pekan adalah biaya obatnya. Hujahnya berbunyi "A tradition kept only for visitors is a tradition already halfway lost".

qs: Which detail about the Year 9 class shows that the obstacle is time rather than interest?
thirty of thirty-four enjoyed the movements, yet only six had practised outside a rehearsal
only six of thirty-four said they enjoyed the movements at all
thirty of thirty-four had joined a rehearsal for a visiting delegation
most of the class practised at home but refused to perform for guests

qs.evidence: When I questioned a Year 9 class, thirty of thirty-four said they enjoyed the movements, yet only six had ever practised outside a rehearsal for guests.
qs.answer: thirty of thirty-four enjoyed the movements, yet only six had practised outside a rehearsal
qs.why: Dua angka dalam satu kalimat itu menopang gagasan utama: minatnya tinggi (30 dari 34) tapi kesempatannya nggak ada (cuma 6 pernah berlatih di luar gladi), jadi hambatannya waktu, bukan sikap.
qs.whyOthersFail: Enam adalah jumlah yang pernah berlatih di luar gladi, bukan jumlah yang menyukai gerakannya. Tiga puluh adalah jumlah yang menyukai tari, bukan jumlah yang ikut gladi untuk delegasi — gladi itu untuk dua puluh murid terbaik. Dan latihan di rumah nggak pernah disebut.

qs: Which evidence supports the writer's claim that the barrier is practical?
Thirty of thirty-four pupils said they enjoyed the movements themselves.
Nowhere to rehearse, no free period, and no paid instructor.
Heads of department guard their teaching hours against any new subject.
Only twenty pupils are chosen to rehearse for a visiting delegation.

qs.evidence: Their difficulty was practical: no timetable slot, no space after four o'clock, no teacher paid for it.
qs.answer: Nowhere to rehearse, no free period, and no paid instructor.
qs.why: Penulis menyebut kesulitan murid sebagai hal praktis dan merincinya: nggak ada slot di jadwal, nggak ada ruang setelah jam empat, nggak ada guru yang dibayar. Tiga kekurangan itulah buktinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah fakta yang memang ada di teks, jadi pemblokirnya adalah tugas tiap fakta. Angka 30 dari 34 justru membuktikan minat, dan kalimatnya menyebut hambatan itu bukan “indifference”. Sikap kepala jurusan datang di paragraf akhir sebagai keberatan yang penulis akui, bukan kesulitan murid, dan kuota dua puluh adalah pola yang ia tolak.

qs: What does the writer imply about the twice-yearly performances?
They can hide how rarely the dances are done between shows.
They can lift the standard reached by the twenty pupils chosen.
They can matter more to the delegations than to the pupils watching.
They can begin habits that keep pupils dancing through the year.

qs.evidence: The dances survive on the stage and disappear from the corridors.
qs.answer: They can hide how rarely the dances are done between shows.
qs.why: Satu kalimat memberi sinyalnya: “The dances survive on the stage and disappear from the corridors.” Pertunjukan menutupi kenyataan bahwa di hari biasa tari nggak dilakukan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk “they can …” dan sama-sama masuk akal untuk sebuah pertunjukan tahunan, jadi teks yang memutus. Mutu dua puluh penari nggak pernah dinilai, dan kepentingan delegasi nggak pernah dibahas. Opsi terakhir berlawanan langsung dengan “disappear from the corridors” serta “only six had ever practised outside a rehearsal”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Under the writer's plan, a visiting dancer would work with every class, not a chosen few."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Under the writer's plan, a visiting dancer would work with every class, not a chosen few.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Give every class forty minutes with a local dancer, mark it on the timetable, and abandon the selection of twenty.
qs.why: Usulnya memang begitu: semua kelas dapat empat puluh menit dengan penari setempat dan pemilihan dua puluh dihapus. Jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada proposisi yang dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena usul itu tertulis lengkap di paragraf akhir.

topic: opinion on teaching traditional dance in ordinary lessons
author: opinion piece by a district arts teacher
setting: district schools that stage dance for official visitors

title: Bins Are Cheap, Explaining Is Not
text:
A study that lasted a whole year in two city wards has measured what really happens to household waste after people have sorted it. Both wards were given the same green bins in January. Only one of them also received a weekly visit from a collector trained to explain the system. The researchers weighed 1,200 sampled bags every fortnight and photographed the contents.

The numbers show a clear chain of cause and effect. Where collectors explained the rules, contamination of the food waste bin fell from 31 per cent to 9 per cent. Cleaner food waste let the compost yard sell what it made, and that money paid for two more collection rounds. In the ward without visits, contamination remained near a third, so the yard diverted much of the material to landfill. Equipment by itself altered very little. Conversation altered a great deal.

The authors are careful about wider claims, yet their advice is blunt. They urge councils to budget for people rather than for containers, because the cheaper item is the one that quietly fails. Bins are visible and easy to announce, while patient explanation seldom appears in any press release. My own reading of these figures is that the invisible half of such a scheme performs most of the work. A ward that buys only the visible half should expect only half a result.
qs: Taken together, what does this year-long ward study establish about sorting waste?
Explanation, not equipment, produced the fall in contaminated food waste.
Contamination in the visited ward fell from 31 per cent to 9 per cent.
Cleaner food waste let the compost yard pay for two more rounds.
A scheme's visible half is the part a council chooses to buy.

qs.evidence: Equipment by itself altered very little.
qs.answer: Explanation, not equipment, produced the fall in contaminated food waste.
qs.why: Dua kalimat pendek memutuskannya: “Equipment by itself altered very little. Conversation altered a great deal.” Kontaminasi turun di ward yang dikunjungi petugas penjelas.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah angka nyata dari paragraf kedua kajian ini, tetapi masing-masing satu langkah dalam rantai sebab-akibat, bukan simpulannya. Penurunan 31 ke 9 persen adalah ukuran akibatnya. Kompos yang membiayai dua ronde tambahan adalah akibat lanjutan. Bahan yang dialihkan ke tempat pembuangan adalah keadaan bangsal pembanding. Simpulannya dinyatakan sendiri: "Equipment by itself altered very little. Conversation altered a great deal". Opsi terakhir berbentuk rangkuman, tetapi kalimat tentang bagian yang kelihatan adalah tafsir penulis di penutup, bukan yang diukur kajian ini.

qs: Taken together, how did the researchers collect the material they measured?
Households in both wards filled in a fortnightly form about sorting.
Collectors noted the contents of every bin they emptied each week.
Compost yard staff weighed the material arriving from each ward.
Sample bags were put on the scales and pictured every two weeks.

qs.evidence: The researchers weighed 1,200 sampled bags every fortnight and photographed the contents.
qs.answer: Sample bags were put on the scales and pictured every two weeks.
qs.why: Metodenya menimbang 1.200 kantong sampel setiap dua pekan sekaligus memotret isinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Yang ditimbang dan difoto adalah 1.200 kantong sampel oleh peneliti, bukan seluruh tong oleh petugas maupun bahan masuk oleh pekerja kompos. Formulir warga nggak pernah ada; kunjungan petugas adalah perlakuan yang diuji, bukan cara mengumpulkan data.

qs: How did the two wards differ in what happened to the sorted material?
One ward's food waste was weighed; the other's was only photographed.
One ward's food waste was sold as compost; the other's was refused entry.
One ward's food waste was collected weekly; the other's was collected twice.
One ward's food waste was sold as compost; the other's went to landfill.

qs.evidence: In the ward without visits, contamination remained near a third, so the yard diverted much of the material to landfill.
qs.answer: One ward's food waste was sold as compost; the other's went to landfill.
qs.why: Nasib bahannya berbeda: kompos dari ward yang dikunjungi bisa dijual, sedangkan di ward tanpa kunjungan “the yard diverted much of the material to landfill.”
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “one ward's food waste …; the other's …”, jadi pemblokirnya perlakuan yang tercatat. Kantong sampel dari kedua ward ditimbang dan difoto, jadi nggak ada ward yang cuma difoto. Nggak ada bahan yang ditolak masuk; yang terjadi adalah dialihkan ke pembuangan. Dan ronde tambahan justru muncul di ward yang dikunjungi, bukan sebagai pembeda arah bahan.

qs: Which conclusion do the contamination figures from the two wards best support?
bins on their own leave the sorting mistakes in place
contamination fell to 9 per cent in the ward that had no visits
councils that pay for bins are left with nothing for collectors
the compost yard sent most of both wards' material to landfill

qs.evidence: Equipment by itself altered very little.
qs.answer: bins on their own leave the sorting mistakes in place
qs.why: Dua ward dapat tong yang sama; yang beda cuma kunjungan penjelas. Kontaminasi turun 31% → 9% di ward yang dikunjungi dan tetap sekitar sepertiga di ward yang cuma dapat tong, jadi “Equipment by itself altered very little”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Angka 9 per cent milik ward yang dikunjungi, bukan yang tanpa kunjungan, jadi opsi kedua membalik data. Teks nggak pernah bilang anggaran habis di tong sehingga tak ada dana penjelas — itu di luar teks. Dan yang mengalihkan bahannya ke landfill cuma ward tanpa kunjungan; ward lainnya menjual kompos.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Collectors trained to explain the scheme visited households in both wards."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Collectors trained to explain the scheme visited households in both wards.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Only one of them also received a weekly visit from a collector trained to explain the system.
qs.why: Teks tegas: hanya satu ward yang mendapat kunjungan petugas terlatih, jadi klaim "kedua ward" bertentangan langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena cakupannya diperluas dari satu ke dua. "Not stated" salah karena perbedaan itu justru inti rancangan penelitian.

topic: study of household waste separation in two city wards
author: popular research summary for a city environment bulletin
setting: two urban wards trialling a green bin scheme

title: A Room in a House or a Room in a Hotel
text:
Visitors to this coastal town now choose between two very distinct arrangements, and the brochures rarely mention the trade-off. A homestay provides a room inside a family house for roughly a third of the hotel rate. The two hotels on the harbour road offer a locked door, a key card and breakfast at a fixed hour. Both arrangements provide shelter, yet the experiences are scarcely comparable.

Homestays win decisively on money and on knowledge. A host who has fished the bay for thirty years will reveal which boat leaves at dawn and which guide overcharges. Hotels, by contrast, win on predictability, because a guest arriving at midnight is never an inconvenience. Homestays also transfer more of the payment to households, since roughly four fifths of the fee stays in the town. Against that, standards vary sharply from one lane to the next, and a visitor who requires quiet may find none. Hotels are duller and more expensive, yet nobody has to negotiate the bathroom.

In my judgement the sensible advice depends on the traveller rather than on the accommodation. A family with small children and an early flight should reserve the hotel without embarrassment. A visitor whose purpose is to understand the bay should choose a household. What the town must not do is impose a single model on everyone through licensing rules. Two imperfect options, honestly described, serve more visitors than one polished standard.
qs: Taken together, what position does the writer defend about homestays and hotels?
The right choice depends on the traveller, so both kinds should stay.
Roughly four fifths of a homestay fee stays inside the town.
A hotel guest arriving at midnight is never an inconvenience.
Homestay standards vary sharply from one lane to the next.

qs.evidence: In my judgement the sensible advice depends on the traveller rather than on the accommodation.
qs.answer: The right choice depends on the traveller, so both kinds should stay.
qs.why: Penulis menyebut dasarnya sendiri: “the sensible advice depends on the traveller rather than on the accommodation”, lalu menyimpulkan dua pilihan tak sempurna melayani lebih banyak pengunjung daripada satu standar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh betul-betul tercatat di paragraf kedua artikel ini, tetapi masing-masing satu keunggulan atau satu kelemahan, bukan pokoknya. Empat perlima ongkos yang tetap di kota adalah keunggulan homestay. Tamu tengah malam yang tak menyusahkan adalah keunggulan hotel. Mutu yang berbeda dari satu lorong ke lorong lain adalah kelemahan homestay. Pokoknya berbunyi "the sensible advice depends on the traveller rather than on the accommodation" dan "Two imperfect options, honestly described, serve more visitors than one polished standard".

qs: Taken together, what do the two hotels on the harbour road provide?
A room at about a third of the homestay rate and a late breakfast.
A private lock, an electronic key and a set breakfast time.
A guide to the bay and a place on a boat that leaves at dawn.
A quiet room, a key card and a choice of breakfast hours.

qs.evidence: The two hotels on the harbour road offer a locked door, a key card and breakfast at a fixed hour.
qs.answer: A private lock, an electronic key and a set breakfast time.
qs.why: Yang ditawarkan hotel: pintu terkunci, kartu kunci, dan sarapan pada jam tetap. Kunci menyebut ketiganya dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tarif sepertiga itu milik homestay, bukan hotel, dan pengetahuan soal perahu subuh datang dari tuan rumah homestay. Hotel memang memberi kartu kunci, tapi sarapannya pada jam tetap, bukan jam pilihan.

qs: On which point does the article say hotels are clearly stronger?
A guest hears from the host which local guide overcharges visitors.
A guest leaves about four fifths of the fee inside the town.
A guest pays roughly a third of what a room in the lanes costs.
A guest who arrives at midnight causes the staff no trouble.

qs.evidence: Hotels, by contrast, win on predictability, because a guest arriving at midnight is never an inconvenience.
qs.answer: A guest who arrives at midnight causes the staff no trouble.
qs.why: Kelebihan hotel disebut satu kali dan jelas: “Hotels, by contrast, win on predictability, because a guest arriving at midnight is never an inconvenience.”
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk “a guest …” dan semuanya kelebihan penginapan, jadi teks yang menentukan pemiliknya. Keterangan soal pemandu yang mematok terlalu tinggi datang dari tuan rumah homestay, begitu pula empat perlima uang yang tinggal di kota. Tarif sepertiga juga milik homestay: hotel disebut “duller and more expensive”.

qs: What does the writer suggest is the risk of choosing a homestay?
Hosts fish the bay all season, so their advice on boats ages.
Breakfast comes at a fixed hour, so a late arrival goes unfed.
Standards differ from lane to lane, so quiet cannot be promised.
Most of the fee leaves the town, so households gain little.

qs.evidence: Against that, standards vary sharply from one lane to the next, and a visitor who requires quiet may find none.
qs.answer: Standards differ from lane to lane, so quiet cannot be promised.
qs.why: Risikonya tertulis di kalimat “Against that”: “standards vary sharply from one lane to the next, and a visitor who requires quiet may find none.”
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk “X, so Y” dan sama-sama terdengar seperti risiko menginap di rumah orang, jadi teks yang memblokir. Pengalaman tuan rumah dipakai sebagai kelebihan, bukan kelemahan, dan sarapan berjam tetap adalah ciri hotel. Uang yang keluar dari kota dibantah langsung: “roughly four fifths of the fee stays in the town.”

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Most visitors to the coastal town arrive between June and August."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Most visitors to the coastal town arrive between June and August.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Visitors to this coastal town now choose between two very distinct arrangements, and the brochures rarely mention the trade-off.
qs.why: Teks bicara soal pilihan menginap tapi nggak pernah menyebut bulan atau musim kedatangan. Nggak ada angka waktu, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh data musim yang nggak ada di teks. "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal pola kedatangan itu; ia diam.

topic: comparison of homestays and hotels for visitors to a coastal town
author: travel comparison column for a weekend supplement
setting: a coastal town with homestays and two small hotels

title: A Documentary That Trusts Its Silence
text:
The documentary screened on the opening night of the film week runs for eighty-four minutes and contains almost no narration. That deliberate restraint is the making of it. Instead of a commentary telling us that the catch has shrunk, we watch three families count what emerges from the nets over eleven months. The figures appear as chalk marks on a boat, and they are more persuasive than any voice could be.

Not everything works. The middle section repeats itself, and two long sequences of mending nets add texture without adding meaning. The music, arriving suddenly in the final reel, tells the audience how to feel about a scene that had already earned its own weight. A tighter edit would have removed twelve minutes and gained considerable force. I would also have appreciated one interview with the buyers who set the price, since their absence leaves a hole in the argument.

Even with those faults, this is the most honest local film I have seen this year, and I recommend it warmly. It credits its audience with sufficient judgement to reach a conclusion unaided. Anyone who has been told that fishing communities are simply disappearing should watch the sequence in which a daughter rejects her father's advice and remains. The film declines to settle that dispute. It merely shows us that the argument is being had.
qs: Taken together, what verdict does the reviewer reach on the fishing documentary?
Chalk marks on a boat persuade more than any commentary could.
Flawed in editing and music, yet honest enough to recommend warmly.
Two sequences of mending nets add texture, though not meaning.
A tighter edit could have removed about twelve minutes of film.

qs.evidence: Even with those faults, this is the most honest local film I have seen this year, and I recommend it warmly.
qs.answer: Flawed in editing and music, yet honest enough to recommend warmly.
qs.why: Penilaian akhirnya jelas: “Even with those faults, this is the most honest local film I have seen this year, and I recommend it warmly.”
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah pengamatan nyata dari paragraf lain ulasan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu pujian atau satu keluhan terperinci, bukan putusan menyeluruhnya. Angka kapur di lambung perahu adalah contoh kekuatan filmnya. Dua rangkaian menjahit jaring adalah satu cacat susunan. Dua belas menit yang bisa dibuang adalah saran penyuntingan. Putusannya berbunyi "Even with those faults, this is the most honest local film I have seen this year, and I recommend it warmly".

qs: Taken together, how does the film present the falling catch?
A narrator sets out the figures over shots of empty nets.
A buyer explains how the price paid at the harbour has fallen.
A daughter reads her father's catch records from eleven years back.
Three families record their hauls for nearly a year in chalk.

qs.evidence: Instead of a commentary telling us that the catch has shrunk, we watch three families count what emerges from the nets over eleven months.
qs.answer: Three families record their hauls for nearly a year in chalk.
qs.why: Penurunan hasil ditunjukkan lewat tiga keluarga yang mencatat tangkapan selama sebelas bulan, angkanya ditulis pakai kapur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Film ini justru hampir tanpa narasi, dan pembeli yang menentukan harga nggak pernah diwawancarai; ketiadaan itu malah dikeluhkan penulis. Anak perempuan muncul di adegan lain, dan angka sebelas mengacu pada sebelas bulan pencatatan, bukan sebelas tahun.

qs: Which detail does the reviewer use to show that the music is a mistake?
It enters late and instructs the audience about an already strong scene.
It plays under the two long sequences of nets being mended.
It repeats a single theme throughout the slow middle section.
It covers the sound of the families calling out their catch on the shore.

qs.evidence: The music, arriving suddenly in the final reel, tells the audience how to feel about a scene that had already earned its own weight.
qs.answer: It enters late and instructs the audience about an already strong scene.
qs.why: Keluhannya satu kalimat: musik masuk mendadak di rol terakhir dan memberi tahu penonton harus merasa apa tentang adegan yang udah kuat dengan sendirinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “it …” dan semuanya keluhan musik yang wajar, jadi teks yang memblokir. Adegan menjahit jaring dikritik karena “add texture without adding meaning”, bukan karena musiknya. Pengulangan yang disebut penulis adalah pengulangan bagian tengah film, bukan tema musik. Dan karena musik baru masuk di rol terakhir, ia nggak menimpa penghitungan tangkapan.

qs: Which statement best restates the reviewer's last remark about the film?
The film shows a dispute already decided and records the winning side.
The film shows a dispute still running and refuses to decide it.
The film shows a dispute still running and takes the daughter's side.
The film shows a dispute closing as the fishing families quietly leave.

qs.evidence: It merely shows us that the argument is being had.
qs.answer: The film shows a dispute still running and refuses to decide it.
qs.why: Dua kalimat penutup: “The film declines to settle that dispute. It merely shows us that the argument is being had.” Perdebatan direkam, bukan diputuskan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “the film shows a dispute …”, jadi kata kerjanya yang diuji. “Declines to settle” memblokir perselisihan yang udah diputus dan juga pemihakan pada si anak. Gagasan keluarga nelayan yang lenyap justru anggapan yang film bantah lewat adegan si anak yang “rejects her father's advice and remains”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The reviewer believes the film would be stronger if it were shorter."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The reviewer believes the film would be stronger if it were shorter.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A tighter edit would have removed twelve minutes and gained considerable force.
qs.why: "Tighter edit ... gained considerable force" sama artinya dengan film jadi lebih kuat kalau lebih pendek. Jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada yang dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena penilaian soal durasi ditulis terang.

topic: review of a documentary about a fishing community
author: film review for a regional cultural weekly
setting: a documentary screening at a regional film week

title: Let the Hill Temple Breathe
text:
Nobody appreciates being told that a public place is full, which is why the proposed daily limit at the hill temple has been received so badly. The complaint is understandable. A limit seems like a fence around something that belongs to everyone. Yet the argument against limits ignores what is happening to the stone.

The problem is measurable rather than sentimental. Conservators recorded the wear on the eastern staircase and found that the upper steps have lost eleven millimetres of surface in nine years. On festival weekends four thousand people use a stairway built for a few hundred pilgrims a day. Guides are pushed to hurry groups through, so nobody explains the carvings, and the visit becomes a queue with a view. The site loses its stone and its meaning at the same time.

A daily cap of twelve hundred, with free tickets released in advance, would treat both losses at once. Those turned away could be directed to the lower shrine, which is nearly empty and equally ancient. I would go further and charge nothing at all, since a limit that operates through price excludes exactly the wrong people. Critics call this rationing, and in a sense it is. The alternative is to let everyone in until there is nothing left worth queueing for.
qs: What is the writer trying to achieve in this column?
To urge repairs to the eastern staircase before the next festival.
To urge visitors to climb to the lower shrine instead of the temple.
To urge a higher ticket price so that festival crowds thin out.
To urge a daily ceiling on numbers, with tickets given free.

qs.evidence: A daily cap of twelve hundred, with free tickets released in advance, would treat both losses at once.
qs.answer: To urge a daily ceiling on numbers, with tickets given free.
qs.why: Usul penulis satu paket: batas harian dua belas ratus orang dengan tiket gratis yang dilepas lebih awal, karena itu “would treat both losses at once”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk “to urge …” dan semuanya tindakan yang wajar bagi situs yang terkikis, jadi teks yang memilih. Perbaikan tangga nggak pernah diminta; yang diukur konservator dipakai untuk membenarkan pembatasan. Kuil bawah muncul sebagai tempat alih bagi “those turned away”, jadi ia bagian usul, bukan maksudnya. Dan tarif ditolak terang-terangan: “I would go further and charge nothing at all.”

qs: Taken together, what do the conservators' measurements cover on the eastern staircase?
How many pilgrims the stairway was first built to carry.
How long each guided group spends beside the carvings.
How many people use the eastern staircase on a festival weekend.
How much stone the highest steps had gradually lost.

qs.evidence: Conservators recorded the wear on the eastern staircase and found that the upper steps have lost eleven millimetres of surface in nine years.
qs.answer: How much stone the highest steps had gradually lost.
qs.why: Yang diukur konservator: batu yang terkikis di bagian tangga paling atas, sebelas milimeter dalam sembilan tahun.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kapasitas asli tangga dan angka empat ribu pengunjung dipakai penulis sebagai pembanding, bukan hasil pengukuran konservator. Waktu pemandu bersama tiap kelompok nggak pernah diukur; yang diukur adalah kikisan sebelas milimeter pada anak tangga teratas.

qs: Which fact does the writer offer as proof that crowding damages the visit itself?
Four thousand people climb a stairway meant for a few hundred.
Hurried parties pass the carved stone without hearing what it means.
The upper steps have lost eleven millimetres of surface in nine years.
The lower shrine stands nearly empty on those same festival weekends.

qs.evidence: Guides are pushed to hurry groups through, so nobody explains the carvings, and the visit becomes a queue with a view.
qs.answer: Hurried parties pass the carved stone without hearing what it means.
qs.why: Kerusakan pengalaman ditulis di satu kalimat: pemandu didesak mempercepat kelompok, nggak ada yang menjelaskan ukirannya, dan kunjungan “becomes a queue with a view”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah fakta yang benar-benar ada di teks, jadi pemblokirnya adalah apa yang dibuktikan tiap fakta. Angka empat ribu membuktikan kepadatan, dan sebelas milimeter membuktikan hilangnya batu — bukan hilangnya makna kunjungan. Kuil bawah yang lengang adalah bagian dari usul pengalihan, bukan bukti kerusakan.

qs: Why does the writer reject a system based on ticket prices?
Because a charge would shut out those least able to pay.
Because a charge would leave the stairway as crowded as before.
Because a charge would send temple income to the district office.
Because a charge would force guides to collect money at the gate.

qs.evidence: I would go further and charge nothing at all, since a limit that operates through price excludes exactly the wrong people.
qs.answer: Because a charge would shut out those least able to pay.
qs.why: Alasannya ditulis lugas: batas yang bekerja lewat harga “excludes exactly the wrong people”, karena itu penulis memilih tiket gratis.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “because a charge would …”, jadi alasan mana yang ada di teks itulah pembedanya. Teks nggak mengklaim tarif gagal menipiskan kerumunan — keberatannya soal siapa yang tersaring. Ke mana uang tiket pergi nggak pernah dibahas, dan tugas memungut uang di gerbang juga nggak disebut; pemandu hanya disebut didesak mempercepat kelompok.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The lower shrine is much more recent than the temple on the hill."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The lower shrine is much more recent than the temple on the hill.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Those turned away could be directed to the lower shrine, which is nearly empty and equally ancient.
qs.why: Teks bilang kuil bawah sama tuanya, jadi klaim "jauh lebih baru" membalik proposisi yang tertulis.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena usianya dipertukarkan. "Not stated" salah karena umur kuil bawah disebut lewat kata "equally ancient".

topic: opinion supporting a daily visitor limit at a hill temple
author: opinion column by a heritage conservation volunteer
setting: a hill temple receiving large numbers of day visitors

title: Why Teenagers Went Back to Listening
text:
For a decade, researchers assumed that teenagers had abandoned audio for video, and the assumption was reasonable. A survey of 2,400 secondary pupils across nine districts now suggests something more complicated. Video still occupies most of their screen time, yet spoken audio has quietly regained an hour a day. The interesting part is not the total but the reason.

The team asked pupils to keep a diary for two weeks, noting what they listened to and what else they were doing. Almost nobody listened while sitting still. Audio grew because it survives movement: it accompanies a bus ride, a kitchen shift or a walk to a tuition class. Where video demands the eyes, spoken programmes demand only patience, so they fit into gaps that video cannot enter. The consequence is that listening rose fastest among pupils with the longest journeys, not among those with the best equipment. Ownership of expensive headphones explained almost none of the difference.

The report draws one firm conclusion, and I think it is right. Producers who chase attention with shorter and louder material have misread their audience. The diaries show teenagers choosing episodes of forty minutes precisely because a journey lasts that long. Cutting an episode to three minutes does not suit a listener with an hour to fill. If the industry wants these listeners, it should study timetables rather than trends.
qs: Taken together, what does this survey establish about teenage listening?
Almost nobody in the diaries listened while sitting still.
Expensive headphones explained almost none of the difference.
Listening has grown because sound fits itself around a moving day.
Pupils chose forty-minute episodes to match a long journey.

qs.evidence: Audio grew because it survives movement: it accompanies a bus ride, a kitchen shift or a walk to a tuition class.
qs.answer: Listening has grown because sound fits itself around a moving day.
qs.why: Laporan menyebut sebabnya, bukan angkanya: audio tumbuh karena ia bertahan saat orang bergerak — menemani perjalanan bus, giliran di dapur, jalan ke tempat bimbingan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah temuan nyata dari catatan harian yang dilaporkan di sini, tetapi masing-masing bukti atau akibat, bukan penekanannya. Tak ada yang mendengarkan sambil duduk diam adalah bukti awal untuk sebabnya. Headphone mahal yang tak menjelaskan apa-apa adalah penyingkiran penjelasan saingan. Episode empat puluh menit adalah pelajaran bagi produser di paragraf penutup. Penekanannya dinyatakan sendiri: "The interesting part is not the total but the reason", lalu "Audio grew because it survives movement".

qs: Taken together, what were the pupils in the study asked to do?
Report each week how long the journey to school had taken.
List the video channels they had stopped watching that year.
Record for a fortnight what they heard and what they were doing.
Note for a month which programmes they had chosen themselves.

qs.evidence: The team asked pupils to keep a diary for two weeks, noting what they listened to and what else they were doing.
qs.answer: Record for a fortnight what they heard and what they were doing.
qs.why: Tugas mereka menulis buku harian dua pekan: apa yang didengar dan kegiatan apa yang sedang dilakukan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tugasnya buku harian dua pekan, bukan laporan pekanan atau catatan sebulan. Waktu perjalanan dan kanal video memang dibahas di bagian temuan, tapi murid nggak pernah diminta mencatat keduanya.

qs: How does the report contrast video with spoken programmes?
Video needs a screen in view, while talk needs only time.
Video needs a screen in view, while talk needs a still listener.
Talk needs a screen in view, while video needs only patience.
Video needs a screen in view, while talk needs costly headphones.

qs.evidence: Where video demands the eyes, spoken programmes demand only patience, so they fit into gaps that video cannot enter.
qs.answer: Video needs a screen in view, while talk needs only time.
qs.why: Kontrasnya satu kalimat: video menuntut mata, sedangkan siaran suara hanya menuntut kesabaran, sehingga audio masuk ke celah yang tak bisa dimasuki video.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk kontras dua-arah yang sama, jadi pelaku dan tuntutannya yang diuji. Audio justru yang bertahan saat pendengar bergerak — “almost nobody listened while sitting still” — jadi bukan audio yang butuh pendengar duduk tenang. Pelakunya juga nggak boleh ditukar: yang menuntut mata adalah video. Dan alat mahal disebut hampir tak menjelaskan perbedaan apa pun.

qs: Which conclusion about episode length do the two-week listening diaries support?
listeners pick a length that matches the journey ahead of them
listeners prefer three-minute episodes once a journey is long
listeners with expensive headphones listen for the longest
listeners turn to video whenever an episode runs past forty minutes

qs.evidence: The diaries show teenagers choosing episodes of forty minutes precisely because a journey lasts that long.
qs.answer: listeners pick a length that matches the journey ahead of them
qs.why: Buku harian dua pekan nunjukin audio tumbuh karena “it survives movement” dan remaja milih episode empat puluh menit “precisely because a journey lasts that long”, jadi panjang episode ngikut lama perjalanan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang memotong episode jadi tiga menit “does not suit a listener with an hour to fill”, jadi opsi kedua bertentangan langsung. Kepemilikan headphone mahal “explained almost none of the difference”, jadi bukan penentu lama mendengar. Dan audio justru mengisi celah yang nggak bisa dimasuki video (“Where video demands the eyes”), bukan kalah oleh video.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The study covered pupils from more than eight different districts."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The study covered pupils from more than eight different districts.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A survey of 2,400 secondary pupils across nine districts now suggests something more complicated.
qs.why: Sembilan distrik berarti lebih dari delapan, jadi klaim ini parafrasa angka yang tertulis dan kuncinya True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena angkanya nggak dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena jumlah distrik disebut di paragraf pertama.

topic: research on teenage audio and podcast habits
author: popular research article for a media studies bulletin
setting: a media research centre surveying secondary pupils

title: Letter to the Tourism Office: The Cave Path Signs
text:
On behalf of the eleven registered guides at the cave, I am writing to request a decision on the path signs before the next holiday season. We raised the matter in April and were informed that a survey was under way. Four months later the survey has not reached us, and the season begins in six weeks.

The situation on the ground has altered since our first letter. The upper path was widened in June, so visitors now reach the second chamber without encountering any guide at all. Two parties last month entered with torches after the last patrol had departed. Nobody was hurt, but the floor of that chamber is wet limestone. Our members are no longer willing to be described as responsible for safety they cannot see. The single wooden notice at the car park is faded and mentions a route that was closed in 2019.

We propose three practical measures, none of which requires new funding. First, replace the notice with two boards, one at the car park and one at the fork above it. Second, mark the closing time on both boards in figures rather than in words. Third, confirm in writing that the association's duty ends at the marked barrier. We remain willing to meet you at the site on any weekday morning, and we would appreciate a written reply within a fortnight.
qs: Why is the association writing to the tourism office?
To press the office to publish the visitor survey it began last April.
To press the office to fund two new boards at the cave entrance.
To press the office to settle the sign question within six weeks.
To press the office to release the guides from duty this season.

qs.evidence: On behalf of the eleven registered guides at the cave, I am writing to request a decision on the path signs before the next holiday season.
qs.answer: To press the office to settle the sign question within six weeks.
qs.why: Kalimat pertama surat menyebut maksudnya: meminta keputusan soal papan penunjuk jalan sebelum musim libur berikutnya, dan musim itu mulai enam pekan lagi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “to press the office to …”, jadi permintaan mana yang tertulis itulah pembedanya. Yang diminta bukan penerbitan survei melainkan keputusan; survei hanya disebut belum sampai setelah empat bulan. Dana baru ditolak surat sendiri: “none of which requires new funding.” Dan pemandu nggak minta dibebaskan bertugas; mereka minta batas tanggung jawabnya ditegaskan.

qs: Taken together, what does the letter say changed at the site in June?
A second notice was put up at the fork above the car park.
A patrol was added to check the second chamber after closing time.
A route that had been closed in 2019 was opened again.
A broader upper track now lets visitors pass the guides entirely.

qs.evidence: The upper path was widened in June, so visitors now reach the second chamber without encountering any guide at all.
qs.answer: A broader upper track now lets visitors pass the guides entirely.
qs.why: Perubahan Juni: jalur atas diperlebar, akibatnya pengunjung bisa sampai ruang kedua tanpa bertemu pemandu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Papan kedua di percabangan adalah usulan pertama surat, jadi belum ada. Patroli tambahan nggak pernah disebut, dan rute 2019 tetap tertutup; ia hanya masih tertulis di papan lama yang pudar.

qs: Which incident does the letter use to justify its concern about safety?
A visitor slipped on the wet limestone of the second chamber.
A guide turned back two parties who were carrying torches after closing.
Unaccompanied parties went in with their own lamps once patrols ended.
A party lost its way inside the second chamber in April.

qs.evidence: Two parties last month entered with torches after the last patrol had departed.
qs.answer: Unaccompanied parties went in with their own lamps once patrols ended.
qs.why: Kejadiannya satu: dua kelompok bulan lalu masuk membawa obor setelah patroli terakhir pergi, dan lantai ruang itu batu kapur basah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk kejadian yang wajar dipakai surat keselamatan, jadi teks yang memblokir. Surat menegaskan “Nobody was hurt”, jadi nggak ada yang tergelincir. Nggak ada pemandu yang menahan siapa pun — justru itu masalahnya: jalur atas yang dilebarkan membuat pengunjung lewat tanpa bertemu pemandu. Dan April adalah bulan surat pertama diajukan, bukan bulan orang tersesat.

qs: Which sentence best restates the association's third proposal?
They want the office to print the closing time as figures.
They want the office to build a barrier above the path fork.
They want the office to answer their letter within a fortnight.
They want the office to confirm on paper where their duty ends.

qs.evidence: Third, confirm in writing that the association's duty ends at the marked barrier.
qs.answer: They want the office to confirm on paper where their duty ends.
qs.why: Usul ketiga ditulis terpisah: konfirmasi tertulis bahwa tugas asosiasi berakhir di pembatas yang udah ditandai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah permintaan yang benar-benar ada di surat, jadi pemblokirnya adalah nomor urutnya. Jam tutup berupa angka adalah usul kedua, dan balasan tertulis dalam dua pekan adalah permintaan penutup. Pembatas baru nggak pernah diminta; surat menyebut pembatas yang udah ditandai sebagai titik akhir tanggung jawab.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The association first raised the question of the signs six weeks ago."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The association first raised the question of the signs six weeks ago.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: We raised the matter in April and were informed that a survey was under way.
qs.why: Teks bilang perkaranya diajukan pada April, sementara enam pekan adalah jarak menuju musim liburan. Waktunya ditukar, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena angka waktunya dipindah. "Not stated" salah karena bulan pengajuan pertama disebut jelas.

topic: formal letter requesting better signs and guide arrangements at a cave
author: formal letter from the chair of a village guides association
setting: a cave site reached by a steep unmarked path

title: Two Ways to Boil Water
text:
A household in this village that replaces its wood stove must choose between a biogas unit and bottled gas. The two are not simply cheap and expensive versions of one thing. A bottled cylinder arrives on a truck and works within minutes. A biogas digester must be dug, fed daily and repaired locally.

On convenience the cylinder wins easily. It needs no space, no cattle and no daily attention, which matters greatly to households where both adults work away from the village. Biogas, by contrast, wins on running cost and on waste. A family with three cows can cook for nothing and still obtain fertilizer for the garden. The comparison shifts again when supply is considered. Cylinder prices here rose twice last year and deliveries stop whenever the river road floods. A digester, once built, is indifferent to the road, although it produces less gas in a cold month and nothing at all if the animals are sold.

My conclusion is that the village should stop presenting these options as rivals for the same household. Families with livestock and someone at home should be offered digesters; families without either should be offered cylinders at a fair price. The present scheme, which promotes one technology to everybody, guarantees that half the equipment will stand unused. A choice made honestly is more durable than a target met quickly.
qs: Taken together, what argument does the writer build about the two cooking systems?
A family with three cows can cook for nothing and gain fertilizer.
Each family should be offered the system its own situation fits.
Cylinder prices rose twice and deliveries stop when the road floods.
A digester may produce less gas once a cold month arrives.

qs.evidence: My conclusion is that the village should stop presenting these options as rivals for the same household.
qs.answer: Each family should be offered the system its own situation fits.
qs.why: Kesimpulan penulis menolak memperlakukan keduanya sebagai saingan untuk rumah tangga yang sama: keluarga berternak dengan orang di rumah diberi digester, keluarga tanpa keduanya diberi tabung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah keterangan nyata dari paragraf kedua kolom ini, tetapi masing-masing satu sisi perbandingan, bukan hujahnya. Keluarga bersapi tiga yang memasak tanpa biaya adalah keunggulan biogas. Kenaikan harga tabung dan banjir jalan sungai adalah kelemahan tabung. Gas yang menyusut di bulan dingin adalah kelemahan digester. Hujahnya berbunyi "the village should stop presenting these options as rivals for the same household".

qs: Taken together, what does the article say a biogas unit requires?
Digging, daily feeding and repairs carried out nearby.
A cylinder delivered to the house and lit within a few minutes.
Three cows, a garden and a spare cylinder kept for cold months.
A daily payment to the village scheme and a yearly repair visit.

qs.evidence: A biogas digester must be dug, fed daily and repaired locally.
qs.answer: Digging, daily feeding and repairs carried out nearby.
qs.why: Syaratnya tiga: digali, diisi tiap hari, dan diperbaiki di tempat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pengiriman dan menyala dalam beberapa menit adalah ciri tabung gas, bukan digester. Tiga ekor sapi dan taman muncul sebagai hasil pemakaian, bukan syarat pemasangan, dan nggak ada iuran harian maupun kunjungan perbaikan tahunan dalam teks.

qs: How do the two options differ when the road is flooded?
A digester needs repairs then, whereas cylinders still come in by boat.
Both stop working until the river road has been reopened.
A digester carries on, whereas cylinders cannot reach the village.
A digester makes less gas then, whereas cylinder prices drop.

qs.evidence: A digester, once built, is indifferent to the road, although it produces less gas in a cold month and nothing at all if the animals are sold.
qs.answer: A digester carries on, whereas cylinders cannot reach the village.
qs.why: Teks memasangkan keduanya di soal pasokan: pengiriman tabung berhenti tiap jalan sungai banjir, sedangkan digester yang udah dibangun “is indifferent to the road”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk kontras “X, whereas Y” yang sama, jadi arah tiap klaim yang diuji. Pengiriman lewat perahu nggak ada di teks, dan “indifferent to the road” menutup opsi yang menghentikan keduanya. Gas digester berkurang pada bulan dingin, bukan saat banjir, dan harga tabung di sini disebut naik dua kali tahun lalu, bukan turun.

qs: What does the writer imply about the present village scheme?
It hands digesters to the families with nobody left at home.
It has pushed cylinder prices up twice within a single year.
It suits the households where both adults work away from the village.
It wastes much of what is installed by treating households alike.

qs.evidence: The present scheme, which promotes one technology to everybody, guarantees that half the equipment will stand unused.
qs.answer: It wastes much of what is installed by treating households alike.
qs.why: Penilaian penulis atas skema sekarang tegas: mendorong satu teknologi kepada semua orang “guarantees that half the equipment will stand unused”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “it …” dan semuanya penilaian yang wajar atas sebuah program desa, jadi teks yang memblokir. Skema ini justru nggak memilah siapa pun: ia menawarkan satu teknologi kepada semua. Kenaikan harga tabung disebut sebagai keadaan pasar setempat, bukan akibat skema. Dan teks nggak menyebut skema ini cocok bagi kelompok mana pun; separuh alatnya diramalkan menganggur.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The village council pays part of the cost of installing a digester."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The village council pays part of the cost of installing a digester.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Families with livestock and someone at home should be offered digesters; families without either should be offered cylinders at a fair price.
qs.why: Teks membahas siapa yang cocok dapat digester, tapi nggak sekali pun menyebut siapa yang menanggung biaya pemasangan. Nggak ada atribusi dana, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh keterangan subsidi yang nggak ada. "False" juga salah sebab teks nggak menyangkal adanya bantuan biaya.

topic: comparison of village biogas units and bottled gas for cooking
author: comparison feature for a rural development magazine
setting: a farming village weighing biogas against bottled gas

title: Please Do Not Make Volunteering Compulsory
text:
The proposal to require forty hours of community service from every school leaver comes from a generous instinct. It will nonetheless damage the very thing it admires. I coordinated volunteers in this district for six years. The people who stayed were never the ones sent to us.

Consider what compulsion does to an organization. A shelter that receives thirty willing helpers can plan a rota; the same shelter receiving thirty reluctant ones must supervise, sign forms and repeat instructions. The cost of that supervision falls on staff who are already stretched, and it is paid in hours nobody counts. Worse, compulsory schemes teach a lesson opposite to the intended one. A young person who has been made to sweep a yard for a signature learns that service is a fee charged by adults, not a choice worth making. Our records showed that helpers recruited through friends stayed on average eleven months, while those completing required hours stayed under seven weeks.

There is a better route, and it is unglamorous. Fund three part-time coordinators, publish honest descriptions of each task, and let schools offer the hours as a genuine option. Districts that did this reported waiting lists rather than empty rotas. I would rather have twelve volunteers who return next month than forty who leave with a certificate and no intention of coming back.
qs: What is the writer arguing for in this column?
To call for a shorter requirement of twenty hours for leavers.
To call for certificates only after helpers return a second month.
To call for paid organizers and hours offered as a real choice.
To call for an end to school schemes at shelters altogether.

qs.evidence: Fund three part-time coordinators, publish honest descriptions of each task, and let schools offer the hours as a genuine option.
qs.answer: To call for paid organizers and hours offered as a real choice.
qs.why: Jalan yang penulis tawarkan dirinci: biayai tiga koordinator paruh waktu, terbitkan uraian tugas yang jujur, dan biarkan sekolah menawarkan jam itu “as a genuine option”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “to call for …” dan semuanya usul yang wajar soal kerja sukarela, jadi teks yang memblokir. Memperpendek jam tetap kewajiban, dan penulis bilang “compulsory schemes teach a lesson opposite to the intended one”. Sertifikat justru yang ia sindir di kalimat penutup. Dan ia nggak menutup pintu bagi murid: ia mau dua belas relawan yang kembali bulan depan.

qs: Which record kept by the writer supports the claim that compulsion damages what it admires?
helpers found through friends stayed eleven months, required helpers under seven weeks
helpers completing required hours stayed about eleven months on average
helpers recruited by schools stayed longer than those found through friends
thirty willing helpers stayed on one shelter's rota for seven weeks

qs.evidence: Our records showed that helpers recruited through friends stayed on average eleven months, while those completing required hours stayed under seven weeks.
qs.answer: helpers found through friends stayed eleven months, required helpers under seven weeks
qs.why: Catatan enam tahun itu menopang argumennya: relawan yang datang lewat teman bertahan sebelas bulan, sedangkan yang cuma memenuhi jam wajib kurang dari tujuh pekan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Sebelas bulan milik kelompok yang datang lewat teman, jadi opsi kedua menukar angkanya. Arah perbandingan opsi ketiga kebalikan dari catatan, dan sekolah cuma muncul sebagai penyalur jam wajib. Angka tiga puluh dipakai untuk contoh rota di shelter, bukan untuk lamanya orang bertahan.

qs: Which example shows the hidden cost of compulsory helpers?
Shelters need thirty new helpers before any rota can be planned.
Districts need three part-time coordinators simply to keep the scheme running.
Young people need a signature for each hour of work finished.
Tired staff spend unpaid hours watching over helpers sent against their will.

qs.evidence: A shelter that receives thirty willing helpers can plan a rota; the same shelter receiving thirty reluctant ones must supervise, sign forms and repeat instructions.
qs.answer: Tired staff spend unpaid hours watching over helpers sent against their will.
qs.why: Biaya tersembunyinya disebut di paragraf dua: shelter dengan tiga puluh relawan nggak rela harus mengawasi, menandatangani formulir, dan mengulang perintah — dan itu “paid in hours nobody counts”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah beban yang benar-benar disebut teks, jadi pemblokirnya adalah beban milik siapa. Angka tiga puluh dipakai untuk membandingkan relawan rela dan nggak rela, bukan sebagai syarat menyusun rota. Tiga koordinator paruh waktu adalah usul penulis, jadi ia obat, bukan biaya kewajiban. Tanda tangan muncul di contoh soal pelajaran yang salah tertanam, bukan sebagai kerja tambahan staf.

qs: What does the writer suggest compulsory service teaches young people?
That helping matters more to the adults who sign the forms.
That helping is easier when school friends do it together.
That helping is a charge adults impose, not a choice made.
That helping keeps shelters open when their staff are stretched.

qs.evidence: A young person who has been made to sweep a yard for a signature learns that service is a fee charged by adults, not a choice worth making.
qs.answer: That helping is a charge adults impose, not a choice made.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menyebut pelajaran yang tertanam: yang disuruh menyapu halaman demi tanda tangan belajar bahwa pelayanan adalah “a fee charged by adults, not a choice worth making”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “that helping …” dan semuanya pelajaran yang bisa dibayangkan, jadi teks yang memutus. Untuk siapa sertifikat berharga nggak pernah dinilai. Relawan lewat teman memang bertahan sebelas bulan, tapi itu temuan tentang lamanya bertahan, bukan pelajaran yang tertanam.
