Dan ketergantungan shelter pada lulusan sekolah nggak pernah diklaim penulis.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer led volunteer work in the district for more than five years."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer led volunteer work in the district for more than five years.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I coordinated volunteers in this district for six years.
qs.why: Enam tahun berarti lebih dari lima, jadi klaim ini parafrasa keterangan yang tertulis dan kuncinya True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena lamanya nggak dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena masa kerja itu disebut sendiri oleh penulis.

topic: opinion against compulsory volunteering hours for school leavers
author: opinion column by a former volunteer coordinator
setting: a district considering compulsory service hours for school leavers

title: Counting the Speakers of a Small Language
text:
A district survey of language use has produced a result that neither the optimists nor the pessimists expected. Interviewers visited 900 homes and asked which language was used for four ordinary activities: scolding a child, bargaining at the market, praying and joking. The choice of activities was deliberate, because a single question about the mother tongue tends to collect polite answers rather than accurate ones.

The pattern that emerged runs along function rather than age. Grandparents used the local language for all four activities. Parents used it for scolding and bargaining but switched to the national language for prayer. Pupils aged twelve to seventeen used it almost exclusively for joking, which the researchers had not predicted. The consequence is that the language is not so much dying as narrowing: it retains warmth and humour while losing formality. Because school prizes, official forms and sermons all belong to the wider language, its retreat is fastest in exactly the settings that carry prestige.

The report ends with an argument rather than a lament, which I find refreshing. Its authors maintain that revival campaigns aimed at children misunderstand the problem, since children already use the language every day for jokes. What has disappeared is any adult occasion that requires it. They therefore recommend that councils conduct one public meeting a month in the local language. A language survives where it is needed, not where it is admired.
qs: Taken together, what does this district survey establish about the small language?
Parents keep it for scolding but pray in the national language.
The language is retreating from formal settings but alive in jokes.
Campaigns aimed at children misread a problem that lies with adults.
Councils could hold one public meeting a month in the language.

qs.evidence: The consequence is that the language is not so much dying as narrowing: it retains warmth and humour while losing formality.
qs.answer: The language is retreating from formal settings but alive in jokes.
qs.why: Akibat temuannya ditulis lugas: bahasa itu bukan mati melainkan menyempit — ia menyimpan kehangatan dan humor sambil kehilangan keresmian.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah pernyataan nyata dari paragraf lain laporan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu baris data atau satu anjuran, bukan temuan pokoknya. Kebiasaan orang tua adalah satu baris dalam pola fungsi. Kritik atas kampanye untuk anak-anak serta usul rapat bulanan berada di paragraf penutup sebagai obat. Temuan pokoknya berbunyi "the language is not so much dying as narrowing: it retains warmth and humour while losing formality".

qs: Taken together, which four situations did the interviewers ask about?
Filling in forms, praying, joking and greeting neighbours.
Bargaining, singing, listening to sermons and scolding.
Telling off a child, haggling, prayer and making jokes.
Praying, joking, teaching lessons and reading notices.

qs.evidence: Interviewers visited 900 homes and asked which language was used for four ordinary activities: scolding a child, bargaining at the market, praying and joking.
qs.answer: Telling off a child, haggling, prayer and making jokes.
qs.why: Empat situasinya: memarahi anak, menawar di pasar, berdoa, dan bercanda.
qs.whyOthersFail: Empat kegiatan yang ditanyakan adalah memarahi anak, menawar, berdoa, dan bercanda. Formulir, khotbah, dan hadiah sekolah muncul di kalimat lain sebagai ranah prestise, sementara menyapa tetangga, menyanyi, mengajar, dan membaca pengumuman nggak masuk daftar.

qs: Which result did the researchers say they had not expected?
Grandparents chose the national language whenever they joked with friends.
Teenagers kept the old language almost only for humour.
Parents chose the national language for scolding but not for prayer.
Households gave sharper answers to one direct question about language.

qs.evidence: Pupils aged twelve to seventeen used it almost exclusively for joking, which the researchers had not predicted.
qs.answer: Teenagers kept the old language almost only for humour.
qs.why: Satu temuan disebut di luar dugaan peneliti: murid dua belas sampai tujuh belas tahun memakai bahasa itu hampir semata-mata untuk bercanda.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah hasil yang bisa terjadi dalam survei semacam ini, jadi teks yang memblokir. Kakek-nenek dilaporkan memakai bahasa lokal untuk keempat kegiatan, jadi bukan bahasa nasional saat bercanda. Orang tua memakainya untuk memarahi dan menawar lalu beralih justru saat berdoa, jadi ranahnya tertukar. Dan satu pertanyaan langsung disebut mengumpulkan jawaban sopan, bukan jawaban yang lebih tajam.

qs: Which conclusion about revival campaigns does the pattern of use in the survey lead to?
campaigns for children miss the gap, which lies in adult occasions
campaigns for children work best where grandparents still speak it
campaigns for children failed when this district tried them before
the language is vanishing fastest from the jokes of the youngest

qs.evidence: Its authors maintain that revival campaigns aimed at children misunderstand the problem, since children already use the language every day for jokes.
qs.answer: campaigns for children miss the gap, which lies in adult occasions
qs.why: Polanya mengikuti fungsi, bukan usia: pelajar 12–17 tahun masih memakai bahasa itu untuk bercanda, sementara ranah resmi hilang, jadi penulis nyimpulin kampanye untuk anak salah sasaran dan yang hilang adalah kesempatan orang dewasa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Peniruan bahasa kakek-nenek nggak pernah dibahas survei ini. Nggak ada catatan kampanye anak yang pernah dicoba dan gagal di distrik ini. Dan opsi terakhir membalik temuan: bercanda justru satu-satunya ranah yang masih dipegang kelompok termuda (“almost exclusively for joking”).

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Parents in the survey used the national language when bargaining at the market."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Parents in the survey used the national language when bargaining at the market.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Parents used it for scolding and bargaining but switched to the national language for prayer.
qs.why: Teks bilang orang tua memakai bahasa lokal untuk menawar dan beralih ke bahasa nasional saat berdoa, jadi klaim ini menukar ranahnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena kegiatannya dipertukarkan. "Not stated" salah karena kebiasaan orang tua dirinci di paragraf kedua.

topic: survey research on the use of a local language across generations
author: popular research report for a language documentation project
setting: a coastal district where a local language is spoken at home

title: A Walking Guide That Knows When to Stop Talking
text:
Most walking guides to this port quarter appear designed for readers who will never arrive. They begin with three centuries of commerce and reach the first street on page forty. The new pocket guide, issued in June, adopts the reverse approach. Its history occupies four pages, and the rest belongs to the pavement.

The maps constitute its chief achievement. Each of the six walks fits on a single spread, with the turnings drawn as a walker sees them rather than as a surveyor would. A marginal note beside the fish market specifies the hours when the alley becomes impassable, which no rival guide mentions. The deficiencies are equally conspicuous. Photographs are printed too dark to be useful, and the index omits two of the mosques described in the text. Prices quoted for the ferry were already wrong in July. A guide that dates so quickly should carry the month of printing on its cover.

I would nevertheless purchase it, and purchase it before arrival rather than at the station kiosk. Read at home, its second walk explains why the warehouses stand at an angle to the sea, and that single paragraph rearranges the whole quarter for a visitor. A guidebook is not a historical study and should not pretend otherwise. This one knows the difference, which is why its faults are forgivable.
qs: Taken together, what opinion does the reviewer reach about the walking guide?
Its history fills four pages, and the pavement takes the rest.
Its photographs print too dark and the index omits two mosques.
Its practical strengths outweigh faults that are real and plain.
It should be bought before arrival rather than at the station.

qs.evidence: This one knows the difference, which is why its faults are forgivable.
qs.answer: Its practical strengths outweigh faults that are real and plain.
qs.why: Penilaian akhirnya ada di kalimat penutup: buku ini tahu bedanya panduan jalan dan kajian sejarah, “which is why its faults are forgivable”, setelah cacatnya disebut satu per satu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh betul-betul dinyatakan di bagian lain ulasan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu ciri, satu daftar cacat, atau satu saran beli, bukan penilaian menyeluruhnya. Empat halaman sejarah adalah keterangan susunan buku. Foto gelap dan indeks yang lupa dua masjid adalah rinciannya. Membeli sebelum tiba adalah saran praktis. Penilaiannya berbunyi "This one knows the difference, which is why its faults are forgivable".

qs: Taken together, what does the reviewer say about the maps in the guide?
Each of the six routes is drawn the way a surveyor would record it.
Every route sits on two facing pages and follows a walker's view.
Four routes are mapped, and the fish market alley is left unmarked.
The maps fold out from the back and mark the ferry stops clearly.

qs.evidence: Each of the six walks fits on a single spread, with the turnings drawn as a walker sees them rather than as a surveyor would.
qs.answer: Every route sits on two facing pages and follows a walker's view.
qs.why: Petanya: satu rute satu halaman ganda, dan tikungannya digambar sebagaimana terlihat oleh pejalan, bukan gaya juru ukur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Cara juru ukur justru yang ditolak; tikungan digambar sebagaimana dilihat pejalan. Rutenya enam bukan empat, dan gang pasar ikan punya catatan tepi khusus soal jam nggak bisa dilewati. Peta lipat di belakang nggak pernah disebut.

qs: Which fault does the reviewer report to show the book will date quickly?
The index leaves out two mosques that the text describes.
The photographs are printed too dark to be any use.
The history is squeezed into only four pages of text.
The ferry fares printed inside were wrong within a month.

qs.evidence: Prices quoted for the ferry were already wrong in July.
qs.answer: The ferry fares printed inside were wrong within a month.
qs.why: Yang menandai buku cepat kedaluwarsa adalah satu cacat: harga kapal yang dicetak di dalamnya udah salah pada Juli, sehingga penulis minta bulan cetak dipasang di kover.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah cacat yang benar-benar dilaporkan resensi, jadi pemblokirnya adalah cacat mana yang berubah seiring waktu. Indeks bolong dan foto gelap tetap sama besar setahun kemudian, jadi keduanya bukan soal kedaluwarsa. Sejarah empat halaman bahkan bukan cacat: itu pilihan yang dipuji sebagai kebalikan panduan lain.

qs: Which statement best restates the reviewer's advice on when to read the guide?
Read it on the walk itself and save the history for later.
Read it at home first, since one page recasts the whole district.
Read it after the visit, when the history of the lanes makes sense.
Read it at the station kiosk, since the fares change monthly.

qs.evidence: Read at home, its second walk explains why the warehouses stand at an angle to the sea, and that single paragraph rearranges the whole quarter for a visitor.
qs.answer: Read it at home first, since one page recasts the whole district.
qs.why: Sarannya jelas: beli sebelum tiba dan baca di rumah, sebab satu paragraf tentang gudang yang miring ke laut menata ulang seluruh kawasan bagi pengunjung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “read it …”, jadi waktu dan tempatnya yang diuji. Membaca sesudah kunjungan membalik nasihat “Read at home” yang mendahului perjalanan. Kios stasiun justru ditolak: “purchase it before arrival rather than at the station kiosk”. Dan tarif kapal disebut udah salah, bukan berubah tiap bulan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The guide devotes far more space to the streets than to the past."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The guide devotes far more space to the streets than to the past.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Its history occupies four pages, and the rest belongs to the pavement.
qs.why: Sejarah cuma empat halaman dan sisanya soal jalanan, jadi klaim ini parafrasa yang tepat dan kuncinya True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena perbandingannya nggak dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena porsi halaman disebut jelas.

topic: review of a walking guidebook for an old port quarter
author: book review for a travel supplement
setting: the old port quarter covered by a new walking guidebook

title: The Problem Is Not the Length of the Video
text:
Every term I am told that short videos have destroyed the attention of the young, and every term the pupils in my library disprove it. The same fifteen-year-old who abandons a page after four lines will watch a two-hour repair video without moving. Something is occurring, but it is not a simple loss of patience.

What the short clip has altered is the cost of leaving. A film in a hall or a chapter in a novel makes departure awkward. A video that offers a replacement every three seconds makes staying an active decision. Pupils are therefore learning to judge material within moments, and they judge accurately. The trouble is that the skill they are developing is selection rather than endurance. When a text rewards patience slowly, as history and mathematics both do, that skill misfires. Our reading survey revealed that pupils who described themselves as heavy clip watchers were no worse at reading, yet they abandoned unfamiliar texts twice as often.

So I do not seek a ban, which schools cannot enforce and which teaches nothing. I want the difficulty named out loud. Tell a class that the first four pages of a novel are deliberately slow, and many of them will hold on. Deprived of that warning, they read the slowness as failure and go elsewhere. The attention is intact; what has vanished is the assumption that boredom might be a promise.
qs: What is the writer's purpose in this column?
To show that talk of lost patience among the young is exaggerated.
To rename the problem as a habit of leaving, not lost attention.
To ask that libraries limit clip watching during school hours.
To show why history and mathematics repay a patient reader.

qs.evidence: Something is occurring, but it is not a simple loss of patience.
qs.answer: To rename the problem as a habit of leaving, not lost attention.
qs.why: Penulis menolak dua penjelasan sekaligus: “Something is occurring, but it is not a simple loss of patience”, dan yang berubah adalah “the cost of leaving”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “to show/ask …” dan semuanya sikap yang wajar dalam perdebatan ini, jadi teks yang memblokir. Penulis nggak bilang perubahannya dibesar-besarkan; ia bilang ada yang benar-benar berubah, hanya bukan kesabaran. Pembatasan klip ia tolak sendiri: “I do not seek a ban.” Dan sejarah serta matematika dipakai sebagai contoh teks yang lambat berbalas, bukan pokok bahasan.

qs: Which result from the school's reading survey supports the writer's claim that attention is intact?
heavy clip watchers read no worse, yet abandoned unfamiliar texts twice as often
heavy clip watchers read a good deal worse than the other pupils
pupils who watched few clips abandoned unfamiliar texts twice as often
heavy clip watchers finished unfamiliar texts as often as familiar ones

qs.evidence: Our reading survey revealed that pupils who described themselves as heavy clip watchers were no worse at reading, yet they abandoned unfamiliar texts twice as often.
qs.answer: heavy clip watchers read no worse, yet abandoned unfamiliar texts twice as often
qs.why: Hasil survei ini persis menopang tesisnya: kemampuan membaca nggak turun, yang berubah adalah kesediaan bertahan pada teks baru — soal biaya meninggalkan, bukan soal perhatian.
qs.whyOthersFail: Survei menyebut mereka “no worse at reading”, jadi opsi kedua membalik hasil. Angka dua kali lebih sering meninggalkan teks milik penonton klip berat, bukan kelompok yang sedikit menonton. Dan opsi terakhir menghapus temuan intinya, karena teks baru justru yang paling sering ditinggalkan.

qs: How does the writer contrast a novel with a short video?
Leaving a novel costs nothing, while leaving a clip feels awkward.
Leaving a novel feels awkward, while leaving a clip costs nothing.
Leaving a novel feels awkward, while staying with a clip is automatic.
Leaving a novel feels awkward, while leaving a clip needs a decision.

qs.evidence: A film in a hall or a chapter in a novel makes departure awkward. A video that offers a replacement every three seconds makes staying an active decision.
qs.answer: Leaving a novel feels awkward, while leaving a clip costs nothing.
qs.why: Kontrasnya dibangun di sekitar biaya untuk pergi: bab novel membuat kepergian terasa canggung, sedangkan video yang menawarkan pengganti tiap tiga detik membuat “staying an active decision”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tiga opsi memakai paruh pertama yang sama, jadi paruh keduanya yang diuji. Arahnya nggak boleh dibalik: yang canggung ditinggalkan adalah novel, bukan klip. Dan pada klip, yang menuntut keputusan aktif adalah bertahan, bukan pergi — karena itu bertahan justru nggak berlangsung otomatis.

qs: What does the writer imply teachers should do about slow openings?
Choose novels whose first pages move much more quickly.
Let pupils close a text once they have judged it.
Say in advance that the slow start is meant to be slow.
Show that a slow opening can be skipped safely.

qs.evidence: Tell a class that the first four pages of a novel are deliberately slow, and many of them will hold on.
qs.answer: Say in advance that the slow start is meant to be slow.
qs.why: Penulis memberi contohnya sendiri: beri tahu kelas bahwa empat halaman pertama sebuah novel sengaja lambat, “and many of them will hold on”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk perintah pendek kepada guru dan semuanya terdengar masuk akal, jadi teks yang memblokir. Mengganti novel dan melewati bagian awal sama-sama menghapus bagian lambat itu, padahal penulis justru minta bagian itu dinamai lebih dulu. Membiarkan murid menutup teks juga berlawanan dengan tujuannya: “many of them will hold on”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Pupils at the school watch about three hours of short videos each day."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Pupils at the school watch about three hours of short videos each day.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The same fifteen-year-old who abandons a page after four lines will watch a two-hour repair video without moving.
qs.why: Teks menyebut satu video dua jam sebagai contoh, tapi nggak pernah memberi jumlah jam menonton klip per hari. Kuantitasnya nggak disebut, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh angka harian yang nggak ada. "False" juga salah karena teks nggak membantah angka itu; ia cuma nggak mengukurnya.

topic: opinion on short videos and young viewers attention
author: opinion column by a secondary school librarian
setting: a school where pupils discuss their video habits

title: What Actually Brings Donors Back
text:
A district blood service has published the results of an experiment on repeat donation, and the findings unsettle a familiar assumption. Campaign posters usually appeal to duty. The service wanted to know whether duty is what actually brings a donor back a second time.

Four thousand first-time donors were divided into three groups. One group received a message thanking them and stating that their unit had been used within nine days. The second received a reminder of the district's continuing shortage. The third received nothing beyond the standard card. Sixteen weeks later, the first group had returned at almost twice the rate of the third, while the shortage reminder produced no measurable effect at all. Because the three groups were similar in age and occupation, the difference is unlikely to be an accident of sampling.

The authors interpret the result cautiously, and their explanation seems sound to me. A shortage message tells a donor that the problem is endless, whereas a use message tells her that her own contribution finished a job. Duty may bring somebody in the first time; evidence of effect brings her back. If that is right, the campaign posters in every clinic corridor are addressing the wrong moment. The money spent on them would be better spent on nine hundred short messages telling donors where their blood went.
qs: Taken together, what does this experiment establish about repeat donation?
The shortage reminder produced no measurable effect at all.
Duty is what brings a donor through the door the first time.
Poster money would be better spent on short messages.
Donors come back when told their own unit finished a job.

qs.evidence: Duty may bring somebody in the first time; evidence of effect brings her back.
qs.answer: Donors come back when told their own unit finished a job.
qs.why: Penulis laporan merumuskannya sendiri: kewajiban bisa membawa orang datang pertama kali, tetapi “evidence of effect brings her back” — kelompok yang diberi tahu kantongnya terpakai kembali hampir dua kali lipat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah pernyataan nyata dari laporan percobaan ini, tetapi masing-masing hasil sampingan, catatan metode, atau usul anggaran, bukan simpulannya. Pesan kekurangan tanpa efek adalah pembanding. Kesamaan usia dan pekerjaan adalah alasan hasilnya bukan kebetulan. Pengalihan dana poster ada di kalimat penutup. Simpulannya berbunyi "Duty may bring somebody in the first time; evidence of effect brings her back". Opsi kedua juga berbentuk rangkuman dan memang tertulis, tetapi ia menerangkan kunjungan pertama; percobaan ini menguji kunjungan kedua.

qs: Taken together, what did the first group of donors receive?
Thanks and word that their blood reached a patient in nine days.
Thanks together with a warning that the district shortage was continuing.
A standard card and nothing else during the sixteen weeks.
A reminder sent nine weeks after their first donation.

qs.evidence: One group received a message thanking them and stating that their unit had been used within nine days.
qs.answer: Thanks and word that their blood reached a patient in nine days.
qs.why: Kelompok pertama dapat ucapan terima kasih plus keterangan bahwa kantongnya terpakai dalam sembilan hari.
qs.whyOthersFail: Peringatan kelangkaan adalah pesan kelompok kedua, dan kartu biasa tanpa tambahan adalah kelompok ketiga. Angka sembilan mengacu pada hari, bukan pekan; enam belas pekan adalah jarak pengukuran hasil.

qs: How did the three groups differ in their rate of return?
Both of the message groups came back more often than the card group.
The shortage group came back twice as often as the others.
Only the use-message group came back more than the card group.
All three groups came back at about the same rate.

qs.evidence: Sixteen weeks later, the first group had returned at almost twice the rate of the third, while the shortage reminder produced no measurable effect at all.
qs.answer: Only the use-message group came back more than the card group.
qs.why: Hasilnya dipisahkan tajam: enam belas pekan kemudian kelompok pertama kembali hampir dua kali lipat kelompok ketiga, sedangkan pesan kelangkaan nggak menghasilkan efek terukur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk perbandingan tiga kelompok yang sama, jadi angka teks yang memblokir. Karena pesan kelangkaan nggak menaikkan apa pun, kedua kelompok berpesan nggak bisa sama-sama naik dan kelompok kelangkaan nggak mungkin dua kali lipat. Dan ketiga kelompok jelas nggak setara hasilnya: selisih kelompok pertama dan ketiga hampir dua kali.

qs: Which conclusion about corridor posters does the three-group experiment lead the authors to?
posters reach first-time givers rather than donors weighing a return
posters work only when they mention the district's shortage
posters bring donors back at about twice the usual rate
posters fail because an appeal to duty keeps newcomers away

qs.evidence: Duty may bring somebody in the first time; evidence of effect brings her back.
qs.answer: posters reach first-time givers rather than donors weighing a return
qs.why: Kelompok yang diberi kabar pemakaian darahnya balik hampir dua kali lipat, sedangkan pengingat kelangkaan nggak berefek; simpulannya “Duty may bring somebody in the first time; evidence of effect brings her back”, jadi poster kewajiban bicara di momen yang salah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pengingat kelangkaan “produced no measurable effect at all”, jadi menyebut kelangkaan bukan yang bikin poster bekerja. Angka hampir dua kali lipat milik kelompok pesan pemakaian, bukan poster. Dan kewajiban nggak menjauhkan pendatang baru — teks justru bilang kewajiban bisa membawa orang datang pertama kali.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The three groups of donors differed sharply in age and in the work they did."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The three groups of donors differed sharply in age and in the work they did.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Because the three groups were similar in age and occupation, the difference is unlikely to be an accident of sampling.
qs.why: Teks bilang ketiga kelompok mirip umur dan pekerjaannya, jadi klaim "berbeda tajam" membalik pernyataan itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena polaritasnya dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena kesamaan kelompok disebut untuk membela hasil.

topic: study of repeat blood donation in a district campaign
author: popular research report for a health service newsletter
setting: a district blood service running donation drives

title: Two Ways to Pay for a Festival
text:
Two villages an hour apart celebrate the identical harvest festival yet finance it in opposite ways. One sells naming rights to a telephone company and a fertilizer dealer. The other collects a modest levy from every household and declines outside money. Both festivals occurred last month, and the contrast rewards a comparison.

The sponsored festival is plainly richer. It hired a sound system, printed a schedule and paid three troupes from the provincial capital. Attendance was roughly four thousand, and nobody had to be asked for a contribution. The levy festival raised about a tenth of that budget and used volunteers throughout. Yet its programme contained six local forms that the sponsored village has not performed since 2016, including the long procession that sponsors consider too slow for photographs. The sponsored village, meanwhile, has an audience its neighbour cannot match, and audiences keep traditions alive as surely as committees do.

My own view is that the two villages are buying different things and should admit it. Sponsorship buys scale and comfort at the price of editing. The levy buys control at the price of reach, and control is worth little if only three hundred people watch. A sensible compromise exists: accept sponsorship for the stage and the lighting, but keep the running order in the hands of the households. Whoever chooses the programme owns the festival, whatever the banners say.
qs: Taken together, what point does the writer make about the two festivals?
Each way of paying buys something the other village gives up.
The sponsored village paid three troupes from the provincial capital.
The levy programme held six forms unperformed since 2016.
Audiences keep traditions alive as surely as committees do.

qs.evidence: My own view is that the two villages are buying different things and should admit it.
qs.answer: Each way of paying buys something the other village gives up.
qs.why: Penulis menyebut pendiriannya: kedua desa “are buying different things and should admit it” — sponsor membeli skala dengan harga penyuntingan, iuran membeli kendali dengan harga jangkauan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah keterangan nyata dari paragraf kedua kolom ini, tetapi masing-masing satu butir perbandingan, bukan pokoknya. Tiga sanggar dari ibu kota provinsi adalah bukti kemewahan festival bersponsor. Enam bentuk yang tak dipentaskan sejak 2016 adalah keunggulan festival iuran. Kalimat tentang penonton yang menjaga tradisi adalah pengakuan sebelah untuk desa bersponsor. Pokoknya berbunyi "the two villages are buying different things and should admit it".

qs: Taken together, what did the sponsored village spend its money on?
Volunteers, six older dance forms and one very long procession.
A sound system, a levy collector and two provincial troupes.
Amplification, a printed programme and troupes from the capital.
Banners, naming rights and a photographer from the provincial capital.

qs.evidence: It hired a sound system, printed a schedule and paid three troupes from the provincial capital.
qs.answer: Amplification, a printed programme and troupes from the capital.
qs.why: Uangnya dipakai untuk tata suara sewaan, jadwal cetak, dan tiga sanggar dari ibu kota provinsi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Relawan, enam bentuk lokal, dan prosesi panjang adalah ciri desa beriuran. Sanggar yang dibayar ada tiga, bukan dua, dan nggak ada penarik iuran di desa bersponsor; hak penamaan adalah sumber dananya, bukan belanjanya.

qs: What advantage does the article say the levy festival has?
It drew about four thousand people to its harvest programme.
It still performs six older items its neighbour has dropped.
It spent about ten times as much on stage equipment.
It paid three troupes from the provincial capital to appear.

qs.evidence: Yet its programme contained six local forms that the sponsored village has not performed since 2016, including the long procession that sponsors consider too slow for photographs.
qs.answer: It still performs six older items its neighbour has dropped.
qs.why: Kelebihan festival beriuran disebut di kalimat “Yet”: acaranya memuat enam bentuk lokal yang desa bersponsor nggak pernah pentaskan sejak 2016, termasuk prosesi panjang itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “it …” dan semuanya keunggulan yang mungkin bagi sebuah festival, jadi teks yang memblokir. Empat ribu penonton dan tiga sanggar bayaran dari ibu kota provinsi milik desa bersponsor. Anggaran festival beriuran justru sekitar sepersepuluh, bukan sepuluh kali, dan acaranya memakai relawan sepanjang jalan.

qs: What does the writer mean by saying sponsorship involves editing?
Sponsors quietly decide which items are worth putting on stage.
Sponsors quietly pay for the printed programme and the sound system.
Sponsors quietly leave the running order to the households.
Sponsors quietly ask for their banners to appear in photographs.

qs.evidence: Sponsorship buys scale and comfort at the price of editing.
qs.answer: Sponsors quietly decide which items are worth putting on stage.
qs.why: Kata “editing” dijelaskan oleh contohnya: prosesi panjang dianggap sponsor “too slow for photographs” dan enam bentuk lokal hilang dari acara desa bersponsor.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “sponsors quietly …”, jadi arti “editing” yang diuji. Membayari tata suara dan jadwal cetak adalah “scale and comfort” yang dibeli sponsor, bukan penyuntingan acara. Menyerahkan susunan acara kepada warga adalah kompromi yang penulis usulkan, jadi kebalikan sikap sponsor. Dan permintaan memotret spanduk nggak pernah disebut teks.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The village funded by households ran its festival without paid workers."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The village funded by households ran its festival without paid workers.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The levy festival raised about a tenth of that budget and used volunteers throughout.
qs.why: "Used volunteers throughout" sama artinya dengan berjalan tanpa pekerja bayaran. Jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada proposisi yang ditukar. "Not stated" salah karena pemakaian relawan disebut terang.

topic: comparison of sponsor-funded and household-funded village festivals
author: comparison article for a regional heritage magazine
setting: two neighbouring villages funding annual harvest festivals

title: Letter to the Mill: Dust on the Southern Lane
text:
We write as the committee representing the ninety households of the southern lane, which lies directly downwind of your saw shed. Our purpose is to describe a measurable problem and to propose a specific remedy. We have deliberately avoided the language of complaint. We would much prefer an agreement to a dispute.

Since the second saw line opened in March, wood dust has settled on the lane every working day. Two of our members recorded the deposit on identical glass plates for eight weeks. The plate nearest your fence collected roughly five times the dust of the plate at the far end of the lane. Three families have relocated their drying racks indoors. The primary school has since closed the windows on that side. We accept that the mill provides work for many of our own households, and we are not asking for the second line to be shut.

We request two measures and one commitment. First, the extraction hood over the second line should be fitted with the filter your engineer described to us in April. Second, the yard should be dampened before the afternoon shift, when the wind strengthens. Our commitment is to continue the plate readings and to publish them monthly, whatever they show. If the readings fall, your neighbours will know it; if they do not, we shall have a shared record rather than an argument about impressions.
qs: Why has the committee written to the mill?
To ask that the second saw line stop until a filter arrives.
To record that the mill has ignored its engineer since April.
To claim payment for the drying racks three families moved indoors.
To set out dust readings and ask for two practical changes.

qs.evidence: Our purpose is to describe a measurable problem and to propose a specific remedy.
qs.answer: To set out dust readings and ask for two practical changes.
qs.why: Surat menyebut maksudnya di paragraf pertama: menggambarkan masalah yang terukur dan mengusulkan obat yang spesifik, lalu meminta dua tindakan dan satu komitmen.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “to …” dan semuanya langkah yang wajar bagi warga yang terkena debu, jadi teks yang memblokir. Penutupan lini kedua ditolak surat sendiri: “we are not asking for the second line to be shut.” Insinyur pabrik disebut menjelaskan filter pada April, jadi bukan diabaikan. Dan ganti rugi rak jemuran nggak pernah diminta.

qs: Taken together, what did two members of the association do for eight weeks?
They counted the working days on which the second saw line ran.
They asked ninety households to note the wind direction daily.
They photographed the lane at the same hour every afternoon.
They measured how much dust landed on matching glass plates.

qs.evidence: Two of our members recorded the deposit on identical glass plates for eight weeks.
qs.answer: They measured how much dust landed on matching glass plates.
qs.why: Dua anggota mencatat endapan debu di lempeng kaca yang sama jenisnya selama delapan pekan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Yang dilakukan dua anggota adalah mencatat endapan pada lempeng kaca sejenis selama delapan pekan. Angka sembilan puluh adalah jumlah rumah tangga yang diwakili komite, arah angin hanya disebut menguat sore hari, dan nggak ada pemotretan harian.

qs: Which finding does the letter give as proof that the dust comes from the mill?
Dust has settled along the whole lane on every working day.
Deposits near the boundary were several times heavier than further away.
Three of the families have moved all their drying racks indoors permanently.
The school has closed the windows on the side facing the mill.

qs.evidence: The plate nearest your fence collected roughly five times the dust of the plate at the far end of the lane.
qs.answer: Deposits near the boundary were several times heavier than further away.
qs.why: Yang menunjuk sumber adalah perbandingan dua lempeng sejenis: yang paling dekat pagar pabrik menampung sekitar lima kali debu lempeng di ujung jauh jalan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah temuan yang benar-benar ada di surat, jadi pemblokirnya adalah apa yang dibuktikan tiap temuan. Debu yang mengendap tiap hari kerja membuktikan ada debu, bukan asalnya. Rak jemuran yang dipindah dan jendela sekolah yang ditutup membuktikan dampak. Hanya selisih antar-lempeng yang menunjuk arah datangnya debu.

qs: Why does the committee promise to publish its readings whatever they show?
To prove the committee measures dust more carefully than the mill.
To press the school into reopening the windows on that side.
To leave both sides one record instead of competing impressions.
To keep the ninety households informed about the filter's cost.

qs.evidence: If the readings fall, your neighbours will know it; if they do not, we shall have a shared record rather than an argument about impressions.
qs.answer: To leave both sides one record instead of competing impressions.
qs.why: Kalimat penutup menyebut alasannya: kalau angkanya turun tetangga akan tahu, kalau nggak, kedua pihak tetap punya catatan bersama alih-alih “an argument about impressions”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “to …” dan semuanya alasan yang masuk akal untuk menerbitkan angka, jadi teks yang memblokir. Komite nggak pernah membandingkan ketelitiannya dengan pengukuran pabrik. Jendela sekolah disebut sebagai akibat debu, bukan tujuan penerbitan. Dan biaya filter nggak pernah dibahas surat ini.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The dust problem began when the mill opened its first saw line."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The dust problem began when the mill opened its first saw line.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Since the second saw line opened in March, wood dust has settled on the lane every working day.
qs.why: Surat menyebut masalahnya muncul sejak lini gergaji kedua dibuka pada Maret, jadi klaim soal lini pertama menukar pelakunya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena lininya ditukar. "Not stated" salah karena awal masalah disebut jelas di paragraf kedua.

topic: formal letter from residents about wood dust from a mill
author: formal letter from a residents association committee
setting: a residential lane beside a plywood mill

title: Keep the Parents on the Touchline
text:
The district has offered our small football club a qualified coach for two afternoons a week, and the committee is delighted. I am not, although my reason has nothing to do with quality. The offer arrives with a condition: the parents who currently run the sessions would step back. That condition is the whole difficulty.

Consider the effect on the club. A visiting coach improves technique, and nobody sensible denies it. Yet a coach who arrives at four and leaves at six cannot notice that a boy has stopped speaking to his brother. The parents on the touchline are unqualified, inconsistent and occasionally embarrassing, but they are permanent. When rain cancelled sessions for three weeks in February, it was two fathers who telephoned every family. A district timetable, however professional, produces attendance rather than attachment.

The sensible arrangement is obvious and slightly awkward to negotiate. Accept the coach for one afternoon, keep the parents on the other, and let the coach spend an hour a month teaching them what he knows. Skill can be transferred; belonging cannot be delivered by timetable. If the district insists that its coach works alone, the committee should politely decline the offer. A club with worse passing and forty children who feel expected is stronger than a club with neither.
qs: What is the writer trying to persuade the committee to do?
Take the visiting coach for the whole week and thank the district.
Take the visiting coach for the whole week and ask for later hours.
Take the visiting coach for half the week and leave the rest unchanged.
Turn the visiting coach down, since belonging matters more than technique.

qs.evidence: Accept the coach for one afternoon, keep the parents on the other, and let the coach spend an hour a month teaching them what he knows.
qs.answer: Take the visiting coach for half the week and leave the rest unchanged.
qs.why: Usul penulis dirinci: terima pelatih untuk satu sore, pertahankan orang tua di sore yang lain, dan minta pelatih mengajari mereka sejam sebulan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “take/turn the visiting coach …”, jadi cakupannya yang diuji. Mengambil pelatih untuk sepekan penuh berarti memenuhi syarat distrik bahwa orang tua mundur, dan syarat itulah “the whole difficulty”. Jam kerja pelatih nggak pernah diminta diperpanjang. Dan menolak tawaran hanya ia sarankan sebagai cadangan, “if the district insists that its coach works alone”.

qs: Taken together, what condition arrived with the district's offer?
The parents now running the sessions would have to withdraw.
The club would pay for one of the two coaching afternoons.
The parents would take an hour of training every month.
The sessions would have to run from four until six.

qs.evidence: The offer arrives with a condition: the parents who currently run the sessions would step back.
qs.answer: The parents now running the sessions would have to withdraw.
qs.why: Syaratnya cuma satu: orang tua yang sekarang menjalankan latihan harus mundur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Syarat yang disebut cuma satu: orang tua yang kini menjalankan latihan harus mundur. Biaya nggak pernah disinggung, satu jam latihan untuk orang tua adalah usulan penulis, dan jam empat sampai enam adalah gambaran kedatangan pelatih, bukan syarat.

qs: Which incident does the writer use to show what parents provide?
Forty children kept turning up through the whole of February.
When rain stopped play, parents rang round the whole club themselves.
The coach stayed past six o'clock on the wettest afternoons of February.
A parent noticed a boy had stopped speaking to his brother.

qs.evidence: When rain cancelled sessions for three weeks in February, it was two fathers who telephoned every family.
qs.answer: When rain stopped play, parents rang round the whole club themselves.
qs.why: Contoh yang dipakai penulis satu: ketika hujan membatalkan latihan tiga pekan pada Februari, dua ayahlah yang menelepon setiap keluarga.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk kejadian di klub kecil yang sama-sama masuk akal, jadi teks yang memblokir. Februari justru bulan latihan batal tiga pekan, jadi bukan bulan anak-anak tetap datang. Pelatih tamu belum bekerja di klub, dan teks menyebut ia datang jam empat dan pergi jam enam. Anak yang berhenti bicara dengan kakaknya adalah contoh hal yang pelatih dua jam nggak akan sempat lihat, bukan kejadian yang dilaporkan.

qs: What does the writer mean by contrasting attendance with attachment?
A timetable records absences better than a group of parents.
A timetable brings children more regularly than volunteers manage.
A timetable matters more to parents than any coaching skill.
A timetable fills a session but cannot make children feel expected.

qs.evidence: A district timetable, however professional, produces attendance rather than attachment.
qs.answer: A timetable fills a session but cannot make children feel expected.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menyebut hasil yang dibedakan: jadwal distrik, sekaligus profesional, “produces attendance rather than attachment” — anak datang, tapi rasa ditunggu nggak lahir dari jadwal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “a timetable …” dan semuanya klaim yang wajar soal jadwal resmi, jadi teks yang memblokir. Pencatatan absen nggak pernah dibahas. Kenaikan kehadiran karena pelatih profesional juga nggak diklaim; yang diklaim adalah kehadiran tanpa keterikatan. Dan orang tua digambarkan justru bukan penjaga angka: kekuatan mereka “they are permanent”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer admits that a visiting coach would raise the players' technical level."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer admits that a visiting coach would raise the players' technical level.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A visiting coach improves technique, and nobody sensible denies it.
qs.why: Penulis mengakui pelatih tamu memperbaiki teknik, jadi klaim ini parafrasa pengakuan itu dan kuncinya True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada yang dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena pengakuan itu tertulis di paragraf kedua.

topic: opinion on parent coaches versus a visiting district coach
author: opinion column by a neighbourhood club committee member
setting: a neighbourhood football club coached by parents

title: Who Actually Rides the Shared Bicycles
text:
The shared bicycle scheme in this town was justified by an argument about traffic, and a new study has tested it. Planners predicted that riders would abandon motorbikes. Researchers followed 600 registered users for five months and matched their trips against their previous habits.

The result is awkward for the original argument. Only 14 per cent of shared bicycle journeys replaced a motorbike trip. Nearly half replaced a walk, and a quarter replaced a ride on a minibus. Because walking produces no emissions, that substitution weakens the scheme's environmental case considerably. The pattern arises from where the docking points stand: fourteen of the twenty sit inside a single flat district that was already walkable. Users living on the hill, who own most of the town's motorbikes, reported that the nearest dock was too far to be convenient.

The authors do not recommend closing the scheme, and neither would I. Their argument is that its stated purpose should be corrected or its map redrawn. Moving six docks to the hill would test the traffic claim honestly for the first time. Leaving the docks where they are is defensible too, provided the town stops describing the bicycles as a measure against motorbike traffic. A scheme judged by the wrong promise will be called a failure even when it is useful.
qs: Taken together, what does this five-month study conclude about the bicycle scheme?
The scheme is useful, but not for the reason it was sold.
Nearly half of the journeys replaced a walk rather than a motorbike.
Where the docks stand, rather than the fare, decides who rides.
Moving six docks uphill could test the traffic claim honestly.

qs.evidence: Their argument is that its stated purpose should be corrected or its map redrawn.
qs.answer: The scheme is useful, but not for the reason it was sold.
qs.why: Kesimpulannya dua sisi: skema itu tetap berguna, tapi janji resminya salah — maka tujuannya harus dikoreksi atau petanya digambar ulang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah temuan nyata dari kajian ini, tetapi masing-masing satu angka atau satu usul, bukan simpulannya. Setengah perjalanan yang menggantikan jalan kaki adalah bukti. Empat belas dari dua puluh titik parkir adalah penjelasan sebab pola itu. Pemindahan enam titik ke bukit adalah usul yang, kata penulis, hanya salah satu dari dua jalan sah. Simpulannya berbunyi "its stated purpose should be corrected or its map redrawn". Opsi ketiga berbentuk rangkuman pula, tetapi letak titik parkir adalah sebab pola penggantian, bukan putusan yang ditarik kajian ini tentang tujuan skema.

qs: Taken together, what did the researchers do during the five months?
They tracked 600 users and compared new trips with their old ones.
They counted the motorbikes passing fourteen of the twenty docks.
They asked hill residents why they preferred to walk to work.
They recorded the emissions saved on each bicycle journey.

qs.evidence: Researchers followed 600 registered users for five months and matched their trips against their previous habits.
qs.answer: They tracked 600 users and compared new trips with their old ones.
qs.why: Selama lima bulan mereka mengikuti 600 pengguna terdaftar dan mencocokkan perjalanan baru dengan kebiasaan lama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Metodenya mengikuti 600 pengguna terdaftar lima bulan dan mencocokkan perjalanan baru dengan kebiasaan lama. Angka empat belas dari dua puluh adalah letak dok, emisi hanya disebut sebagai penalaran, dan warga bukit melapor soal jarak dok, bukan alasan berjalan kaki.

qs: How do the replaced journeys compare with what planners expected?
Most journeys came from minibuses, not from walks or motorbikes.
Journeys came about equally from walks and from motorbike trips.
Most journeys came from walks, far fewer from motorbike trips.
Most journeys came from motorbikes, just as the planners predicted.

qs.evidence: Nearly half replaced a walk, and a quarter replaced a ride on a minibus.
qs.answer: Most journeys came from walks, far fewer from motorbike trips.
qs.why: Angkanya berjenjang jelas: hampir setengah perjalanan menggantikan jalan kaki, seperempat menggantikan minibus, dan hanya 14 persen menggantikan motor.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka perbandingan sumber perjalanan yang sama, jadi angka teks yang memblokir. Minibus hanya seperempat, jadi bukan yang terbanyak. Jalan kaki hampir setengah melawan motor 14 persen, jadi jauh dari seimbang. Dan ramalan perencana bahwa pengendara meninggalkan motor justru nggak terbukti.

qs: Which conclusion about the traffic claim do the substitution figures and the dock map support?
the bicycles mostly replaced walking, so the traffic claim stays untested
the bicycles mostly replaced motorbike trips, as the planners predicted
the scheme should be closed because its environmental case has collapsed
hill residents ride most often because their nearest dock is close by

qs.evidence: Only 14 per cent of shared bicycle journeys replaced a motorbike trip.
qs.answer: the bicycles mostly replaced walking, so the traffic claim stays untested
qs.why: Cuma 14 persen perjalanan menggantikan motor sementara hampir separuh menggantikan jalan kaki, dan empat belas dari dua puluh dok berada di kawasan datar yang memang udah bisa dijalani — jadi klaim lalu lintasnya belum pernah benar-benar diuji.
qs.whyOthersFail: Angka 14 persen langsung membantah opsi kedua. Penulis laporan “do not recommend closing the scheme”, jadi opsi ketiga bertentangan dengan teks. Dan penghuni bukit melapor bahwa “the nearest dock was too far to be convenient”, kebalikan dari opsi terakhir.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Riders pay a monthly fee to use the shared bicycles in the town."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Riders pay a monthly fee to use the shared bicycles in the town.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The shared bicycle scheme in this town was justified by an argument about traffic, and a new study has tested it.
qs.why: Teks menyebut pengguna terdaftar, tapi nggak sekali pun bicara soal biaya atau iuran bulanan. Nggak ada keterangan tarif, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh keterangan tarif yang nggak ada. "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal adanya iuran; ia diam soal itu.

topic: study of a shared bicycle scheme in a district town
author: popular research report for a transport planning bulletin
setting: a district town operating a shared bicycle scheme

title: A Volunteer Company Attempts a Difficult Play
text:
A company of volunteers chose one of the hardest plays in the repertoire for its autumn production, and the choice was braver than it was wise. The text requires eleven actors who can hold a silence. The company has seven, three of whom joined in August.

What they achieved is nevertheless remarkable in places. The set, built from borrowed scaffolding and grey cloth, turns a shallow stage into two rooms without a single wasted plank. The lighting, operated from a stepladder, is the best I have seen in this hall. The costumes, borrowed from a school store, were the one element that looked improvised. The second act, which depends on two characters saying almost nothing for twelve minutes, held an audience of ninety absolutely still. The first act did not: lines were rushed, entrances collided, and the difficult opening speech was delivered towards the wings.

So the honest verdict is mixed, and I offer it as encouragement rather than complaint. This company should not have attempted this play with seven actors and six weeks. It should attempt it again next autumn with nine actors and twelve weeks, because the second act proved the ambition was not misplaced. Volunteer theatre earns nothing by being praised indiscriminately. It earns a great deal by being told, accurately, which twelve minutes worked.
qs: Taken together, what assessment does the reviewer reach on this production?
A production reaching past its means, yet with real achievement in it.
The borrowed scaffolding set makes two rooms of a shallow stage.
The second act held ninety people still, though the first rushed.
It could try the play again with nine actors and twelve weeks.

qs.evidence: So the honest verdict is mixed, and I offer it as encouragement rather than complaint.
qs.answer: A production reaching past its means, yet with real achievement in it.
qs.why: Penilaiannya disebut “mixed” dan dirinci: pilihan lakon lebih berani daripada bijak dengan tujuh pemain, namun babak kedua dan tata cahayanya capaian nyata.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh betul-betul tertulis di paragraf kedua dan ketiga ulasan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu pujian, satu perbandingan babak, atau satu saran, bukan penilaian menyeluruhnya. Panggung dari perancah adalah satu keberhasilan teknis. Babak kedua berbanding babak pertama adalah bukti kesenjangannya. Sembilan pemain dan dua belas pekan adalah anjuran untuk tahun depan. Penilaiannya berbunyi "the honest verdict is mixed, and I offer it as encouragement rather than complaint".

qs: Taken together, what does the review say about the company's actors?
It fielded eleven actors, the number the text actually requires.
It fielded nine actors after twelve weeks of rehearsal.
It fielded seven actors who had all joined in the autumn.
It fielded a cast of seven, three of them recent newcomers.

qs.evidence: The company has seven, three of whom joined in August.
qs.answer: It fielded a cast of seven, three of them recent newcomers.
qs.why: Rombongan itu tampil dengan tujuh pemain, dan tiga di antaranya baru gabung pada Agustus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Sebelas adalah jumlah yang dituntut naskah, sedangkan sembilan pemain dan dua belas pekan adalah usul untuk tahun depan. Rombongan itu punya tujuh pemain dan hanya tiga yang baru masuk, dan masuknya pada Agustus.

qs: Which detail does the reviewer give as proof of what the company can do?
A wordless stretch of act two kept the whole hall motionless.
The borrowed school costumes fitted the play better than expected.
The set was built new from timber bought for the run.
Three newcomers learned their parts in only six weeks together.

qs.evidence: The second act, which depends on two characters saying almost nothing for twelve minutes, held an audience of ninety absolutely still.
qs.answer: A wordless stretch of act two kept the whole hall motionless.
qs.why: Bukti kemampuan yang penulis pakai satu: babak kedua yang bergantung pada dua tokoh nyaris tanpa kata selama dua belas menit membuat sembilan puluh penonton diam sama sekali.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk keterangan produksi yang sama-sama terdengar seperti pujian, jadi teks yang memblokir. Kostum pinjaman gudang sekolah justru “the one element that looked improvised”. Setnya dibangun dari perancah pinjaman dan kain kelabu, bukan kayu beli baru. Dan tiga pemain baru masuk Agustus tanpa satu pun pujian atas kecepatan hafalan mereka.

qs: Which statement best restates the reviewer's closing point?
Volunteer companies gain from praise whenever they take on hard work.
Volunteer companies gain from choosing easier plays until the cast has grown larger.
Volunteer companies gain from reviews that stay short and kind.
Volunteer companies gain from exact judgement, not from indiscriminate praise.

qs.evidence: It earns a great deal by being told, accurately, which twelve minutes worked.
qs.answer: Volunteer companies gain from exact judgement, not from indiscriminate praise.
qs.why: Dua kalimat penutup saling melengkapi: teater relawan nggak memperoleh apa pun dari pujian tanpa pandang bulu, dan banyak sekali dari diberi tahu secara tepat bagian mana yang berhasil.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “volunteer companies gain from …”, jadi isi penutupnya yang diuji. Pujian sekadar karena mencoba hal sulit persis yang ditolak: “earns nothing by being praised indiscriminately”. Beralih ke lakon mudah bertentangan dengan anjuran mencoba lakon yang sama lagi. Dan panjang atau nada ulasan nggak pernah dibahas.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The reviewer advises the company never to stage this play again."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The reviewer advises the company never to stage this play again.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: It should attempt it again next autumn with nine actors and twelve weeks, because the second act proved the ambition was not misplaced.
qs.why: Teks justru menyarankan lakon itu dipentaskan lagi tahun depan dengan pemain dan waktu lebih banyak, jadi klaim ini kebalikannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena polaritas saran dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena saran mengulang pementasan disebut jelas.

topic: review of an amateur theatre production staged by volunteers
author: theatre review for a community arts page
setting: a community hall staging an amateur production

title: Count the Old Trees Before Planting New Ones
text:
Our city has promised to plant fifty thousand saplings, and the announcement was greeted with the applause such promises always receive. I would applaud too if the same month had not seen four mature trees removed from the market road. A planting figure is easy to celebrate. A felling figure is rarely published at all.

The arithmetic behind my objection is not complicated. A sapling planted this year gives almost no shade for a decade, and about a third of the last campaign's trees died within two summers. The four trees on the market road, by contrast, were cooling a bus stop and holding a bank of soil. They also supported birds that no sapling will attract for twenty years. Trading them for saplings is not a gain but a delay disguised as progress. Nobody counted what was lost, because nothing obliges anyone to count it.

So I want two lines added to the campaign, not the campaign cancelled. First, publish the number of mature trees felled beside the number planted, in the same document. Second, require a written reason whenever a tree above a certain girth is removed. Neither line costs money, and both would make the promise honest. Planting is a pleasure; protecting is a duty, and duties are what get quietly dropped.
qs: Taken together, what claim does this column build about the planting promise?
About a third of the last campaign's trees died within two summers.
The city should guard the trees it has, not just announce new ones.
Four market-road trees were cooling a bus stop and holding soil.
A written reason should be required before a large tree is removed.

qs.evidence: Trading them for saplings is not a gain but a delay disguised as progress.
qs.answer: The city should guard the trees it has, not just announce new ones.
qs.why: Inti keberatannya aritmetika perbandingan: menukar pohon dewasa dengan bibit “is not a gain but a delay disguised as progress”, jadi melindungi yang udah ada lebih penting daripada mengumumkan penanaman.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah pernyataan nyata dari kolom ini, tetapi masing-masing satu angka pendukung atau satu langkah teknis, bukan klaim pusatnya. Sepertiga pohon kampanye lalu yang mati adalah bahan hitungannya. Empat pohon di jalan pasar adalah contohnya. Kewajiban menulis alasan adalah baris kedua dari dua usul, bukan tesis yang menaunginya. Klaim pusatnya berbunyi "Trading them for saplings is not a gain but a delay disguised as progress".

qs: Which supporting detail strengthens the claim that saplings are a poor exchange for mature trees?
about a third of the last campaign's trees died within two summers
the four felled trees on the market road were replaced within the month
the last campaign's saplings gave useful shade within their first two summers
the city already publishes felling figures beside its planting figures

qs.evidence: A sapling planted this year gives almost no shade for a decade, and about a third of the last campaign's trees died within two summers.
qs.answer: about a third of the last campaign's trees died within two summers
qs.why: Angka kematian sepertiga itu yang bikin pertukarannya buruk: bibit baru butuh sepuluh tahun untuk memberi naungan, dan sebagian besarnya belum tentu selamat dua musim panas pertama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Nggak ada penggantian empat pohon di jalan pasar yang disebut teks — justru kehilangannya yang nggak dihitung. Bibit disebut “gives almost no shade for a decade”, jadi opsi ketiga bertentangan langsung. Dan angka penebangan belum diterbitkan sama sekali; penerbitan itu yang sedang diminta penulis.

qs: Which evidence does the writer give for the value of the four felled trees?
They sheltered wildlife while shading commuters and steadying the ground.
They had been standing beside the market road for several decades already.
They were thicker round the trunk than any rule allows.
They were cut down in the very month of the announcement.

qs.evidence: The four trees on the market road, by contrast, were cooling a bus stop and holding a bank of soil. They also supported birds that no sapling will attract for twenty years.
qs.answer: They sheltered wildlife while shading commuters and steadying the ground.
qs.why: Nilai keempat pohon itu dibuktikan lewat fungsinya: mendinginkan perhentian bus, menahan tebing tanah, dan menampung burung yang nggak akan didatangi bibit selama dua puluh tahun.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “they …” dan semuanya keterangan yang ada di teks, jadi pemblokirnya fungsi mana yang dijadikan bukti nilai. Umur pohon nggak pernah disebut angka. Ambang lingkar batang baru diusulkan sebagai aturan, jadi belum ada aturan yang dilampaui. Dan waktu penebangan membuktikan ironi pengumuman, bukan nilai pohonnya.

qs: Why does the writer say losses go unrecorded?
Because the city publishes planting figures only once each year.
Because mature trees are taken down at night, unseen by anyone.
Because nothing in the rules obliges anyone to write a felling down.
Because a third of the saplings died before anyone counted them.

qs.evidence: Nobody counted what was lost, because nothing obliges anyone to count it.
qs.answer: Because nothing in the rules obliges anyone to write a felling down.
qs.why: Sebabnya dinyatakan langsung: nggak ada yang menghitung kehilangan karena nggak ada apa pun yang mewajibkan siapa pun menghitungnya, sedangkan angka penebangan “is rarely published at all”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “because …” dan semuanya sebab administratif yang masuk akal, jadi teks yang memblokir. Angka penanaman justru diumumkan meriah, bukan setahun sekali diam-diam. Waktu penebangan nggak pernah disebut malam. Dan kematian sepertiga bibit milik kampanye sebelumnya, bukan alasan kehilangan tak tercatat.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer wants felling figures printed alongside planting figures."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer wants felling figures printed alongside planting figures.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: First, publish the number of mature trees felled beside the number planted, in the same document.
qs.why: Usul pertamanya memang menerbitkan jumlah pohon dewasa yang ditebang berdampingan dengan jumlah yang ditanam. Jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada proposisi yang dibalik. "Not stated" salah karena usul itu ditulis jelas.

topic: opinion on protecting mature trees rather than planting saplings
author: opinion column by a city parks volunteer
setting: a city announcing a large tree-planting campaign

title: Folk Tales on Air and on Demand
text:
The same body of folk tales now reaches this region through two very different channels, and the difference is not merely technical. The evening radio programme has told one story a week since 1994. The podcast series, begun three years ago, releases three episodes a month and keeps everything available.

Radio wins on discipline and on chance. A storyteller with seven minutes must cut, and the cutting produces versions that grandparents recognize from their own childhood. Listeners also encounter tales they did not choose, which is how anybody meets an unfamiliar story. The podcast wins on depth and on record: an episode may run forty minutes, include the storyteller's own explanation and preserve a dialect version beside a standard one. Against that, its listeners search for what they already know, so the strange tales are heard least. The archive is fuller, while the audience is narrower.

In my view the region needs both formats, and it needs them to talk to each other. The radio programme should announce which podcast episode extends the story it has just told. The podcast should let the radio hosts choose one episode a month, precisely because their taste is less predictable than a search box. Preservation without circulation becomes a locked cupboard. Circulation without preservation becomes a rumour that fades.
qs: Taken together, what does the writer conclude about radio and the podcast?
Both channels should stay, each steering its audience towards the rival.
A storyteller with seven minutes must cut, and the cutting helps.
A podcast episode may run forty minutes and keep a dialect version.
An archive matters less than the chance of meeting a strange tale.

qs.evidence: In my view the region needs both formats, and it needs them to talk to each other.
qs.answer: Both channels should stay, each steering its audience towards the rival.
qs.why: Penutupnya dua bagian: kawasan itu butuh kedua format dan butuh keduanya bicara satu sama lain — radio menyebut episode lanjutan, podcast menyerahkan satu episode sebulan pada penyiar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah keterangan nyata dari paragraf kedua tulisan ini, tetapi masing-masing satu keunggulan atau satu kelemahan satu saluran, bukan simpulannya. Tujuh menit yang memaksa memangkas adalah keunggulan radio. Episode empat puluh menit dengan versi dialek adalah keunggulan siniar. Pendengar yang mencari yang udah dikenal adalah kelemahan siniar. Simpulannya berbunyi "the region needs both formats, and it needs them to talk to each other". Opsi terakhir berbentuk simpulan, tetapi memihak satu saluran; tulisan ini menolak pemihakan itu dengan "Preservation without circulation becomes a locked cupboard. Circulation without preservation becomes a rumour that fades".

qs: Taken together, what does the article say about the podcast series?
Running since 1994, it broadcasts one story a week in the evening.
Begun three years ago, it takes each episode down after a month.
Newly started, it releases one forty-minute episode every month.
Barely three years old, it adds three instalments a month and drops none.

qs.evidence: The podcast series, begun three years ago, releases three episodes a month and keeps everything available.
qs.answer: Barely three years old, it adds three instalments a month and drops none.
qs.why: Podcast itu baru berumur tiga tahun, nambah tiga bagian tiap bulan, dan nggak ada yang dihapus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tahun 1994 dan satu cerita sepekan adalah program radio. Podcast justru menyimpan semuanya, jadi nggak ada episode yang dihapus, dan empat puluh menit adalah kemungkinan durasi, bukan jumlah episode per bulan.

qs: What does the article identify as radio's particular strength?
Long episodes that let a storyteller explain a tale fully.
Seven-minute limits that force cuts and unplanned encounters.
Dialect versions kept alongside versions in standard speech.
Free access to the stories a listener already remembers.

qs.evidence: A storyteller with seven minutes must cut, and the cutting produces versions that grandparents recognize from their own childhood.
qs.answer: Seven-minute limits that force cuts and unplanned encounters.
qs.why: Kekuatan radio disebut dua: pencerita dengan tujuh menit harus memotong sehingga lahir versi yang dikenali kakek-nenek, dan pendengar bertemu cerita yang nggak mereka pilih.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk frasa keunggulan format yang sejenis, jadi teks yang memblokir. Episode panjang empat puluh menit dengan penjelasan pencerita dan versi dialek yang tersimpan adalah keunggulan podcast, bukan radio. Akses bebas ke cerita yang udah dikenal juga milik podcast, dan justru dari situ “the strange tales are heard least”.

qs: Why does the writer want radio hosts to select a podcast episode?
Because they have run the evening programme since 1994.
Because they can record dialect versions of the older tales.
Because a human choice throws up stories nobody would look for.
Because their listeners seldom search for unfamiliar stories.

qs.evidence: The podcast should let the radio hosts choose one episode a month, precisely because their taste is less predictable than a search box.
qs.answer: Because a human choice throws up stories nobody would look for.
qs.why: Alasannya dinyatakan di kalimat usul itu: selera penyiar “less predictable than a search box”, sedangkan kotak pencarian hanya memberi apa yang udah dicari.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai pembuka “because …”, jadi alasan yang benar-benar ditulis yang memblokir. Umur program sejak 1994 dipakai menerangkan disiplin radio, bukan wewenang memilih episode. Perekaman versi dialek adalah kerja podcast. Dan yang jarang mencari cerita asing adalah pendengar podcast, bukan penyiar radio yang jadi alasan usul ini.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The radio programme has more listeners now than it had ten years ago."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The radio programme has more listeners now than it had ten years ago.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The evening radio programme has told one story a week since 1994.
qs.why: Teks menyebut umur program dan iramanya, tapi nggak pernah membandingkan jumlah pendengarnya antar waktu. Perbandingan itu nggak dibuat, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh data pendengar yang nggak ada. "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal kenaikan itu; ia nggak mengukurnya.

author: comparison feature for a media and heritage review
setting: a region where folk tales are broadcast and also published as podcasts

title: The Quiet Arrival of the Watching Camera
text:
Few shoppers pause at the small notice fixed beside the entrance, and fewer still read it. Yet in a growing number of retail centres, cameras no longer merely record; they measure faces and compare them against a privately held list. What is marketed to retailers as a defence against theft has quietly become an instrument for sorting the public. The change arrived without debate, and its defenders have relied on that silence rather more than they admit. A measure that would once have demanded a public argument now requires only a purchase order and a compliant landlord.

Supporters of the technology advance a reasonable case: retail staff face genuine risks, and a small minority of repeat offenders accounts for much of the loss. If recognition software can identify such a person at the door, the argument runs, everybody benefits. What the argument omits is the cost carried by the thousands of innocent faces measured every hour. Nothing in the design of these systems distinguishes a suspect from a customer buying milk. They are not suspects; they are merely the raw material of the method.

There remains the awkward question of authority. The lists are compiled by private security firms rather than by courts, and the standard of proof is whatever a firm finds convenient. A shopper wrongly included has no reliable route to discovering the fact, still less to having the entry deleted. Nor is there any independent body to which a complaint might sensibly be addressed. Errors of this kind are distributed unevenly, since such systems are documented as performing worse on darker and younger faces. A tool that fails hardest on those already watched most closely can hardly be described as neutral.

None of this requires that the cameras be removed tomorrow. It does require that the burden of justification rest with whoever installs them. Publish the rules, provide an appeal, delete what is unnecessary, and demonstrate that losses genuinely decline. Retailers who genuinely fear theft should welcome such tests, since a system that survives them commands a confidence mere assertion can never buy. Until those conditions are satisfied, shoppers are being asked to accept permanent inspection in exchange for a promise that nobody has audited. That is not security; it is convenience dressed as safety.
qs: Which best describes what the writer is doing in this piece?
arguing that the cameras should stop until the rules are published
arguing that the unequal error rate is the gravest of the costs described
arguing that a technology already installed must be made to prove itself
arguing that the entrance notice ought to be written so shoppers read it

qs.evidence: It does require that the burden of justification rest with whoever installs them.
qs.answer: arguing that a technology already installed must be made to prove itself
qs.why: Sinyal pengunci ada dua: "the burden of justification rest with whoever installs them" dan daftar tuntutan yang ditutup "demonstrate that losses genuinely decline". Alatnya udah dipasang; yang diminta penulis adalah pembuktian dari pihak yang memasangnya, bukan pencabutan dan bukan satu perbaikan tunggal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sama-sama berdiri di sisi penulis (curiga pada pengawasan itu), tapi salah derajat atau salah sasaran, dan masing-masing punya frasa pemblokir. Penghentian sementara sampai aturan diterbitkan salah DERAJAT: diblokir "None of this requires that the cameras be removed tomorrow", sebab penulis membiarkan kamera menyala selama syaratnya dikerjakan. Pemberatan pada tingkat galat yang tak merata salah SASARAN: diblokir "the cost carried by the thousands of innocent faces measured every hour" dan "they are merely the raw material of the method" — pengukurannya sendiri udah biaya, sedangkan galat tak merata dipakai hanya untuk menolak klaim netral, bukan diperingkat sebagai yang terberat. Perbaikan papan pemberitahuan salah CAKUPAN: diblokir daftar empat tuntutan "Publish the rules, provide an appeal, delete what is unnecessary, and demonstrate that losses genuinely decline", sedangkan papan di pintu cuma pembuka pengamatan.

qs: According to the piece, who decides whose face goes on the list?
security firms working outside any court process
courts applying a published standard of proof to each case
landlords who let the units in the retail centre
shop staff who report repeat offenders during a shift

qs.evidence: The lists are compiled by private security firms rather than by courts, and the standard of proof is whatever a firm finds convenient.
qs.answer: security firms working outside any court process
qs.why: Teks menyebut daftar itu disusun firma keamanan swasta, bukan pengadilan, dan standar buktinya ditentukan firma sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pengadilan justru disebut sebagai pihak yang NGGAK menyusun daftar itu; tuan tanah muncul hanya sebagai pihak yang menyetujui pemasangan kamera, bukan yang memutuskan nama; dan staf toko disebut sebagai pihak yang menghadapi risiko, tanpa peran apa pun dalam pencatatan.

qs: Which best describes the writer's attitude as the piece develops?
unpersuaded by the centres' case, yet not asking for the cameras to go
unpersuaded by the same case, yet content to leave appeals to the firms
troubled by the uneven errors, yet not pressing for losses to be shown
troubled by the small notice, yet easy about the measuring itself

qs.evidence: Until those conditions are satisfied, shoppers are being asked to accept permanent inspection in exchange for a promise that nobody has audited.
qs.answer: unpersuaded by the centres' case, yet not asking for the cameras to go
qs.why: Penutupnya menolak menuntut pencabutan ("None of this requires that the cameras be removed tomorrow") sekaligus menyebut "a promise that nobody has audited": nggak yakin pada pembelaan pusat perbelanjaan, tapi nggak meminta kameranya dibongkar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk yang sama — nggak yakin atau terusik, lalu menahan diri — sehingga bentuk opsi nggak lagi menunjuk kunci; pemilihnya adalah sasaran penahanan itu. Menyerahkan jalur banding kepada firma salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "provide an appeal" dan "Nor is there any independent body to which a complaint might sensibly be addressed". Nggak menuntut angka kerugian salah SASARAN juga: frasa pemblokirnya "demonstrate that losses genuinely decline". Ketenangan pada pengukurannya sendiri salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "the cost carried by the thousands of innocent faces measured every hour".

qs: What does the piece imply about the promise that losses will fall?
the reduction has been measured but never made public
nobody has yet shown that the losses actually fall
the firms keeping the lists may audit the figure, though rarely
retailers now admit the saving is smaller than claimed

qs.evidence: Publish the rules, provide an appeal, delete what is unnecessary, and demonstrate that losses genuinely decline.
qs.answer: nobody has yet shown that the losses actually fall
qs.why: Penurunan kerugian masih berdiri sebagai syarat yang harus dipenuhi ("demonstrate that losses genuinely decline"), dan syarat cuma diminta untuk hal yang belum ditunjukkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pengukuran yang disembunyikan diblokir frasa "a promise that nobody has audited" — bukan disimpan, memang belum ada; audit sesekali oleh firma penyusun daftar dibantah frasa yang sama, sebab yang "convenient" bagi firma menyangkut standar pembuktian daftar, bukan angka kerugian yang diaudit; dan pengakuan peritel soal penghematan yang lebih kecil nggak punya jejak, sebab teks cuma menduga peritel "should welcome such tests".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "A shopper added to one of these lists is left without a dependable way of finding out."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: A shopper added to one of these lists is left without a dependable way of finding out.
qs.answer: True
