qs.evidence: A shopper wrongly included has no reliable route to discovering the fact, still less to having the entry deleted.
qs.why: Ini parafrasa: "no reliable route to discovering the fact" sama artinya dengan nggak punya cara andal untuk tahu.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena teks nggak menyangkal soal ini; "Not stated" salah karena kalimatnya ada, cuma pakai kata lain.

author: Editorial comment
setting: shopping centres and the firms that police them

title: When a Finding Refuses to Repeat
text:
A decade ago a curious pattern began to trouble psychologists. Studies that had been taught for years, cited in textbooks and rehearsed in lectures, produced far weaker results when other laboratories ran them again. In several well-known cases the effect disappeared altogether. The discovery was uncomfortable, yet in a narrow sense it was also a triumph for the method, because the discipline had caught itself out without outside help. Nobody had set out to test the memory of an entire field, yet that is precisely what the exercise became.

The reasons proved less dramatic than fraud. Many original studies had used small samples, sometimes fewer than thirty volunteers, which makes any single result unstable. Researchers also enjoyed considerable freedom in how they measured and analysed what they collected, and small choices made in good faith tend to favour the outcome an investigator expects. Journals compounded the problem by preferring surprising findings to ordinary ones, so the published record filled with the loudest results rather than the steadiest.

Reform followed, and much of it has been strikingly practical. Teams now register their predictions and their procedures before gathering data, which makes any later adjustment visible to a reader. Sample sizes have grown, several laboratories often run the same procedure together, and raw measurements are increasingly published alongside the paper itself. Editors at several journals now accept a paper on the strength of its design alone, before a single result is known. Where these habits have taken hold, replication rates have improved, though nobody claims the problem is settled.

For a general reader the lesson is not that psychology is unreliable but that a single study is a weak thing. Confidence ought to accumulate slowly, through repetition, and should be withheld from any headline resting on one experiment. A reader who waits for the second and third attempt is not being awkward; she is behaving exactly as the evidence requires. Researchers who keep insisting on the point are occasionally accused of dampening enthusiasm. In truth they are protecting the only asset the discipline has, which is the right to be believed.
qs: On balance, which claim does the piece actually defend?
the discipline's habit of auditing itself, not its errors, is the real story
journals, more surely than the researchers, produced a record of loud results
ordinary weakness in method, rather than dishonesty, explains the failed repeats
the reforms already adopted, though slow, have largely restored the field's credit

qs.evidence: The reasons proved less dramatic than fraud.
qs.answer: ordinary weakness in method, rather than dishonesty, explains the failed repeats
qs.why: Paragraf dua menyebut sebabnya “less dramatic than fraud” lalu merinci sampel kecil, kebebasan analisis, dan seleksi jurnal: kelemahan biasa, bukan kecurangan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi audit-diri sebagai inti dibatasi teks sendiri lewat “in a narrow sense”; opsi jurnal sebagai penyebab utama bertabrakan dengan “Journals compounded the problem”, jadi menambah bukan mendahului; opsi kredibilitas telah pulih bertabrakan dengan “nobody claims the problem is settled”.

qs: What order does the reformed practice impose on a study?
Predictions and procedures are registered before the data is gathered, so any later adjustment is visible
The measurements are analysed first, and whichever prediction fits them best is registered afterwards
A finding is published only once several laboratories have already repeated it in full
Procedures are lodged with a journal only after the raw measurements have been released

qs.evidence: Teams now register their predictions and their procedures before gathering data, which makes any later adjustment visible to a reader.
qs.answer: Predictions and procedures are registered before the data is gathered, so any later adjustment is visible
qs.why: Reformasinya menetapkan urutan: "Teams now register their predictions and their procedures before gathering data, which makes any later adjustment visible to a reader." Prediksi dan prosedur didaftarkan lebih dulu, sehingga penyesuaian belakangan terlihat oleh pembaca.
qs.whyOthersFail: Menganalisis data dulu lalu mendaftarkan prediksi yang paling cocok MEMBALIK urutan tersebut dan justru menggambarkan kebebasan yang dikoreksi: "Researchers also enjoyed considerable freedom in how they measured and analysed what they collected." Menuntut replikasi penuh sebelum penerbitan MELAMPAUI teks, sebab editor menerima makalah "on the strength of its design alone, before a single result is known". Menahan pendaftaran prosedur sampai data mentah dirilis membalik keduanya: data mentah diterbitkan "alongside the paper itself", bukan sebagai prasyarat.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the reforms set out in the third paragraph?
approving of the reforms, yet unwilling to grant that the field caught itself out
approving of the reforms, yet unwilling to describe the trouble as over
approving of the reforms, yet unwilling to acquit the first researchers of fraud
approving of the reforms, though only where they alter how work is published

qs.evidence: Where these habits have taken hold, replication rates have improved, though nobody claims the problem is settled.
qs.answer: approving of the reforms, yet unwilling to describe the trouble as over
qs.why: Kalimat penutup paragraf tiga memuji hasilnya lalu menahan diri: "replication rates have improved, though nobody claims the problem is settled". Jadi persetujuannya penuh, penutupan masalahnya ditolak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyetujui reformasi dan ketiganya sama-sama menolak sesuatu, jadi pola "menahan diri" nggak lagi menandai kunci; pemilihnya sasaran penolakan itu. Menolak mengakui bahwa disiplinnya menangkap dirinya sendiri salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "the discipline had caught itself out without outside help". Menolak membebaskan peneliti pertama dari tuduhan kecurangan salah SASARAN dan DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "The reasons proved less dramatic than fraud" serta "small choices made in good faith". Pembatasan pada perubahan cara menerbitkan salah CAKUPAN: frasa pemblokirnya "Sample sizes have grown, several laboratories often run the same procedure together".

qs: Which restatement comes closest to the writer's final point about what these researchers defend?
not dampening enthusiasm so much as defending the standing psychology keeps among neighbouring sciences
not dampening enthusiasm so much as defending the credit that journals still draw from their readers
not dampening enthusiasm so much as defending a reputation they expect to recover before long
not dampening enthusiasm so much as defending the ground a reader has for trusting a published claim

qs.evidence: In truth they are protecting the only asset the discipline has, which is the right to be believed.
qs.answer: not dampening enthusiasm so much as defending the ground a reader has for trusting a published claim
qs.why: Kalimat terakhir menyebut aset satu-satunya disiplin itu "the right to be believed", yaitu alasan yang masih dimiliki pembaca untuk mempercayai yang diterbitkan; sikap itu dipasang sebagai bantahan atas tuduhan memadamkan semangat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk kontras yang sama ("not X so much as Y") dan bentuk yang sama-sama rapi; tiap pengecoh menggeser TEPAT SATU unsur dari klaim sumber. Opsi kedudukan di antara ilmu tetangga menggeser CAKUPAN, dari kepercayaan pembaca ke gengsi antardisiplin, dan diblokir "the only asset the discipline has, which is the right to be believed". Opsi jurnal menggeser AGEN: kalimatnya menyebut "Researchers who keep insisting on the point", bukan jurnal, yang di paragraf dua justru disebut ikut memperparah masalah. Opsi reputasi yang segera pulih menggeser WAKTU dan diblokir "Confidence ought to accumulate slowly, through repetition".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Journals in that period favoured ordinary findings over surprising ones."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Journals in that period favoured ordinary findings over surprising ones.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Journals compounded the problem by preferring surprising findings to ordinary ones, so the published record filled with the loudest results rather than the steadiest.
qs.why: Teks menyatakan sebaliknya: jurnal lebih memilih temuan yang mengejutkan daripada yang biasa, jadi arah klaimnya dibalik.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" bertentangan langsung dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" nggak berlaku karena preferensi jurnal disebut terang-terangan.

author: Science desk feature
setting: psychology laboratories and the journals that publish them

title: Two Markers, One Pile of Essays
text:
Every autumn, university departments confront the same arithmetic: more essays, the same number of markers, and a promise that feedback will reach students within three weeks. Software that scores student writing automatically is offered as the obvious remedy. Two colleagues in one faculty describe that proposal in strikingly different terms, and the distance between them is instructive. Neither is arguing in bad faith, which is what makes the disagreement worth setting out at length.

The first, who teaches a first-year module of four hundred students, is briskly pragmatic. Her markers currently spend whole weekends on structure and referencing, matters a machine can check consistently and without fatigue. Released from that drudgery, staff could turn their attention to argument, which is where trained judgement genuinely adds something. She also observes that the software is at least predictable, whereas a tired marker working towards midnight is not. Consistency, she adds, is a form of fairness, since two identical essays ought not to attract different marks.

Her colleague in literature remains unpersuaded. What such systems reward, he argues, is fluent conformity: tidy structure, familiar vocabulary, sentences of moderate length. An essay that takes a genuine risk and half succeeds may well score below one that says nothing gracefully. The risk, on his account, is not that machines mark badly but that students rapidly learn what machines reward. He concedes that the workload problem is real, yet insists the proposed remedy shifts the definition of good writing towards whatever the model happens to count.

Neither colleague disputes the arithmetic; their quarrel concerns what marking is for. If marking measures compliance with a form, automation will serve it perfectly well. If marking is instead a conversation about thinking, software may prepare the ground but cannot conduct the exchange. Departments weighing the two accounts should notice which description of their own work they are quietly adopting, because the choice of tool will settle the question long before anyone votes on it. That is a decision about values, and it deserves to be made deliberately rather than absorbed from a procurement document.
qs: Why does the writer set out both colleagues' positions at length?
to show that a quarrel about a tool is really one about workload
to weigh the two accounts and find the pragmatic case the stronger
to show that a quarrel about marking is really one about trust in staff
to show that a quarrel about a tool is really a quarrel about purpose

qs.evidence: Neither colleague disputes the arithmetic; their quarrel concerns what marking is for.
qs.answer: to show that a quarrel about a tool is really a quarrel about purpose
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci memisahkan dua lapis: "Neither colleague disputes the arithmetic; their quarrel concerns what marking is for", lalu penutupnya menyebutnya "a decision about values". Jadi perselisihan soal alat sesungguhnya soal tujuan menilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tiga opsi memakai bingkai "really one about X" yang sama, jadi kuncinya nggak menonjol bentuknya, dan ketiganya sejalan dengan tesis bahwa perselisihan itu lebih dalam daripada alatnya. Yang menunjuk beban kerja salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "Neither colleague disputes the arithmetic" dan pengakuan "He concedes that the workload problem is real". Yang menunjuk kepercayaan pada staf salah SASARAN juga: frasa pemblokirnya "their quarrel concerns what marking is for", bukan sejauh mana staf dipercaya. Penimbangan yang memenangkan pihak pragmatis salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Neither is arguing in bad faith", dan penulis nggak memutus.

qs: What does the first lecturer say her markers currently spend their time on?
marking the argument in essays from four hundred students
checking how essays are structured and sources listed
advising students on the risks worth taking in their writing
comparing their own marks with the scores the software gives

qs.evidence: Her markers currently spend whole weekends on structure and referencing, matters a machine can check consistently and without fatigue.
qs.answer: checking how essays are structured and sources listed
qs.why: Teks menyebut pemeriksa sekarang menghabiskan akhir pekan untuk struktur dan penulisan rujukan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Menilai argumen justru pekerjaan yang ingin direbut kembali kalau mesin mengambil alih hal teknis, jadi bukan keadaan sekarang; nasihat soal keberanian menulis adalah kekhawatiran dosen sastra, bukan tugas pemeriksa; dan perbandingan nilai manusia dengan nilai software nggak pernah dilaporkan terjadi.

qs: Which observation most clearly conveys the writer's own view rather than a colleague's?
the claim that trained judgement adds most when argument is judged
the objection that such systems may reward fluent conformity
the promise that written feedback will arrive within three weeks
the warning that a purchase may quietly redefine the work

qs.evidence: That is a decision about values, and it deserves to be made deliberately rather than absorbed from a procurement document.
qs.answer: the warning that a purchase may quietly redefine the work
qs.why: Tiga pilihan lain adalah janji institusi atau suara salah satu dosen; peringatan bahwa keputusan pembelian bisa menggeser makna pekerjaan itu penilaian penulis sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Soal pertimbangan terlatih adalah argumen dosen pertama yang dikutip penulis, bukan pendapatnya; keberatan tentang keseragaman yang lancar milik dosen sastra; dan janji umpan balik tiga minggu adalah janji jurusan yang dibuka sebagai latar administratif.

qs: Which conclusion about essays that experiment and only partly work does the piece support?
automated scoring is likely to mark such work down
a tired marker tends to reward such work more warmly
the software scores such work erratically rather than low
the literature lecturer accepts the workload case because of it

qs.evidence: An essay that takes a genuine risk and half succeeds may well score below one that says nothing gracefully.
qs.answer: automated scoring is likely to mark such work down
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci menyandingkan esai berani yang separuh berhasil dengan esai rapi yang tak berkata apa-apa, dan yang berani disebut bisa jatuh di bawahnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kemurahan hati pemeriksa yang kelelahan diblokir "a tired marker working towards midnight is not [predictable]" — dia digambarkan sulit diduga, bukan lebih baik hati; penilaian yang naik-turun bertabrakan dengan "the software is at least predictable", jadi masalahnya arah nilainya, bukan keajekannya; dan pengaitan dengan dosen sastra salah baca konsesi "He concedes that the workload problem is real", yang dia terima demi jujur, bukan karena esai eksperimental.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "One lecturer values the software partly because its behaviour does not vary."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: One lecturer values the software partly because its behaviour does not vary.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: She also observes that the software is at least predictable, whereas a tired marker working towards midnight is not.
qs.why: "Predictable" di teks sama maksudnya dengan nggak berubah-ubah, dan itu memang alasan dosen pertama menghargainya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada bantahan; "Not stated" salah karena alasan itu tertulis, hanya dengan pilihan kata lain.

author: Higher education review
setting: a large humanities faculty

title: Credit Where No Wage Is Paid
text:
Ask a university why an unpaid placement carries academic credit and the answer arrives smoothly: students gain experience, employers gain fresh energy, and nobody pays for the privilege. The arrangement looks like a gift. Examined a little longer, it looks more like a charge quietly transferred from the employer to the student, and from the student to whoever supports her.

Consider who can accept such an offer. A student whose family can cover three months of rent in a costly city may take the placement and profit from it. A student supporting relatives, or paying her own rent from evening shifts, cannot, and the credit she forgoes is not optional. It appears on the same transcript, weighed by the same admissions panels, read by the same recruiters. The transcript records what was achieved, never what could be afforded. Employers, meanwhile, receive an applicant filtered by household wealth and mistake the outcome for merit. What was presented as an equal opportunity therefore reproduces the advantage that already existed.

Defenders reply that the labour market is competitive and that experience must be obtained somewhere. That is true, and it is precisely the difficulty. Because the credit makes the placement part of a degree, the university lends its authority to work it does not pay for and often does not inspect. Placement diaries are marked; the hours behind them are rarely audited. Nor is the practice confined to glamorous industries; it now reaches accountancy, publishing and local government alike. Where an employer substitutes a stream of unpaid students for a junior post, the university has become a supplier rather than an educator.

The remedy need not be dramatic: universities could require that any credit-bearing placement pay at least a modest stipend. They could also publish the proportion of students who complete one, and treat an unpaid offer as a matter for negotiation rather than gratitude. None of that abolishes competition for good positions; it merely stops an institution funded to widen access from certifying an arrangement that narrows it.
qs: On balance, which statement carries the weight of the argument?
the university now supplies labour to employers rather than educating students
credit for unpaid work leaves the cost with the student rather than the employer
unpaid placements should leave the degree scheme rather than be reformed
the transcript, not the placement itself, reproduces the advantage already there

qs.evidence: Examined a little longer, it looks more like a charge quietly transferred from the employer to the student, and from the student to whoever supports her.
qs.answer: credit for unpaid work leaves the cost with the student rather than the employer
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyimpulkan bahwa penempatan berkredit tanpa upah adalah beban yang dipindahkan dari pemberi kerja ke mahasiswa dan penanggungnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi universitas sebagai penyuplai tenaga kerja hanya berlaku bersyarat di teks (“Where an employer substitutes”) dan bukan klaim pokoknya; opsi menghapus penempatan dari skema gelar bertabrakan dengan “The remedy need not be dramatic” yang meminta stipendium; opsi transkrip sebagai pelaku menggeser sebabnya, sebab transkrip hanya mencatat capaian tanpa mencatat apa yang terjangkau.

qs: According to the column, what is rarely checked by the university?
the diaries that students hand in to be marked
whether an employer has replaced a junior post
the rent a student pays while living in a costly city
the hours actually worked during a placement

qs.evidence: Placement diaries are marked; the hours behind them are rarely audited.
qs.answer: the hours actually worked during a placement
qs.why: Teks memisahkan dua hal: catatan harian dinilai, tapi jam kerja di belakangnya jarang diperiksa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Catatan harian justru contoh hal yang memang dinilai; penggantian posisi junior disebut sebagai akibat yang penulis khawatirkan, bukan sesuatu yang universitas periksa; dan sewa rumah dipakai untuk menjelaskan siapa yang sanggup ikut, tanpa kaitan dengan pemeriksaan.

qs: How would you describe the writer's tone in the first paragraph?
drily sceptical of an answer that arrives a little too smoothly
drily sceptical of students who take the placement and profit by it
drily doubtful that experience must be obtained somewhere at all
briskly factual about how such placements come to carry credit

qs.evidence: The arrangement looks like a gift.
qs.answer: drily sceptical of an answer that arrives a little too smoothly
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut jawaban resmi datang "smoothly" dan tampak "like a gift", lalu kalimat ketiga membalikkannya menjadi "a charge quietly transferred": kering, curiga, tanpa kemarahan terbuka.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tiga opsi memakai nada kering-skeptis yang sama seperti kunci, jadi register nggak lagi memisahkan; pemilihnya sasaran dan nuansanya. Skeptis pada mahasiswa yang mengambil penempatan salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "the credit she forgoes is not optional" dan "an applicant filtered by household wealth" — yang disoal penyaringnya, bukan yang lolos. Keraguan bahwa pengalaman harus diperoleh di suatu tempat salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "That is true, and it is precisely the difficulty". Opsi laporan faktual salah NUANSA juga: frasa pemblokirnya "The arrangement looks like a gift", sebuah penilaian, bukan keterangan.

qs: What does the writer imply about a student who turns down an unpaid placement?
her university may offer her a stipend instead
recruiters may read the refusal as sound judgement
she gives up marks that richer students collect
she can take the placement in a later term

qs.evidence: A student supporting relatives, or paying her own rent from evening shifts, cannot, and the credit she forgoes is not optional.
qs.answer: she gives up marks that richer students collect
qs.why: Frasa "the credit she forgoes is not optional" mengunci kerugiannya: kredit itu tetap muncul di transkrip yang sama dengan milik mahasiswa yang sanggup ikut.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tunjangan dari universitas diblokir statusnya sebagai usulan, "universities could require", jadi belum ada; pembacaan perekrut atas penolakan bertabrakan dengan "Employers... mistake the outcome for merit", karena yang sampai ke mereka hasil seleksi kekayaan, sementara penolakannya tak terlihat; dan pengulangan di semester lain dibantah kata "not optional", yang menutup pintu penggantian.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "About one in five students at these universities completes a credit-bearing placement."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: About one in five students at these universities completes a credit-bearing placement.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: They could also publish the proportion of students who complete one, and treat an unpaid offer as a matter for negotiation rather than gratitude.
qs.why: Kalimat terdekat cuma mengusulkan agar proporsi itu diterbitkan, jadi angkanya justru belum ada di teks; jenis ketiadaannya: kuantitas nggak disebut.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh angka yang nggak pernah ditulis; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal proporsi apa pun.

author: Opinion column
setting: universities and the employers they place students with

title: Reading the Temperature of a Street
text:
A city does not have a single temperature. On a still afternoon in late September, a bus stop on a wide commercial road may register eight degrees above a shaded lane in the same district. The two sit four hundred metres apart, and official statistics rarely capture such a gap. The instruments that generate them stand in open ground, deliberately distant from traffic, and their purpose is comparison between years rather than between streets.

Researchers have therefore begun measuring at the height of a walking body, using compact sensors strapped to lamp posts or carried on cargo bicycles. Others are fitted to refuse lorries, which already follow fixed routes through every neighbourhood. The technique yields a reading every few seconds along thousands of streets. The resulting maps show heat gathering in predictable places: broad junctions, open car parks, and roads lined with dark surfaces and little else. Shade, it emerges, governs the pattern more powerfully than any single building material.

The underlying mechanism is not mysterious: hard surfaces absorb radiation through the day and release it slowly after dark. A street beneath continuous tree cover therefore receives less heat and sheds it faster. Across one summer, a mature avenue held night temperatures three degrees below a treeless equivalent. That advantage was widest precisely when a resting body most needs relief. Modelling indicates that planting achieves most where existing cover is thinnest, which is seldom where planting budgets have historically been directed.

Such findings matter only if they reach the departments that dig holes. Where sensor readings have been published street by street, residents have asked why their own road was excluded from a planting programme. That question is considerably harder to deflect than a general appeal for greener cities: officials can dispute a slogan, whereas a table of measurements is more stubborn. A number attached to one particular road creates an obligation that a vague civic ambition never does. Measurement, in other words, does not merely describe an inequality of shade. It converts that inequality into something a council can be asked to answer for.
qs: What is the main purpose of the article?
to show how street-level readings make a council answerable
to show that shade governs street heat more than materials do
to show why planting belongs first where existing cover is thinnest
to show why official instruments miss the gap between two streets

qs.evidence: It converts that inequality into something a council can be asked to answer for.
qs.answer: to show how street-level readings make a council answerable
qs.why: Rangkaian di paragraf akhir adalah penguncinya: "officials can dispute a slogan, whereas a table of measurements is more stubborn", lalu penutup tentang ketimpangan yang berubah menjadi "something a council can be asked to answer for".
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh mengulang bagian nyata dari tesis teks (pengukuran jalanan itu penting), tapi berhenti pada temuan, bukan pada tujuan tulisannya. Klaim soal naungan salah CAKUPAN: frasa pemblokirnya letaknya sendiri, "Shade, it emerges, governs the pattern more powerfully than any single building material", berdiri sebagai temuan tengah, sedangkan penutupnya bicara pertanggungjawaban. Prioritas penanaman salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Modelling indicates that planting achieves most where existing cover is thinnest" — itu hasil model, dan teks berhenti pada pertanyaan warga yang "harder to deflect", tanpa menuntut pemindahan anggaran. Kelemahan alat resmi salah SASARAN: dipakai sekadar menerangkan kenapa "official statistics rarely capture such a gap".

qs: How do researchers obtain readings from thousands of streets?
equipment travels on vehicles that already serve fixed rounds
readings are modelled from the height of a walking body
residents report the temperature of their own road each day
one instrument in open ground records the whole district

qs.evidence: Others are fitted to refuse lorries, which already follow fixed routes through every neighbourhood.
qs.answer: equipment travels on vehicles that already serve fixed rounds
qs.why: Sensor ditempelkan pada truk sampah yang memang udah punya rute tetap ke setiap lingkungan, jadi alatnya bergerak bersama kendaraan yang beroperasi rutin.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketinggian tubuh yang berjalan adalah tinggi tempat sensor mengukur, bukan hasil pemodelan; laporan harian warga muncul sebagai akibat setelah data diterbitkan, bukan cara mengumpulkannya; dan alat tunggal di lahan terbuka justru pengukuran resmi yang dikritik karena melewatkan selisih antar jalan.

qs: Which finding gives the strongest support for the claim about shade?
tree-covered streets stayed cooler right through the night
the gap was widest at the hottest point of the afternoon
official instruments recorded eight degrees of difference
sensors were carried through every neighbourhood by lorries

qs.evidence: Across one summer, a mature avenue held night temperatures three degrees below a treeless equivalent.
qs.answer: tree-covered streets stayed cooler right through the night
qs.why: Selisih tiga derajat pada malam hari antara jalan berpohon dewasa dan jalan gundul adalah bukti paling langsung untuk klaim soal naungan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Waktu selisih terlebar disebut justru saat tubuh yang beristirahat paling butuh kelegaan, yaitu malam, bukan sore; selisih delapan derajat diukur di ketinggian tubuh oleh peneliti, bukan oleh alat resmi yang berdiri jauh dari jalan; dan cara sensor dibawa hanya soal metode, bukan bukti tentang naungan.

qs: What does the article imply about where trees have been planted in the past?
planting has largely followed what the new sensors revealed
planting was concentrated on junctions and car parks
planting may have cooled most streets by three degrees at night
planting has mostly bypassed the barest streets

qs.evidence: Modelling indicates that planting achieves most where existing cover is thinnest, which is seldom where planting budgets have historically been directed.
qs.answer: planting has mostly bypassed the barest streets
qs.why: Klausa "which is seldom where planting budgets have historically been directed" mengunci arahnya: tempat yang paling gundul justru jarang jadi tujuan anggaran.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kepatuhan pada pola sensor diblokir urutan waktu, sebab peneliti "have therefore begun measuring" belakangan, jadi anggaran lama tak mungkin mengikutinya, dan teks menyebutnya "seldom where planting budgets have historically been directed"; pemusatan pada simpang dan lahan parkir salah baca daftar "broad junctions, open car parks", yang menyebut tempat panas menumpuk, bukan tempat pohon ditanam; dan selisih tiga derajat dibatasi teks pada "a mature avenue" dibanding "a treeless equivalent", satu pasangan jalan, bukan sebagian besar jalan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Official measuring instruments are placed close to busy traffic."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Official measuring instruments are placed close to busy traffic.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The instruments that generate them stand in open ground, deliberately distant from traffic, and their purpose is comparison between years rather than between streets.
qs.why: Teks bilang alat resmi berdiri di lahan terbuka dan sengaja dijauhkan dari lalu lintas, jadi klaim ini kebalikannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" bertabrakan langsung dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" salah karena posisi alat memang disebutkan.

author: Urban science feature
setting: a city measuring its own hottest streets

title: Street Lighting Replacement: Two-Year Review
text:
This report reviews the first two years of the street lighting replacement programme and sets out four recommendations. Of the borough's twenty-nine thousand lamps, roughly two-thirds have now been converted to light-emitting units. Energy consumption on converted routes has fallen by about forty per cent, and maintenance visits have become markedly less frequent. The financial case, on those figures alone, is secure. The programme is on course to finish next winter, and the first bills have already come in lower.

Resident feedback complicates the picture. Complaints recorded through the council's portal fall into two groups: light spilling into bedrooms, and a colour of illumination described repeatedly as harsh. Both objections concentrate in streets fitted during the first year, before the specification was revised towards a warmer tone and a shallower angle. Comparable complaints from second-year streets are far fewer, which suggests the revision worked rather than that residents grew accustomed to the change. Most of the letters come from a small number of roads, which is worth keeping in mind.

Two risks deserve attention. First, the programme's savings have been calculated against a tariff agreed in the previous financial year; a rise in unit prices would reduce the margin without altering the physical benefit. Second, the decision to dim converted lamps after midnight was taken without consultation, and the evidence connecting that measure to reported feelings of safety remains thin. Officers should not assume public tolerance of dimming merely because complaints have been few. Neither risk threatens the programme, yet neither has been recorded in the published summaries.

Four recommendations follow. Fit first-year streets with the revised specification within eighteen months, beginning with residential roads rather than main routes. Publish route-level energy figures each quarter instead of annually, and commission an independent assessment of dimming before extending it to any further streets. Finally, record complaints by street rather than by ward, since the present arrangement conceals precisely the variation this programme needs to understand. None of this asks the council to slow down; it asks the council to look where it is going.
qs: On balance, which position does the report settle on once its cautions are counted?
the complaints from first-year streets may outweigh the savings recorded
the revised specification has settled the objections residents first raised
the programme should pause, though only until the refitting is finished
the savings hold, while several parts of the programme need revisiting

qs.evidence: The financial case, on those figures alone, is secure.
qs.answer: the savings hold, while several parts of the programme need revisiting
qs.why: Laporan menyebut kasus keuangannya kukuh atas angka itu, lalu tetap menandai dua risiko dan empat rekomendasi yang harus digarap.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keluhan melebihi penghematan bertabrakan dengan sebaran keluhan pada beberapa jalan saja; opsi keberatan udah tuntas bertabrakan dengan rekomendasi memasang spesifikasi baru di jalan tahun pertama; opsi menjeda program bertabrakan dengan jadwal selesai musim dingin depan yang tetap dipertahankan.

qs: In what order does the report want the remaining work carried out?
Refit the first-year streets, residential roads before main routes, and assess dimming before it spreads further
Extend the dimming across the borough first and commission an assessment of it afterwards
Finish converting the outstanding lamps before any first-year street is refitted
Refit the main routes first, since complaints there outnumber those from residential streets

qs.evidence: Fit first-year streets with the revised specification within eighteen months, beginning with residential roads rather than main routes.
qs.answer: Refit the first-year streets, residential roads before main routes, and assess dimming before it spreads further
qs.why: Urutannya ditulis jelas di daftar rekomendasi: "beginning with residential roads rather than main routes", dan untuk peredupan "commission an independent assessment of dimming before extending it to any further streets". Jadi retrofit spesifikasi baru dimulai dari jalan permukiman, sedangkan perluasan peredupan menunggu penilaian independen.
qs.whyOthersFail: Memperluas peredupan dulu lalu menilainya kemudian MEMBALIK urutan yang diminta laporan; frasa "before extending it to any further streets" memblokirnya. Menunggu seluruh konversi lampu selesai sebelum satu jalan tahun pertama diretrofit MELAMPAUI teks: laporan memberi tenggat delapan belas bulan dan nggak pernah mengaitkannya dengan selesainya konversi. Mengutamakan jalan utama karena keluhan di sana lebih banyak membalik prioritas sekaligus salah fakta: "Most of the letters come from a small number of roads", dan rekomendasinya justru mendahulukan jalan permukiman.

qs: What attitude do the authors take towards the dimming of converted lamps?
wary, yet not pressing for the first-year streets to be refitted
wary, and still unwilling to credit the revision with fewer complaints
wary, and still unwilling to read quiet streets as agreement
wary, though chiefly about the tariff on which the savings rest

qs.evidence: Officers should not assume public tolerance of dimming merely because complaints have been few.
qs.answer: wary, and still unwilling to read quiet streets as agreement
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci melarang persis satu langkah nalar: "Officers should not assume public tolerance of dimming merely because complaints have been few". Jadi sikapnya waspada, dan jalan yang sepi nggak dibaca sebagai persetujuan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi waspada dan sama-sama menahan diri, jadi bentuknya nggak menunjuk kunci; pemilihnya objek penahanan itu. Nggak menuntut pemasangan ulang jalan tahun pertama salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya rekomendasi "Fit first-year streets with the revised specification within eighteen months". Penolakan memberi kredit kepada revisi spesifikasi salah SASARAN juga: frasa pemblokirnya "which suggests the revision worked rather than that residents grew accustomed to the change". Kewaspadaan yang terutama soal tarif salah SASARAN: tarif adalah risiko pertama yang terpisah, sedangkan untuk peredupan frasa pemblokirnya "the evidence connecting that measure to reported feelings of safety remains thin".

qs: Which conclusion about the calculated savings does the report support?
they may grow as the remaining lamps are converted
they rest on a tariff that may not last
they may leave out the drop in maintenance visits
they have been checked by an outside assessor

qs.evidence: First, the programme's savings have been calculated against a tariff agreed in the previous financial year; a rise in unit prices would reduce the margin without altering the physical benefit.
qs.answer: they rest on a tariff that may not last
qs.why: Sinyalnya dua bagian dalam satu kalimat: penghematan dihitung terhadap tarif tahun keuangan lalu, dan kenaikan harga satuan akan menggerus marginnya. Jadi angka itu menggantung pada tarif.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pertumbuhan seiring konversi masuk akal di dunia nyata, tapi teks cuma mengaitkan margin dengan harga satuan, "a rise in unit prices would reduce the margin", tanpa menautkannya ke jumlah lampu; kemungkinan kunjungan pemeliharaan tertinggal dari hitungan bertabrakan dengan "maintenance visits have become markedly less frequent", yang justru dipakai menopang angka itu; dan pemeriksaan pihak luar diblokir statusnya sebagai usulan, dan usulan itu ditujukan pada pemudaran, bukan pada penghematan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Roughly two in three of the borough's lamps have already been replaced."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Roughly two in three of the borough's lamps have already been replaced.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Of the borough's twenty-nine thousand lamps, roughly two-thirds have now been converted to light-emitting units.
qs.why: "Two-thirds udah dikonversi" sama artinya dengan dua dari tiga lampu udah diganti; cuma satuannya diucapkan lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena angkanya sama; "Not stated" salah karena proporsi itu memang tertulis di paragraf pembuka.

topic: a council review of its street lighting programme
author: Borough infrastructure committee
setting: a borough halfway through replacing its lamps

title: The Hierarchy Nobody Writes Down
text:
Every capital budget contains a hierarchy, and it is rarely written down anywhere. Nobody defends that hierarchy openly, and the silence is part of how it survives. Money for a new flyover is found; money for a continuous footway is postponed. Ask which decision moved more people and the answer becomes inconvenient. The footway carries the schoolchild, the market trader and the person pushing a wheelchair, all of whom are counted, if at all, as an afterthought.

The bias is partly a matter of measurement. Traffic engineers have decades of vehicle counts, delay models and cost-benefit conventions, every one of them calibrated to time saved by drivers. Walking generates no comparable statistics, so a scheme that removes a hazard for a thousand pedestrians a day competes against one that saves ninety seconds for four thousand cars, and loses on paper. A number that exists will always defeat a number that does not, whatever either of them measures. What cannot be counted in the accepted unit tends to be treated as sentiment.

The consequences are visible at any junction after rain. A footway that ends without warning, a crossing timed for an athlete, a drain positioned so that a bus soaks the queue: none of these is an accident of nature. Each represents a choice made where the loudest interest held the better data. The people who wait at that crossing were never consulted about what their own time was worth. Meanwhile the flyover, having attracted the traffic it was built to relieve, produces a fresh demand for another.

None of this argues against major road works, some of which are unavoidable. It argues for symmetry. Count pedestrians as carefully as vehicles, publish the cost of a schoolchild's detour, and require any scheme above a stated threshold to report its effect on people walking. Cities that have adopted such rules did not stop building; they simply stopped pretending the choice was technical rather than political. A preference dressed up as engineering necessity persists precisely because nobody signs it. The hierarchy will survive until somebody writes it down and asks who consented to it.
qs: On balance, what does the writer finally commit to?
walking loses because it never enters the unit used to judge schemes
delay models may overstate the time that drivers are said to save
the unwritten hierarchy in a budget is largely kept quiet on purpose
major road schemes should in most cases give way to walking schemes

qs.evidence: What cannot be counted in the accepted unit tends to be treated as sentiment.
qs.answer: walking loses because it never enters the unit used to judge schemes
qs.why: Paragraf dua menyebut jalan kaki tak menghasilkan statistik sebanding, dan yang tak terhitung dalam satuan yang diterima diperlakukan sebagai sentimen.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi model penundaan melebih-lebihkan waktu bertabrakan dengan teks yang nggak menggugat ketepatan model, hanya cakupannya; opsi hierarki disembunyikan sengaja bertabrakan dengan “Nobody defends that hierarchy openly”, yakni diam yang mewarisi, bukan konspirasi; opsi jalan raya harus mengalah bertabrakan dengan “None of this argues against major road works”.

qs: What comparison does the writer use to show how schemes are judged?
the delay suffered by buses against the delay suffered by cars
removing a hazard for walkers against seconds saved for drivers
the cost of a child's detour against the cost of a new crossing
a flyover in one city measured against a flyover in another

qs.evidence: Walking generates no comparable statistics, so a scheme that removes a hazard for a thousand pedestrians a day competes against one that saves ninety seconds for four thousand cars, and loses on paper.
qs.answer: removing a hazard for walkers against seconds saved for drivers
qs.why: Perbandingan di teks memang antara menghilangkan bahaya bagi seribu pejalan kaki sehari dan menghemat sembilan puluh detik bagi empat ribu mobil.
qs.whyOthersFail: Bus cuma muncul sebagai kendaraan yang menyiram antrean di halte, tanpa perbandingan keterlambatan; biaya jalan memutar anak sekolah adalah angka yang penulis usulkan diterbitkan nanti, bukan pembanding yang udah dipakai; dan dua kota nggak pernah dibandingkan di teks ini.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the way such decisions are presented?
critical, though content to let vehicle counts stand as the measure
critical, yet unwilling to hold anybody answerable for the ranking
critical, since the preference for drivers is defended too openly
critical, since a political choice is offered as pure technique

qs.evidence: Cities that have adopted such rules did not stop building; they simply stopped pretending the choice was technical rather than political.
qs.answer: critical, since a political choice is offered as pure technique
qs.why: Kalimat tentang kota yang mengubah aturannya adalah penguncinya: "they simply stopped pretending the choice was technical rather than political", diperkuat "A preference dressed up as engineering necessity". Yang dikecam adalah penyajian pilihan politis sebagai teknik murni.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi kritis dan dua di antaranya memakai penahanan diri yang sama seperti register kunci, jadi bentuknya nggak memisahkan; pemilihnya sasaran dan nuansanya. Kesediaan membiarkan hitungan kendaraan menjadi ukurannya salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "Count pedestrians as carefully as vehicles". Keengganan menuntut pertanggungjawaban salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "The hierarchy will survive until somebody writes it down and asks who consented to it". Keberatan bahwa preferensi itu dibela terlalu terbuka salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "Nobody defends that hierarchy openly, and the silence is part of how it survives".

qs: What does the writer suggest about the flyover mentioned in the third paragraph?
it may have been approved after pedestrians were counted
it has largely weakened the case for building another
it created the congestion it was meant to cure
it was funded from money set aside for footways

qs.evidence: Meanwhile the flyover, having attracted the traffic it was built to relieve, produces a fresh demand for another.
qs.answer: it created the congestion it was meant to cure
qs.why: Frasa "having attracted the traffic it was built to relieve" mengunci ironinya: yang seharusnya dikurangi justru dipanggil masuk.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penghitungan pejalan kaki sebelum persetujuan diblokir statusnya sebagai tuntutan di paragraf akhir, "Count pedestrians as carefully as vehicles", jadi belum pernah dilakukan; melemahnya alasan membangun lagi bertabrakan langsung dengan klausa "produces a fresh demand for another"; dan pendanaan dari pos trotoar nggak punya jejak, teks cuma menyebut uang trotoar "postponed", tanpa dialihkan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer maintains that large road projects are never necessary."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer maintains that large road projects are never necessary.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: None of this argues against major road works, some of which are unavoidable.
qs.why: Penulis menulis terang-terangan bahwa sebagian proyek jalan besar tak terhindarkan, jadi klaim ini kebalikan posisinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" bertabrakan dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" salah karena sikap penulis soal proyek besar dinyatakan langsung.

topic: spending priorities between roads and footways
author: Opinion essay
setting: a city deciding what to build next

title: What the Ticket Machine Knows
text:
For most of the twentieth century a bus timetable was an act of informed guesswork. Planners counted passengers by hand for a fortnight, extrapolated, and rewrote the timetable every few years. Electronic ticketing altered the raw material available to them, because every tap of a card registers a boarding, a stop and a minute. What was once a sample has become something close to a census, and the change was quiet, arriving without anybody commissioning a new survey of passengers.

The findings have not always flattered established practice. On many routes the published interval bore little relation to the observed one: buses arrived in pairs separated by long gaps, a pattern familiar to passengers and long denied by operators. The cause is well understood mathematically. A bus that falls slightly behind collects more waiting passengers, loses further time at each stop, and is steadily caught by the vehicle behind. Once the pattern was visible in the records, the argument about whether it existed simply ended.

Ticketing records also revealed journeys that no timetable had anticipated. Substantial flows appeared between outer districts, bypassing the centre altogether, and these were served by routes designed on the assumption that everybody travelled inward each morning. Where operators added direct connections, use rose faster than any model had predicted. That suggests suppressed demand had existed for years without leaving a trace in the older counts.

Data of this kind is not self-interpreting. Card records show boardings, not intentions; they cannot say whether a passenger changed vehicles reluctantly or preferred to walk part of the way. Nor do they capture anybody who abandoned the service long ago. Used carefully, alongside interviews and street observation, the records make bus planning far less speculative than it was. A timetable remains a promise made to people, and no promise can be derived from a table alone. Treated as an oracle, they simply automate the assumptions already built into the network.
qs: On balance, which reading of the whole piece holds up?
the records may now make passenger interviews largely unnecessary
the records sharpen planning, though they still need careful reading
the records still ended an argument operators long denied, though slowly
the records reveal outer-district demand that older counts may have missed

qs.evidence: Used carefully, alongside interviews and street observation, the records make bus planning far less speculative than it was.
qs.answer: the records sharpen planning, though they still need careful reading
qs.why: Paragraf akhir menyebut catatan itu membuat perencanaan jauh kurang spekulatif bila dipakai hati-hati bersama wawancara dan pengamatan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi wawancara jadi tak perlu bertabrakan dengan syarat “alongside interviews and street observation”; opsi perselisihan yang berakhir dan opsi permintaan yang tersembunyi memang disebut teks, tetapi keduanya temuan penopang di paragraf dua dan tiga, sedangkan simpulan pokoknya soal cara membaca.

qs: Why, mathematically, do buses end up travelling in pairs?
drivers hold at stops to keep to the published interval
a late bus picks up more waiting passengers and slows further
planners counted passengers by hand for only a fortnight
flows between outer districts crowd the buses in the centre

qs.evidence: A bus that falls slightly behind collects more waiting passengers, loses further time at each stop, and is steadily caught by the vehicle behind.
qs.answer: a late bus picks up more waiting passengers and slows further
qs.why: Bus yang tertinggal sedikit mengumpulkan lebih banyak penumpang menunggu, kehilangan waktu di setiap halte, lalu dikejar bus di belakangnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penahanan bus di halte demi jadwal masuk akal di dunia nyata, tapi teks nggak menyebutnya sebagai sebab; hitungan manual dua minggu adalah praktik lama sebelum tiket elektronik, bukan penyebab penumpukan; dan arus antar daerah luar justru temuan terpisah tentang perjalanan yang melewati pusat kota.

qs: How does the writer regard the operators' earlier denials of this pattern?
unimpressed, though allowing the mathematics was grasped only lately
unimpressed, though chiefly with models that assumed inward travel
unimpressed, since passengers had described the pattern for years
unimpressed, yet leaving the disagreement for the operators to settle

qs.evidence: On many routes the published interval bore little relation to the observed one: buses arrived in pairs separated by long gaps, a pattern familiar to passengers and long denied by operators.
qs.answer: unimpressed, since passengers had described the pattern for years
qs.why: Polanya disebut "familiar to passengers and long denied by operators", jadi penyangkalan itu nggak dihargai penulis: yang membatalkannya bukan kebaruan angka, melainkan kesaksian yang udah lama ada.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi nggak terkesan dan dua di antaranya mengaku memberi kelonggaran, sehingga register kunci nggak menonjol; pemilihnya sinyal leksikal. Kelonggaran bahwa matematikanya baru dipahami salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "The cause is well understood mathematically". Keberatan yang terutama pada model perjalanan ke pusat salah SASARAN: itu temuan terpisah tentang arus antar-distrik, sedangkan frasa pemblokir untuk penyangkalannya adalah "a pattern familiar to passengers and long denied by operators". Penyerahan sengketa kepada operator salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "the argument about whether it existed simply ended".

qs: Which restatement is closest to the writer's warning in the final paragraph?
used with care they inform a timetable, while read as the last word they repeat what the routes assume
used with care they inform a timetable, while treated as an oracle they overstate demand between outer districts
used with care they inform a timetable, while read as the last word they harden the beliefs that passengers bring
used with care they inform a timetable, while read as the last word they stand in for intentions no card records

qs.evidence: Treated as an oracle, they simply automate the assumptions already built into the network.
qs.answer: used with care they inform a timetable, while read as the last word they repeat what the routes assume
qs.why: Peringatan penutupnya berpasangan: dipakai hati-hati catatan itu memperbaiki perencanaan, tetapi dijadikan penentu akhir ia sekadar mengulang apa yang udah tertanam dalam rancangan jaringan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi ditulis dalam satu bentuk kontras dua-arah yang sama, jadi kuncinya nggak bisa ditebak dari bentuknya; tiap pengecoh menggeser TEPAT SATU unsur. Opsi permintaan antardistrik menggeser AKIBAT, dari asumsi ke angka permintaan, dan diblokir "they simply automate the assumptions already built into the network". Opsi keyakinan penumpang menggeser PEMILIK asumsi, yang di teks adalah jaringannya. Opsi menggantikan niat menggeser CAKUPAN ke keberatan lain, "Card records show boardings, not intentions", yang berada di kalimat lain dan bukan isi peringatan penutup.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Some travel between outer districts avoided the city centre entirely."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Some travel between outer districts avoided the city centre entirely.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Substantial flows appeared between outer districts, bypassing the centre altogether, and these were served by routes designed on the assumption that everybody travelled inward each morning.
qs.why: "Bypassing the centre altogether" persis sama maksudnya dengan sepenuhnya menghindari pusat kota.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada bantahan; "Not stated" salah karena arus antar daerah luar disebut jelas.

author: Transport research digest
setting: a transport authority rewriting its timetables

title: Eleven Streets, Two Calendars
text:
The plan is modest on paper: eleven streets in the old centre closed to private vehicles between eight in the morning and seven in the evening, with deliveries permitted before nine. It has nonetheless produced a dispute in which both sides speak with evident sincerity. The strongest arguments, as often happens, are not the loudest ones. Both cases deserve to be stated at full strength, which is not how either has been reported.

For the traders' association the objection is arithmetic. Its members sell furniture, tiles and building materials, goods that customers arrive to collect by car and would never carry on a tram. A shop that loses its kerbside loses the transaction, not merely the convenience, and rents in the centre already assume a certain turnover. The association also notes, reasonably enough, that consultation took place through an online form during a fortnight in August.

The planning department answers with a different set of numbers. Counts on the same streets show pedestrians outnumbering car passengers by roughly nine to one, and most arrivals by car are visitors passing through rather than customers. Similar schemes elsewhere, it argues, produced a temporary decline in trade followed by a slow recovery, particularly for cafés and small retailers. The department also points out that the closure hours were chosen to protect early morning trade. It accepts that furniture merchants are a genuine exception and has offered loading permits.

What the exchange reveals is a mismatch of time horizons. The trader's difficulty is immediate and specific; the planner's benefit is gradual and general, and gradual benefits are poor compensation for a rent due in March. A scheme of this sort can still be defended, but only where the transition is funded rather than merely announced. Neither side is asking the other to disappear; each is asking to be counted properly. Whether the council has grasped that distinction is, on the evidence of its consultation, unclear.
qs: Why does the writer set out both cases in such detail?
to show that the traders' arithmetic is weaker than the planners' counts
to show that the real difference between the sides is timing
to argue that the consultation leaves the scheme poorly defended
to show that the sides disagree over how many customers arrive by car

qs.evidence: What the exchange reveals is a mismatch of time horizons.
qs.answer: to show that the real difference between the sides is timing
qs.why: Frasa "What the exchange reveals is a mismatch of time horizons" adalah kesimpulan penulis sendiri, dan langsung dijabarkan: kesulitan pedagang "immediate and specific", manfaat perencana "gradual and general".
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sejalan dengan tesis bahwa kedua pihak tulus dan perselisihannya nyata, tapi salah sasaran atau derajat. Pelemahan angka pedagang diblokir "reasonably enough" dan "Both cases deserve to be stated at full strength". Klaim bahwa konsultasi membuat skema sulit dibela diblokir "A scheme of this sort can still be defended, but only where the transition is funded rather than merely announced" — konsultasi meragukan pemahaman dewan, bukan keabsahan rencananya. Perselisihan soal jumlah pelanggan bermobil salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "What the exchange reveals is a mismatch of time horizons", bukan sengketa angka.

qs: What do the department's counts show about arrivals by car?
car customers tend to spend more per visit than those on foot
most drivers arrive before nine to collect building materials
most people arriving by car are not there to shop
car passengers outnumber pedestrians on the eleven streets

qs.evidence: Counts on the same streets show pedestrians outnumbering car passengers by roughly nine to one, and most arrivals by car are visitors passing through rather than customers.
qs.answer: most people arriving by car are not there to shop
qs.why: Pencacahan dinas perencanaan menyebut sebagian besar yang datang bermobil adalah pelintas, bukan pembeli.
qs.whyOthersFail: Belanja per kunjungan nggak pernah dihitung di teks, meski itu argumen yang wajar dipakai pedagang; jam sebelum sembilan adalah aturan bongkar-muat dalam rencana, bukan temuan pencacahan; dan perbandingannya justru dibalik, sebab pejalan kaki disebut sembilan banding satu terhadap penumpang mobil.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the council's consultation?
unimpressed, though chiefly with the way the dispute was reported
unimpressed, while granting the online form reached both sides fairly
unimpressed, yet content that the funded transition is already in hand
unimpressed, and doubtful that the exercise was adequate

qs.evidence: Whether the council has grasped that distinction is, on the evidence of its consultation, unclear.
qs.answer: unimpressed, and doubtful that the exercise was adequate
qs.why: Kalimat penutup menyebut, "on the evidence of its consultation", nggak jelas apakah dewan menangkap perbedaan itu; jadi konsultasinya sendiri yang diragukan kecukupannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi nggak terkesan dan dua di antaranya memberi kelonggaran serupa kunci, jadi tesis lintas-soal nggak memilih; pemilihnya sasaran dan derajat. Keberatan yang terutama pada pemberitaan salah SASARAN: pemberitaan memang ditegur, tetapi frasa pemblokirnya "on the evidence of its consultation", yang menunjuk dewan. Kelonggaran bahwa formulir daring menjangkau kedua pihak salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "consultation took place through an online form during a fortnight in August", yang dicatat sebagai keberatan wajar. Kepuasan bahwa transisi berbiaya udah tersedia salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "only where the transition is funded rather than merely announced".

qs: What can be inferred about a trader with rent falling due in March?
a benefit that arrives slowly is no use to her
the slow recovery in cafe trade may still reach her
she has already been given a loading permit
she may accept the scheme once takings recover

qs.evidence: The trader's difficulty is immediate and specific; the planner's benefit is gradual and general, and gradual benefits are poor compensation for a rent due in March.
qs.answer: a benefit that arrives slowly is no use to her
qs.why: Frasa "poor compensation for a rent due in March" mengunci ketidakcocokannya: manfaat bertahap tak menutup tagihan yang jatuh tempo.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pemulihan kafe yang masih sampai kepadanya diblokir "gradual benefits are poor compensation for a rent due in March" plus "a temporary decline in trade followed by a slow recovery"; pemberian izin bongkar-muat gugur karena teks menyebut dinas "has offered" izin dan khusus untuk pedagang furnitur, tanpa penerima yang digambarkan; dan penerimaan setelah pendapatan pulih bertabrakan dengan syarat penulis, "only where the transition is funded rather than merely announced".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The scheme was introduced because deliveries in the centre had become unmanageable."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The scheme was introduced because deliveries in the centre had become unmanageable.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The plan is modest on paper: eleven streets in the old centre closed to private vehicles between eight in the morning and seven in the evening, with deliveries permitted before nine.
qs.why: Kalimat terdekat cuma menerangkan isi rencana dan jam bongkar-muat; alasan kenapa rencana itu dibuat nggak pernah dinyatakan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh sebab yang nggak ada di teks; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal sebab apa pun.

topic: a proposal to close central streets to cars
author: City affairs report
setting: an old commercial centre under consultation

title: Eleven Small Charges
text:
A decade ago the household ledger was mostly a list of purchases; now it is a list of arrangements. Streaming, storage, insurance, software, a monthly delivery of razor blades: each removes a small sum every month, and each was designed to be easier to begin than to end. The individual amounts are trivial, which is precisely the mechanism. Nobody signs up intending to forget, and that is exactly why the arrangement works so well.

Consider how the choice is presented. A trial costs nothing for a month and requires payment details at the outset. Cancellation is available, though rarely on the page where the subscription began, and the reminder that would prompt it is seldom sent. None of this is fraud; every term appears somewhere in the agreement. The wording is honest and the placement is not, and only one of those is regulated. The design simply relies on a well-documented feature of human attention: we discount small recurring costs and overestimate how carefully we monitor them.

The aggregate is not trivial at all. Surveys of household spending routinely find that people underestimate their monthly commitments by about a third, and that the shortfall is widest among those with the least room to absorb it. A charge of four pounds is easy to ignore; eleven such charges are a utility bill. Firms understand this arithmetic better than their customers do, since only one party sees the whole ledger. The firm, meanwhile, enjoys revenue that requires no further persuasion, which is exactly why investors value it so highly.

Regulation here need not be heavy. Require that cancellation be no harder than subscription, that a reminder precede any annual renewal, and that the yearly total appear beside the monthly figure. Firms confident of their value have little to fear from such rules; those relying on inattention will object loudly, and their objection is itself the evidence. Households, for their part, might usefully audit their own arrangements once a year, in the same spirit as checking a bank statement.
qs: On balance, which conclusion is the argument built to reach?
the placement of the terms, not their wording, is what needs a rule
households would spend far less if they audited their own arrangements
small recurring charges are designed around a predictable inattention
firms read the household ledger rather better than the household does

qs.evidence: The design simply relies on a well-documented feature of human attention: we discount small recurring costs and overestimate how carefully we monitor them.
qs.answer: small recurring charges are designed around a predictable inattention
qs.why: Paragraf dua menyebut rancangannya bersandar pada ciri perhatian manusia: biaya kecil berulang diabaikan dan pemantauannya ditaksir terlalu tinggi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penempatan syarat dan opsi firma yang lebih paham buku belanja memang kalimat teks, tetapi keduanya penopang, bukan tesisnya; opsi audit rumah tangga menggeser bebannya ke pelanggan, padahal teks menaruh remedi utama pada aturan bagi firma.

qs: According to the essay, by how much do households typically misjudge their commitments?
by rather less among households with the least room to spare
by roughly one pound in every three that they owe
by the cost of one annual renewal they forgot to stop
by about four pounds in an average month

qs.evidence: Surveys of household spending routinely find that people underestimate their monthly commitments by about a third, and that the shortfall is widest among those with the least room to absorb it.
qs.answer: by roughly one pound in every three that they owe
qs.why: Survei yang dikutip menyebut orang meremehkan kewajiban bulanan mereka sekitar sepertiga, jadi kira-kira satu pound dari setiap tiga pound yang harus dibayar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Arah selisihnya justru dibalik, karena teks menyebut selisih paling lebar pada rumah tangga yang paling sempit ruangnya; biaya satu pemberitahuan perpanjangan nggak pernah dijadikan ukuran; dan empat pound adalah contoh satu tagihan kecil, bukan besar selisihnya.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards firms that would resist the proposed rules?
sceptical, though allowing that compliance would cost such firms something
sceptical, taking a loud objection largely as evidence in itself
sceptical, since every term is kept out of the customer's sight
sceptical, though content to leave cancellation where it is now placed

qs.evidence: Firms confident of their value have little to fear from such rules; those relying on inattention will object loudly, and their objection is itself the evidence.
qs.answer: sceptical, taking a loud objection largely as evidence in itself
qs.why: Kalimat penutup paragraf empat menyediakan penguncinya: "those relying on inattention will object loudly, and their objection is itself the evidence". Keberatan yang lantang dibaca sebagai bukti, bukan sebagai keluhan yang perlu ditimbang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi skeptis dan dua di antaranya memakai kelonggaran terukur yang sama seperti kunci, jadi menebak tesis nggak menolong; pemilihnya sasaran dan derajat. Kelonggaran pada biaya kepatuhan salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Firms confident of their value have little to fear from such rules" dan "Regulation here need not be heavy". Tuduhan menyembunyikan syarat salah DERAJAT juga: frasa pemblokirnya "every term appears somewhere in the agreement" — yang dipersoalkan penempatannya. Kesediaan membiarkan letak pembatalan salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "Require that cancellation be no harder than subscription".

qs: What does the essay imply about a trial that requires payment details in advance?
regulators may already require a reminder before it ends
the seller counts on customers forgetting to leave
the seller means to charge more than the terms allow
most customers may cancel on the page where they joined

qs.evidence: Cancellation is available, though rarely on the page where the subscription began, and the reminder that would prompt it is seldom sent.
qs.answer: the seller counts on customers forgetting to leave
qs.why: Dua sinyal berderet: pembatalan "rarely on the page where the subscription began" dan pengingat "seldom sent". Rancangan seperti itu menghitung pelanggan yang lupa keluar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kewajiban pengingat yang mungkin udah berlaku diblokir daftar usulan di paragraf akhir, "that a reminder precede any annual renewal", jadi belum ada aturannya; niat menagih di luar perjanjian gugur pada "None of this is fraud; every term appears somewhere in the agreement"; dan kebiasaan membatalkan di halaman pendaftaran bertabrakan dengan kata "rarely on the page where the subscription began".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The essay treats these subscription practices as unlawful."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The essay treats these subscription practices as unlawful.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: None of this is fraud; every term appears somewhere in the agreement.
qs.why: Penulis menegaskan praktik ini bukan penipuan dan seluruh syaratnya tertulis, jadi klaim soal melanggar hukum bertentangan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" bertabrakan langsung dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" salah karena status hukumnya justru dibahas.

author: Consumer economics essay
setting: the modern household ledger

title: The Clock That Will Not Be Argued With
text:
Shift work is often discussed as a matter of preference, as though the only difficulty were that some people dislike early mornings. Laboratory evidence suggests something considerably less negotiable. The internal clock that governs body temperature, hormone release and alertness runs on a cycle of roughly twenty-four hours, and it takes its instructions chiefly from light. Ask that clock to invert its cycle and it complies slowly, incompletely, and never for good. It is not a habit that a worker can be talked out of.

The consequences are measurable within days. Volunteers kept awake at night under controlled conditions show reduced glucose tolerance, raised blood pressure and impaired attention on tasks demanding sustained vigilance. Performance declines most sharply between three and five in the morning, precisely when hospital wards, lorry cabs and control rooms are least supervised. Errors at that hour are not evidence of carelessness; they are a predictable output of the rota. Nobody chooses to be least capable at the moment of greatest responsibility; the pattern shows up in the same hours, week after week, on every kind of site.

Not every rota is equally punishing. Studies of rotating patterns consistently find that shifts advancing forwards, from morning to afternoon to night, are tolerated better than those which jump backwards. Longer runs on a single pattern allow partial adjustment, whereas a week alternating between days and nights prevents any adjustment at all. Access to daylight after a night shift, and darkness during recovery sleep, matters more than the total hours logged. These are cheap adjustments, and they are frequently the last to be considered.

None of this argues for the abolition of night work, which some services plainly require. It argues that the rota is a piece of safety equipment, and should be designed with the same seriousness as any other. Where employers have redesigned patterns on the evidence, absence and error rates have fallen without any reduction in output. Rotas are drawn up months ahead, so the chance to get them right comes round often. Where they have not, the cost is still paid, simply by somebody else.
qs: On balance, which claim survives the qualifications made along the way?
night work should end wherever a service does not require it
the body clock adjusts fully once one pattern is kept long enough
errors before dawn reflect how thinly such sites are supervised
night work imposes measurable costs that rota design can reduce

qs.evidence: It argues that the rota is a piece of safety equipment, and should be designed with the same seriousness as any other.
qs.answer: night work imposes measurable costs that rota design can reduce
qs.why: Paragraf akhir menyebut rota sebagai perlengkapan keselamatan yang harus dirancang serius, sesudah dua paragraf mengukur biaya kerja malam.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi mengakhiri kerja malam bertabrakan dengan “None of this argues for the abolition of night work”; opsi jam tubuh menyesuaikan penuh bertabrakan dengan “complies slowly, incompletely, and never for good”; opsi pengawasan tipis sebagai sebab bertabrakan dengan kesalahan yang disebut keluaran rota yang terduga.

qs: At what time of night does performance fall most sharply?
towards the end of a long run on one single pattern
in the hour after daylight returns following a night shift
during the first hour of any rotating night shift
in the small hours before dawn, around four o'clock

qs.evidence: Performance declines most sharply between three and five in the morning, precisely when hospital wards, lorry cabs and control rooms are least supervised.
qs.answer: in the small hours before dawn, around four o'clock
qs.why: Teks menyebut penurunan paling tajam terjadi antara pukul tiga dan lima pagi, jadi kira-kira pukul empat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Rangkaian panjang pada satu pola justru disebut memungkinkan penyesuaian sebagian, bukan penurunan terburuk; cahaya pagi setelah sif malam disebut sebagai hal yang membantu pemulihan; dan jam pertama sif nggak pernah disebut sebagai titik terburuk.

qs: How does the writer regard employers who leave punishing rotas unchanged?
disapproving, and holding such employers answerable for the cost
disapproving, yet accepting that a punishing rota is sometimes unavoidable
disapproving, though unwilling to press for the rota to be redesigned
disapproving, though hopeful the cheap adjustments are now widely made

qs.evidence: Where they have not, the cost is still paid, simply by somebody else.
qs.answer: disapproving, and holding such employers answerable for the cost
qs.why: Kalimat penutup memindahkan tanggungan: "Where they have not, the cost is still paid, simply by somebody else". Jadi pemberi kerja yang membiarkan rota tetap dianggap berutang atas biaya itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi mencela pemberi kerja dan tiga di antaranya menahan diri atau memberi kelonggaran, sehingga bentuk kunci nggak lagi khas; pemilihnya sinyal leksikal. Penerimaan bahwa rota menyiksa itu tak terhindarkan salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Not every rota is equally punishing" dan "These are cheap adjustments". Keengganan menuntut perancangan ulang rota salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "the rota is a piece of safety equipment, and should be designed with the same seriousness as any other". Harapan bahwa penyesuaian murah kini lazim salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "they are frequently the last to be considered".

qs: What does the article imply about a week alternating between day and night shifts?
it may suit workers who dislike long runs
it matters less than the total number of hours logged
it is perhaps tolerated better than forward rotation
it denies the body any chance to settle

qs.evidence: Longer runs on a single pattern allow partial adjustment, whereas a week alternating between days and nights prevents any adjustment at all.
qs.answer: it denies the body any chance to settle
qs.why: Penanda kontras "whereas" memisahkan dua nasib: rangkaian panjang memberi penyesuaian sebagian, minggu bergantian "prevents any adjustment at all".
qs.whyOthersFail: Kecocokan dengan selera pekerja diblokir kalimat pembuka yang menolak kerangka itu, "Shift work is often discussed as a matter of preference... Laboratory evidence suggests something considerably less negotiable"; peremehan pola dibanding total jam gugur karena teks menempatkan total jam di bawah akses cahaya, bukan di atas pola; dan klaim lebih tertahankan bertabrakan dengan "shifts advancing forwards... are tolerated better than those which jump backwards", jadi arahnya justru dibalik.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The body clock takes its timing mainly from light."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The body clock takes its timing mainly from light.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The internal clock that governs body temperature, hormone release and alertness runs on a cycle of roughly twenty-four hours, and it takes its instructions chiefly from light.
qs.why: "Instructions chiefly from light" itu parafrasa langsung: penanda waktunya terutama cahaya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada bantahan; "Not stated" salah karena peran cahaya disebut jelas di paragraf pertama.

topic: night work and the human body clock
author: Health science feature
setting: sleep laboratories and the industries that run at night

title: Advice on Publishing Admissions Figures
text:
This paper responds to a request for advice on publishing university admissions data. Institutions currently release the number of applications and offers by course, but not the distribution of grades among those admitted, nor the proportion of places filled through routes other than the standard one. Applicants therefore plan against a picture that is accurate in outline and misleading in detail. That gap is small in law and large in practice. Most applicants apply to five courses and hear back from all but one of them.

Three arguments for fuller publication are persuasive. Where entry requirements are advertised as higher than those actually accepted, applicants from schools without experienced advisers are the ones most likely to be deterred. Publication also permits scrutiny of contextual offers, which several institutions defend in principle while declining to say how often they are made. Finally, the present opacity protects nobody except the institution, since rejected applicants learn nothing whatever about why. Nobody should have to guess at a rule that has already been written down.

Two objections deserve a serious answer. Small courses cannot publish grade distributions without effectively identifying individuals, so any scheme must set a minimum cohort size. More broadly, institutions fear that fuller data will be compressed into a league table rewarding the selection of already advantaged applicants.
