That risk is real, though it argues for publishing alongside a measure of progress after entry, not for publishing nothing. Refusing to measure is itself a decision about who bears the uncertainty. A bad table is a reason to build a better one.

None of this asks a single institution to lower its bar. We recommend that the department require annual publication of grade distributions for courses above a threshold of forty admitted students, together with the number of offers made on contextual grounds. Publication should be centralized in a single register rather than left to individual prospectuses. The department should also fund one longitudinal study of how applicants actually use such information, since the case for transparency currently rests more on principle than on evidence about behaviour.
qs: What is the main purpose of this paper?
to advise the department to fund a study of how applicants choose
to warn that fuller data may be squeezed into a new league table
to advise that admissions figures be published more fully
to ask that entry requirements be lowered where they mislead

qs.evidence: We recommend that the department require annual publication of grade distributions for courses above a threshold of forty admitted students, together with the number of offers made on contextual grounds.
qs.answer: to advise that admissions figures be published more fully
qs.why: Penguncinya kalimat "We recommend that the department require annual publication of grade distributions ... together with the number of offers made on contextual grounds", yang menyatukan ketiga hujah sebelumnya menjadi satu nasihat: terbitkan lebih lengkap.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh mengulang bagian nyata dari tesis makalah (keterbukaan itu baik) dan dua di antaranya memakai register nasihat yang sama dengan kunci; yang memisahkan adalah cakupan dan derajat. Usulan mendanai studi perilaku pelamar salah CAKUPAN: frasa pemblokirnya "The department should also fund one longitudinal study", ditandai "also" sebagai tambahan atas rekomendasi utama "We recommend that the department require annual publication of grade distributions". Peringatan tabel peringkat salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "That risk is real, though it argues for publishing alongside a measure of progress after entry, not for publishing nothing". Penurunan syarat masuk salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "None of this asks a single institution to lower its bar".

qs: What does the paper say institutions do not currently release?
the proportion of applicants rejected at each institution
the number of applications received for each course
how far marks vary within an admitted cohort
the entry requirements advertised for each course

qs.evidence: Institutions currently release the number of applications and offers by course, but not the distribution of grades among those admitted, nor the proportion of places filled through routes other than the standard one.
qs.answer: how far marks vary within an admitted cohort
qs.why: Yang ditahan justru sebaran nilai di antara mahasiswa yang diterima, jadi seberapa jauh nilai mereka berbeda-beda.
qs.whyOthersFail: Proporsi pelamar yang ditolak nggak pernah masuk daftar data yang dibahas; jumlah lamaran dan tawaran justru disebut udah diterbitkan sekarang; dan syarat masuk memang diiklankan, malah kadang lebih tinggi daripada yang sungguh diterima.

qs: How does the paper treat the fear of a new league table?
an objection worth answering, though raised largely to shield institutions
a genuine risk that argues for withholding the contextual offer counts
a genuine risk that argues for a better measure instead
a genuine risk that argues for leaving publication to each prospectus

qs.evidence: That risk is real, though it argues for publishing alongside a measure of progress after entry, not for publishing nothing.
qs.answer: a genuine risk that argues for a better measure instead
qs.why: Kalimatnya mengakui lalu mengalihkan: "That risk is real, though it argues for publishing alongside a measure of progress after entry, not for publishing nothing", dan ditutup "A bad table is a reason to build a better one".
qs.whyOthersFail: Tiga opsi mengakui risikonya sungguhan dan menarik satu kesimpulan terukur, jadi register kunci nggak menonjol; pemilihnya jalan keluar yang dipilih teks. Tuduhan motif melindungi institusi salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "That risk is real", sebuah pengakuan, bukan pembongkaran motif. Penahanan angka tawaran kontekstual salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "together with the number of offers made on contextual grounds". Penyerahan penerbitan kepada prospektus salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Publication should be centralized in a single register rather than left to individual prospectuses".

qs: What does the paper imply about the evidence behind the case for transparency?
it is thinner than the principle it supports
it may rest on a finished study of behaviour
it comes perhaps mainly from small cohorts
it was gathered before the advice was requested

qs.evidence: The department should also fund one longitudinal study of how applicants actually use such information, since the case for transparency currently rests more on principle than on evidence about behaviour.
qs.answer: it is thinner than the principle it supports
qs.why: Klausa "rests more on principle than on evidence about behaviour" mengunci timbangannya, dan studinya masih berupa permintaan pendanaan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Studi yang udah selesai diblokir kata "The department should also fund one longitudinal study", yaitu belum dikerjakan; asal bukti dari kursus kecil gugur karena kursus kecil muncul di keberatan privasi, "without effectively identifying individuals", bukan sebagai sumber data; dan pengumpulan sebelum permintaan nasihat nggak punya jejak apa pun di teks.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The paper wants the figures gathered in one central register."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The paper wants the figures gathered in one central register.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Publication should be centralized in a single register rather than left to individual prospectuses.
qs.why: "Centralized in a single register" sama maksudnya dengan dikumpulkan dalam satu daftar pusat.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena nggak ada penolakan; "Not stated" salah karena rekomendasi itu tertulis jelas.

author: Education policy unit
setting: a policy unit advising an education department

title: A Private Habit Made Public
text:
Not long ago, few people outside research had heard of a preprint. A study posted directly to a public server, without review by other specialists, was an internal convenience: a way for colleagues to read work early and comment on it. Then such papers began appearing in news bulletins within hours of posting, and a habit developed inside the profession became a public instrument almost overnight.

The gains are real and should not be surrendered. Rapid posting allowed methods to be shared during an emergency in weeks rather than months, and mistakes were sometimes identified in public within a day. Speed of circulation is itself a scientific value when the question is urgent. Review by journals is slow, unpaid and unevenly performed; treating it as a guarantee of truth was always a comfortable fiction. Anyone who has seen a reviewed paper retracted knows the seal was never worth what readers assumed.

The difficulty lies not in posting but in translation. A preprint carries no signal a general reader can use, and the phrase 'not yet reviewed' does no work in a headline. Coverage therefore treats a first draft and a settled finding as equivalent claims, and the correction, when it comes, reaches a fraction of the original audience. A reader sees a study, a number and a headline, and very little else. Trust is spent at the moment of announcement and can only be repaid slowly.

Responsibility here is shared and mostly unclaimed, though servers could readily require a plain statement of what remains untested. Institutions could stop issuing press releases about work nobody outside the group has examined. Reporters could resist the verb 'shows' where 'suggests' would be accurate. None of that slows research by a single day; it merely stops a useful internal habit from being sold to the public as a finished product. None of these interventions imposes expenditure or requires additional institutional machinery.
qs: On balance, where does the argument come to rest?
journal review is slower and less reliable than readers assume
a practice useful inside research fails as the public reads it
the servers rather than the reporters must supply the warning
institutions should stop announcing work no outsider has read

qs.evidence: None of that slows research by a single day; it merely stops a useful internal habit from being sold to the public as a finished product.
qs.answer: a practice useful inside research fails as the public reads it
qs.why: Kalimat penutup menyebut usulannya hanya menghentikan kebiasaan internal yang berguna dari dijual kepada publik sebagai produk jadi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kelemahan telaah jurnal adalah anggapan dasar paragraf dua, bukan tesisnya; opsi server sebagai satu-satunya yang harus berubah bertabrakan dengan tanggung jawab yang disebut “shared” antara server, institusi, dan reporter; opsi institusi berhenti mengumumkan adalah satu dari tiga saran, bukan simpulannya.

qs: On balance, what does the essay say a preprint fails to give a general reader?
a record of which specialists have commented on it
a marker of status that a lay reader can interpret
an audience large enough to notice a later correction
a server that can publish it within a few hours

qs.evidence: A preprint carries no signal a general reader can use, and the phrase 'not yet reviewed' does no work in a headline.
qs.answer: a marker of status that a lay reader can interpret
qs.why: Teks menyebut preprint nggak membawa penanda apa pun yang bisa dipakai pembaca umum, dan frasa 'belum ditinjau' tak bekerja di judul berita.
qs.whyOthersFail: Catatan siapa saja yang mengomentari memang bukan bagian dari preprint, tapi teks nggak pernah menyebutnya sebagai yang hilang; jangkauan koreksi adalah akibat di ranah pemberitaan, bukan sesuatu yang seharusnya ada di preprintnya; dan server cepat justru tersedia, itulah sebab makalah bisa terbit dalam hitungan jam.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards review by journals?
unimpressed, though allowing that an early posting still needs translating
unimpressed, yet grateful that it filters weak work before release
unimpressed, though content to let the seal stand as a signal for readers
unimpressed, since readers hand it an authority it never earned

qs.evidence: Anyone who has seen a reviewed paper retracted knows the seal was never worth what readers assumed.
qs.answer: unimpressed, since readers hand it an authority it never earned
qs.why: Frasa penguncinya dua: telaah jurnal sebagai jaminan kebenaran disebut "a comfortable fiction", dan siapa pun yang pernah melihat makalah tertelaah ditarik tahu segelnya tak sebernilai dugaan pembaca.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi nggak terkesan pada telaah jurnal dan dua di antaranya memberi kelonggaran atau menahan diri seperti kunci, jadi bentuknya nggak memisahkan; pemilihnya sasaran dan nuansa. Kelonggaran soal draf yang perlu diterjemahkan salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "The difficulty lies not in posting but in translation", yaitu kesulitan praterbitan, bukan sifat telaahnya. Rasa syukur pada penyaringan salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "treating it as a guarantee of truth was always a comfortable fiction". Kesediaan membiarkan segelnya berdiri sebagai isyarat salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "the seal was never worth what readers assumed" dan usul "servers could readily require a plain statement of what remains untested".

qs: Which conclusion about corrections issued after the first story does the essay lead to?
they may reach much the same readers as the first claim
most readers of the first story never see them
they are perhaps issued by the reporter involved
they rebuild trust faster than it was spent

qs.evidence: Coverage therefore treats a first draft and a settled finding as equivalent claims, and the correction, when it comes, reaches a fraction of the original audience.
qs.answer: most readers of the first story never see them
qs.why: Frasa "reaches a fraction of the original audience" mengunci jangkauannya: sebagian besar pembaca berita pertama tak pernah menemuinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Khalayak yang sama diblokir "the correction, when it comes, reaches a fraction of the original audience"; penunjukan reporter sebagai penerbit koreksi gugur karena teks diam soal siapa yang mengeluarkannya dan hanya meminta jurnalis menahan kata "shows"; dan pemulihan kepercayaan yang cepat bertabrakan dengan "Trust is spent at the moment of announcement and can only be repaid slowly".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer argues that posting papers before review should stop."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer argues that posting papers before review should stop.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The gains are real and should not be surrendered.
qs.why: Penulis menyatakan keuntungan praktik itu nyata dan tak boleh dilepaskan, jadi klaim ini berlawanan dengan posisinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" bertabrakan dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" salah karena sikapnya soal melanjutkan praktik itu dinyatakan langsung.

topic: preprints and the reporting of new research
author: Argumentative essay
setting: public servers, newsrooms and research institutions

title: The Number a Rule Chooses to Notice
text:
Complaints about railway noise are usually met with an average. The figure quoted, a level averaged across the whole day, is the measure written into most regulations, and by that measure many flats beside a busy line are comfortably compliant. Residents who cannot sleep are therefore told, in effect, that their experience is not the thing being measured. The reply is legally sound and beside the point.

Research on sleep disturbance suggests those residents are describing something the average conceals. A body asleep responds not to the mean level but to the change: the rise from a quiet background to the pass-by of a freight train. Recordings made in bedrooms show heart rate increases and brief awakenings that the sleeper never remembers. These events track the number of individual trains rather than the daily total of sound energy. Two lines with identical averages can therefore produce quite different nights.

The practical implications are unwelcome for planners. A freight service moved to the small hours to relieve daytime congestion improves the average while worsening exactly the events that matter. Barriers help, but chiefly for the upper floors they were never designed to shield. The most effective single measure, according to several studies, is maintenance: grinding the rail and truing the wheels reduce the sharp components of the sound that wake people. That work helps along the whole route, not at one screened point.

What follows is not that averages are useless, but that a rule written around one quantity will be defended in that quantity's terms. Until events during the night are counted, an operator can satisfy every requirement while a street sleeps badly. That is not a scientific difficulty, since the measurements exist and are not expensive; rather, regulatory metrics acquire an authority disproportionate to their original justification. The choice of measure is itself a policy, and it has been made already. It is a question of which number a rule chooses to notice.
qs: On balance, which claim would the author refuse to give up?
the quantity the rule counts is not the one that wakes people
grinding rail and truing wheels may be the cheapest remedy
residents beside a busy line have little legal ground to stand on
the science of night-time disturbance is too unsettled to act on

qs.evidence: The choice of measure is itself a policy, and it has been made already.
qs.answer: the quantity the rule counts is not the one that wakes people
qs.why: Teks menyimpulkan pilihan ukuran itu sendiri sebuah kebijakan, sesudah menunjukkan bahwa yang membangunkan orang adalah peristiwa, bukan rata-rata.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi perawatan termurah adalah temuan penopang di paragraf tiga, bukan tesisnya; opsi penghuni tanpa dasar hukum membalik nilai kalimat “legally sound and beside the point”; opsi ilmunya belum mapan bertabrakan dengan “That is not a scientific difficulty, since the measurements exist”.

qs: According to the research, what does a sleeping body react to?
the number of trains passing during the working day
the total sound energy accumulated across a day
each abrupt jump in loudness when a train goes past
the average level written into most regulations

qs.evidence: A body asleep responds not to the mean level but to the change: the rise from a quiet background to the pass-by of a freight train.
qs.answer: each abrupt jump in loudness when a train goes past
qs.why: Tubuh yang tidur disebut menanggapi perubahan, yaitu lonjakan dari latar sunyi ke suara kereta yang melintas.
qs.whyOthersFail: Jumlah kereta memang penting, tapi teks mengaitkannya dengan peristiwa terbangun pada malam, bukan lalu lintas siang; energi bunyi harian justru yang nggak dirasakan tubuh; dan rata-rata dalam regulasi adalah ukuran yang sedang dikritik.

qs: Which finding gives the strongest support for the claim that averages mislead?
barriers can help the floors they were not meant to shield
identical daily figures can hide very unequal nights
regulations are written around a level averaged over the day
grinding the rail reduces the sharp components of the sound

qs.evidence: Two lines with identical averages can therefore produce quite different nights.
qs.answer: identical daily figures can hide very unequal nights
qs.why: Dua jalur dengan rata-rata sama bisa menghasilkan malam yang sangat berbeda; itu bukti paling langsung bahwa rata-rata menyesatkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Soal penghalang dan penggerindaan rel adalah pilihan penanganan, bukan bukti tentang cacat rata-rata; dan fakta bahwa regulasi ditulis di sekitar angka rata-rata cuma menjelaskan asal masalahnya, bukan menunjukkan bahwa angkanya salah.

qs: What does the article imply about moving freight trains to the night?
it may lower the average and the awakenings alike
it perhaps satisfies residents on the upper floors
it flatters the figure while making nights worse
it removes the case for grinding rails and wheels

qs.evidence: A freight service moved to the small hours to relieve daytime congestion improves the average while worsening exactly the events that matter.
qs.answer: it flatters the figure while making nights worse
qs.why: Satu kalimat memuat dua arah sekaligus, "improves the average while worsening exactly the events that matter": angkanya membaik, malamnya memburuk.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penurunan pada kedua ukuran diblokir separuh kedua kalimat itu, "while worsening exactly the events that matter"; kepuasan penghuni lantai atas salah alamat, sebab lantai atas muncul dalam urusan penghalang, "Barriers help, but chiefly for the upper floors"; dan hilangnya kebutuhan perawatan bertabrakan dengan "The most effective single measure, according to several studies, is maintenance".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Freight trains wake nearby residents more often than passenger trains do."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Freight trains wake nearby residents more often than passenger trains do.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: These events track the number of individual trains rather than the daily total of sound energy.
qs.why: Kalimat terdekat cuma menghubungkan terbangun dengan jumlah kereta; perbandingan antara kereta barang dan kereta penumpang nggak pernah dibuat.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh perbandingan yang nggak ada di teks; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal perbandingan itu.

topic: railway noise and how it is measured
author: Applied acoustics feature
setting: flats beside a busy freight line

title: The Room and the Recording
text:
Three years after lecture halls reopened, attendance in many departments has not recovered, and the recorded lecture is the usual suspect. Two heads of department, in the same university and looking at the same figures, draw opposite conclusions. Their disagreement is worth following, because each is arguing from something real. The disagreement concerns interpretation rather than arithmetic: what an attendance figure is presumed to represent.

The first sees a straightforward matter of access. Her cohort includes students working two evening shifts, students caring for relatives, and students commuting ninety minutes each way. For them a recording is not an alternative to attending; it is the difference between studying and withdrawing. Attendance figures, she adds, were never a measure of learning but a measure of presence, and nobody has yet shown that students watching later perform worse. Her argument is one of proportionality: a policy defended as protection should not fall hardest on those with the least discretion over their own time.

Her colleague accepts every word of that and reaches a different conclusion. What has quietly disappeared, he argues, is the room: the question asked badly and answered patiently, the argument overheard between two students on the stairs. A recording preserves the content and discards the encounter, and first-year students in particular do not know what they are missing. He notes that those most likely to watch alone are the ones already least connected to the department. His objection is developmental rather than administrative, since incidental exchanges accumulate into a sense of belonging that no recording transmits.

Both accounts rest on evidence chosen to fit the expectation each observer brought to it. The honest conclusion is that recordings redistribute something rather than simply adding it: they widen access to information while narrowing access to the incidental. A department that records everything and changes nothing else has made a choice without admitting it. So has one that refuses to record and calls the result community. Institutional honesty, on this reading, demands an explicit justification rather than an inherited arrangement.
qs: On balance, what does the piece establish once its concessions are counted?
attendance figures may never have measured learning at all
a recording may buy wider reach at the price of contact
the two heads may be reading the same figures differently
a department may record everything and still change nothing

qs.evidence: The honest conclusion is that recordings redistribute something rather than simply adding it: they widen access to information while narrowing access to the incidental.
qs.answer: a recording may buy wider reach at the price of contact
qs.why: Simpulan yang penulis sebut jujur: rekaman mendistribusikan ulang, melebarkan akses ke informasi sambil menyempitkan akses ke yang tak terjadwal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi angka kehadiran tak pernah mengukur pembelajaran adalah hujah kepala departemen pertama, bukan simpulan penulis; opsi keduanya membaca angka berbeda bertabrakan dengan “the same figures” dan dengan sengketa yang disebut soal tafsir; opsi departemen yang merekam tanpa mengubah apa pun adalah akibat yang ditarik sesudah simpulan itu, bukan simpulannya.

qs: Which students does the first head of department describe?
students already least connected to the department
students who prefer to study in their own time
students who have withdrawn from the course
students with jobs, caring duties or long journeys

qs.evidence: Her cohort includes students working two evening shifts, students caring for relatives, and students commuting ninety minutes each way.
qs.answer: students with jobs, caring duties or long journeys
qs.why: Dia menyebut mahasiswa dengan dua sif malam, yang merawat keluarga, dan yang menempuh sembilan puluh menit sekali jalan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Mahasiswa yang paling tak terhubung adalah kelompok yang diamati kepala jurusan kedua, bukan dia; pilihan belajar di waktu sendiri nggak pernah jadi alasannya, karena argumennya soal keterbatasan waktu bukan selera; dan penarikan diri disebut sebagai risiko yang ingin dicegah, bukan keadaan mahasiswanya sekarang.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the two positions?
even-handed, though persuaded the access case is finally the stronger
even-handed, and content to leave both conclusions where they stand
even-handed, yet unwilling to press either department to change its policy
even-handed, yet critical of a department that drifts without saying so

qs.evidence: A department that records everything and changes nothing else has made a choice without admitting it.
qs.answer: even-handed, yet critical of a department that drifts without saying so
qs.why: Penulis menimbang kedua posisi ("each is arguing from something real") lalu tetap menghakimi: "A department that records everything and changes nothing else has made a choice without admitting it", begitu pula yang menolak merekam.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menerima bahwa kedua posisi masuk akal dan dua di antaranya menahan diri seperti kunci, jadi tesis lintas-soal nggak memilih; pemilihnya sinyal leksikal penutupnya. Keberpihakan pada kasus akses salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Both accounts rest on evidence chosen to fit the expectation each observer brought to it". Kepuasan membiarkan kedua simpulan berdiri salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "The honest conclusion is that recordings redistribute something rather than simply adding it", sebuah simpulan yang ditarik penulis sendiri. Keengganan mendesak salah satu jurusan berubah salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Institutional honesty, on this reading, demands an explicit justification rather than an inherited arrangement".

qs: What does the writer imply about a department that refuses to record lectures?
it may have protected the exchanges students value
it will see attendance return to its earlier level
it perhaps follows the evidence more closely
it too is choosing without saying so

qs.evidence: So has one that refuses to record and calls the result community.
qs.answer: it too is choosing without saying so
qs.why: Frasa "So has" menyalin tuduhan kalimat sebelumnya ke jurusan penolak rekaman: sama-sama memilih tanpa mengakuinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Klaim bahwa pertemuan tak terjadwal terselamatkan diblokir kata "calls the result community", yaitu penamaan bukan pembuktian; kembalinya angka kehadiran gugur pada pembuka "attendance in many departments has not recovered" setelah tiga tahun; dan keunggulan berdasar bukti bertabrakan dengan "Both accounts rest on evidence chosen to fit the expectation each observer brought to it".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The second head of department agrees with his colleague's account of student circumstances."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The second head of department agrees with his colleague's account of student circumstances.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Her colleague accepts every word of that and reaches a different conclusion.
qs.why: "Accepts every word of that" sama artinya dengan menyetujui gambaran keadaan mahasiswa yang disampaikan rekannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena persetujuan itu tertulis; "Not stated" salah karena kalimatnya ada, cuma diucapkan dengan kata lain.

author: Campus debate feature
setting: one university, two heads of department

title: What the Feed Is Told to Want
text:
Debate about teenagers and recommendation feeds has settled into an unproductive pattern. One side describes an addiction; the other observes that every generation has been accused of ruining itself with a new medium. Both formulations obscure the mechanism, which is neither mysterious nor especially contested. A feed is an optimization process, and what it optimizes is measured in seconds of attention. It is worth saying plainly what such a system does, because everything else in the argument depends on that one point.

The consequence is not that harmful material is deliberately promoted. It is that content producing an intense reaction outperforms content producing a mild one, and intensity is easier to manufacture than quality. A recommendation system therefore drifts towards the extreme end of whatever category a user has already touched, because that is where the seconds accumulate. Nobody designed this outcome; it follows from the objective. An engineer optimizing for duration is doing the job as specified.

Age matters here, and not for sentimental reasons: adolescents are more sensitive to social comparison and to signals of exclusion, so a feed sorted by reaction assembles the material likeliest to unsettle them. Regulators have responded with age verification, which governs who is admitted rather than what is then served. A gate answers the wrong question, since the difficulty begins after entry. The teenager who passes the check meets exactly the system that prompted the concern. A young person told to look away will very often go back and find the same clip again.

The remedy that follows is unglamorous and technically undemanding. Require that feeds for accounts registered to minors be optimized for something other than duration, and require the chosen objective to be published. Firms will reply that such an aim is impossible to specify, yet they specify comparable objectives every quarter, in language precise enough to pay bonuses on. The impossibility is not technical; it is commercial, and it should be named as such. The point is not that these firms are wicked, only that nobody else has been asked to choose the aim.
qs: On balance, which summary fits the argument as a whole rather than one paragraph?
the harm follows largely from the target the system is given
teenagers may be more exposed than the older panics allowed
age verification governs entry rather than what is then served
the firms are largely indifferent to the users they serve

qs.evidence: Nobody designed this outcome; it follows from the objective.
qs.answer: the harm follows largely from the target the system is given
qs.why: Teks menyebut tak seorang pun merancang hasil itu: ia mengikuti tujuan yang dipasang, yakni detik perhatian.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kerentanan remaja adalah anggapan dasar paragraf tiga yang dipakai untuk menerangkan mekanismenya, bukan klaim pokoknya; opsi verifikasi umur adalah contoh jawaban yang salah sasaran, bukan tesisnya; opsi firma tak peduli bertabrakan dengan “Nobody designed this outcome” dan dengan insinyur yang disebut mengerjakan tugas sesuai spesifikasi.

qs: What does the essay say a feed is optimized for?
the material a user is most likely to pass on to friends
the intensity a producer of content intended to create
the number of seconds a user keeps watching
the age recorded on the account at registration

qs.evidence: A feed is an optimization process, and what it optimizes is measured in seconds of attention.
qs.answer: the number of seconds a user keeps watching
qs.why: Teks menyebut yang dioptimalkan diukur dalam detik perhatian, jadi lamanya orang terus menonton.
qs.whyOthersFail: Berbagi ke teman masuk akal sebagai sasaran sistem semacam ini, tapi teks nggak pernah menyebutnya; intensitas disebut sebagai sifat konten yang menang dalam persaingan, bukan besaran yang dioptimalkan; dan umur di akun cuma urusan gerbang masuk yang menurut teks menjawab pertanyaan yang salah.

qs: How does the writer regard the claim that such an objective cannot be specified?
dismissive, though granting that naming such an aim is genuinely hard
dismissive, though allowing the age check answers part of the difficulty
dismissive, reading the claim as a defence of revenue
dismissive, though content to let each firm name its own aim

qs.evidence: The impossibility is not technical; it is commercial, and it should be named as such.
qs.answer: dismissive, reading the claim as a defence of revenue
qs.why: Kalimat penguncinya "The impossibility is not technical; it is commercial, and it should be named as such", didahului catatan bahwa firma merumuskan tujuan sebanding tiap kuartal. Jadi klaim itu dibaca sebagai pembelaan pendapatan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menolak klaim firma dan ketiga pengecoh memberi kelonggaran atau menahan diri, sehingga register kunci nggak menonjol; pemilihnya sasaran dan derajat. Kelonggaran bahwa merumuskan tujuan itu sukar salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "they specify comparable objectives every quarter, in language precise enough to pay bonuses on". Kelonggaran bahwa verifikasi usia menjawab sebagian kesulitan salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "A gate answers the wrong question, since the difficulty begins after entry". Kesediaan membiarkan tiap firma menamai tujuannya sendiri salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "require the chosen objective to be published".

qs: What does the essay imply about age verification?
it may lower the value of teenage attention
it perhaps works better for younger users
it guards the door and leaves the feed alone
it was offered by the firms as a cheaper remedy

qs.evidence: A gate answers the wrong question, since the difficulty begins after entry.
qs.answer: it guards the door and leaves the feed alone
qs.why: Metafora "gate" plus klausa "the difficulty begins after entry" mengunci batas kerjanya: pintunya diatur, isi umpannya nggak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pelemahan nilai perhatian remaja diblokir "A gate answers the wrong question, since the difficulty begins after entry", sebab sasaran durasi tetap utuh setelah orang masuk; perbandingan pengguna muda dan tua nggak pernah dibuat di teks, yang cuma menyebut remaja "more sensitive to social comparison"; dan usulan dari firma bertabrakan dengan "Regulators have responded with age verification", yang menempatkannya sebagai langkah pengatur.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The essay says platforms promote harmful material on purpose."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The essay says platforms promote harmful material on purpose.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The consequence is not that harmful material is deliberately promoted.
qs.why: Teks membantah langsung: materi berbahaya bukan dipromosikan dengan sengaja.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" berlawanan dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" salah karena bantahannya tertulis di awal paragraf kedua.

author: Argumentative essay
setting: public argument about platform regulation

title: The Form Decides First
text:
Economists once treated the decision to save as a straightforward calculation. A worker weighed present consumption against future security, and whatever choice emerged was assumed to reveal a preference. Then employers began altering one apparently trivial detail: whether joining a pension scheme required a signature to opt in or a signature to opt out. Participation shifted by tens of percentage points, and the tidy account of preference has never fully recovered.

The finding has since been replicated across countries, sectors and income levels. The effect shows up in firms of every size, and it does not fade after the first year. What changes is not the underlying wish to save but the effort required to act upon it. A default carries three things at once: it removes a decision, it signals what the employer considers normal, and it supplies an excuse for postponement in the opposite direction. Any one of the three would move behaviour; together they move it a long way.

This is not simply a convenient discovery for policy. A default set carelessly can be as consequential as one set well, and the contribution rate accompanying automatic enrolment is frequently minimal. Workers enrolled at three per cent often remain at three per cent for a decade, treating the figure as advice rather than a floor. A number printed on a form quietly turns into a piece of advice. Inertia is indifferent to direction; it holds people wherever they have been placed, and the mechanism that raised participation also freezes the amount.

The practical lesson is uncomfortable for anyone who dislikes interference. There is no arrangement without a default, because somebody must determine what happens when nothing is determined. The question is therefore not whether to nudge, but who selects the resting position and how visibly that selection is made. Silence in the design is still a decision, taken by whoever drew up the form.
qs: On balance, which position is the piece prepared to stand behind?
automatic enrolment may lift participation but not contributions
workers left at a low rate rarely move away from it later
a rate printed on a form may be read as advice, not a floor
the default on the form moves saving more than preference does

qs.evidence: Participation shifted by tens of percentage points, and the tidy account of preference has never fully recovered.
qs.answer: the default on the form moves saving more than preference does
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut partisipasi bergeser puluhan poin persen begitu bentuk formulirnya berubah, dan penjelasan lewat preferensi tak pernah pulih.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi partisipasi naik tanpa iuran naik dan opsi angka tercetak dibaca sebagai anjuran keduanya rincian paragraf tiga tentang akibat lanjutan, bukan temuan pokoknya; opsi pekerja jarang beranjak dari tarif rendah adalah gejala inersia yang dipakai untuk menerangkan, bukan klaimnya.

qs: Besides removing a decision, what does the article say a default supplies?
a record of what the worker has chosen before
a contribution rate agreed with the worker in advance
a signal of what the employer treats as normal
a replication of the finding across countries and sectors

qs.evidence: A default carries three things at once: it removes a decision, it signals what the employer considers normal, and it supplies an excuse for postponement in the opposite direction.
qs.answer: a signal of what the employer treats as normal
qs.why: Salah satu dari tiga hal yang dibawa pengaturan bawaan adalah isyarat tentang apa yang dianggap wajar oleh pemberi kerja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Catatan pilihan sebelumnya nggak pernah disebut sebagai bagian pengaturan bawaan; iuran yang disepakati lebih dulu bertabrakan dengan gambaran pekerja yang menerima angka apa pun yang tercetak di formulir; dan replikasi antarnegara adalah status temuannya, bukan isi pengaturannya.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards automatic enrolment as it is currently set?
approving of the mechanism, though uneasy that it fades after the first year
approving of the mechanism, yet uneasy about the rate it carries
approving of the mechanism, though uneasy that a default overrides choice
approving of the mechanism, though sure three per cent suits most workers

qs.evidence: Workers enrolled at three per cent often remain at three per cent for a decade, treating the figure as advice rather than a floor.
qs.answer: approving of the mechanism, yet uneasy about the rate it carries
qs.why: Teks menerima pendaftaran otomatis sebagai temuan yang bekerja, lalu menahan pujiannya: "Workers enrolled at three per cent often remain at three per cent for a decade, treating the figure as advice rather than a floor".
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyetujui mekanismenya dan tiga di antaranya memakai keresahan terukur yang sama, jadi bentuk kunci nggak lagi khas; pemilihnya sasaran dan derajat. Keresahan bahwa efeknya memudar salah SASARAN dan bertentangan dengan teks: frasa pemblokirnya "it does not fade after the first year". Keberatan bahwa default menindas pilihan salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "There is no arrangement without a default, because somebody must determine what happens when nothing is determined". Keyakinan bahwa tiga persen cocok bagi kebanyakan pekerja salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "the contribution rate accompanying automatic enrolment is frequently minimal".

qs: Which conclusion about a scheme carrying no default at all does the article lead to?
no such scheme can exist, since inaction needs a rule
it would show preferences more accurately than a default
it might lift participation in firms of every size
it has been tried across several countries and sectors

qs.evidence: There is no arrangement without a default, because somebody must determine what happens when nothing is determined.
qs.answer: no such scheme can exist, since inaction needs a rule
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci menutup kemungkinannya: selalu harus ada ketentuan tentang apa yang terjadi ketika tak ada yang memutuskan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketepatan mengungkap selera diblokir paragraf pembuka, sebab "the tidy account of preference has never fully recovered"; kenaikan partisipasi di firma segala ukuran adalah akibat dari adanya pengaturan bawaan opt-out, "The effect shows up in firms of every size", bukan dari ketiadaan pengaturan; dan pengujian antarnegara menyangkut "The finding has since been replicated", yaitu temuan opt-in versus opt-out.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The move to opt-out enrolment was first proposed by government economists."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The move to opt-out enrolment was first proposed by government economists.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Then employers began altering one apparently trivial detail: whether joining a pension scheme required a signature to opt in or a signature to opt out.
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang pemberi kerja mulai mengubah detail itu; siapa yang pertama mengusulkannya nggak pernah disebut.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" mengarang sumber gagasan; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal peran ekonom pemerintah, ia diam soal itu.

author: Economics desk feature
setting: pension schemes and the research on enrolment

title: Review of the Rooftop Solar Grant
text:
This report reviews the rooftop solar grant after four years of operation. The scheme has funded some nineteen thousand installations, exceeded its capacity target and remained within budget. It has also delivered a distribution of benefit that the council did not intend and cannot easily defend. The failure is worth setting out precisely, because it is not a failure of administration. The point of this review is to say where the money has actually gone.

The design itself produces the pattern. The grant covers forty per cent of installation cost, which leaves an applicant to raise the remaining sixty, and it is paid in arrears against a receipt. Households able to advance several thousand pounds and wait eleven weeks for reimbursement are, predictably, not the households by which the scheme was justified. Applications from the four wards with the lowest median income account for under seven per cent of the total.

Tenants are excluded almost entirely, for a reason nobody has yet addressed. A tenant cannot fit a panel to a roof that belongs to somebody else. A grant towards a roof requires an owner, and the owner of a rented roof captures the asset while the tenant pays the bill. Two neighbouring authorities have piloted split arrangements under which the landlord receives the grant on condition that a share of the saving is passed through. The monitoring obligations of such schemes, however, are far from trivial.

None of the changes below needs new money, only a different order of payment; we recommend three amendments. First, replace reimbursement with direct payment to the installer, so that no applicant requires capital. Second, reserve a fifth of the annual allocation for the four lowest-income wards, and permit that portion to fund a larger share of cost. Third, commission an assessment of the split arrangements before extending them here, since the passed-through saving in both pilots remains unverified. Without the first amendment, the remaining two will change very little.
qs: What is the main purpose of this report?
to record that the scheme met its target within the budget set
to establish that tenants are the group the scheme has excluded
to redirect a grant that reaches the wrong households
to ask for more money so the poorer wards can be reached

qs.evidence: It has also delivered a distribution of benefit that the council did not intend and cannot easily defend.
qs.answer: to redirect a grant that reaches the wrong households
qs.why: Kata "also" membalik paragraf pembuka: "It has also delivered a distribution of benefit that the council did not intend and cannot easily defend", dan tiga amandemen di penutup memperbaiki arah pembayarannya, bukan jumlahnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh mengulang bagian nyata dari isi laporan, tapi salah cakupan atau derajat. Pencatatan keberhasilan salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya kata "also" pada "It has also delivered a distribution of benefit that the council did not intend", yang memasang capaian target sebagai latar. Penetapan bahwa penyewa adalah kelompok yang tersisih salah CAKUPAN: frasa pemblokirnya amandemen ketiga, "commission an assessment of the split arrangements before extending them here", jadi soal penyewa justru ditunda, dan sebaran per ward tetap temuan utamanya. Permintaan dana baru salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "None of the changes below needs new money, only a different order of payment".

qs: Why does the report say low-income households rarely apply?
because the four lowest-income wards were left out of the scheme
because they must find the money and then wait for it
because installers are reluctant to work in poorer wards
because the capacity target had already been exceeded

qs.evidence: Households able to advance several thousand pounds and wait eleven weeks for reimbursement are, predictably, not the households by which the scheme was justified.
qs.answer: because they must find the money and then wait for it
qs.why: Skema menuntut pemohon menalangi ribuan pound lebih dulu dan menunggu sebelas pekan sebelum diganti.
qs.whyOthersFail: Empat ward berpendapatan terendah justru tetap boleh melamar, cuma jumlahnya di bawah tujuh persen; keengganan pemasang nggak pernah disebut di laporan; dan target kapasitas yang terlampaui adalah keberhasilan skema, bukan penghalang bagi pemohon.

qs: Which figure gives the strongest support for the claim of uneven benefit?
fewer than one claim in fourteen comes from the poorest wards
reimbursement arrives about eleven weeks after payment
the grant meets forty per cent of installation cost
some nineteen thousand installations have been funded

qs.evidence: Applications from the four wards with the lowest median income account for under seven per cent of the total.
qs.answer: fewer than one claim in fourteen comes from the poorest wards
qs.why: Di bawah tujuh persen dari seluruh lamaran berarti kurang dari satu dari empat belas, dan itu langsung menunjukkan manfaat yang tak merata.
qs.whyOthersFail: Tenggat sebelas pekan dan porsi empat puluh persen menjelaskan sebab pola itu lewat rancangan pembayaran, bukan menunjukkan sebarannya; dan jumlah pemasangan cuma menggambarkan skala skema, yang justru dipakai laporan untuk menyebut skema ini berhasil pada ukuran lain.

qs: What does the report imply about the second and third amendments on their own?
they may remove the need to pay installers directly
little would change while applicants still need capital
they might confirm the saving passed to tenants
they would sharply raise the number of installations

qs.evidence: Without the first amendment, the remaining two will change very little.
qs.answer: little would change while applicants still need capital
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci menaruh syarat: tanpa usulan pertama, dua sisanya hampir tak mengubah apa pun, dan usulan pertama itulah yang menghapus kebutuhan modal awal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penghapusan pembayaran langsung diblokir "Without the first amendment, the remaining two will change very little", sebab urutan ketergantungannya justru sebaliknya; kepastian penghematan yang diteruskan ke penyewa gugur pada "the passed-through saving in both pilots remains unverified"; dan lonjakan jumlah pemasangan nggak pernah dijanjikan, sebab laporan menyebut skema ini udah "exceeded its capacity target".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Renters are almost completely shut out of the scheme."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Renters are almost completely shut out of the scheme.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Tenants are excluded almost entirely, for a reason nobody has yet addressed.
qs.why: "Excluded almost entirely" sama maksudnya dengan hampir sepenuhnya tertutup bagi penyewa.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena teks menyatakan hal yang sama; "Not stated" salah karena keadaan penyewa dibahas sepanjang paragraf ketiga.

topic: who benefits from a rooftop solar subsidy
author: Borough finance review
setting: a borough council reviewing its own scheme

title: The Hour That Is Counted
text:
Most undergraduate seminars in this country are taught by postgraduates, and most of those postgraduates are paid by the contact hour. The arrangement is defended as flexible, a word performing a great deal of concealment. What it means in practice is that the university purchases the visible portion of teaching and receives the remainder as a gift. The distinction between compensated and uncompensated labour is obscured, conveniently, by an accounting unit that registers only presence.

Consider what a single seminar genuinely requires. Reading the set text takes an hour if it is familiar and three if it is not; devising questions that survive contact with twenty students takes another. The marking, the message at eleven at night and the student who is plainly unwell all fall outside the counted hour. Departments understand this, which is why contracts frequently specify a preparation multiplier. The multiplier is typically two, and the honest figure is nearer four. An institution that specifies any multiplier has conceded the principle and merely disputes the magnitude.

The defence offered is that this constitutes training, and training is partly its own reward; there is something in the argument, yet it collapses under inspection. Training implies observation, feedback and a reduction in load while competence is built, and few of these appear on any timetable. What is actually being trained is a tolerance for unpaid work, on which the sector will then draw for decades.

The remedy is not complicated, merely expensive. Pay for the work the work demands: count preparation honestly, pay marking by the script rather than by the hour, and cap the number of students per seminar so that the two remain compatible. Departments will reply that budgets do not permit it. Budgets have permitted the present arrangement precisely because somebody else has been absorbing the difference. Moving the shortfall around, rather than removing it, has been the working policy throughout.
qs: On balance, which claim does the piece actually defend?
paying by the contact hour moves the cost onto the teacher
the preparation multiplier in contracts is set rather too low
what the arrangement trains is a tolerance for unpaid work
seminar sizes need capping so that preparation stays possible

qs.evidence: What it means in practice is that the university purchases the visible portion of teaching and receives the remainder as a gift.
qs.answer: paying by the contact hour moves the cost onto the teacher
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut universitas membeli bagian yang terlihat dari pengajaran dan menerima sisanya sebagai hadiah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pengganda persiapan terlalu rendah adalah rincian paragraf dua, dan teks justru menyebut yang menerima prinsipnya hanya berdebat soal besaran; opsi yang dilatih adalah toleransi terhadap kerja tanpa upah adalah akibat di paragraf tiga; opsi pembatasan jumlah mahasiswa adalah satu butir remedi di paragraf akhir.

qs: What does the essay say about the preparation multiplier in contracts?
it is set at half of what the work truly takes

True
False

title: Half the Story of a Flood
text:
Flood warnings in cities have traditionally been issued on rainfall alone. A forecast of forty millimetres in an hour triggers an alert, and the alert is the same whether the preceding fortnight has been wet or dry. Anyone who has watched water stand on one street and disappear from the next knows the rainfall figure is only half the story. An alert insensitive to antecedent conditions rapidly forfeits its credibility with residents.

The other half is whatever the ground can still absorb. Soil that has already taken up water behaves, for the purposes of a storm, much like paving: almost nothing soaks in. Networks of inexpensive buried sensors now report moisture continuously, and combining those readings with the forecast improves the prediction of surface water substantially. In one catchment the number of false alerts fell by half without any warning being missed. The ground, in other words, keeps a record of the weeks before the storm.

Two complications prevent this from being straightforward. Urban soil is extraordinarily variable, since a century of building leaves rubble beneath one garden and clay beneath the next, so a sensor speaks only for a small area around itself. Sensors also fail quietly, drifting rather than stopping, which is harder to detect than an outright breakdown. A network therefore requires redundancy and routine inspection, neither of which appears in the price of the hardware. Someone has to go out and look at the kit from time to time.

None of this makes the approach a poor investment, but it alters what is being bought. A moisture network is a maintenance commitment rather than a purchase, and the value appears only where warnings are actually acted upon. Cities that install the sensors and leave the response plan untouched have bought a better forecast of a flood they will handle exactly as before. A better number is only worth as much as the city does with it.
qs: On balance, which statement carries the weight of the argument?
urban soil varies too much for one sensor to speak for it
the hardware price is what makes such a network a poor investment
the forecast improves only where the sensors are inspected often enough
ground-moisture readings make a flood warning sharper

qs.evidence: Networks of inexpensive buried sensors now report moisture continuously, and combining those readings with the forecast improves the prediction of surface water substantially.
qs.answer: ground-moisture readings make a flood warning sharper
qs.why: Paragraf dua menyebut jaringan sensor melaporkan kelembapan terus-menerus, dan menggabungkannya dengan ramalan memperbaiki prediksi genangan secara berarti.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tanah kota terlalu beragam adalah komplikasi di paragraf tiga yang menurut teks nggak membuat pendekatan ini investasi buruk; opsi komitmen pemeliharaan dan opsi nilai ramalan bergantung pada tindakan kota keduanya syarat di paragraf akhir, bukan temuan pokoknya. | "the forecast improves only where the sensors ..." is wrong: inspection concerns the drifting sensors, while the text ties the forecast's worth to where warnings are acted upon | "the hardware price is what makes such a netwo..." is wrong: the text says 'None of this makes the approach a poor investment' and the real costs never appear in the hardware price

qs: What happens to soil that is already wet when a storm arrives?
it dries more slowly than the paving beside it
it takes up more water than dry soil does
almost none of the rain soaks in, so it runs off
it makes the buried sensors drift out of calibration

qs.evidence: Soil that has already taken up water behaves, for the purposes of a storm, much like paving: almost nothing soaks in.
qs.answer: almost none of the rain soaks in, so it runs off
qs.why: Tanah yang udah menyerap air berlaku seperti perkerasan saat badai datang: hampir tak ada air yang masuk.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kecepatan mengering dibanding perkerasan nggak pernah dibahas; daya serap yang lebih besar justru kebalikan dari kalimat itu; dan penyimpangan sensor disebut sebagai cacat perangkat yang muncul sendiri, tanpa kaitan dengan tanah yang basah.

qs: Which result gives the strongest support for the value of a sensor network?
moisture readings are reported without interruption
one area halved its needless alarms and missed none
urban soil varies from one garden to the next

qs.evidence: In one catchment the number of false alerts fell by half without any warning being missed.
qs.answer: one area halved its needless alarms and missed none
qs.why: Satu daerah tangkapan air memotong separuh peringatan palsu tanpa melewatkan satu peringatan sungguhan; itu bukti manfaat paling langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pelaporan tanpa henti cuma menjelaskan cara kerja alatnya; sedangkan keragaman tanah dan penyimpangan bacaan adalah dua komplikasi yang justru mengurangi nilai jaringan, bukan mendukungnya.

qs: What does the article imply about a city that installs sensors but changes nothing else?
it will miss more warnings than it did before
it may have avoided the cost of inspection
a sharper forecast brings it no better result
it needs less redundancy inside the network

qs.evidence: Cities that install the sensors and leave the response plan untouched have bought a better forecast of a flood they will handle exactly as before.
qs.answer: a sharper forecast brings it no better result
qs.why: Frasa "a flood they will handle exactly as before" mengunci hasilnya: ramalannya membaik, penanganannya nggak, dan penutup menambahkan "A better number is only worth as much as the city does with it".
qs.whyOthersFail: Peringatan yang lebih sering terlewat diblokir laporan sebaliknya, "without any warning being missed"; penghindaran biaya pemeriksaan gugur pada "neither of which appears in the price of the hardware", jadi biaya itu tetap menunggu; dan pengurangan cadangan sensor bertabrakan dengan "A network therefore requires redundancy and routine inspection".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Sensor faults are hard to notice because the readings slowly go wrong."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Sensor faults are hard to notice because the readings slowly go wrong.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Sensors also fail quietly, drifting rather than stopping, which is harder to detect than an outright breakdown.

title: Note on the River Monitoring Network
text:
This note advises on the future of the river monitoring network, whose funding lapses in March. The network consists of thirty-one gauging stations recording level and flow, with dissolved oxygen measured at eleven of them. Nineteen stations were installed in the 1970s, and four have not reported reliably for two years. The decision is presented as a budget question, which is where most of the confusion begins.

The value of the network lies chiefly in the length of its record. A single year of readings establishes very little, whereas a fifty-year series permits a genuine estimate of how often a given flood level recurs. Insurers, planners and the flood defence programme all draw on that series, and a gap in the record cannot be filled retrospectively. Discontinuing a station therefore destroys an asset that no later investment can rebuild. Continuity is the product itself, rather than a desirable feature of a system whose purpose lies elsewhere.

That argument does not justify preserving the network unchanged: three stations sit on reaches that have since been culverted, and they now measure a channel nobody manages. The oxygen sensors require calibration every six weeks, and that work is delivered under a contract which has not been retendered for a decade. Modern telemetry would reduce visits, though the saving is smaller than suppliers imply once installation is counted.

We recommend continuation with three conditions. The four unreliable stations should be repaired or formally closed, with the reason recorded, rather than left in their present ambiguous state. The oxygen monitoring contract should be retendered before renewal. Finally, the series should be published in a machine-readable form, since data held by one authority tends to be used by that authority alone. A closure recorded honestly is preferable to a station that reports intermittently and is trusted regardless. The cost of all three measures falls well within the existing allocation.
qs: What is the main purpose of this note?
to advise keeping the network with three conditions
to establish that a long record cannot be rebuilt later
to press that the oxygen contract be put out to tender
to seek extra funds before the lapse in March

qs.evidence: We recommend continuation with three conditions.
qs.answer: to advise keeping the network with three conditions
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci menyatakan dua hal sekaligus: "We recommend continuation with three conditions", dan tiga syarat itu dirinci di paragraf yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh mengulang bagian nyata dari nota ini, tapi salah cakupan atau derajat. Nilai catatan panjang salah CAKUPAN: frasa pemblokirnya kalimat berikutnya, "That argument does not justify preserving the network unchanged", jadi ia langkah dalam alasan, bukan tujuan nota. Penenderan kontrak oksigen salah CAKUPAN juga: ia satu dari tiga syarat dalam "We recommend continuation with three conditions". Permintaan dana tambahan salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "The cost of all three measures falls well within the existing allocation".

qs: Why does the note say a gap in the record matters so much?
because missing years can never be recovered later
because insurers pay for each reading that they use
because the oldest stations were installed in the 1970s
because telemetry cannot measure dissolved oxygen

qs.evidence: Insurers, planners and the flood defence programme all draw on that series, and a gap in the record cannot be filled retrospectively.
qs.answer: because missing years can never be recovered later
qs.why: Teks menyebut lubang dalam rekaman nggak bisa diisi belakangan, jadi tahun yang hilang lenyap untuk selamanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penanggung asuransi disebut sebagai pemakai rangkaian data, bukan pembayar per bacaan; tahun pemasangan cuma latar tentang usia jaringan; dan kemampuan telemetri mengukur oksigen nggak pernah dibahas, teks hanya menyebut telemetri mengurangi kunjungan.

three stations now measure a channel that has been culverted

modern telemetry would reduce the number of visits
a record spanning decades shows how often floods return

qs.evidence: A single year of readings establishes very little, whereas a fifty-year series permits a genuine estimate of how often a given flood level recurs.
qs.answer: a record spanning decades shows how often floods return
qs.why: Rangkaian lima puluh tahun memungkinkan perkiraan seberapa sering suatu tinggi banjir berulang, dan itu alasan terkuat mempertahankan stasiun yang udah ada.
qs.whyOthersFail: Saluran yang udah ditutup justru dipakai sebagai alasan menutup tiga stasiun, bukan mempertahankannya; sedangkan jadwal kalibrasi dan pengurangan kunjungan menyangkut biaya operasi, bukan nilai rekaman panjangnya.

it may exceed the cost of the calibration work
it might cover repairs to the weak stations

sellers of the equipment have overstated it

qs.evidence: Modern telemetry would reduce visits, though the saving is smaller than suppliers imply once installation is counted.
qs.answer: sellers of the equipment have overstated it
qs.why: Sinyal penguncinya "smaller than suppliers imply", yang menaruh angka pemasoknya di atas angka sebenarnya begitu biaya pemasangan dihitung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Perbandingan dengan biaya kontrak kalibrasi nggak pernah dibuat, dan kalimat pengunci justru mengecilkan penghematannya, "the saving is smaller than suppliers imply once installation is counted"; pembiayaan perbaikan empat stasiun gugur karena seluruh biaya usulan disebut "falls well within the existing allocation", tanpa ditautkan ke penghematan telemetri; dan kaitan dengan penutupan situs oksigen bertabrakan dengan usulan notanya sendiri, yang cuma meminta kontraknya ditenderkan ulang.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The network takes up about a fifth of the department's monitoring budget."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The network takes up about a fifth of the department's monitoring budget.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The cost of all three measures falls well within the existing allocation.
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang biayanya masih di dalam alokasi yang ada; porsi anggaran pemantauan nggak pernah diberi angka.

title: Who Pays for the End of Cash
text:
The argument for a cashless economy is usually made in terms of convenience and record-keeping, and on both counts it is sound. Card and phone payments are faster, harder to steal and simpler to account for. What the argument routinely omits is the distribution of the transition's cost, which does not fall on the people who design it. That omission is the whole of the difficulty: distributional questions are conventionally treated as secondary, which is convenient for whoever drafts the timetable.

Consider a market trader selling vegetables on small margins. A card terminal carries a rental fee and takes a percentage of every sale, and on a two-pound purchase that percentage is not trivial. Cash, whatever its inconveniences, is free at the point of use and clears instantly rather than in three working days. A trader whose stock is bought each morning cannot easily wait for settlement. The fee is small in isolation and substantial in aggregate.

Customers are affected too, though less visibly. Roughly one adult in twenty here has no usable card, and that group is not randomly distributed: it is concentrated among the old, the recently arrived and those with irregular income. A shop that stops accepting cash has not merely changed its systems; it has quietly selected its customers. That decision is seldom announced in those terms. Exclusion of this kind is administrative rather than deliberate, and therefore attracts no argument at all.

None of this is an argument for freezing payment technology, which would be both futile and patronising. It is an argument for treating the transition as a policy rather than as weather. Terminal fees on small transactions could be capped; settlement periods could be shortened by rule; and an obligation to accept cash could be retained for essential goods. The alternative is to let the cost settle where it always settles, on those least able to argue about it.
qs: On balance, what does the writer finally commit to?
a shop that drops cash has quietly chosen its own customers
the move away from cash loads its cost onto the weakest
terminal fees may weigh most heavily on the smallest sales
the exclusion at work here is administrative, not deliberate

qs.evidence: The alternative is to let the cost settle where it always settles, on those least able to argue about it.
qs.answer: the move away from cash loads its cost onto the weakest
qs.why: Kalimat penutup menyebut biaya peralihan dibiarkan mengendap pada mereka yang paling kecil kemampuannya untuk memperdebatkannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi toko yang memilih pelanggan dan opsi eksklusi yang administratif keduanya kalimat paragraf tiga, yaitu ilustrasi sebaran biaya itu; opsi biaya terminal pada transaksi kecil adalah contoh paragraf dua, dan teks menyebutnya kecil satu per satu tetapi besar dalam agregat.

qs: What does the essay say about card settlement for a trader?
it is delayed only where the terminal has been rented
it takes days, which is awkward for daily buying
it costs the trader nothing on a two-pound purchase
it happens instantly at the point of sale

qs.evidence: A trader whose stock is bought each morning cannot easily wait for settlement.
qs.answer: it takes days, which is awkward for daily buying
qs.why: Pedagang yang membeli barang tiap pagi nggak bisa menunggu dana cair, sedangkan pembayaran kartu butuh tiga hari kerja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Sewa terminal disebut sebagai biaya tetap, tanpa kaitan dengan lama pencairan; biaya persentase pada belanja dua pound justru disebut nggak sepele; dan yang cair seketika adalah uang tunai, bukan kartu.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards shops that stop accepting cash?
critical, yet content to leave the terminal fees uncapped
critical, though chiefly of the settlement delay that traders carry
critical, since the shops will not admit the choice
critical, though satisfied the change is usually announced

qs.evidence: A shop that stops accepting cash has not merely changed its systems; it has quietly selected its customers.
qs.answer: critical, since the shops will not admit the choice
qs.why: Kalimat penguncinya "it has quietly selected its customers" disusul "That decision is seldom announced in those terms": pilihannya nyata tapi tak diakui sebagai pilihan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi kritis terhadap peralihan itu dan ketiga pengecoh memberi kelonggaran atau menahan diri, jadi menebak tesis nggak menolong; pemilihnya sasaran dan derajat. Kesediaan membiarkan ongkos terminal tanpa batas salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "Terminal fees on small transactions could be capped". Keberatan yang terutama pada tenggat penyelesaian salah SASARAN: itu beban pedagang, sedangkan soal ini tentang toko, dan frasa pemblokirnya "A shop that stops accepting cash has not merely changed its systems; it has quietly selected its customers". Kepuasan bahwa perubahannya diumumkan salah NUANSA: frasa pemblokirnya "That decision is seldom announced in those terms".

qs: What does the essay imply about who bears the cost of the transition?
perhaps the firms that design the systems
customers who already hold a usable card
those with the least power to object
traders who may work on wide margins

qs.evidence: What the argument routinely omits is the distribution of the transition's cost, which does not fall on the people who design it.
qs.answer: those with the least power to object
qs.why: Klausa "which does not fall on the people who design it" menyingkirkan perancangnya, dan penutup menaruh biayanya "on those least able to argue about it".
qs.whyOthersFail: Perancang sistem justru dikecualikan oleh klausa "which does not fall on the people who design it"; pemegang kartu yang udah ada gugur karena yang disorot adalah "one adult in twenty here has no usable card"; dan pedagang bermargin lapang bertabrakan dengan contohnya sendiri, "a market trader selling vegetables on small margins".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer wants payment technology to stop developing."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer wants payment technology to stop developing.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: None of this is an argument for freezing payment technology, which would be both futile and patronising.
qs.why: Penulis menyatakan tegas bahwa tulisannya bukan alasan untuk membekukan teknologi pembayaran.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" berlawanan dengan kalimat pembuka paragraf terakhir; "Not stated" salah karena posisinya dinyatakan jelas.

title: Two Readings of a Rent Cap
text:
Few policies divide researchers as sharply as a cap on rents, and the division is not simply ideological. Two housing researchers who share a dataset and a broad political outlook reach opposite recommendations, and each has reasons worth hearing. Their disagreement turns on which harm they consider harder to reverse; the methodological question is which counterfactual each of them regards as plausible.

The first is concerned with the tenant already in place. A household on a fixed income facing a twenty per cent increase does not move to a cheaper city. It moves to a worse flat, a longer commute, or a room in a relative's house. Her evidence is that displacement of this kind leaves durable marks on schooling and employment, whereas a slightly smaller supply of new flats does not. A cap, in her account, buys time for people who have none of it.

The second accepts the harm and doubts the remedy. Caps, he argues, apply to the stock that exists and discourage the stock that does not, since a developer chooses between markets. He points to conversions withdrawn from the rental market, to maintenance quietly deferred, and to the informal payments that appear where the legal rent is held below the market one. His argument is essentially dynamic, concerned with the stock that never materializes rather than the stock now standing. His concern is not the first year of a cap but the eighth.

The honest position is that both effects are real. Their magnitudes depend on details rarely present in the argument: how long a cap lasts, whether it applies to new buildings, and how vigorously it is enforced. A cap combined with construction is a different policy from a cap alone. Specification, not vocabulary, determines the empirical outcome. Debating the word rather than the design is what allows the same evidence to support both sides.
qs: On balance, which reading of the whole piece holds up?
displacement may leave marks a smaller supply does not
caps may discourage the flats not yet built at all
what a cap does depends on the details of its design
the disagreement turns on which harm is harder to undo

qs.evidence: A cap combined with construction is a different policy from a cap alone.
qs.answer: what a cap does depends on the details of its design
qs.why: Simpulan pengulas: pembatasan yang digabung dengan pembangunan adalah kebijakan lain daripada pembatasan sendirian, jadi rinciannya yang menentukan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi jejak pemindahan adalah bukti peneliti pertama; opsi flat yang tak pernah dibangun adalah hujah peneliti kedua; opsi soal kerugian mana yang lebih sulit dibalik adalah rumusan sengketanya di paragraf satu, sedangkan pengulas menutup dengan spesifikasi, bukan kosakata.

qs: What does the first researcher say happens to a household facing a large increase?
it takes worse housing or a longer journey
it waits for the cap to be enforced more vigorously
it relocates to a city where rents are cheaper
it defers repairs to cover the difference

qs.evidence: It moves to a worse flat, a longer commute, or a room in a relative's house.
qs.answer: it takes worse housing or a longer journey
qs.why: Rumah tangga itu pindah ke flat yang lebih buruk, perjalanan yang lebih panjang, atau kamar di rumah kerabat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penegakan yang lebih tegas muncul di paragraf akhir sebagai salah satu rincian rancangan, bukan sebagai tindakan penyewa; kepindahan ke kota yang lebih murah dibantah langsung oleh teks; dan penundaan perbaikan adalah tindakan pemilik rumah dalam argumen peneliti kedua.

qs: Which observation does the second researcher use against caps?
tenants on fixed incomes face increases of twenty per cent
displacement leaves lasting marks on schooling and work
enforcement is vigorous in most capped markets
landlords let repairs slide and side payments appear

qs.evidence: He points to conversions withdrawn from the rental market, to maintenance quietly deferred, and to the informal payments that appear where the legal rent is held below the market one.
qs.answer: landlords let repairs slide and side payments appear
qs.why: Ia menunjuk perawatan yang ditunda diam-diam dan pembayaran tak resmi yang muncul saat sewa resmi ditahan di bawah harga pasar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kenaikan dua puluh persen bagi penyewa berpendapatan tetap dan bekas panjang pada sekolah serta pekerjaan adalah dua bukti peneliti pertama, yang justru mendukung pembatasan; dan ketegasan penegakan di sebagian besar pasar nggak pernah diklaim di teks, ia cuma disebut sebagai salah satu rincian yang menentukan hasil.

qs: What does the reviewer imply about arguing over the term itself?
it may settle which researcher has better evidence
it shows enforcement alone decides the outcome
it perhaps favours whoever takes the longer view
the same evidence then supports opposite views

qs.evidence: Debating the word rather than the design is what allows the same evidence to support both sides.
qs.answer: the same evidence then supports opposite views
qs.why: Kalimat pengunci menyebut akibatnya langsung: berdebat soal kata membuat bukti yang sama bisa dipakai dua pihak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penyelesaian perdebatan diblokir "The honest position is that both effects are real"; penegakan sebagai penentu tunggal gugur pada "Specification, not vocabulary, determines the empirical outcome", sebab penegakan cuma satu dari tiga rincian; dan keunggulan pandangan jangka panjang bertabrakan dengan cara peninjau menaruh "the first year of a cap" dan "the eighth" sebagai dua kepedulian yang sama nyata.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The two researchers work from the same body of figures."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The two researchers work from the same body of figures.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Two housing researchers who share a dataset and a broad political outlook reach opposite recommendations, and each has reasons worth hearing.
qs.why: "Share a dataset" berarti mereka memang bekerja dari kumpulan angka yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena teks menyatakan hal yang sama; "Not stated" salah karena berbagi data disebut di paragraf pertama.

title: An Earnings Floor for Delivery Riders
text:
This paper assesses the case for a minimum earnings floor for delivery riders working through applications. Riders are engaged as independent contractors, paid for each completed job, and they bear the cost of the vehicle, the insurance and the waiting. The question before the committee is not whether they are employees in law, but whether the present arrangement produces earnings that anybody would defend on inspection. Contractor status is not, in itself, the object of this assessment.

The evidence we obtained is uneven, though consistent in direction. Gross earnings per hour compare reasonably with the statutory minimum; earnings net of costs and unpaid waiting time do not. Two of the three operators declined to supply data on time spent logged in without an assignment, which is precisely the period in dispute. Where such data exists, it suggests riders spend between a quarter and a third of a shift waiting. The gap between the two figures is the entire question.

Two objections were put to us with some force. The first is that a floor would reduce the flexibility riders value, since an operator guaranteeing earnings must control availability. That trade-off is genuine, though smaller than claimed: a floor applied to engaged time alone would leave logging in unrestricted. The second objection is that operators would leave the city. Both operators making that argument have remained in jurisdictions where floors were introduced. Neither objection survives contact with the comparative evidence.

We therefore recommend a floor calculated on engaged time, set with reference to the statutory minimum plus an allowance for costs, together with a duty to disclose waiting time in aggregate each quarter. Enforcement should rest on the disclosed data rather than on individual complaints, which riders have obvious reasons to avoid making. The committee should note that a floor on engaged time alone leaves an incentive to over-recruit, and the disclosure duty is what makes that visible.
qs: What is the main purpose of this paper?
to propose a guaranteed rate for time actually worked
to test whether a floor would drive the operators away
to establish that waiting fills a quarter of a shift
to require quarterly publication of the waiting time
