qs.evidence: We therefore recommend a floor calculated on engaged time, set with reference to the statutory minimum plus an allowance for costs, together with a duty to disclose waiting time in aggregate each quarter.
qs.answer: to propose a guaranteed rate for time actually worked
qs.why: Kata "therefore" menyambung seluruh bukti ke satu usulan: "a floor calculated on engaged time, set with reference to the statutory minimum plus an allowance for costs", yaitu waktu yang benar-benar terpakai bekerja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh mengulang bagian nyata dari makalah ini, tapi salah cakupan atau derajat. Pengujian soal hengkangnya operator salah CAKUPAN: frasa pemblokirnya "Neither objection survives contact with the comparative evidence", jadi ia keberatan yang dijawab, bukan tujuan. Penetapan porsi waktu menunggu salah CAKUPAN juga: ia bukti antara, dan frasa pemblokirnya "We therefore recommend", yang menjadikannya langkah menuju usulan. Kewajiban publikasi triwulanan salah DERAJAT: dalam kalimat rekomendasi ia pelengkap, ditandai "together with".

qs: What did two of the three operators refuse to provide?
the number of riders recruited each quarter
gross hourly earnings for each of their riders
the cost of insurance and of the vehicle
records of hours spent waiting for an order

qs.evidence: Two of the three operators declined to supply data on time spent logged in without an assignment, which is precisely the period in dispute.
qs.answer: records of hours spent waiting for an order
qs.why: Yang ditolak adalah data tentang waktu masuk aplikasi tanpa pesanan, yaitu jam menunggu yang justru jadi pokok sengketa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Jumlah rekrutmen baru muncul di rekomendasi sebagai hal yang perlu terlihat, bukan yang ditolak; pendapatan kotor per jam justru tersedia dan udah dibandingkan dengan upah minimum; dan biaya asuransi serta kendaraan disebut ditanggung pengendara, tanpa sengketa data.

qs: Which finding gives the most direct support for a floor?
riders bear the cost of insurance themselves
pay after costs falls short of the legal minimum
operators stayed in cities that introduced floors
operators objected to the loss of flexibility

qs.evidence: Gross earnings per hour compare reasonably with the statutory minimum; earnings net of costs and unpaid waiting time do not.
qs.answer: pay after costs falls short of the legal minimum
qs.why: Pendapatan setelah biaya dan waktu tunggu tak lagi sebanding dengan upah minimum, dan itu dasar paling langsung bagi tarif dasar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Beban asuransi menjelaskan sebagian penyebab selisih itu, bukan menunjukkan selisihnya; kepergian operator dipakai untuk menjatuhkan keberatan kedua; dan keberatan soal keleluasaan adalah argumen penentang tarif dasar.

qs: What does the paper imply about a floor applied only to engaged time?
it may remove the need to disclose waiting time
it would push the operators out of the city
operators are tempted to sign up too many riders
it perhaps ends the flexibility riders value

qs.evidence: The committee should note that a floor on engaged time alone leaves an incentive to over-recruit, and the disclosure duty is what makes that visible.
qs.answer: operators are tempted to sign up too many riders
qs.why: Frasa "leaves an incentive to over-recruit" mengunci akibatnya, dan separuh kedua kalimat menjelaskan kenapa kewajiban pelaporan tetap dibutuhkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penghapusan kewajiban pelaporan diblokir separuh kedua kalimat itu, "the disclosure duty is what makes that visible"; hengkangnya operator gugur pada "Both operators making that argument have remained in jurisdictions where floors were introduced"; dan hilangnya keleluasaan bertabrakan dengan "a floor applied to engaged time alone would leave logging in unrestricted".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The paper concludes that riders are employees in law."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The paper concludes that riders are employees in law.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The question before the committee is not whether they are employees in law, but whether the present arrangement produces earnings that anybody would defend on inspection.
qs.why: Teks justru menyatakan status hukum itu bukan pertanyaan yang sedang dijawab.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" bertabrakan dengan kalimat itu; "Not stated" salah karena penolakan membahas status hukum disebut jelas.

topic: minimum earnings for app-based delivery riders
author: Labour committee paper
setting: a committee taking evidence from operators

title: The Notes That Write Themselves
text:
Software that listens to a medical consultation and generates the notes afterwards has entered routine use in some practices. Two clinicians in the same partnership, using the same system for a year, describe it quite differently. Neither is describing the software inaccurately; they are describing different parts of the work. Practices have adopted it faster than anyone has established what it displaces.

The first can hardly overstate the improvement in her working conditions; documentation, on her account, had become the principal constraint on attentiveness. She used to spend two hours each evening writing up what she had already done, and she now spends twenty minutes correcting a draft. More importantly, she says, she looks at the patient rather than the screen, and patients notice. The record produced is longer and more thorough than the one she wrote herself, and the summaries she sends to colleagues are clearer than before. Her case is one of reallocation: attention formerly consumed by documentation returns to the consultation itself.

Her partner accepts all of that yet remains uneasy. Writing the note, he argues, was where he thought: the act of choosing what mattered compelled a decision he now makes less deliberately. A generated summary is fluent and slightly bland, and blandness conceals uncertainty rather well. He has twice signed a draft containing a symptom the patient never mentioned, and a fluent error is harder to detect than an awkward one. Correcting a fluent draft demands scepticism rather than proofreading. His unease is epistemic rather than technical, concerning the formation of a judgement rather than the record of it.

The instructive point is that they are not disagreeing about accuracy. Both concede that the drafts are ordinarily reliable, and both accept the saving as genuine. The unresolved variable is cognitive rather than administrative. What is in dispute is whether a step that resembled paperwork was in fact part of the reasoning. Until that question is settled, a practice adopting such a system is running an experiment on its own judgement, whether it says so or not. A cautious practice would insist that the displacement be described in advance.
qs: On balance, which conclusion is the argument built to reach?
what remains unsettled is thinking rather than accuracy
the software may return the time documentation had taken
writing a note may be where a judgement actually forms
both clinicians describe different parts of the same work

qs.evidence: The instructive point is that they are not disagreeing about accuracy.
qs.answer: what remains unsettled is thinking rather than accuracy
qs.why: Teks menyebut inti yang mendidik: keduanya nggak berselisih soal akurasi, dan yang belum terjawab bersifat kognitif.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi waktu yang kembali adalah kasus klinisi pertama; opsi menulis catatan sebagai tempat pertimbangan terbentuk adalah keberatan klinisi kedua; opsi keduanya menggambarkan bagian kerja yang berbeda adalah pengantar paragraf satu, bukan pokok yang ditegaskan penulis.

qs: On balance, how much of the first clinician's evening does the record still take?
she spends two hours correcting each generated draft
the evening write-up now takes a sixth of the time
she sends her summaries to colleagues every evening
she writes the full record herself once again

qs.evidence: She used to spend two hours each evening writing up what she had already done, and she now spends twenty minutes correcting a draft.
qs.answer: the evening write-up now takes a sixth of the time
qs.why: Dua jam menjadi dua puluh menit, jadi pekerjaan malamnya tinggal sekitar seperenam waktu semula.
qs.whyOthersFail: Dua jam adalah keadaan lama sebelum perangkat itu dipakai, bukan waktu mengoreksi; pengiriman ringkasan ke kolega disebut jadi lebih jelas, tanpa keterangan waktu; dan menulis sendiri dari awal justru yang dia tinggalkan.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the second clinician's worry?
treats it as serious, though answered by the saving both accept
treats it as serious, though only as a worry about accuracy
treats it as serious, yet content to leave the displacement undescribed
treats it as serious and as a question still unsettled

qs.evidence: Until that question is settled, a practice adopting such a system is running an experiment on its own judgement, whether it says so or not.
qs.answer: treats it as serious and as a question still unsettled
qs.why: Penulis menyebut variabelnya "cognitive rather than administrative" dan menutup dengan "Until that question is settled, a practice adopting such a system is running an experiment on its own judgement": keberatannya berat dan belum terjawab.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memperlakukan keberatan itu sebagai serius dan dua pengecoh memberi kelonggaran atau menahan diri seperti kunci, jadi register nggak memisahkan; pemilihnya derajat dan sasaran. Anggapan udah terjawab oleh penghematan salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "The unresolved variable is cognitive rather than administrative". Penyempitan menjadi kekhawatiran akurasi salah SASARAN: frasa pemblokirnya "they are not disagreeing about accuracy". Kesediaan membiarkan pergeseran itu tak diuraikan salah DERAJAT: frasa pemblokirnya "A cautious practice would insist that the displacement be described in advance".

qs: Which conclusion about fluent generated drafts does the second clinician's account support?
they may make an error easier to notice
they are perhaps shorter than his own notes
they remove any need for him to sign the record
they can hide doubt behind smooth wording

qs.evidence: A generated summary is fluent and slightly bland, and blandness conceals uncertainty rather well.
qs.answer: they can hide doubt behind smooth wording
qs.why: Kata "conceals" mengunci arahnya: kelancaran menutupi ketidakpastian, bukan menampakkannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kemudahan menemukan kesalahan diblokir kalimat berikutnya yang membalik arahnya, "a fluent error is harder to detect than an awkward one"; draf yang lebih pendek gugur pada laporan klinisi pertama, "longer and more thorough than the one she wrote herself"; dan hilangnya keharusan menandatangani bertabrakan dengan "He has twice signed a draft".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Patients are more satisfied with consultations than they were before the software."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Patients are more satisfied with consultations than they were before the software.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: More importantly, she says, she looks at the patient rather than the screen, and patients notice.
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang pasien memperhatikan perubahan itu; tingkat kepuasan sebelum dan sesudah nggak pernah dibandingkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" menyimpulkan perbandingan yang nggak ada; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal kepuasan pasien, ia diam soal ukurannya.

author: Practice review feature
setting: a medical partnership after a year of use

title: The Quiet Work of Arranging a Room
text:
Self-control is often described as a private struggle, the familiar image being that of a teenager who wants to revise, fights a bright screen, and wins or fails alone. That image is flattering, and it is also misleading. What research on habit formation continues to demonstrate is considerably less heroic: individuals who appear disciplined are frequently those who have quietly rearranged their surroundings, so that fewer confrontations ever begin. The difference matters, because the advice we give follows the image we hold.

Consider two candidates who face the same examination with equally weak motivation. One keeps her phone face down on the desk beside her textbooks; the other abandons it in a drawer in a separate room. Their reserves of willpower may be equal, yet their evenings are not the same at all. Every glance at the screen acts as an invitation, and invitations add up. Across an entire term the second candidate does not resist temptation more often; she is simply invited less often. The difference lies in the room rather than in the person.

Critics object that such reasoning reduces character to furniture and leaves the person oddly passive. The objection deserves a fair hearing. Moving the furniture is itself a decision, and real judgement is needed to see which cue should go. Nevertheless, the objection confuses the moment of effort with its location. Effort invested once in a sensible arrangement continues to repay the investment for weeks, whereas effort expended in resisting an identical cue every evening yields nothing and leaves its owner exhausted.

None of this means that a taste for hard work counts for nothing. It means, rather, that advice built on willpower alone sets an unfair test, and that it fails exactly those who ask for help. Institutions distributing cheerful reminders about determination, while tolerating noisy classrooms and chaotic timetables, are examining patience rather than cultivating it. A bright poster is no substitute for a quiet corner and a clear hour; rarely does a candidate collapse for want of resolve. Far more often the room, the timetable and the device had been arranged against her, and nobody considered moving them.
qs: On balance, which claim survives the qualifications made along the way?
Effort spent once on the arrangement keeps repaying for weeks afterwards.
People who look disciplined have usually arranged their surroundings first.
Advice that rests on willpower alone sets an unfair test for pupils.
Institutions preaching determination are testing patience, not building it.

qs.evidence: What research on habit formation continues to demonstrate is considerably less heroic: individuals who appear disciplined are frequently those who have quietly rearranged their surroundings, so that fewer confrontations ever begin.
qs.answer: People who look disciplined have usually arranged their surroundings first.
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut riset kebiasaan menunjukkan hal yang kurang heroik: yang tampak disiplin biasanya udah menata sekelilingnya lebih dulu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi usaha sekali yang terus terbayar adalah balasan bagi kritik di paragraf tiga; opsi nasihat berbasis kemauan dan opsi institusi yang menguji kesabaran keduanya akibat yang ditarik di paragraf empat, bukan klaim yang menopang seluruh esai.

qs: According to the essay, how do the two candidates in the example differ?
One candidate keeps her phone silenced; the other switches hers off.
One candidate has far more time to revise; the other works longer.
One candidate feels strong motivation; the other has almost none.
One candidate stores her phone out of reach; the other keeps it in sight.

qs.evidence: One keeps her phone face down on the desk beside her textbooks; the other abandons it in a drawer in a separate room.
qs.answer: One candidate stores her phone out of reach; the other keeps it in sight.
qs.why: Bedanya cuma letak ponsel: satu di meja dekat buku, satu ditinggal di lemari kamar lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi senyap/dimatikan terdengar seperti trik belajar yang wajar, tapi teks nggak pernah bicara soal mode suara — yang dibedakan cuma “face down on the desk” lawan “in a drawer in a separate room”. Opsi waktu belajar menambah beda yang nggak ada; teks bilang keduanya menghadapi ujian yang sama. Opsi motivasi malah bertabrakan langsung dengan “equally weak motivation” di kalimat pembuka contohnya.

qs: What attitude does the writer take towards the objection raised by critics?
Respectful of the objection, and ready to soften his central claim
Respectful of the objection, and reluctant to blame institutions for it
Respectful of the objection, and unpersuaded all the same
Respectful of the objection, and content to leave it open

qs.evidence: The objection deserves a fair hearing. Moving the furniture is itself a decision, and real judgement is needed to see which cue should go. Nevertheless, the objection confuses the moment of effort with its location.
qs.answer: Respectful of the objection, and unpersuaded all the same
qs.why: Keempat opsi memberi keberatan itu penghormatan yang sama; teks memilih derajatnya: keberatan disebut layak didengar, menata ruang diakui sebagai keputusan, lalu penulis tetap menyimpulkan keberatan itu mengacaukan momen usaha dengan tempatnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sejalan dengan tesis bahwa penataan ruang mengalahkan tekad, sama-sama menghormati keberatan, dan ketiganya juga menahan diri sesudah penghormatan itu — jadi bentuk kunci nggak lagi khas. Melunakkan hujah diblokir "Nevertheless, the objection confuses the moment of effort with its location", sebab tak satu klaim pun ditarik dan "Effort invested once in a sensible arrangement continues to repay the investment for weeks". Keengganan menyalahkan institusi salah SASARAN: keberatan itu datang dari pengeritik, sedangkan tentang institusi penulis justru tegas — "Institutions distributing cheerful reminders about determination, while tolerating noisy classrooms and chaotic timetables, are examining patience rather than cultivating it". Membiarkannya terbuka diblokir oleh bantahan yang justru diberikan di kalimat berikutnya.

qs: What does the writer imply about institutions that only preach determination?
They may not afford the quiet rooms and clear hours they would prefer.
They perhaps expect a pupil's family to supply the calm they cannot.
They test pupils against an obstacle they have never tried to remove.
They find that reminders work best for pupils who already revise well.

qs.evidence: Institutions distributing cheerful reminders about determination, while tolerating noisy classrooms and chaotic timetables, are examining patience rather than cultivating it.
qs.answer: They test pupils against an obstacle they have never tried to remove.
qs.why: Lembaga itu membiarkan “noisy classrooms and chaotic timetables” sambil menuntut ketekunan, sehingga yang mereka lakukan “examining patience rather than cultivating it” — murid diuji lewat hambatan yang nggak pernah disingkirkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi biaya adalah penjelasan paling wajar untuk sekolah mana pun dan udah dipagari "may", tapi teks nggak menyebut uang sama sekali dan menutup dengan "nobody considered moving them", yaitu soal perhatian, bukan anggaran. Opsi keluarga juga masuk akal di dunia nyata, namun yang disebut teks cuma ruang, jadwal, dan perangkat yang "arranged against her", semuanya di bawah kendali lembaga. Opsi temuan tentang murid rajin terdengar seperti hasil evaluasi biasa, tapi teks bilang nasihat semacam itu "fails exactly those who ask for help", dan nggak ada temuan apa pun yang dilaporkan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Arranging a room once brings no lasting benefit compared with resisting a cue every night."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Arranging a room once brings no lasting benefit compared with resisting a cue every night.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Effort invested once in a sensible arrangement continues to repay the investment for weeks, whereas effort expended in resisting an identical cue every evening yields nothing and leaves its owner exhausted.
qs.why: Teks justru bilang usaha sekali menata itu terbayar selama berminggu-minggu, sedangkan melawan isyarat tiap malam nggak membayar apa pun. Klaim ini membalik polaritasnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena arah pernyataannya berlawanan; "Not stated" salah karena perbandingan itu ditulis persis dalam satu kalimat.

topic: Self-control and the design of everyday surroundings
author: A school counsellor who writes a monthly column on study habits
setting: Weekend opinion column in an English-language weekly

title: Four Letters Are Not a Person
text:
Every few years a fresh questionnaire promises to explain your character in four letters, five factors or sixteen types. The attraction is obvious. A label converts a bewildering life into a compact narrative, and it supplies an excuse that resembles insight: I am simply constructed this way. Yet the consolation offered by the label is purchased at a price, and that price is generally paid rather later. The habit of sorting people is old; only the marketing is new.

Researchers who investigate traits seldom speak of types at all. Their instruments describe positions along a continuum, not membership of a tribe, and the same individual may sit near the midpoint on virtually every dimension. Assess the same adult again after two years and the score frequently drifts, particularly if employment, health or friendships have altered. What the popular quiz records, therefore, is a mood on a Tuesday afternoon, dressed up as destiny. A scale invites a further question, while a type quietly closes it.

The damage becomes visible in classrooms and offices. A pupil informed that she is an introvert may cease volunteering for the debating society, since volunteering now feels dishonest. A manager who reads that his department consists of thinkers and feelers will delegate the awkward conversation to whoever holds the appropriate badge. Neither has discovered anything genuinely new about the pupil or the department; both have acquired an excuse to stop observing.

None of this renders description worthless. Careful instruments do predict conduct modestly, and recognition can bring genuine relief when a private pattern is finally named. The honest version, however, retains the present tense and keeps the scale in view: you tend to prefer quiet, for the moment, in these particular settings. What merits suspicion is not the questionnaire but the certainty it invites, because certainty about a person is the swiftest route to overlooking whoever that person is becoming. Description turns into a cage only when the tense hardens.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this essay?
To question the certainty that personality labels invite in daily life
To question the instruments that place a person along each continuum
To question the relief that a private pattern brings when it is named
To question the drift that a repeated score shows after two years

qs.evidence: What merits suspicion is not the questionnaire but the certainty it invites, because certainty about a person is the swiftest route to overlooking whoever that person is becoming.
qs.answer: To question the certainty that personality labels invite in daily life
qs.why: Keempat opsi menyebut pekerjaan yang sama, yaitu menyoal sesuatu; teks menentukan sasarannya: "What merits suspicion is not the questionnaire but the certainty it invites".
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya menyoal unsur yang benar-benar ada dalam tesis esai ini, dan masing-masing salah sasaran. Menyoal instrumennya diblokir kalimat yang sama, sebab yang dicurigai bukan kuesionernya, dan diblokir "Careful instruments do predict conduct modestly". Menyoal rasa lega diblokir "recognition can bring genuine relief when a private pattern is finally named", sebab itu justru diakui. Menyoal pergeseran skor diblokir pemakaiannya sendiri, sebab pergeseran itu bukti penulis, bukan yang dia curigai.

qs: What does the essay say happens when the same adult is measured again after two years?
The score usually stays steady unless the person answers less honestly.
The score usually moves, above all when circumstances have altered.
The score tends to drift towards the middle of the scale used.
The score moves only for adults whose health has stayed the same.

qs.evidence: Assess the same adult again after two years and the score frequently drifts, particularly if employment, health or friendships have altered.
qs.answer: The score usually moves, above all when circumstances have altered.
qs.why: Teks bilang skornya sering bergeser, terutama kalau pekerjaan, kesehatan, atau pertemanan berubah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi skor tetap itu asumsi wajar orang soal tes kepribadian, tapi teks jelas menulis skornya “frequently drifts”. Opsi geser ke tengah mencampur kalimat lain: yang disebut dekat titik tengah adalah posisi sebagian orang di banyak dimensi, bukan arah pergeseran setelah dua tahun. Opsi kesehatan tetap membalik syaratnya, karena teks justru menyebut perubahan “employment, health or friendships” sebagai pemicu pergeseran.

qs: Which detail is offered as evidence that a label can narrow a pupil's choices?
A manager hands the awkward conversation to the matching badge.
A pupil's score drifts after two years of altered friendships.
A pupil is said to sit near the midpoint on most dimensions.
A pupil stops offering herself for the debating society.

qs.evidence: A pupil informed that she is an introvert may cease volunteering for the debating society, since volunteering now feels dishonest.
qs.answer: A pupil stops offering herself for the debating society.
qs.why: Contoh konkretnya: murid berlabel introvert berhenti mendaftar klub debat karena terasa nggak jujur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi manajer memang detail benar dari teks, tapi itu contoh soal kantor, bukan bukti bahwa pilihan seorang murid menyempit. Opsi skor bergeser justru dipakai teks untuk melawan gagasan tipe, jadi arahnya nggak nyambung dengan stem. Opsi titik tengah menggambarkan cara peneliti memetakan sifat, dan nggak menyebut satu pun akibat pada murid.

qs: What can be inferred about the manager described in the third paragraph?
He has perhaps learned which of his staff handle a hard talk best.
He has let a badge take the place of noticing his own colleagues.
He distrusts the questionnaire but has been told by the firm to use it.
He has found that his department talks more freely since the labels arrived.

qs.evidence: Neither has discovered anything genuinely new about the pupil or the department; both have acquired an excuse to stop observing.
qs.answer: He has let a badge take the place of noticing his own colleagues.
qs.why: Teks bilang dia dan si murid “have acquired an excuse to stop observing”, jadi label itu menggantikan kerja memperhatikan orang, bukan menambahnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi belajar siapa yang cakap terdengar seperti hasil normal seorang manajer, dan pagar "perhaps" nggak menolongnya, sebab teks menutupnya: "Neither has discovered anything genuinely new about the pupil or the department". Opsi disuruh perusahaan adalah cerita kantor yang sangat masuk akal, namun teks nggak menyebut perintah atau kebijakan apa pun; dia cuma "reads that his department consists of thinkers and feelers". Opsi departemen jadi lebih terbuka juga wajar dipercaya sebagai manfaat label, tapi yang dilaporkan teks kebalikannya, yaitu percakapan sulit yang dilemparkan ke pemegang lencana yang sesuai.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Serious trait measures predict a person's conduct to a small extent."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Serious trait measures predict a person's conduct to a small extent.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Careful instruments do predict conduct modestly, and recognition can bring genuine relief when a private pattern is finally named.
qs.why: Ini parafrasa kalimat yang mengakui bahwa alat ukur yang cermat memang meramalkan perilaku sedikit.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena teks justru mengakuinya; "Not stated" salah karena pengakuan itu tertulis jelas.

topic: Personality labels and the limits of type thinking
author: A researcher in educational assessment writing for general readers
setting: Comment pages of a monthly current-affairs magazine

title: How a Witness Rebuilds the Evening
text:
Ask a witness what she observed and she will normally reply with confidence. Ask her twice, with different wording inserted between the attempts, and the reply may shift in ways she never detects. Memory researchers have devoted decades to that gap between confidence and accuracy. Their conclusion has become difficult to avoid: recollection resembles reconstruction far more than replay. Confidence, it turns out, is a surprisingly poor guide to the accuracy of a memory.

The clearest results emerge from experiments in which volunteers watch a brief film of a road accident. Afterwards, half of them are asked how fast the vehicles were travelling when they smashed; the remainder hear the milder verb hit. A week later, those exposed to the stronger verb are markedly more likely to report broken glass which never appeared in the film. Both groups had watched exactly the same short film, yet a single word, supplied once, has been folded into the record.

Reconstruction is not a defect in the design of an ordinary memory. A memory preserving every detail would be expensive to maintain and slow to search, and the majority of those details would never become relevant again. What the mind retains is a sketch carrying a few emphatic marks, and the gaps are completed from expectation whenever the episode is narrated afresh. The sketch is normally adequate for ordinary purposes, and the completion is normally plausible. Neither storage nor searching comes free, and the mind appears to have noticed the bill.

For courts, the practical lesson concerns procedure rather than despair. Because early questioning leaves traces, the initial interview matters more than the tenth, and it ought to be recorded, neutral in wording and free of hints. Witnesses may be simultaneously honest and mistaken, and treating confidence as proof punishes the innocent. The finding is uncomfortable; nevertheless it directs attention somewhere useful, namely towards better questions asked sooner. Nor is the remedy expensive: a recorder, a neutral script and a little patience.
qs: On balance, where does the argument come to rest?
Recalling an event rebuilds it instead of playing it back.
A single word inserted afterwards can enter the record itself.
Discarding detail keeps an ordinary memory cheap and quick.
The first interview matters more than the tenth to a court.

qs.evidence: Their conclusion has become difficult to avoid: recollection resembles reconstruction far more than replay.
qs.answer: Recalling an event rebuilds it instead of playing it back.
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut simpulan yang sulit dihindari: ingatan lebih mirip rekonstruksi daripada pemutaran ulang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi satu kata yang masuk ke rekaman adalah percobaan film di paragraf dua yang menopang klaim itu; opsi membuang rincian adalah penjelasan mengapa rekonstruksi bukan cacat; opsi wawancara pertama adalah pelajaran prosedural di paragraf empat.

qs: What did the volunteers who heard the stronger verb tend to report a week later?
Speeds a good deal lower than the other group of viewers gave
Glass they had seen in the film but failed to mention at first
Glass that the film had never shown at any point in the crash
Details they had already given during the first interview

qs.evidence: A week later, those exposed to the stronger verb are markedly more likely to report broken glass which never appeared in the film.
qs.answer: Glass that the film had never shown at any point in the crash
qs.why: Mereka melaporkan kaca pecah yang sebenarnya nggak pernah muncul di film.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kecepatan lebih rendah membalik arah efeknya: kata yang lebih keras menaikkan taksiran, bukan menurunkannya. Opsi kaca yang tadinya lupa disebut terdengar wajar, tapi teks tegas bilang kaca itu “never appeared in the film”, jadi bukan soal lupa. Opsi detail yang udah disebutkan nggak menjawab stem, karena yang menarik justru laporan baru yang muncul seminggu kemudian.

qs: How is the road-accident experiment run from the viewing to the later account?
Volunteers watch one short film, half of them meet a stronger verb, and both groups are asked again a week later
Volunteers watch two different films, one of which contains the broken glass they afterwards report
Volunteers are questioned once immediately, and the wording is varied only for those who mention glass
Volunteers describe the crash from memory a week later, before any verb has been put to them

qs.evidence: Afterwards, half of them are asked how fast the vehicles were travelling when they smashed; the remainder hear the milder verb hit. A week later, those exposed to the stronger verb are markedly more likely to report broken glass which never appeared in the film.
qs.answer: Volunteers watch one short film, half of them meet a stronger verb, and both groups are asked again a week later
qs.why: Prosedurnya berurutan: satu film pendek untuk semua peserta, lalu "half of them are asked how fast the vehicles were travelling when they smashed; the remainder hear the milder verb hit", dan "A week later" kedua kelompok diminta melaporkan apa yang mereka lihat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Dua film berbeda bertentangan dengan "Both groups had watched exactly the same short film", dan kaca itu "never appeared in the film". Pilihan yang membuat variasi kata bergantung pada siapa yang menyebut kaca MEMBALIK sebab-akibat: kata itu disisipkan lebih dulu lalu "has been folded into the record". Pilihan yang meminta cerita seminggu kemudian tanpa kata apa pun disisipkan menghapus justru variabel yang menghasilkan efek itu.

qs: In the final paragraph, what does "it" refer to in "it ought to be recorded"?
the wording chosen, rather than the interview itself
the first interview conducted with the witness
the tenth interview, once the account has largely settled
the confidence the witness expresses in her account

qs.evidence: Because early questioning leaves traces, the initial interview matters more than the tenth, and it ought to be recorded, neutral in wording and free of hints.
qs.answer: the first interview conducted with the witness
qs.why: Subjek klausa sebelumnya adalah “the initial interview matters more than the tenth”, dan “it” melanjutkan subjek itu; sisa kalimatnya, “neutral in wording and free of hints”, cuma bisa dikenakan pada wawancara.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pilihan kata masuk akal karena teks memang mempersoalkan kata kerja "smashed", tapi kalau "it" berarti wording, frasa "neutral in wording" di kalimat yang sama jadi mengulang dirinya sendiri. Opsi wawancara kesepuluh sama wajarnya sebagai hal yang direkam pengadilan, namun teks memakai "the tenth" justru sebagai pembanding yang kurang penting dalam "the initial interview matters more than the tenth". Opsi keyakinan saksi juga hal yang biasa dicatat pengadilan, tapi kalimat setelahnya melarang memperlakukan keyakinan sebagai bukti, bukan menyuruh merekamnya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "A person can give an account honestly and still be wrong about what happened."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: A person can give an account honestly and still be wrong about what happened.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Witnesses may be simultaneously honest and mistaken, and treating confidence as proof punishes the innocent.
qs.why: Ini parafrasa langsung: saksi bisa jujur dan keliru sekaligus.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena teks menyatakan hal yang sama; "Not stated" salah karena kalimatnya ada di paragraf terakhir.

author: A psychology lecturer writing for non-specialists
setting: Popular science section of a national newspaper

title: The Hour Before the File Is Closed
text:
Students who postpone an essay are seldom lazy, whatever their own diaries appear to suggest. Many of them work long hours, and some of the severest delays occur in people who hold exacting standards. When researchers began measuring what happens during the hour before a task is abandoned, a different picture emerged. Delay tracks emotion far more closely than it tracks effort. The word lazy explains nothing here, and their problem is not a missing timetable.

In diary studies, participants report a modest surge of anxiety, boredom or shame as the file opens. Turning towards something else eliminates that sensation immediately, and the relief is the reward which trains the habit. Delay, on this account, is a technique for managing mood, and in the short term it functions beautifully. Its short-term success is precisely why the habit proves so durable. Nothing here is mysterious, since this is simply the way in which relief teaches a habit.

The account also explains why conventional advice disappoints: timetables and stern lists treat the difficulty as defective planning, so they impose additional pressure on somebody already fleeing pressure. Approaches which address the emotion perform better: composing one ugly opening sentence, shrinking the assignment to two minutes, or pardoning the previous delay before resuming. Self-forgiveness sounds indulgent, yet in one study it predicted less delay before the following examination. Small and kind steps appear to work better than large and stern ones.

Two cautions belong here, and neither of them is small. The studies overwhelmingly involve undergraduates and depend on self-report, so the effects may prove weaker in a warehouse or a hospital ward. Nor does the account excuse missed deadlines which leave colleagues carrying the burden. Still, if avoidance is emotional at root, the useful question concerns not how somebody might force herself, but what renders this particular file unpleasant to open. That question is a practical one, and a student can usually answer it within a single afternoon.
qs: On balance, which claim would the author refuse to give up?
Relief at turning away is often what trains the habit.
Gentle steps may work better than stern lists here.
Students who delay often hold exacting standards themselves.
Putting work off answers a feeling rather than a lack of effort.

qs.evidence: Delay tracks emotion far more closely than it tracks effort.
qs.answer: Putting work off answers a feeling rather than a lack of effort.
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut penundaan mengikuti emosi jauh lebih dekat daripada mengikuti usaha.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kelegaan yang melatih kebiasaan adalah mekanisme di paragraf dua yang menjelaskan klaim itu; opsi langkah lembut adalah akibat praktisnya di paragraf tiga; opsi standar yang menuntut adalah pengamatan pembuka yang dipakai untuk menyingkirkan kata malas.

qs: What do participants in the diary studies report as the file opens?
A steady loss of interest that usually lasts the whole afternoon
A short rise of unease, dullness or shame about the work
A wish to plan the essay rather fully before any writing begins
A calm that arrives before the file has even been opened

qs.evidence: In diary studies, participants report a modest surge of anxiety, boredom or shame as the file opens.
qs.answer: A short rise of unease, dullness or shame about the work
qs.why: Yang dilaporkan adalah kenaikan kecil rasa cemas, bosan, atau malu saat berkas dibuka.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kehilangan minat sepanjang sore menukar rasa sesaat jadi keadaan panjang, padahal teks menyebut “a modest surge” tepat saat berkasnya dibuka. Opsi ingin merencanakan dulu terdengar seperti penundaan yang kita kenal, tapi teks nggak melaporkannya; rencana malah dibahas sebagai nasihat yang gagal. Opsi tenang sebelum berkas dibuka membalik urutannya, sebab kelegaan baru datang setelah orangnya beralih ke hal lain.

qs: Which finding is given as evidence that gentler methods can work?
Two-minute tasks removed the unease reported in the diary studies.
Stern lists cut delay in students who already worked long hours.
Pardoning an earlier delay was followed by less delay before an exam.
An ugly opening sentence was rated better than a careful one.

qs.evidence: Self-forgiveness sounds indulgent, yet in one study it predicted less delay before the following examination.
qs.answer: Pardoning an earlier delay was followed by less delay before an exam.
qs.why: Buktinya satu studi: memaafkan penundaan sebelumnya diikuti penundaan yang lebih sedikit menjelang ujian.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tugas dua menit memang salah satu saran di teks, tapi nggak ada hasil studi yang dilampirkan padanya, jadi ia bukan bukti. Opsi daftar tegas membalik teks, yang bilang daftar keras justru menambah tekanan. Opsi kalimat pembuka jelek juga cuma saran praktis; teks nggak pernah membandingkan mutunya dengan kalimat yang rapi.

qs: Which statement best paraphrases the first caution in the final paragraph?
The studies rest on watching students, so their own accounts add little.
The studies rest on students' own accounts, so other workers may differ.
The studies rest on students' accounts, so effects elsewhere may be larger.
The studies rest on ward and warehouse reports, so students may differ.

qs.evidence: The studies overwhelmingly involve undergraduates and depend on self-report, so the effects may prove weaker in a warehouse or a hospital ward.
qs.answer: The studies rest on students' own accounts, so other workers may differ.
qs.why: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk yang sama, yaitu dasar bukti lalu akibatnya; peringatan pertama menyebut studinya hampir seluruhnya melibatkan mahasiswa dan bersandar pada laporan diri, sehingga efeknya mungkin lebih lemah di gudang atau bangsal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya seelegan kunci dan masing-masing menggeser tepat satu unsur. Opsi mengamati mahasiswa menggeser metodenya, padahal teks menyebut "depend on self-report". Opsi efek lebih besar di luar kampus menggeser arah dugaannya, sebab teks menyebut "may prove weaker". Opsi bukti dari bangsal dan gudang menggeser sumbernya, sebab kedua tempat itu justru yang belum diuji.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Delay brings no relief at the moment when a student turns to another task."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Delay brings no relief at the moment when a student turns to another task.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Turning towards something else eliminates that sensation immediately, and the relief is the reward which trains the habit.
qs.why: Teks bilang beralih ke hal lain langsung menghapus perasaan itu, dan kelegaan itulah hadiahnya — klaim ini kebalikannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena polaritasnya dibalik; "Not stated" salah karena kelegaan itu dinyatakan terang-terangan.

topic: Delay as the management of feeling rather than defective planning
author: A learning adviser reporting current research to students
setting: Study-skills feature in a university magazine

title: Two Ways to Praise a Ten-Year-Old
text:
Few pieces of classroom guidance travel faster than the instruction to praise effort rather than ability. It now decorates staffroom posters in schools which share almost nothing else. Two researchers who broadly accept that instruction were asked what they would actually say to a newly appointed teacher. Their answers prove to be close neighbours rather than twins. Advice which travels this quickly is rarely examined at close range.

The first, a developmental psychologist, would retain the emphasis on effort, with a single repair. Children informed that they are clever, she argues, learn to guard the label and therefore avoid tasks which might damage it. Praise for trying keeps them in the contest. Her repair is that such praise must be truthful. A child told she laboured hard when she did not will detect the flattery quickly, and cheap approval for weak work teaches that adults cannot be trusted.

The second, who trains teachers of mathematics, concedes that praise for ability is hazardous, yet he doubts that effort is the appropriate replacement. Effort combined with a poor method is merely exhausting, and a warm remark about trying may reach the child as a polite verdict on her intelligence. He would commend the strategy instead: the choice to check the units, the decision to draw a diagram, the willingness to abandon an approach which has stalled.

Placed side by side, the two positions share a target and separate over the remedy. Both would forbid the cheerful line about being clever, and both want the child still working ten minutes later. One protects the pupil's willingness; the other steers the pupil's next move. A teacher who follows the psychologist will console more readily, while a teacher who follows the trainer will instruct more, and may console rather less. Neither position is a mere slogan, and both survive contact with a noisy Monday class.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this article?
To set out two close positions on praise and show where they part
To set out two positions on praise and settle which repair is sounder
To set out two positions that differ over the aim rather than the remedy
To set out two positions and show the gap too small to alter teaching

qs.evidence: Placed side by side, the two positions share a target and separate over the remedy.
qs.answer: To set out two close positions on praise and show where they part
qs.why: Keempat opsi menyebut pekerjaan yang sama, yaitu memaparkan dua posisi; teks menentukan bentuknya: "the two positions share a target and separate over the remedy", dan penulis menutup tanpa memilih.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya nyambung dengan tesis dua posisi berdekatan dan masing-masing salah pada satu unsur. Memutuskan mana yang lebih kukuh diblokir "Neither position is a mere slogan". Berbeda pada tujuannya diblokir kalimat yang menyebut keduanya berbagi sasaran dan berpisah pada obatnya. Jarak yang terlalu kecil untuk mengubah pengajaran diblokir "A teacher who follows the psychologist will console more readily, while a teacher who follows the trainer will instruct more".

qs: What repair does the developmental psychologist add to the usual advice?
Praise for trying should wait until the task has been finished.
Praise for trying works best once the word clever is dropped.
Praise for trying has to be honest if a child is to trust an adult.
Praise for trying should name the method the pupil has chosen.

qs.evidence: Her repair is that such praise must be truthful.
qs.answer: Praise for trying has to be honest if a child is to trust an adult.
qs.why: Tambalannya: pujian usaha harus jujur, karena anak cepat mendeteksi pujian palsu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tunggu selesai kedengaran seperti aturan kelas yang masuk akal, tapi psikolog itu nggak menyinggung waktu pemberian pujian. Opsi buang kata clever adalah bagian nasihat lama yang dia terima, bukan tambalan yang dia tambahkan. Opsi sebut metode itu posisi peneliti kedua yang justru mengganti usaha dengan strategi, jadi salah pemilik pendapat.

qs: How does the writer present the disagreement between the two researchers?
As a narrow difference that nonetheless divides them over the aim
As a narrow difference that a plainer slogan would nonetheless dissolve
As a narrow difference that still changes what teachers do
As a narrow difference that the mathematics trainer has already settled

qs.evidence: A teacher who follows the psychologist will console more readily, while a teacher who follows the trainer will instruct more, and may console rather less.
qs.answer: As a narrow difference that still changes what teachers do
qs.why: Keempat opsi menyebutnya perbedaan sempit; teks menentukan akibatnya: guru yang mengikuti psikolog lebih sering menghibur, guru yang mengikuti pelatih lebih sering mengajari dan mungkin lebih jarang menghibur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menerima bahwa jaraknya sempit dan ketiga pengecoh memakai bentuk "sempit namun tetap" yang sama seperti kunci, jadi bentuknya nggak memisahkan; yang salah adalah unsurnya. Perpisahan pada tujuan diblokir "the two positions share a target and separate over the remedy", sebab yang berpisah justru obatnya. Soal pilihan kata diblokir "Neither position is a mere slogan". Udah diputus oleh pelatih matematika diblokir "both survive contact with a noisy Monday class", sebab penulis tak memberi kemenangan kepada siapa pun.

qs: What can be inferred about the second researcher's view of effort praise?
He thinks it may shield a pupil from praise for cleverness.
He thinks it perhaps works once a method has been settled.
He thinks it suits pupils who find mathematics discouraging.
He thinks it may tell a pupil that little more is expected.

qs.evidence: Effort combined with a poor method is merely exhausting, and a warm remark about trying may reach the child as a polite verdict on her intelligence.
qs.answer: He thinks it may tell a pupil that little more is expected.
qs.why: Dia bilang komentar hangat soal berusaha “may reach the child as a polite verdict on her intelligence”, yaitu sinyal halus bahwa harapan terhadap anak itu udah rendah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi melindungi dari pujian kecerdasan masuk akal karena itu memang alasan resmi nasihat memuji usaha, tapi si pelatih "doubts that effort is the appropriate replacement", jadi dia nggak memakai pembelaan itu. Opsi udah punya metode terdengar wajar, namun teks bilang "Effort combined with a poor method is merely exhausting" dan yang dia puji adalah pilihan strateginya, bukan usahanya. Opsi murid yang kesulitan matematika sangat bisa dipercaya untuk seorang pelatih guru matematika, tapi teks nggak pernah menyebut kelompok murid mana pun sebagai pengecualian.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The two researchers based their advice on a joint study of ten-year-olds."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The two researchers based their advice on a joint study of ten-year-olds.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Two researchers who broadly accept that instruction were asked what they would actually say to a newly appointed teacher.
qs.why: Teks cuma menyebut keduanya diminta memberi nasihat; dasar nasihat itu, apalagi soal riset bersama, nggak pernah disebut.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh atribusi riset bersama yang nggak ada; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal studi seperti itu, hanya diam.

topic: Two neighbouring views on how teachers should praise pupils
author: An education journalist summarizing two researchers' advice
setting: Feature in a professional magazine for teachers

title: The Label Is the Argument
text:
A glass case in a provincial museum holds a carved door panel taken from a burned palace more than a century ago. Visitors pause, skim three lines of commentary, and drift onward. Campaigners now argue that such objects should be withdrawn from view until their ownership has been settled, and the argument is an honourable one. On the evidence of the past decade, however, it is also a gift to forgetting. Institutions have discovered how convenient a controversy becomes once the object has vanished from the gallery.

Removal feels decisive, yet it commonly resolves nothing at all. A crate in a store room generates no research, no complaint and no conversation with the community that made the panel. Meanwhile the wall label, which is the one place where a museum must commit itself in public, disappears along with the object. Silence in a store room is considerably cheaper than an honest paragraph on a wall; invisibility protects the institution far more efficiently than it protects the claimant.

The alternative demands more work than either camp readily admits. A label can name the regiment, the year, the fire and the person who signed the receipt. It can record who has requested the panel, and when, and what the museum has answered. Where the record remains unclear, the label can say so, since uncertainty printed in public is a form of respect, whereas uncertainty filed in a drawer is merely convenient. A visitor can check a printed label against the record; an apology leaves nothing to check.

None of this settles the question of return, and nothing here should delay a claim that succeeds. What ought to be resisted is the reflex which treats disappearance as repair. Objects removed quietly tend to stay removed, since the pressure to act fades once the case stands empty. Better a difficult panel behind glass, with its history spelled out and its claimant named, than a tidy gallery which has learned to say nothing. A museum earns trust by what it prints, not by what it hides.
qs: On balance, what does the piece establish once its concessions are counted?
A contested object belongs on view with its history printed.
Removal protects the institution more than it does a claimant.
A label should record uncertainty rather than file it away.
Objects quietly taken off display tend to remain that way.

qs.evidence: Better a difficult panel behind glass, with its history spelled out and its claimant named, than a tidy gallery which has learned to say nothing.
qs.answer: A contested object belongs on view with its history printed.
qs.why: Kalimat penutup memilih panel sulit di balik kaca dengan riwayat tertulis dan penuntutnya disebut, daripada galeri rapi yang belajar nggak berkata apa-apa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penarikan melindungi institusi adalah pengamatan paragraf dua yang menopang; opsi label mencatat ketidakpastian adalah rincian usulnya di paragraf tiga; opsi benda yang tetap tersimpan adalah akibat di paragraf empat, bukan posisi yang dianjurkan.

qs: According to the essay, what does an object in a store room produce?
a steady stream of scholars who wish to inspect the collection
no enquiry, no protest and no contact with the community concerned
a legal record which a court may consult during a later claim
a saving that the museum can spend on the wall label instead

qs.evidence: A crate in a store room generates no research, no complaint and no conversation with the community that made the panel.
qs.answer: no enquiry, no protest and no contact with the community concerned
qs.why: Peti di gudang nggak menghasilkan riset, keluhan, maupun percakapan dengan komunitas pembuatnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi arus peneliti kedengaran wajar untuk gudang museum, tapi teks bilang peti di gudang “generates no research”. Opsi catatan hukum menambah manfaat yang nggak pernah disebut; yang disebut hilang justru label dinding, satu-satunya tempat museum berjanji di depan publik. Opsi penghematan memutar kalimat soal biaya: teks memakai murahnya keheningan untuk menuduh, bukan untuk bilang uangnya pindah ke label.

qs: Which detail is given to show that a label can carry uncomfortable facts?
It may be printed in three short lines that a visitor can skim.
It may disappear from the wall as soon as the case stands empty.
It may set out the unit involved, the date of the blaze and a signature.
It may be redrafted each time a fresh claim is received.

qs.evidence: A label can name the regiment, the year, the fire and the person who signed the receipt.
qs.answer: It may set out the unit involved, the date of the blaze and a signature.
qs.why: Contohnya konkret: label bisa mencantumkan resimen, tahun, kebakaran, dan penanda tangan kuitansi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tiga baris pendek memang detail dari teks, tapi itu gambaran komentar yang dilewati pengunjung, bukan bukti bahwa label bisa memuat fakta yang nggak nyaman. Opsi label ikut hilang justru akibat penarikan benda, jadi arahnya berlawanan dengan stem. Opsi label ditulis ulang tiap ada klaim menambah prosedur yang nggak ada; teks cuma bilang label bisa mencatat siapa yang meminta dan kapan.

qs: What does the writer imply about objects that are quietly withdrawn?
Their absence may be a step on the way back to the claimant.
Their absence perhaps shows the campaigners' case was accepted.
Their absence protects the object from the damage that display causes.
Their absence removes the pressure that might have forced a decision.

qs.evidence: Objects removed quietly tend to stay removed, since the pressure to act fades once the case stands empty.
qs.answer: Their absence removes the pressure that might have forced a decision.
qs.why: Teks bilang benda yang disingkirkan diam-diam “tend to stay removed, since the pressure to act fades once the case stands empty” — tekanan yang hilang itu intinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi langkah menuju pengembalian adalah harapan yang wajar dan banyak dipercaya, tapi teks menutupnya: "Objects removed quietly tend to stay removed". Opsi museum menerima tuntutan sama masuk akalnya sebagai tafsir sebuah penarikan, namun teks bilang "invisibility protects the institution far more efficiently than it protects the claimant". Opsi melindungi benda dari kerusakan pameran adalah argumen konservasi yang biasa, tapi teks nggak menyebut kerusakan sama sekali; yang disebut peti yang "generates no research, no complaint and no conversation".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer accepts that a successful request for return should not be held up."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer accepts that a successful request for return should not be held up.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: None of this settles the question of return, and nothing here should delay a claim that succeeds.
qs.why: Penulis menyatakan tak ada di tulisannya yang boleh menunda klaim yang berhasil — klaim ini parafrasanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena isinya sejalan; "Not stated" salah karena kalimatnya jelas di paragraf akhir.

topic: Contested museum objects and the honesty of labels
author: A museum curator writing in a personal capacity
setting: Arts comment page of a national daily

title: Bronze Can Wait; Paper Cannot
text:
Every provincial capital seems to want a monument. The proposal arrives with a sketch, a cost and a promise about identity, and such proposals are difficult to oppose in public. Yet a few streets away, above the district office, a damp room holds a century of land deeds, school registers and market ledgers, all slowly turning to dust. If heritage money comes from a single pot, the priority is not obvious, and it is not the statue. Two claims on one budget deserve comparison rather than sentiment.

Monuments are, in a sense, easy heritage. They can be photographed on the day they are unveiled, they require little explanation, and they seldom contradict the people who paid for them. An archive behaves quite differently. It answers questions nobody thought to ask, it embarrasses official chronologies, and it demands stable dry storage rather than a ribbon. No ribbon can be attached to a shelf of ledgers, however carefully they have been ordered; unveiling an archive is impossible, which is precisely why it is neglected.

The practical case is stronger still: a single ledger can establish who farmed a plot before a boundary dispute reached the courts, and a school register can settle a pension claim eighty years later. The sums are relevant here: listing and shelving an entire district collection costs less than one bronze figure. The work also employs graduates in the town itself rather than a studio in the capital.

This is not a plea to demolish anything, for monuments do teach civic feeling, and an empty square teaches very little. But a community which cannot produce its own documents ends up borrowing somebody else's version of its past. The borrowed version is usually a flattering one. Neglect is rarely a decision; it is what happens when nobody decides. Bronze survives a decade of delay without harm, whereas paper does not, and the damp room should therefore be dealt with first.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this column?
To urge that scarce heritage money reach the records before the statues
To urge that heritage money be split evenly between the two claims
To urge that the district stop unveiling monuments while paper rots
To urge that the deeds be moved to the capital before the damp wins

qs.evidence: Bronze survives a decade of delay without harm, whereas paper does not
qs.answer: To urge that scarce heritage money reach the records before the statues
qs.why: Keempat opsi mendesak hal yang sama besar; teks menentukan isinya: "the priority is not obvious, and it is not the statue", lalu ruang lembap itu disuruh ditangani lebih dulu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya sejalan dengan tesis bahwa kertas lebih rapuh daripada bronse dan masing-masing salah pada satu unsur. Membagi rata diblokir kalimat yang justru memberi peringkat. Menghentikan peresmian monumen menggeser derajatnya dari menunda ke melarang dan diblokir "This is not a plea to demolish anything" serta "Bronze survives a decade of delay without harm". Memindahkan akta ke ibu kota menggeser tempatnya dan diblokir "The work also employs graduates in the town itself rather than a studio in the capital".

qs: What does the column say the archive requires?
a ribbon, a speech and a photograph on the day it opens
a studio in the capital where graduates list the collection
a boundary dispute before its ledgers are of use to a court
conditions that stay dry and steady instead of a ceremony

qs.evidence: It answers questions nobody thought to ask, it embarrasses official chronologies, and it demands stable dry storage rather than a ribbon.
qs.answer: conditions that stay dry and steady instead of a ceremony
qs.why: Yang dibutuhkan arsip adalah lemari kering bersuhu stabil, bukan pita dan pidato.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pita dan pidato justru yang ditolak teks: arsip menuntut penyimpanan kering “rather than a ribbon”. Opsi studio di ibu kota membalik kalimat soal tenaga kerja, karena pekerjaan itu disebut menyerap lulusan di kota itu sendiri. Opsi sengketa batas mengubah satu contoh kegunaan ledger jadi syarat sebelum arsip berguna, padahal teks bilang arsip menjawab pertanyaan yang belum terpikir.

qs: How would you describe the writer's attitude towards monuments?
Granting their civic value though slow to question the cost
Granting their civic value while placing them second
Granting their civic value while treating neglect as a decision
Granting their civic value while leaving the ranking to others

qs.evidence: monuments do teach civic feeling, and an empty square teaches very little.
qs.answer: Granting their civic value while placing them second
qs.why: Keempat opsi mengakui nilai kewargaan monumen; teks menentukan derajatnya: monumen memang mengajarkan rasa kewargaan, dan penulis tetap menaruhnya di urutan kedua sesudah kertas yang lembap.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memberi pengakuan lalu menahan diri dengan cara yang sama, jadi register kunci nggak menonjol; yang salah adalah satu unsurnya. Lambat menyoal biaya diblokir kalimat biaya yang justru dihitung, "listing and shelving an entire district collection costs less than one bronze figure". Menganggap kelalaian sebagai keputusan diblokir "Neglect is rarely a decision; it is what happens when nobody decides". Menyerahkan peringkat kepada orang lain diblokir "the priority is not obvious, and it is not the statue".

qs: Which statement best paraphrases the point about a borrowed version of the past?
A town without its own papers must borrow the capital's own ledgers.
A town without its own papers keeps only the disputes it can recall.
A town without its own papers is told a story that spares nobody.
A town without its own papers inherits a story told to please.

qs.evidence: But a community which cannot produce its own documents ends up borrowing somebody else's version of its past. The borrowed version is usually a flattering one.
qs.answer: A town without its own papers inherits a story told to please.
qs.why: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk yang sama; teks menentukan isinya: komunitas yang tak bisa mengeluarkan dokumennya sendiri berakhir meminjam versi orang lain, dan versi pinjaman itu biasanya menyanjung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya sama-sama berbentuk paradoks kota tanpa kertasnya sendiri dan masing-masing menggeser satu unsur. Meminjam buku besar ibu kota menggeser objeknya dari versi masa lalu ke dokumen, dan bertabrakan dengan pekerjaan yang justru dikerjakan di kota itu sendiri. Mengingat perselisihan menggeser cakupannya ke ingatan. Cerita yang tak menyisakan siapa pun membalikkan arahnya, sebab "The borrowed version is usually a flattering one".

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Listing and shelving a whole district collection costs more than a single bronze figure."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Listing and shelving a whole district collection costs more than a single bronze figure.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: listing and shelving an entire district collection costs less than one bronze figure.
qs.why: Teks menyebut biayanya lebih murah daripada satu patung bronze, jadi klaim ini menukar arah perbandingannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena angkanya dibalik; "Not stated" salah karena perbandingan biaya itu memang ditulis.

topic: Funding priorities between monuments and local archives
author: A district archivist writing about local budgets
setting: Opinion column in a regional newspaper

title: Two Clocks in One Village
text:
How old is a village? The question sounds simple until two categories of record disagree. In one upland district, elders date the founding of their settlement to the arrival of an ancestor seven generations ago. A colonial tax ledger lists the same hamlet, under a slightly different spelling, a full century earlier. Historians now treat that gap as evidence in itself rather than as an error requiring correction.

Oral genealogies are not casual inventions: they are rehearsed at ceremonies, corrected in public by rivals, and tied to rights over land and water. What they compress, however, is the middle. Generations without disputes or migrations tend to drop out of the count, so a list of names measures remembered events more faithfully than it measures elapsed decades. Rehearsal in public is a strict discipline, and errors are costly for whoever commits them.

The ledger has the opposite habit. Officials recorded what they could reach and name, and they entered a settlement only when a road, a market or a quarrel brought it into view. An early entry therefore proves that inhabitants were present, but it does not prove that the village considered itself founded. Nor is spelling a neutral matter, because a clerk's guess at an unfamiliar sound may attach one hamlet's name to another hamlet's fields. Absence from a ledger measures the reach of officials rather than the antiquity of a place.

Read together, the two records describe different things: continuous occupation on one side, and the founding of a community as its members define it on the other. The reconciliation is unglamorous: pollen samples, house timbers and pottery from the terraces can date occupation independently. Where such work has been done, the elders' account and the ledger usually turn out to be answering separate questions. Neither source was lying; each was simply asked something it had never claimed to know. Chronology, in short, is only as sound as the question that produced it.
qs: On balance, which summary fits the argument as a whole rather than one paragraph?
An oral genealogy drops the generations that saw no dispute.
An early ledger entry proves presence but not a founding.
Each record answered a question that the other never asked.
Pollen and timbers can date an occupation on their own.

qs.evidence: Read together, the two records describe different things: continuous occupation on one side, and the founding of a community as its members define it on the other.
qs.answer: Each record answered a question that the other never asked.
qs.why: Teks menutup dengan keduanya menjawab pertanyaan terpisah dan tak ada sumber yang berdusta; masing-masing ditanya hal yang tak pernah diakuinya diketahui.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi silsilah yang memangkas generasi adalah kebiasaan satu sumber di paragraf dua; opsi catatan pajak awal adalah kebiasaan sumber lain di paragraf tiga; opsi polen dan kayu adalah cara rekonsiliasinya, bukan klaim pusatnya.

qs: What does the article say tends to drop out of an oral genealogy?
names of ancestors whose rights over water were disputed openly
the ceremonies at which the list of names is rehearsed in public
spellings that a clerk could not match to a familiar sound
quiet generations in which no dispute or movement took place

qs.evidence: Generations without disputes or migrations tend to drop out of the count, so a list of names measures remembered events more faithfully than it measures elapsed decades.
qs.answer: quiet generations in which no dispute or movement took place
qs.why: Yang hilang dari hitungan adalah generasi tanpa sengketa atau perpindahan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi nama yang haknya disengketakan membalik aturannya, karena sengketa justru yang membuat satu generasi diingat. Opsi upacara menukar isi daftar dengan tempat daftar itu dilafalkan. Opsi ejaan memindahkan masalah dari genealogi lisan ke ledger kolonial, dua sumber yang teks bedakan dengan hati-hati.

qs: Which point is used as evidence that an early ledger entry proves less than it seems?
Settlements entered the records only when something drew official notice.
Elders rehearse their genealogies at ceremonies attended by rivals.
Pollen samples and house timbers can date occupation on their own.
A clerk's spelling could attach one hamlet's name to another's fields.

qs.evidence: Officials recorded what they could reach and name, and they entered a settlement only when a road, a market or a quarrel brought it into view.
qs.answer: Settlements entered the records only when something drew official notice.
qs.why: Buktinya: hamlet baru dicatat saat ada jalan, pasar, atau perselisihan yang menariknya ke perhatian pejabat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi latihan genealogi adalah bukti untuk keandalan sumber lisan, bukan untuk batas arti sebuah entri ledger. Opsi pollen dan kayu rumah datang dari paragraf rekonsiliasi dan justru dipakai untuk menengahi, bukan untuk menilai entri awal. Opsi ejaan juru tulis memang kelemahan ledger, tapi ia soal nama tertukar, bukan soal apakah entri dini membuktikan pendirian desa.

qs: What can be inferred about the value of the disagreement between the two records?
It suggests one account may have been reworked long afterwards.
It suggests the hamlet in the ledger was perhaps another settlement.
It shows the elders revised their count once the ledger was read to them.
It can be studied as evidence instead of being tidied away as an error.

qs.evidence: Historians now treat that gap as evidence in itself rather than as an error requiring correction.
qs.answer: It can be studied as evidence instead of being tidied away as an error.
qs.why: Teks bilang sejarawan sekarang memperlakukan selisih itu “as evidence in itself rather than as an error requiring correction”, dan paragraf akhir menunjukkan apa yang bisa dipelajari darinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi salah satu catatan digarap ulang belakangan adalah kesimpulan yang wajar dari dua angka yang bentrok, tapi teks menegaskan "Neither source was lying". Opsi hamlet yang berbeda memakai masalah ejaan yang memang disebut teks, namun kalimatnya sendiri bilang ledger itu mencatat "the same hamlet, under a slightly different spelling". Opsi elders merevisi hitungan setelah mendengar ledger sama masuk akalnya sebagai proses sejarah lisan, tapi koreksi yang disebut teks datang "in public by rivals", bukan dari dokumen pejabat.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "A tax official's rough spelling of an unheard word could attach one settlement's name to another settlement's land."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: A tax official's rough spelling of an unheard word could attach one settlement's name to another settlement's land.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Nor is spelling a neutral matter, because a clerk's guess at an unfamiliar sound may attach one hamlet's name to another hamlet's fields.
qs.why: Teks bilang tebakan juru tulis atas bunyi asing bisa menempelkan nama satu hamlet ke ladang hamlet lain, jadi klaim ini parafrasanya, bukan kutipan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena isi klaim sejalan dengan teks; "Not stated" salah karena risiko ejaan itu dibahas jelas di paragraf tentang ledger.

topic: Oral genealogy and written tax records as dating evidence
author: A historian of upland settlement writing for general readers
setting: History feature in a popular science monthly

title: A Wound or a Document
text:
A brick temple on a river terrace lost its upper tiers to an earthquake and its carvings to weather in the decades since. Two conservation architects, trained in the same faculty and equally opposed to invented ornament, were asked what should happen next. They agree on the danger and on the budget; they differ on what a visitor should be shown. The site is protected on paper and unprotected in every practical sense.

The first would rebuild the missing tiers using the fallen stone that lies catalogued in the field beside the site. A ruin, she argues, is not a neutral state but a wound which continues to bleed. Water enters, roots follow, and the surviving carving goes last. Reconstruction, carried out only where the original blocks and their positions are documented, protects what remains and restores the proportions the builders intended. Her caution is procedural: no block returns unless its former position is certain.

The second accepts the engineering and rejects the shape. Rebuilding, he notes, always requires interpretation, and the joint where fresh mortar meets old brick teaches visitors that the past can be tidied. He would install a discreet steel canopy, stabilize the walls, and leave the gap in plain view. Where his colleague sees a wound, he sees a document which records the earthquake and the long neglect that followed it. Honesty about loss, in his view, outlasts the pleasure of a restored outline.

The distance between the two positions is narrower than it appears, and it is nonetheless real. Both would use fallen material, both refuse invented ornament, and both agree that the site cannot be fenced off and forgotten. One wants the visitor to understand the building; the other wants the visitor to understand its history. A committee will describe this as a technical dispute. It is closer to a choice about which truth the terrace ought to carry, and committees dislike such choices, because measurement cannot settle them.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this article?
To contrast two positions and settle which treatment is the more honest
To contrast two positions that differ over the engineering of the walls
To contrast two positions produced by two rather different faculties
To contrast two close positions on how a ruined temple should be treated

qs.evidence: The distance between the two positions is narrower than it appears, and it is nonetheless real.
qs.answer: To contrast two close positions on how a ruined temple should be treated
qs.why: Keempat opsi menyebut pekerjaan yang sama, yaitu mempertentangkan dua posisi; teks menentukan bentuknya: jaraknya "narrower than it appears, and it is nonetheless real", dan pilihannya diserahkan sebagai soal nilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya menerima tesis dua posisi berdekatan dan masing-masing salah pada satu unsur. Memutuskan mana yang lebih jujur diblokir "It is closer to a choice about which truth the terrace ought to carry", sebab penulis tak memilih. Berbeda pada rekayasa dindingnya diblokir "The second accepts the engineering and rejects the shape". Dua fakultas berbeda diblokir "trained in the same faculty".

qs: What does the second architect say about the joint between new and old material?
It teaches visitors that history can be made to look neat.
It weakens the wall wherever fresh mortar has been applied.
It should be hidden beneath a canopy of discreet steel bars.
It records the earthquake more plainly than the gap does.

qs.evidence: Rebuilding, he notes, always requires interpretation, and the joint where fresh mortar meets old brick teaches visitors that the past can be tidied.
qs.answer: It teaches visitors that history can be made to look neat.
qs.why: Menurut arsitek kedua, sambungan itu mengajari pengunjung bahwa masa lalu bisa dirapikan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi melemahkan dinding terdengar seperti keberatan teknis yang wajar, tapi teks bilang dia “accepts the engineering” dan menolak bentuknya, bukan kekuatannya. Opsi disembunyikan di bawah kanopi salah sasaran: kanopi dipasang untuk menstabilkan dinding sambil membiarkan celahnya terlihat. Opsi mencatat gempa membalik pemilik peran, karena yang dia sebut dokumen adalah celah yang dibiarkan, bukan sambungan mortar baru.

qs: How does the writer treat the disagreement between the two architects?
As a small difference that nonetheless decides what is shown
As a small difference that nonetheless careful measurement could close
As a small difference about ornament that both would refuse
As a small difference that the shared budget has nonetheless settled

qs.evidence: The distance between the two positions is narrower than it appears, and it is nonetheless real. Both would use fallen material, both refuse invented ornament, and both agree that the site cannot be fenced off and forgotten. One wants the visitor to understand the building; the other wants the visitor to understand its history.
qs.answer: As a small difference that nonetheless decides what is shown
qs.why: Keempat opsi menyebutnya perbedaan kecil; teks menentukan letaknya: jaraknya lebih sempit daripada tampaknya dan tetap nyata, sebab satu ingin pengunjung memahami bangunannya dan satu ingin pengunjung memahami sejarahnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menerima tesis bahwa dua posisi itu berdekatan dan ketiga pengecoh memakai bentuk konsesif yang sama, jadi bentuknya nggak menunjuk kunci; yang salah adalah unsurnya. Bisa ditutup pengukuran diblokir "committees dislike such choices, because measurement cannot settle them". Soal ornamen rekaan diblokir "both refuse invented ornament", jadi itu bukan sumbu perbedaannya. Udah diputus anggaran diblokir "They agree on the danger and on the budget".

qs: Which statement best paraphrases the first architect's view of a ruin?
A ruin is a record that the years of neglect keep writing.
A ruin is an injury that keeps causing further loss.
A ruin is a condition that steady weather would hold still.
A ruin is a loss that careful cataloguing has already limited.

qs.evidence: A ruin, she argues, is not a neutral state but a wound which continues to bleed.
qs.answer: A ruin is an injury that keeps causing further loss.
qs.why: Keempat opsi mendefinisikan puing dengan gaya yang sama rapinya; arsitek pertama menyebutnya bukan keadaan netral melainkan luka yang terus mengeluarkan darah, sebab air masuk, akar menyusul, dan ukiran yang bertahan jatuh terakhir.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya berbentuk definisi yang setara dan masing-masing menggeser satu unsur. Puing sebagai rekaman menggeser agennya ke arsitek kedua, "he sees a document which records the earthquake and the long neglect". Keadaan yang bisa ditahan cuaca menggeser derajatnya, padahal lukanya disebut terus berlanjut. Kerugian yang udah dibatasi katalog menggeser derajatnya juga, sebab batu yang terkatalog di lapangan tak menghentikan air dan akar.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The canopy proposed by the second architect would cost more than rebuilding the upper tiers."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The canopy proposed by the second architect would cost more than rebuilding the upper tiers.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: They agree on the danger and on the budget; they differ on what a visitor should be shown.
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang keduanya sepakat soal anggaran; biaya kanopi dibanding biaya membangun ulang nggak pernah diperbandingkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" butuh angka yang tak pernah muncul; "False" juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkalnya, hanya diam soal itu.
