A manager in each department must judge that a heat episode has begun
Admissions must have climbed for two days, which is when relief now starts
The register of vulnerable residents must first be brought up to date

qs.evidence: When the forecast night-time minimum exceeds a stated figure for two consecutive nights, four measures take effect automatically.
qs.answer: The forecast night-time minimum must pass a stated figure on two nights running
qs.why: Pemicunya berupa ambang, bukan penilaian orang: "When the forecast night-time minimum exceeds a stated figure for two consecutive nights, four measures take effect automatically."
qs.whyOthersFail: Keputusan seorang manajer adalah pengaturan LAMA yang hendak diganti: "Response at present depends on the discretion of individual departments." Menunggu dua hari kenaikan rawat inap MEMBALIK maksud rencana, karena kelambatan itulah yang dikoreksi: "action begins on the second or third day of a heat episode, by which time admissions have already risen". Pemutakhiran daftar penduduk rentan disebut sebagai kelemahan yang diakui, bukan prasyarat: "Neither weakness argues against the threshold."

qs: Which conclusion about the proposal to plant for shade does the plan support?
It may be offered as an alternative to opening the halls now.
It is valued for the long term despite giving no relief this year.
It is perhaps the cheapest of the measures the plan proposes.
It is counted among the four measures that take effect automatically.

qs.evidence: Planting for shade, meanwhile, will not affect this year or the next, though it remains the only measure that reduces the underlying hazard.
qs.answer: It is valued for the long term despite giving no relief this year.
qs.why: Satu kalimat memuat keduanya: penanaman “will not affect this year or the next, though it remains the only measure that reduces the underlying hazard”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi sebagai alternatif masuk akal karena keduanya sama-sama soal panas, tapi teks bilang kedua kelemahan itu "argue for beginning the slower work at the same time", jadi bukan pilihan salah satu. Opsi paling murah terdengar wajar untuk penanaman pohon, namun teks nggak pernah membandingkan biaya keempat tindakan. Opsi termasuk empat tindakan otomatis juga bisa dipercaya, tapi keempatnya disebut satu per satu dan penanaman nggak ada di daftar itu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The four measures in the plan depend on new buildings being completed first."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The four measures in the plan depend on new buildings being completed first.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: None of the four requires new construction. All four require a decision taken in advance.
qs.why: Teks menyatakan tak satu pun dari empat langkah itu butuh bangunan baru, hanya keputusan lebih awal.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena bertolak belakang; "Not stated" salah karena soal konstruksi disebut jelas.

topic: A city heat action plan with automatic triggers
author: A municipal resilience officer drafting policy
setting: Action plan submitted to a city executive committee

title: The Tax Nobody Records
text:
The working week is now organized around a calendar rather than around work. A request for thirty minutes costs the sender nothing and costs the room whatever the room is worth, which is why the number of meetings grows without anybody deciding that it should. The expense is real and unrecorded, yet nobody enters the price of an hour's attention in any ledger, and so nobody defends it.

Defenders of the calendar point out, correctly, that decisions require discussion. The difficulty is that most meetings are not decisions at all; they are broadcasts with an audience obliged to attend. Attendance obligations of this kind are rarely negotiable, since declining an invitation is interpreted as indifference rather than as a judgement about the value of the hour. A status update read aloud to eleven people consumes eleven hours in order to deliver information that could have been read in four minutes. Repeated across a quarter, that pattern produces exactly the exhaustion which firms then attempt to treat with wellbeing programmes. Every pound of expenditure has a custodian somewhere in the hierarchy; the vanished hours have none.

Written updates are the obvious substitute, and they are harder than they look. Asynchronous composition imposes an intellectual discipline which verbal improvisation comfortably evades. A document must state its purpose in the opening line, and the writer has nowhere to hide behind tone of voice or a diagram drawn on a board. That difficulty is precisely the point: a reader can verify whether a document stands up, whereas an assured voice escapes scrutiny entirely. A proposal which cannot survive being read will not survive being implemented either. Writing also leaves a record, whereas a meeting leaves only the memories of whoever happened to attend it. A colleague who was never present can audit what a document claims. No such check exists for a recollection.

Some conversations resist the page, and pretending otherwise is its own kind of managerial vanity. Negotiations, disputes between colleagues who mistrust one another, and anything involving bad news belong in a room with faces in it. A serviceable rule follows from the distinction: convene when the outcome depends on how people react, and write when it depends on what is true. Most organizations have that rule inverted. Managers persist in booking the room regardless, which reveals what the calendar genuinely protects. Their own calendars demonstrate the preference plainly enough.
qs: On balance, which conclusion is the argument built to reach?
Written updates demand a discipline that speech evades.
Some conversations belong in a room with faces present.
Meetings spend attention that no ledger ever records.
Declining an invitation reads as indifference to colleagues.

qs.evidence: yet nobody enters the price of an hour's attention in any ledger, and so nobody defends it.
qs.answer: Meetings spend attention that no ledger ever records.
qs.why: Paragraf pertama menyebut tak ada yang mencatat harga satu jam perhatian dalam buku mana pun, sehingga tak ada yang membelanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi disiplin menulis adalah usul penggantinya di paragraf tiga; opsi percakapan yang harus bertatap muka adalah pengecualian di paragraf empat; opsi menolak undangan adalah mekanisme yang menjelaskan mengapa jam itu terus terpakai.

qs: What example does the writer give of a meeting that is really a broadcast?
a negotiation between colleagues who do not trust one another
a discussion held before a difficult decision has been taken
a routine progress summary delivered by voice to a whole team
a wellbeing programme delivered to staff at a quarter's end

qs.evidence: A status update read aloud to eleven people consumes eleven hours in order to deliver information that could have been read in four minutes.
qs.answer: a routine progress summary delivered by voice to a whole team
qs.why: Contohnya laporan status yang dibacakan ke sebelas orang padahal bisa dibaca sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi negosiasi adalah jenis percakapan yang teks bilang memang harus di ruangan, jadi ia bukan siaran satu arah. Opsi diskusi sebelum keputusan justru pembelaan kalender yang penulis terima sebagai sah. Opsi program kesejahteraan adalah akibat kelelahan di teks, bukan contoh rapat siaran.

qs: How would you describe the writer's attitude towards meeting face to face?
Prepared to keep it for good news while pricing the rest
Prepared to keep it for reactions while limiting its reach
Prepared to keep it for decisions while writing down the disputes
Prepared to keep it for briefings while writing the rest down

qs.evidence: Negotiations, disputes between colleagues who mistrust one another, and anything involving bad news belong in a room with faces in it. A serviceable rule follows from the distinction: convene when the outcome depends on how people react, and write when it depends on what is true.
qs.answer: Prepared to keep it for reactions while limiting its reach
qs.why: Keempat opsi mempertahankan ruangan untuk sebagian hal saja; teks menentukan pemilahnya: berkumpul bila hasilnya bergantung pada bagaimana orang bereaksi, dan menulis bila bergantung pada apa yang benar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi mempertahankan rapat untuk sesuatu sambil membatasinya, jadi bentuknya seragam; yang salah adalah dasar pemilahnya. Kabar baik diblokir "anything involving bad news belong in a room with faces in it", jadi arahnya terbalik. Menuliskan perselisihan diblokir "disputes between colleagues who mistrust one another" yang justru harus berlangsung di ruangan. Rapat pemaparan diblokir "they are broadcasts with an audience obliged to attend", sebab justru itu yang harus dijadikan tulisan.

qs: Which statement best paraphrases the writer's proposed rule?
Meet when reactions matter; write when the facts do.
Meet when the facts matter; write when reactions do.
Meet when a record matters; write when speed does.
Meet when a team is new; write once it is settled.

qs.evidence: convene when the outcome depends on how people react, and write when it depends on what is true
qs.answer: Meet when reactions matter; write when the facts do.
qs.why: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk aturan dua sisi yang sama; teks menentukan arahnya: berkumpul bila hasilnya bergantung pada bagaimana orang bereaksi, dan menulis bila bergantung pada apa yang benar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya seringkas dan seelegan kunci, dan masing-masing menggeser satu unsur. Versi terbalik menukar kedua sisi aturannya, padahal teks menaruh reaksi di ruangan dan kebenaran di halaman. Rekaman lawan kecepatan menggeser dasarnya dan bertabrakan dengan "Writing also leaves a record, whereas a meeting leaves only the memories". Tim baru lawan tim mapan menggeser dasarnya menjadi waktu, yang tak pernah dijadikan pemilah.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer accepts that some subjects are better handled in person than on paper."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer accepts that some subjects are better handled in person than on paper.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Some conversations resist the page, and pretending otherwise is its own kind of managerial vanity.
qs.why: Penulis mengakui ada percakapan yang menolak dituliskan, jadi klaim ini parafrasa yang tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena pengakuan itu ada; "Not stated" salah karena kalimatnya jelas di paragraf akhir.

topic: The hidden cost of meetings and the case for written updates
author: An organisational consultant writing on working practices
setting: Management essay in a business monthly

title: Eighty Per Cent of the Hours
text:
The four-day week has moved from manifesto to measurement. Several hundred firms have now run trials in which staff worked roughly eighty per cent of their previous hours for unchanged pay, and the results were monitored rather than merely announced. The headline findings are encouraging, though the detail underneath them is considerably more interesting.

Most participating firms reported output holding steady, and a majority chose to retain the arrangement once the trial had finished. Sickness absence fell, and reported exhaustion fell further still. The caveat is straightforward, and the researchers state it themselves: firms which volunteer for an experiment of this kind are not a random sample of employers. An organization confident enough to try is probably managed competently already, and its results travel poorly to firms that are not.

Where output held, it was seldom because anybody worked faster. It held because a shorter week forced a review of activity that had continued out of habit. Recurring meetings were cancelled, approvals were delegated downwards, and reporting cycles were lengthened. The gains therefore came from removing waste which a five-day week had comfortably absorbed. That also explains why office-based firms fared better than those where a bed, a lathe or a checkout must be attended by somebody. You can only rearrange a week which belongs to the employer in the first place.

The honest conclusion is a conditional one. A shorter week appears to work where the work itself can be reorganised, and it struggles where the hours are the service being sold. Claiming more than that overstates the evidence, while claiming less ignores it. What the trials have established is narrower than the enthusiasts suggest and more subversive than the sceptics admit. The five-day week is a convention rather than a law of production, and conventions of that kind have been revised before. What the trials cannot settle is whether such a revision would hold once the novelty of being observed had worn off.
qs: On balance, which claim survives the qualifications made along the way?
Output held because old habits were finally reviewed.
The volunteering firms were probably well managed already.
The five-day week is a convention and not a law.
A shorter week pays off where tasks can be rebuilt.

qs.evidence: A shorter week appears to work where the work itself can be reorganised, and it struggles where the hours are the service being sold.
qs.answer: A shorter week pays off where tasks can be rebuilt.
qs.why: Simpulan jujurnya bersyarat: pekan lebih pendek bekerja di tempat kerjanya bisa ditata ulang dan tersendat di tempat jamnya adalah jasa yang dijual.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keluaran yang bertahan karena kebiasaan ditinjau adalah mekanismenya di paragraf tiga; opsi perusahaan sukarela yang terkelola baik adalah peringatan di paragraf dua; opsi pekan lima hari sebagai konvensi adalah akibat retorisnya, bukan syarat keberhasilannya.

qs: On balance, what did most participating firms report once the trial had ended?
a small but measurable fall in the volume of work that was completed
the work still got done, and most kept the shorter week afterwards
a rise in sickness absence during the months of the trial
a decision to return to five days once the trial ended

qs.evidence: Most participating firms reported output holding steady, and a majority chose to retain the arrangement once the trial had finished.
qs.answer: the work still got done, and most kept the shorter week afterwards
qs.why: Hasil kerja tetap tuntas, dan mayoritas perusahaan meneruskan pekan pendek setelah uji coba.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penurunan hasil kerja bertentangan dengan laporan bahwa output bertahan. Opsi absen sakit naik membalik arahnya, karena teks bilang absen sakit turun dan kelelahan turun lebih jauh lagi. Opsi kembali ke lima hari menukar pilihan mayoritas, yang justru mempertahankan pengaturan barunya.

qs: Which point is offered as evidence that the trial firms were unusual?
Employers that put themselves forward are not representative.
Recurring meetings were cancelled during the trial period.
Reporting cycles were lengthened in most firms taking part.
Office-based firms did better than those with beds or lathes to staff.

qs.evidence: firms which volunteer for an experiment of this kind are not a random sample of employers
qs.answer: Employers that put themselves forward are not representative.
qs.why: Perusahaan yang mendaftar sendiri bukan sampel acak, jadi hasilnya nggak bisa digeneralkan begitu saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi rapat berulang dibatalkan dan opsi siklus pelaporan diperpanjang keduanya menjelaskan kenapa hasil kerja bertahan, bukan kenapa peserta uji coba nggak mewakili semua perusahaan. Opsi kantor lebih unggul menunjuk batas jenis pekerjaan, dan tetap berlaku meski sampelnya acak.

qs: Which conclusion about firms where a checkout must be staffed does the evidence warrant?
They perhaps reported the largest falls in exhaustion in the trials.
They may have been left out of the trials by the researchers.
They found it harder, because their hours are the service being sold.
They held output steady by lengthening their reporting cycles.

qs.evidence: That also explains why office-based firms fared better than those where a bed, a lathe or a checkout must be attended by somebody. You can only rearrange a week which belongs to the employer in the first place.
qs.answer: They found it harder, because their hours are the service being sold.
qs.why: Dua kalimat itu memberi sebabnya: perusahaan kantoran lebih berhasil, dan penataan ulang cuma mungkin pada pekan yang memang milik pemberi kerja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penurunan kelelahan terbesar masuk akal karena pekerjaan berjaga memang melelahkan, tapi teks menempatkan mereka di sisi yang kalah, sebab "office-based firms fared better than those where a bed, a lathe or a checkout must be attended by somebody". Opsi dikeluarkan dari uji coba sama wajarnya sebagai keputusan metodologis, namun teks membandingkan hasil mereka, jadi mereka ikut. Opsi memperpanjang siklus laporan memakai mekanisme yang benar ada di teks, tapi itu daftar perubahan yang bisa dilakukan kantor, bukan tempat yang mesinnya harus dijaga orang.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The trials were funded by public grants rather than by the participating firms."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The trials were funded by public grants rather than by the participating firms.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Several hundred firms have now run trials in which staff worked roughly eighty per cent of their previous hours for unchanged pay, and the results were monitored rather than merely announced.
qs.why: Teks cuma menyebut ratusan perusahaan menjalankan uji coba dan hasilnya dipantau; soal siapa yang membiayai sama sekali nggak disinggung, jadi kamu nggak bisa menyimpulkan apa pun.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" dan "False" sama-sama butuh keterangan sumber dana, dan teks nggak pernah menyebut hibah maupun siapa yang menanggung biaya uji coba.

author: A science writer reporting on trials of shorter working weeks
setting: Work and economics feature in a popular science magazine

title: Who Decides Which Days
text:
A firm of nine hundred people must finally write down the hybrid policy it has avoided writing for two years. Two directors, both persuaded that full attendance will not return, disagree about what ought to replace it, though both want people in the building sometimes. What divides them is the question of who decides when. What they are really deciding is who holds the pen, rather than which attendance pattern eventually appears in the document.

The first would fix two anchor days for everybody. Coordination, she argues, is the only defensible reason to travel at all, and a building half full on five separate days delivers none of it. A shared timetable also protects the people whom informal arrangements invariably disadvantage: new joiners, part-time staff and anybody who lacks the confidence to ask. Predictability, on her account, is a form of fairness rather than a constraint upon it. Where nothing is fixed, advantage drifts towards employees already comfortable enough to negotiate privately.

The second accepts the coordination argument and distrusts the instrument. A rule imposed centrally will be sensible for some teams and absurd for others, he notes, and the teams for which it is absurd will comply in form while evading it in substance. He would require every team to publish its own pattern, reviewed each quarter, with attendance visible to the whole firm. Where his colleague locates fairness in a fixed timetable, he locates it in a published one. He would rather every pattern were visible than impose an identical timetable upon unwilling teams.

The distance between them is smaller than the meetings suggest, and it will not disappear. Both reject attendance as a measure of commitment, both insist that the pattern be written down, and both accept that somebody will lose from any arrangement whatsoever. One of them trusts a rule; the other trusts a rule about how rules get made. Neither policy will ultimately be judged by occupancy figures gathered on a particular Tuesday morning. Whichever is adopted, the argument that follows will concern trust rather than desks.
qs: What is the writer's main purpose in this piece?
To lay out two close but competing answers on one policy
To lay out two answers and settle which of them a firm might adopt
To lay out two answers that differ over whether it might be written down
To lay out two answers whose gap the next quarter will close

qs.evidence: The distance between them is smaller than the meetings suggest, and it will not disappear.
qs.answer: To lay out two close but competing answers on one policy
qs.why: Keempat opsi menyebut pekerjaan yang sama; teks menentukan bentuknya: jaraknya "smaller than the meetings suggest, and it will not disappear", lalu titik pisahnya ditunjuk tanpa pemenang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya nyambung dengan tesis dua jawaban berdekatan dan masing-masing salah pada satu unsur. Memutuskan mana yang dipakai diblokir penutupnya, "the argument that follows will concern trust rather than desks", sebab penulis tak memilih. Berbeda soal menuliskannya diblokir "both insist that the pattern be written down". Jarak yang akan tertutup diblokir "it will not disappear".

qs: Whom does the first director say a shared timetable protects?
directors who need the building to be full on all five days of a week
newcomers, part-time staff and those reluctant to make requests
teams whose own pattern would otherwise have to be published
employees whose commitment is measured by their attendance record

qs.evidence: A shared timetable also protects the people whom informal arrangements invariably disadvantage: new joiners, part-time staff and anybody who lacks the confidence to ask.
qs.answer: newcomers, part-time staff and those reluctant to make requests
qs.why: Jadwal bersama melindungi pendatang baru, pekerja paruh waktu, dan mereka yang enggan meminta.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi direktur yang ingin gedung penuh lima hari justru pola yang keduanya tolak. Opsi tim yang harus menerbitkan polanya adalah usulan direktur kedua, bukan yang dilindungi jadwal bersama. Opsi karyawan yang komitmennya diukur dari kehadiran memakai ukuran yang teks sebut ditolak kedua pihak.

qs: Which point does the second director use against a central rule?
Coordination is the only defensible reason for travelling to work here.
Teams for which the rule makes no sense will obey it only formally.
Attendance should never be treated as a measure of commitment at all.
A pattern reviewed each quarter is easier to publish than to enforce.

qs.evidence: A rule imposed centrally will be sensible for some teams and absurd for others, he notes, and the teams for which it is absurd will comply in form while evading it in substance.
qs.answer: Teams for which the rule makes no sense will obey it only formally.
qs.why: Tim yang aturannya tak masuk akal akan patuh di atas kertas dan mengakalinya dalam praktik.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi koordinasi satu-satunya alasan datang adalah argumen direktur pertama, jadi ia mendukung aturan pusat, bukan menyerangnya. Opsi kehadiran bukan ukuran komitmen adalah titik yang mereka sepakati. Opsi lebih mudah diterbitkan daripada ditegakkan menyerang usulan direktur kedua sendiri dan nggak pernah muncul di teks.

qs: What can be inferred about the disagreement between the two directors?
It concerns whether people may come into the building at all.
It concerns how many days each team should perhaps spend together.
It concerns whether attendance is a fair measure of commitment.
It concerns where the authority to set the pattern should sit.

qs.evidence: One of them trusts a rule; the other trusts a rule about how rules get made.
qs.answer: It concerns where the authority to set the pattern should sit.
qs.why: Paragraf pembuka menyebutnya langsung — yang mereka putuskan “is who holds the pen” — dan paragraf akhir mengulanginya: satu memercayai aturan, satu memercayai aturan tentang cara aturan dibuat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi soal datang atau nggak masuk akal sebagai inti debat hibrida di mana pun, tapi teks bilang "both want people in the building sometimes". Opsi jumlah hari juga bacaan yang paling sering dipakai, namun teks menegaskan yang memisahkan mereka adalah "the question of who decides when". Opsi kehadiran sebagai ukuran komitmen adalah perdebatan nyata di kantor, tapi keduanya udah menolaknya bersama-sama.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The second director wants each team's attendance pattern kept within that team."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The second director wants each team's attendance pattern kept within that team.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: He would require every team to publish its own pattern, reviewed each quarter, with attendance visible to the whole firm.
qs.why: Dia justru menuntut pola tiap tim diterbitkan dan kehadirannya terlihat oleh seluruh perusahaan.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" salah karena membalik maksudnya; "Not stated" salah karena keterbukaan itu dinyatakan.

topic: Two approaches to writing a hybrid working policy
author: A human resources writer reporting an internal debate
setting: Discussion feature in a human resources journal

title: The Placement That Pays Nothing
text:
This paper concerns unpaid internships and the informal apprenticeships which have replaced entry-level employment in several sectors. A survey of 340 placements advertised over six months found that 62 per cent offered no payment of any kind. A third of those described duties indistinguishable from those of a junior employee. The practice is no longer marginal; it has become the ordinary route into at least three professions. Employers describe such arrangements as training even where no instruction has been scheduled.

The cost falls unevenly, which is the substance of the objection. An unpaid placement is affordable to a graduate whose family can house and feed her, and unaffordable to everybody else, so a hiring channel quietly becomes a form of inheritance. Two sectors elsewhere in the region adopted mandatory payment and saw no reduction in the number of placements offered. Average duration did shorten, which suggests that employers had been purchasing time they did not actually need. Paying for the time, on this reading, makes buyers of that time more careful.

Four provisions are proposed. First, any placement lasting more than four weeks must be paid at no less than the statutory minimum. Second, a written agreement must state the learning objectives, the supervisor and the finishing date. Third, advertisements must disclose the payment offered, a requirement that costs the employer almost nothing to meet. Fourth, the inspectorate already visiting these workplaces should add placement records to its existing checklist, which requires no new body and no additional visits.

Two objections deserve an answer rather than a dismissal. Small firms may withdraw from the scheme altogether, so a reduced rate for the first eight weeks is included for employers below twenty staff. Enforcement may also fall upon the employers who keep records instead of those who keep none, which argues for treating the register as a trigger for inspection rather than as proof of compliance. Neither difficulty justifies leaving the present arrangement alone, since continued tolerance of unpaid entry concedes that access to a profession may be purchased with parental subsidy.
qs: What is the main purpose of this paper?
To propose that every unpaid placement be prohibited by statute
To propose that employers stop describing such posts as training
To propose rules making longer placements paid and documented
To propose that the inspectorate visit these workplaces more often

qs.evidence: Four provisions are proposed. First, any placement lasting more than four weeks must be paid at no less than the statutory minimum. Second, a written agreement must state the learning objectives, the supervisor and the finishing date.
qs.answer: To propose rules making longer placements paid and documented
qs.why: Keempat opsi mengusulkan aturan sekuat kunci; teks menentukan isinya: empat ketentuan, dua pertamanya soal pembayaran di atas empat minggu dan perjanjian tertulis yang menyebut tujuan belajar, penyelia dan tanggal berakhir.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya sejalan dengan tesis bahwa jalur masuk tanpa upah adalah warisan terselubung, dan masing-masing salah pada satu unsur. Larangan menyeluruh menggeser cakupannya, sebab penempatan di bawah empat minggu tetap dibiarkan dan perusahaan kecil dapat tarif lebih rendah. Melarang penyebutan pelatihan menggeser obatnya, sebab yang diminta perjanjian tertulis yang menyebut tujuan belajar. Menambah kunjungan pengawas diblokir "which requires no new body and no additional visits".

qs: What did the survey find about the 340 placements?
that most of them lasted for longer than a period of four weeks
that almost two thirds of them came with no payment attached
that a third of them came from firms with fewer than twenty staff
that the inspectorate had already visited most of the workplaces

qs.evidence: A survey of 340 placements advertised over six months found that 62 per cent offered no payment of any kind.
qs.answer: that almost two thirds of them came with no payment attached
qs.why: Survei menemukan 62 persen penempatan itu tanpa bayaran sama sekali.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi sebagian besar lebih dari empat pekan mengambil angka dari ketentuan usulan, bukan dari temuan survei. Opsi sepertiga dari perusahaan kecil menempelkan sepertiga yang di teks menggambarkan tugas setara pegawai junior. Opsi pengawas udah berkunjung memakai bagian keempat usulan sebagai hasil survei.

qs: Which finding is used to answer the fear that payment would reduce opportunities?
Elsewhere, compulsory wages left the volume of such posts unchanged.
A third of placements involved duties like those of a junior employee.
Unpaid placements are affordable only to graduates supported by family.
The inspectorate can add placement records to a checklist it already uses.

qs.evidence: Two sectors elsewhere in the region adopted mandatory payment and saw no reduction in the number of placements offered.
qs.answer: Elsewhere, compulsory wages left the volume of such posts unchanged.
qs.why: Dua sektor yang mewajibkan bayaran nggak mengalami penurunan jumlah penempatan yang ditawarkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tugas setara pegawai junior menunjukkan penyalahgunaannya, bukan bahwa peluang tetap ada setelah upah diwajibkan. Opsi hanya terjangkau bagi yang ditanggung keluarga adalah inti keberatannya, jadi ia soal keadilan, bukan jumlah lowongan. Opsi pengawas menambah daftar periksa menjawab biaya penegakan, bukan kekhawatiran peluang menyusut.

qs: What does the paper imply by describing a hiring channel as inheritance?
that firms may prefer to recruit the relatives of their staff
that a placement is perhaps handed down between graduates
that a profession is entered by whoever's family can support them
that the same employers offer the same placements year after year

qs.evidence: An unpaid placement is affordable to a graduate whose family can house and feed her, and unaffordable to everybody else, so a hiring channel quietly becomes a form of inheritance.
qs.answer: that a profession is entered by whoever's family can support them
qs.why: Kalimat itu menjelaskan istilahnya sendiri: penempatan tanpa upah “is affordable to a graduate whose family can house and feed her, and unaffordable to everybody else”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi merekrut kerabat staf adalah bentuk pewarisan yang benar-benar ada di dunia kerja, tapi teks bicara soal siapa yang mampu bertahan tanpa upah, bukan soal hubungan keluarga dengan perusahaan. Opsi penempatan diwariskan antar-lulusan adalah bacaan harfiah yang wajar dari kata "inheritance", namun kalimatnya berbicara tentang biaya hidup, bukan tentang kursi yang berpindah tangan. Opsi pemberi kerja yang sama tiap tahun sama masuk akalnya, tapi teks nggak menyebut kesinambungan lowongan mana pun.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The proposal would allow employers with fewer than twenty staff to pay a lower rate at first."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The proposal would allow employers with fewer than twenty staff to pay a lower rate at first.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Small firms may withdraw from the scheme altogether, so a reduced rate for the first eight weeks is included for employers below twenty staff.
qs.why: Ada tarif lebih rendah untuk delapan minggu pertama bagi pemberi kerja di bawah dua puluh staf.
qs.whyOthersFail: "False" salah karena keringanan itu ada; "Not stated" salah karena angka dan jangka waktunya ditulis.

topic: Regulating unpaid internships and informal apprenticeships
author: A labour policy analyst advising a ministry committee
setting: Policy paper prepared for a labour ministry committee

title: Why the Report Went Outside
text:
This review examines why staff here report wrongdoing to journalists before they report it internally. Of the eleven substantiated cases in the last four years, nine reached management through an external route. Exit interviews supply the explanation without much ambiguity. Staff did not believe the internal channel was confidential, and several could name a colleague whose career had ended shortly after using it. Reputational memory of that sort outlasts any procedural assurance an employer is able to print.

The existing procedure is defective in its design rather than in its administration. A report goes first to the line manager, which is of no use whatever when the line manager is the subject of it. The form then requires the name of the person reporting before it requires the substance of the report. Anonymity is promised in a paragraph and impossible in practice, since a description of the incident normally identifies its only witness. Confidentiality is therefore promised at precisely the point where the organization is least able to deliver it.

Three changes are therefore proposed. Reports should go to a committee including one member from outside the organization, and never to the reporter's own line of management. A written acknowledgement, carrying a case number and a stated timetable, should be issued within five working days. Any adverse change in the reporter's duties within the following year should be reviewed automatically by that committee, whether or not a complaint has been made. Automatic scrutiny converts an allegation of retaliation into an administrative obligation upon the manager concerned.

None of this eliminates the risk of retaliation, and pretending otherwise would repeat the mistake being corrected. What it does is transfer the burden of explanation onto the organization. A transfer which follows a report will have to be justified, and a manager unable to justify one will be seen to have failed. Justification, unlike secrecy, is a requirement an institution can genuinely enforce upon itself. That is a smaller promise than confidentiality, yet it is also a promise that can actually be kept.
qs: What is the main purpose of this review?
To move the reporting route out of the organization altogether
To redesign an internal reporting route that staff do not trust
To transfer the burden of proof onto the staff who report wrongdoing
To restore the promise of confidentiality the present form makes

qs.evidence: Three changes are therefore proposed. Reports should go to a committee including one member from outside the organization, and never to the reporter's own line of management.
qs.answer: To redesign an internal reporting route that staff do not trust
qs.why: Keempat opsi mengusulkan perubahan jalur yang sama besar; teks menentukan isinya: tiga perubahan pada jalur pelaporan, mulai dari komite dengan satu anggota luar dan larangan melapor ke atasan sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya sejalan dengan tesis bahwa jalur internal tak dipercaya, dan masing-masing salah pada satu unsur. Memindahkan jalurnya keluar sepenuhnya menggeser derajatnya, sebab komitenya cuma memuat "one member from outside the organization". Memindahkan beban kepada pelapor membalikkan arahnya dan diblokir "What it does is transfer the burden of explanation onto the organization". Memulihkan janji kerahasiaan diblokir "Anonymity is promised in a paragraph and impossible in practice" serta "a smaller promise than confidentiality".

qs: On balance, what did the exit interviews establish about the internal channel?
that most reports had been resolved within five working days of arrival
that nine of the eleven cases had been dismissed without any inquiry
that staff doubted confidentiality and knew of a ruined career
that managers preferred reports in writing rather than in person

qs.evidence: Staff did not believe the internal channel was confidential, and several could name a colleague whose career had ended shortly after using it.
qs.answer: that staff doubted confidentiality and knew of a ruined career
qs.why: Wawancara keluar menunjukkan staf tak yakin kerahasiaannya dan tahu ada karier yang tamat setelah melapor.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi selesai dalam lima hari kerja mengambil tenggat dari usulan perubahan, bukan dari temuan wawancara. Opsi sembilan kasus ditolak tanpa penyelidikan memelintir angkanya: sembilan kasus itu sampai ke manajemen lewat jalur luar dan terbukti. Opsi manajer lebih suka laporan tertulis menambah preferensi yang nggak pernah disebut.

qs: How does a report travel through the procedure now in place?
It reaches the line manager first, on a form asking who is reporting before it asks what happened
It reaches a committee with an outside member, which issues a case number within five working days
It is filed without a name, so the substance can be examined without exposing the only witness
It reaches the line manager only in those cases where the manager is not the subject of it

qs.evidence: A report goes first to the line manager, which is of no use whatever when the line manager is the subject of it. The form then requires the name of the person reporting before it requires the substance of the report.
qs.answer: It reaches the line manager first, on a form asking who is reporting before it asks what happened
qs.why: Jalur yang berjalan sekarang disebut dua kalimat berurutan: "A report goes first to the line manager, which is of no use whatever when the line manager is the subject of it. The form then requires the name of the person reporting before it requires the substance of the report."
qs.whyOthersFail: Komite dengan satu anggota luar dan nomor kasus dalam lima hari kerja adalah USULAN ("Three changes are therefore proposed"), bukan prosedur yang sedang dipakai. Pelaporan tanpa nama bertabrakan dengan "Anonymity is promised in a paragraph and impossible in practice". Pengecualian bila manajer justru menjadi subjek laporan MENGARANG pengaman yang nggak ada: teks menyebut jalur itu "of no use whatever" tepat dalam keadaan tersebut.

qs: Which conclusion about the automatic review of a reporter's duties does the proposal warrant?
It might speed up the investigation of the original report.
It may let a manager move a reporter without explaining it.
It would remove the need for a written acknowledgement of a report.
It would make a manager account for a change that looks punitive.

qs.evidence: A transfer which follows a report will have to be justified, and a manager unable to justify one will be seen to have failed.
qs.answer: It would make a manager account for a change that looks punitive.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menyebut akibatnya: perpindahan sesudah laporan “will have to be justified, and a manager unable to justify one will be seen to have failed”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi mempercepat penyelidikan masuk akal karena tinjauan itu otomatis, tapi yang ditinjau adalah perubahan tugas si pelapor sesudahnya, bukan laporannya. Opsi manajer bisa memindahkan tanpa penjelasan adalah bacaan sinis yang wajar terhadap prosedur baru mana pun, namun teks bilang "A transfer which follows a report will have to be justified". Opsi menghapus surat penerimaan sama bisa dipercayanya sebagai penyederhanaan, tapi surat bernomor kasus itu perubahan kedua yang tetap berdiri sendiri.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The review recommends that the outside member of the committee be chosen by the staff."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The review recommends that the outside member of the committee be chosen by the staff.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Reports should go to a committee including one member from outside the organization, and never to the reporter's own line of management.
qs.why: Teks cuma menyebut ada satu anggota dari luar; siapa yang memilihnya sama sekali nggak diatur.
qs.whyOthersFail: "True" dan "False" sama-sama menuntut keterangan cara pemilihan yang nggak pernah ada di teks.

topic: Redesigning an internal channel for reporting wrongdoing
author: A governance adviser reviewing internal reporting procedures
setting: Internal review prepared for an organization's audit committee

title: The Arithmetic of Reading
text:
Every January the same ritual resumes, and the choreography never varies by so much as a step. Somebody publishes a photograph of an alarming tower of unread volumes and announces, with the serenity of a person reciting a grocery list, that this year's quota is one hundred titles. The replies arrive scented with admiration, congratulating an achievement that has not yet happened. Nobody poses the awkward question, which concerns what those hundred volumes accomplished inside the reader, or whether a single one deserved an entire winter to itself.

I harbour no objection to counting, and statistics are honest in a manner that opinions seldom manage. Anyone who genuinely absorbs fifty volumes has clearly spent their evenings somewhere other than a glowing rectangle. What unsettles me is the quiet migration from reading as appetite towards reading as a scoreboard with witnesses. Once a novel becomes a unit of production, the rational manoeuvre is to select brief ones, obliging ones, volumes that surrender their significance on a first careless pass. The reading challenge, that amiable little contest, therefore rewards the precise habits it was invented to cure.

The vocabulary betrays the shift more reliably than any confession would. Acquaintances describe getting through a novel, demolishing it, clearing the shelf, as though literature belonged to the same weary category as household administration. Nobody admits to inhabiting a book any more, and the older expressions for that condition have drifted quietly out of fashion. With them went an entire disposition, one that treated a difficult text as an opponent capable of answering back. A volume you have merely completed cannot argue with anybody; it has been processed and filed.

None of this is anybody's particular fault, which is exactly why the remedy remains so elusive. Our counting culture emerged from a thoroughly decent instinct, the desire to construct a habit, and habits do require modest visible victories. The trouble is that the victories have quietly become the destination rather than the road. An acquaintance of mine, a subtle and unhurried reader, confided last spring that she had abandoned a demanding biography because it was damaging her monthly average. She laughed while confessing it, and I laughed as well, then wandered home feeling obscurely bruised. I understood her reasoning exactly, having performed that very retreat twice inside a fortnight.

So here is a proposal, offered without a single diagram or downloadable template. Preserve the inventory if the inventory sustains you, but append a second column, the one enquiring what each volume actually altered. Most entries will remain gloriously empty, and the emptiness is the honest measurement. It is also, conveniently, the only measurement nobody has yet contrived a method of publishing.
qs: Read as a whole, what argument does this essay finally press about counting books?
Counting may be a decent instinct, though only a second column would rescue it.
The words readers use have coarsened, and while the tally lasts the loss is verbal.
A book counted as output gets chosen for how quickly it yields, so the contest rewards haste.
Habits need small visible wins, which is why public tallies do more good than harm.

qs.evidence: The reading challenge, that amiable little contest, therefore rewards the precise habits it was invented to cure.
qs.answer: A book counted as output gets chosen for how quickly it yields, so the contest rewards haste.
qs.why: Kata “therefore” di paragraf dua menyambung dua kalimat: begitu novel jadi satuan produksi, langkah rasionalnya memilih buku pendek yang gampang, sehingga lombanya justru memberi hadiah pada kebiasaan yang mau disembuhkannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi naluri menghitung memuat usul kolom kedua yang dibuka “So here is a proposal”, jadi obat yang datang setelah argumennya, bukan argumennya; opsi kosakata yang kasar bertumpu pada paragraf tiga yang dibuka “The vocabulary betrays the shift”, yaitu gejala pergeseran, bukan sebabnya; opsi kemenangan kecil mengambil konsesi “habits do require modest visible victories” yang langsung dibalik “The trouble is that the victories have quietly become the destination”.

qs: Suppose a reader signs up publicly to one hundred titles a year. Which choice does this essay predict?
Such a reader will pick demanding books, since a long tally rewards effort most.
Such a reader will pick short, accommodating books that can be finished and counted quickly.
Such a reader will reread familiar titles, the quickest way of adding to the count.
Such a reader will abandon the tally as soon as a book proves worth inhabiting.

qs.evidence: Once a novel becomes a unit of production, the rational manoeuvre is to select brief ones, obliging ones, volumes that surrender their significance on a first careless pass.
qs.answer: Such a reader will pick short, accommodating books that can be finished and counted quickly.
qs.why: Paragraf dua menyebut langkahnya secara langsung: begitu novel dihitung sebagai satuan produksi, “the rational manoeuvre is to select brief ones, obliging ones”. Jadi pembaca yang mengejar seratus judul akan memilih buku pendek yang cepat selesai dan cepat dihitung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi buku berat membalik kalimat itu — teks justru bilang lomba hitungan menghadiahi kebiasaan yang mau disembuhkannya, bukan usaha paling berat. Opsi membaca ulang judul lama terdengar masuk akal untuk menambah angka, tetapi nggak ada satu kata pun tentang membaca ulang di dalam esai ini, jadi prediksinya tanpa dasar. Opsi meninggalkan hitungan begitu satu buku terasa layak didiami dipatahkan kisah kenalan penulis: yang ditinggalkan justru bukunya, “because it was damaging her monthly average”, sementara angkanya dijaga.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the replies that greet these January announcements?
Drily amused, treating the praise as generous rather than as premature.
Wry and forgiving at once, since a habit still new may need an audience.
Mock-solemn, partly at his own appetite for exactly the same applause.
Quietly derisive, since the applause arrives before anything has been done.

qs.evidence: The replies arrive scented with admiration, congratulating an achievement that has not yet happened.
qs.answer: Quietly derisive, since the applause arrives before anything has been done.
qs.why: Yang ditandai penulis bukan kemurahan hati pembalas komentar, tetapi waktunya: pujian datang untuk “an achievement that has not yet happened”, dan kata “scented” membuat kalimat itu menyindir.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pujian yang murah hati mengabaikan klausa “congratulating an achievement that has not yet happened”, jadi yang dipersoalkan justru kedinian pujiannya; opsi memaafkan memindahkan konsesi paragraf empat tentang kebiasaan yang butuh kemenangan kecil ke kalimat ini; opsi mengolok diri sendiri memang terjadi di paragraf empat, tetapi di kalimat ini penulis nggak menyebut dirinya sama sekali.

qs: In the second paragraph, what does it mean that such volumes "surrender their significance"?
They give up their claim on the reader once the last page has been turned.
They yield their meaning to the reader who returns to them a second time.
They hand their meaning over at once, to a reader barely paying attention.
They lay down their defences before a reader who has come to argue.

qs.evidence: Once a novel becomes a unit of production, the rational manoeuvre is to select brief ones, obliging ones, volumes that surrender their significance on a first careless pass.
qs.answer: They hand their meaning over at once, to a reader barely paying attention.
qs.why: Frasa “on a first careless pass” memaksa arti yang bukan arti lazim kata itu: bukan menyerah kalah, melainkan menyerahkan makna langsung kepada pembaca yang nggak cermat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi sama presisinya dan masing-masing memilih satu arti sah dari “surrender”; yang membatalkan ketiga pengecoh adalah keterangan waktu dalam kalimat itu, “on a first careless pass”. Opsi melepaskan klaim sesudah halaman terakhir memindahkan peristiwanya ke akhir pembacaan. Opsi menyerahkan makna pada pembacaan kedua membalik frasa itu, sebab yang dipuji buku-buku ini justru pembacaan pertama yang lalai. Opsi meletakkan pertahanan di depan pembaca yang datang berdebat memakai arti kapitulasi dalam pertandingan, padahal buku yang bisa membalas argumen adalah watak yang menurut paragraf tiga udah hilang, bukan sifat buku ringan ini.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer admits abandoning a book himself to keep his reading figures healthy."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer admits abandoning a book himself to keep his reading figures healthy.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I understood her reasoning exactly, having performed that very retreat twice inside a fortnight.
qs.why: “that very retreat” merujuk pada tindakan yang sama seperti kenalannya, yaitu meninggalkan buku demi angka. Jadi klaim ini parafrasa yang benar.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” nggak bisa dipakai karena teks mengakuinya terang-terangan, dan “Not stated” gagal karena buktinya ada di kalimat penutup paragraf empat.

topic: reading challenges and the counting of books
author: Devi Ramaputra
setting: a critical essay on annual reading targets

title: Eight Pounds for Certainty
text:
The audio guide is presented at the entrance with the warmth of a nurse handing out medicine, and refusal would feel faintly arrogant. Within ninety seconds a velvet voice has established that the woman in the portrait is enigmatic and that her gaze pursues you around the room. The artist, we learn, was of course misunderstood throughout his lifetime. You look up obediently, the gaze does appear to pursue you, and something within the transaction has nevertheless gone quietly wrong.

My objection concerns neither information nor research, which galleries dispense too sparingly rather than too generously, but the smuggling of finished verdicts inside apparently polite descriptions. When the narrator declares that a brushstroke conveys unbearable tenderness, the visitor is no longer looking at a painting. The visitor is auditing a claim, and scarcely any of us possess the nerve to return a verdict of not proven. The commentary carries an entire institution behind it, so disagreement rapidly begins to resemble vandalism.

Consider what an unhurried encounter genuinely demands: several minutes of pure discomfort, during which the image withholds its meaning entirely. You begin suspecting your own dullness, and that suspicion is not an obstacle to appreciation but appreciation itself, in its earliest and least flattering stage. The audio guide abolishes the discomfort within a minute, then charges eight pounds for the abolition. Visitors emerge convinced they have been educated when they have in fact merely been soothed.

Curators understand this perfectly, which explains why the braver institutions now experiment with silence, unlabelled walls, and captions appearing only after a deliberate delay. My local gallery attempted such a scheme two autumns ago throughout its Renaissance wing. Attendance dipped, complaints multiplied, and a councillor denounced the initiative as elitist, his reasoning being that ordinary people cannot tolerate an unexplained painting. The wing was restored to its former talkative condition within a single season, and the councillor was thanked publicly.

I still accept the headphones occasionally, usually when exhausted, and never quite forgive myself afterwards. A particular flatness accompanies leaving an exhibition having agreed with absolutely everything, rather like the aftermath of a comfortable conversation in which nobody said anything true. The guide is not the villain of this narrative; it is merely the symptom of an older surrender. Somewhere along the way we concluded that looking was a skill requiring supervision, and we have been paying rental fees for the use of our own eyes ever since.
qs: How does the writer relate early discomfort to appreciation?
Appreciation begins once the dullness has been got through, not while it lasts.
The dullness is what the commentary removes, and its removal is what visitors buy.
Feeling dull is where appreciation starts, not a barrier standing in front of it.
Appreciation is what makes the dullness bearable, not a stage that grows out of it.

qs.evidence: You begin suspecting your own dullness, and that suspicion is not an obstacle to appreciation but appreciation itself, in its earliest and least flattering stage.
qs.answer: Feeling dull is where appreciation starts, not a barrier standing in front of it.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menolak dua-duanya sekaligus: kecurigaan pada ketumpulan sendiri disebut bukan penghalang, melainkan apresiasi itu sendiri pada tahap paling awal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya menyusun relasi dua-arah yang sama rapinya dengan kunci, dan masing-masing ditolak oleh satu klausa. Opsi apresiasi yang mulai sesudah rasa dungu dilewati tetap menjadikan rasa itu tahap pendahulu, padahal teks menulis “not an obstacle to appreciation but appreciation itself”. Opsi rasa dungu yang dihapus komentar adalah fakta paragraf tiga tentang panduan audio, bukan relasi yang ditanyakan. Opsi apresiasi yang membuat rasa dungu tertahankan membalik arah kalimatnya, yang menempatkan kecurigaan pada diri sendiri di tahap “earliest and least flattering”.

qs: What can be inferred about the councillor's assumption?
That an explanation is owed to visitors, and withholding one insults them.
That the scheme was built to keep less confident visitors out of the wing.
That visitors deprived of captions look once and leave without complaining.
That going unexplained is a pleasure only a certain kind of visitor can take.

qs.evidence: Attendance dipped, complaints multiplied, and a councillor denounced the initiative as elitist, his reasoning being that ordinary people cannot tolerate an unexplained painting.
qs.answer: That going unexplained is a pleasure only a certain kind of visitor can take.
qs.why: Alasan yang dikutip teks adalah soal daya tahan, yaitu “ordinary people cannot tolerate an unexplained painting”; jadi menikmati lukisan tanpa penjelasan dianggap kesenangan kalangan tertentu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sama tegasnya dan sama-sama sejalan dengan tesis bahwa penjelasan menenangkan pengunjung, tetapi salah isi. Opsi penjelasan sebagai hak bicara tentang kewajiban, sedangkan alasan yang teks lampirkan pada councillor bicara tentang daya tahan, “cannot tolerate an unexplained painting”. Opsi skema yang dirancang mengusir pengunjung menambahkan niat yang nggak pernah diatribusikan kepada galeri. Opsi pergi tanpa mengeluh bertabrakan dengan “complaints multiplied” di kalimat yang sama.

qs: What does the comparison with a nurse handing out medicine reveal about the writer's view of the offer?
That the kindness itself does the pressing, since refusal would look like arrogance.
That the kindness is genuine, and the pressure comes only from the visitor's pride.
That the offer is faintly comic, as though a painting required a prescription.
That the staff press the guide on visitors because the gallery counts the takings.

qs.evidence: The audio guide is presented at the entrance with the warmth of a nurse handing out medicine, and refusal would feel faintly arrogant.
qs.answer: That the kindness itself does the pressing, since refusal would look like arrogance.
qs.why: Klausa kedua menyebutkan akibatnya: menolak akan terasa sombong. Jadi kehangatan itulah yang menekan, bukan sekadar bahan lelucon.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya membaca kiasan perawat dengan sama percaya diri dan sejalan dengan tesis pemaksaan halus, tetapi memindahkan sumber tekanannya. Opsi tekanan dari harga diri pengunjung menghapus subjek kalimatnya, sebab yang menekan adalah cara panduan itu disodorkan. Opsi lucu adalah pembacaan wajar untuk perawat dan obat, tetapi kalimatnya ditutup “refusal would feel faintly arrogant”, yaitu tekanan, bukan komedi. Opsi petugas yang mengejar pemasukan menambahkan motif dagang yang justru ditolak paragraf lima, “The guide is not the villain of this narrative”.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the closing image about rental fees?
We pay strangers to save us the time our own eyes would take.
We pay for a skill we could be taught, as with any training.
We pay other people for permission to trust our own eyes.
We rent our eyes to the galleries, which decide where they rest.

qs.evidence: Somewhere along the way we concluded that looking was a skill requiring supervision, and we have been paying rental fees for the use of our own eyes ever since.
qs.answer: We pay other people for permission to trust our own eyes.
qs.why: Kalimat itu bilang kita memutuskan melihat adalah keterampilan yang butuh pengawasan, lalu membayar sewa atas mata sendiri; artinya izin untuk memercayai penglihatan sendiri kita beli dari orang lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi seringkas dan seelegan satu sama lain, dan tiap pengecoh menggeser tepat satu unsur kalimat sumber. Opsi menghemat waktu menukar “supervision” dengan efisiensi. Opsi keterampilan yang wajar diajarkan menerima “a skill requiring supervision” sebagai pendirian penulis, padahal frasa itu dikutip sebagai kesimpulan keliru yang pernah kita ambil. Opsi menyewakan mata kepada galeri membalik arah transaksinya, sebab yang membayar sewa adalah kita.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer refuses the headphones on every visit he makes."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer refuses the headphones on every visit he makes.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I still accept the headphones occasionally, usually when exhausted, and never quite forgive myself afterwards.
qs.why: Teks bilang dia kadang masih memakainya, terutama saat lelah. Jadi klaim “selalu menolak” bertentangan langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan kata “occasionally”, dan “Not stated” nggak berlaku karena kebiasaannya disebut jelas.

topic: museum audio guides and how visitors look at art
author: Halim Prasetyo
setting: a critical essay on gallery interpretation

title: Protect Your Streak
text:
The tidiest confession of our decade is buried in the vocabulary of productivity software, which no longer bothers pretending to be neutral machinery. Applications now congratulate you, gently reprimand you, and enquire whether you would like to protect your streak, a phrase borrowed intact from the language of moral character. My calendar recently informed me that I had reclaimed four hours, as though the hours had been kidnapped and I had negotiated brilliantly for their release.

There is nothing sinister in wanting an ordered week, and I say that as somebody who owns three notebooks devoted to the ambition. The peculiar development is that efficiency has acquired a conscience attached to it. Where a wasted afternoon once counted as a mild embarrassment, it now registers as a lapse against an agreement you signed with an interface. Guilt has been outsourced to a dashboard, which performs the accounting with a cheerfulness no human supervisor would dare imitate.

Observe the grammar of the notifications themselves, because the grammar is precisely where the argument conceals itself. Nobody is ever informed that a target was unrealistic. The phrasing insists instead that momentum was lost, which locates the failure inside the user rather than inside the plan. The software cannot be wrong about your priorities, since it merely records the priorities you typed at eleven o'clock on a Sunday evening while feeling unusually ambitious. That version of you is treated as the authoritative witness, and the exhausted Wednesday version has no right of appeal.

The consequences are subtle rather than tragic, which is precisely why they persist unexamined. Tasks that resist measurement, such as thinking without a deliverable or sitting with a predicament until it changes shape, quietly migrate to the bottom of every list. An engineer I interviewed described deleting his reading time from the system because it kept appearing as an unproductive block. He still reads, he assured me, though secretly, in the manner of a man smuggling contraband past his own border guards.

I would not abolish these instruments, partly because abolition never works and partly because mine has genuinely rescued several deadlines. I would simply like the tone adjusted downwards, from moral tutor to competent clerk. A clerk records what occurred and declines to comment; a tutor decides who you are becoming. We handed a filing system the second occupation without noticing, and it has been diligently issuing verdicts on our characters ever since, one encouraging notification at a time.
qs: Read as a whole, what does this essay say scheduling software has taken on?
Guilt about wasted time has simply found a tidier place to keep its records.
Work that resists measurement slides to the bottom of every list these tools keep.
Scheduling tools have taken on the job of judging what sort of person you are.
The software records the priorities you typed and declines to comment on them.

qs.evidence: The peculiar development is that efficiency has acquired a conscience attached to it.
qs.answer: Scheduling tools have taken on the job of judging what sort of person you are.
qs.why: Kalimat “The peculiar development is that efficiency has acquired a conscience” menamai perubahan yang dibahas seluruh esai, dan penutupnya menyebut alat itu “issuing verdicts on our characters”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sejalan dengan tesis esai dan sama lugasnya dengan kunci, tetapi masing-masing salah cakupan. Opsi rasa bersalah yang cuma tersimpan lebih rapi ditolak “The peculiar development is that efficiency has acquired a conscience”, yang menyebut sesuatu yang baru. Opsi kerja tak terukur yang tersingkir adalah akibat, dibuka “The consequences are subtle rather than tragic”. Opsi perangkat lunak yang mencatat tanpa berkomentar adalah kerani yang penulis INGINKAN di paragraf lima, bukan keadaan yang digambarkannya, “issuing verdicts on our characters ever since”.

qs: On this account of the dashboards, what happens next to work that resists measurement?
Unmeasurable work will be revalued once the user explains its worth to the software.
Unmeasurable work will be logged anyway, since any entry at all pleases the dashboard.
Unmeasurable work will surface as an unproductive block and then be deleted from the system.
Unmeasurable work will be given up altogether by whoever used to do it.

qs.evidence: An engineer I interviewed described deleting his reading time from the system because it kept appearing as an unproductive block.
qs.answer: Unmeasurable work will surface as an unproductive block and then be deleted from the system.
qs.why: Prediksinya ada di paragraf empat: pekerjaan yang menolak diukur turun ke dasar daftar, dan contohnya konkret — insinyur itu menghapus waktu membacanya “because it kept appearing as an unproductive block”. Jadi kerja tak terukur muncul sebagai blok nggak produktif lalu dihapus dari sistem.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tetap dicatat karena dasbor senang pada entri apa pun bertabrakan dengan sebab penghapusan yang disebut teks. Opsi dinilai ulang setelah pengguna menjelaskan nilainya dipatahkan “the exhausted Wednesday version has no right of appeal” — nggak ada jalur banding. Opsi ditinggalkan sama sekali menggoda tetapi salah: insinyur itu tetap membaca, hanya diam-diam, “in the manner of a man smuggling contraband past his own border guards”.

qs: What is the writer's tone when he describes the message about reclaimed hours?
Amused at himself for owning three notebooks devoted to the same ambition.
Grateful for wording that makes a dull number worth remembering.
Alarmed at hours he had not noticed losing until an interface counted them.
Amused at wording that stages a small saving as a daring rescue.

qs.evidence: My calendar recently informed me that I had reclaimed four hours, as though the hours had been kidnapped and I had negotiated brilliantly for their release.
qs.answer: Amused at wording that stages a small saving as a daring rescue.
qs.why: Klausa “as though the hours had been kidnapped and I had negotiated brilliantly” adalah lelucon kering penulis atas bahasanya sendiri: penghematan kecil dikemas sebagai penyelamatan berani.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiganya berada di keluarga nada yang sama dengan kunci dan sejalan dengan tesis, tetapi salah sasaran atau salah derajat. Opsi menertawakan diri sendiri memindahkan pengakuan paragraf dua tentang tiga buku catatan ke kalimat ini, padahal yang dibesar-besarkan di sini adalah kalimat aplikasinya. Opsi bersyukur pada kata-katanya bertabrakan dengan kerangka esai yang menyebut kosakata itu “the tidiest confession of our decade”. Opsi cemas kehilangan jam membaca kiasan penyanderaan secara harfiah, padahal jam itu memang nggak hilang: yang dilebih-lebihkan hanya penyelamatannya.

qs: What does the phrase "protect your streak" bring into the software?
A question of character, borrowed whole from the language of virtue.
A count of unbroken days, which is all the phrase has ever meant.
A warning that a habit once broken may not easily be resumed.
A promise made to the interface, though one the user can be held to.

qs.evidence: Applications now congratulate you, gently reprimand you, and enquire whether you would like to protect your streak, a phrase borrowed intact from the language of moral character.
qs.answer: A question of character, borrowed whole from the language of virtue.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menutup dengan “a phrase borrowed intact from the language of moral character”, jadi yang masuk ke aplikasi adalah urusan watak, bukan arti lazim frasa itu sebagai hitungan hari.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi hitungan hari memakai arti yang paling umum dan justru ditolak klausa penutup kalimat itu, “borrowed intact from the language of moral character”; opsi peringatan soal kebiasaan menambahkan klaim psikologis yang nggak pernah dibuat teks; opsi janji kepada antarmuka memakai kiasan “an agreement you signed with an interface” dari paragraf dua, yang dipakai menjelaskan rasa bersalah, bukan frasa ini.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Fewer than half of the engineer's colleagues deleted their reading time from the system."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Fewer than half of the engineer's colleagues deleted their reading time from the system.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: An engineer I interviewed described deleting his reading time from the system because it kept appearing as an unproductive block.
qs.why: Teks cuma bercerita tentang satu insinyur. Nggak ada angka apa pun soal rekan kerjanya, jadi jumlahnya nggak bisa dinilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” dan “False” sama-sama butuh data jumlah yang nggak pernah ditulis; kalimat terdekat hanya menyebut satu orang.

topic: the moral tone of productivity software
author: Yusra Kaltsum
setting: a critical essay on self-tracking applications

title: The Ruin That Never Arrives
text:
Every generation discovers, with the delight of an archaeologist digging up an old secret, that the language is in decline. The evidence is submitted promptly and invariably consists of teenagers. They abbreviate, they invent verbs from nouns, they deploy literally in ways that would appal a lexicographer of 1890, and civilisation is accordingly presumed to be sliding gently into the sea. The complaint is as old as writing itself, and its persistence ought to make the complainers suspicious, though it rarely does.

I confess a certain tenderness towards the pedants, having belonged to that little club throughout my twenties. Precision furnishes a genuine pleasure, and whoever distinguishes scrupulously between imply and infer is defending something worth preserving. The difficulty is that the defence is invariably aimed at the wrong target. Nobody polices the vocabulary of consultants, whose sentences absorb an entire paragraph without depositing a single clear notion, yet a teenager writing gonna to a companion attracts the full attention of the nation.

Consider what the complaint actually protects, once the decorative outrage has been stripped away. Standards of usage operate as a filter, and filters are wonderfully convenient for whoever already belongs inside. When an interview panel dismisses a candidate for saying between you and I, the panel is not mourning a grammatical error. It is recognizing an accent and discreetly declining to admit it. The rules are genuine, the enforcement is selective, and the selection follows the lines of class with an accuracy no linguist could improve upon.

Meanwhile the language pursues its usual business, which is to change in the mouths of the youthful and be pronounced dead by the middle-aged. Words narrow, widen, sour and sweeten, and no petitions are circulated. Nice formerly meant foolish, awful formerly meant deserving of awe, and no farewell speeches whatever were delivered when the meanings migrated. Our own innovations will one day be defended fiercely by descendants who currently find them intolerable, which is perhaps the single reliable law of the discipline.

So by all means practise your semicolons, and correct your own drafts until the sentences behave themselves. What I would surrender is the pleasure of correcting strangers, a hobby that has never improved one sentence written by anybody else. Language is not a monument requiring uniformed guards; it is a market, noisy and honest, where usefulness eventually outbids etiquette. The pedants will lose, as they always have, and they will lose in beautifully constructed prose.
qs: How does the writer relate the rules of usage to the way they are enforced?
He treats the rules as inventions, yet the enforcement as the only real thing.
He accepts the rules as real but says enforcement follows social lines.
He accepts rules and enforcement alike, though he blames careless writers.
He doubts the rules yet concedes that enforcement is applied evenly enough.

qs.evidence: The rules are genuine, the enforcement is selective, and the selection follows the lines of class with an accuracy no linguist could improve upon.
qs.answer: He accepts the rules as real but says enforcement follows social lines.
qs.why: Teks menyebut aturannya “genuine” dan penerapannya “selective”, dan seleksinya mengikuti garis kelas.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi aturan sebagai rekaan membalik kata “The rules are genuine”; opsi menerima keduanya menghapus keberatan pada penerapannya, padahal kalimat itu menyebut “the enforcement is selective”; opsi penerapan merata bertentangan langsung dengan kata “selective”.

qs: What does the contrast between consultants and teenagers imply?
Consultants escape notice because their prose keeps the rules rather than clarity.
Teenagers draw correction because their abbreviations really do blur plain sense.
Each generation is shocked by a new form, and its shock tends to fade once the form spreads.
Complaints track the speaker rather than any damage done to plain sense.

qs.evidence: Nobody polices the vocabulary of consultants, whose sentences absorb an entire paragraph without depositing a single clear notion, yet a teenager writing gonna to a companion attracts the full attention of the nation.
qs.answer: Complaints track the speaker rather than any damage done to plain sense.
qs.why: Kalimat itu memasangkan prosa yang nggak menyampaikan gagasan apa pun tetapi dibiarkan dengan satu kata remaja yang maksudnya jelas tetapi diawasi seluruh negeri; yang berbeda bukan kejelasannya, melainkan siapa yang bicara.
qs.whyOthersFail: Dua pengecoh memakai bentuk “X rather than Y” yang sama dengan kunci, jadi tanda itu nggak lagi menunjuk siapa pun. Opsi konsultan yang lolos karena patuh aturan bertabrakan dengan penilaian di kalimat yang sama, yaitu kalimat mereka menghabiskan satu paragraf “without depositing a single clear notion”. Opsi singkatan yang benar-benar mengaburkan makna gugur karena contoh yang dipilih teks, “gonna”, sama sekali nggak kabur. Opsi tiap generasi yang terkejut pada bentuk baru adalah pengamatan paragraf satu tentang usia keluhan itu, bukan yang disiratkan oleh perbandingan konsultan dan remaja. | "Each generation is shocked by a new form, and..." is wrong: the defence comes from 'descendants who currently find them intolerable', not from the shocked generation, which keeps pronouncing new forms dead

qs: What attitude does the final sentence convey towards the pedants?
Rueful, since he counts himself among the people he expects to lose.
Coolly detached, recording an outcome that may no longer involve him at all.
Fondly teasing, predicting their defeat while praising the prose it comes in.
Quietly admiring, since the prose is arguably the part of the argument that lasts.

qs.evidence: The pedants will lose, as they always have, and they will lose in beautifully constructed prose.
qs.answer: Fondly teasing, predicting their defeat while praising the prose it comes in.
qs.why: Satu kalimat memuat dua gerakan: ramalan kalah yang diperkuat “as they always have”, lalu pujian pada prosanya. Gabungan itu ledekan yang bersahabat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi getir menempatkan penulis di dalam kelompok itu, padahal keanggotaannya disebut lampau, “throughout my twenties”, dan kalimat ini memakai orang ketiga; opsi berjarak mengabaikan pujian “beautifully constructed prose” yang jelas menilai; opsi memuji saja mengabaikan separuh pertama kalimat, “The pedants will lose, as they always have”.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the image of the market in the final paragraph?
Usage is settled by rules, not by whoever shouts the loudest in the market.
Usage is settled by what proves useful, not by what good manners prefer.
Usage is settled by the market's noise, not by any test of usefulness.
Usage is settled by etiquette in the end, not by what happens to be useful.

qs.evidence: Language is not a monument requiring uniformed guards; it is a market, noisy and honest, where usefulness eventually outbids etiquette.
qs.answer: Usage is settled by what proves useful, not by what good manners prefer.
qs.why: Kiasan pasarnya dipuji dengan dua kata, “noisy and honest”, dan penutupnya menyebut kegunaan akhirnya menawar lebih tinggi daripada etiket.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi dibangun dengan rangka “Usage is settled by X, not by Y” yang identik, sehingga bentuknya sama-sama rapi. Opsi aturan yang diterapkan seseorang persis yang ditolak separuh pertama kalimat, “not a monument requiring uniformed guards”. Opsi kebisingan pasar mengambil kata “noisy” tetapi menghapus kata pendampingnya, “honest”, dan menghapus pula ujungnya, “usefulness eventually outbids etiquette”. Opsi kesopanan yang menentukan harga membalik kata “outbids”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer once belonged to the group of language correctors himself."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer once belonged to the group of language correctors himself.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I confess a certain tenderness towards the pedants, having belonged to that little club throughout my twenties.
qs.why: “That little club” itu para pedan, dan dia mengaku pernah ikut sepanjang usia dua puluhan. Klaimnya parafrasa yang tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan pengakuannya sendiri, dan “Not stated” gagal karena kalimatnya jelas ada di paragraf dua.

topic: complaints about grammar and language change
author: Nadira Amsyar
setting: a critical essay on linguistic pedantry

title: The Overworked Adjective
text:
The adjective authentic has been labouring overtime for a decade, and it now displays unmistakable symptoms of exhaustion. It decorates the menus of restaurants with exposed brickwork and packets of biscuits manufactured in industrial quantities. It hangs above a coffee bar near my office whose sacks bear the name of a village nobody on the premises could locate on a map. Everything is authentic, and consequently nothing whatever is anything in particular.

The transformation deserves tracing, because cynicism alone did not accomplish it, and twenty years ago the word conveyed genuine information. It distinguished the cook who inherited a recipe from her grandmother from the factory that approximated the result with flavourings. Consumers desired the distinction, and the market, ever obliging, supplied the vocabulary instead of the substance. Once a word begins selling merchandise its meaning becomes a cost to be reduced, and reduction continues until the label may be attached to almost anything without provoking laughter.

What interests me is the identity of whoever eventually pays for the arrangement. The cook whose family actually preserved the recipe now competes against a chain that purchased her adjective wholesale, and she cannot readily complain, since the adjective was never hers to register. She raises her prices to signal quality, which makes her appear expensive, while the chain lowers its prices and consequently appears generous. Customers depart persuaded that they have supported tradition, and the arithmetic quietly favours whoever owns the printing press.

A subtler indignity accompanies the commercial one, and no legislation has yet been drafted against it. Communities begin performing versions of themselves that visitors will accept as genuine, which is a peculiar assignment to receive. A friend who runs a modest kitchen in Yogyakarta recently withdrew a dish her family had eaten for generations, because tourists complained repeatedly that it did not taste traditional enough. The dish was traditional; it simply failed to resemble what the guidebooks had promised, and those guidebooks had been printed in enormous quantities.

I possess no elegant remedy, and I distrust essays that arrive brandishing one. I have nevertheless retired the word from my own vocabulary, which costs nothing and clarifies a surprising amount. Enquire instead who cooked the food, who received the money, and how long the establishment has occupied that particular corner. The answers are dull, specific and extremely difficult to counterfeit, and dullness of that kind is the nearest approximation to a guarantee that any of us will obtain.
qs: Read as a whole, what case does this essay build about the overworked adjective?
A word that sells begins to describe the seller rather than anything on the plate.
Those who kept the recipe are the ones a borrowed word may make look expensive.
A word put to work selling things loses precision until it fits almost anything.
