qs: In the first paragraph, what does the colleague's "going beautifully" convey?
That the timetable may be recovering faster than anybody had expected.
That the damage is beyond repair, though saying so plainly would be worse.
That the speaker has stopped caring what becomes of the timetable now.
That the schedule has collapsed, said in words that state the opposite.

qs.evidence: When a colleague surveys a collapsed schedule and remarks that this is going beautifully, no dictionary entry has been violated.
qs.answer: That the schedule has collapsed, said in words that state the opposite.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menaruh ucapannya di depan jadwal yang runtuh, jadi arti yang dipaksa konteks adalah kebalikan dari arti lazim kata-katanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi jadwal yang pulih membaca kalimat itu secara harfiah, padahal konteksnya “surveys a collapsed schedule”; opsi kerusakan tak tertolong menambahkan penilaian yang nggak ada dan mengubah isi ucapannya; opsi berhenti peduli menambahkan sikap yang nggak disebut, sebab yang dipersoalkan jarak antara kata dan maksud.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Knowing the speaker predicts irony detection better than the size of a listener's vocabulary."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Knowing the speaker predicts irony detection better than the size of a listener's vocabulary.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Adults vary considerably as well, and the variation correlates less with vocabulary size than with familiarity with the speaker.
qs.why: Teks bilang variasinya lebih terkait keakraban dengan pembicara daripada ukuran kosakata, dan klaim ini menyatakan hal yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan perbandingan itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena keduanya dibandingkan langsung.

author: Dr Farhan Alwi
setting: an academic article on pragmatics

title: A Performance With No Archive
text:
The karaoke booth is the last place in the city where an audience is contractually obliged to be generous, and this may explain its extraordinary survival. Streaming demolished the recorded music economy, the neighbourhood record shop and much of the pleasurable suspense that once preceded a release. Yet the cramped booth with its tacky remote control and its appalling wallpaper continues to prosper. Something is being purchased there that no immaculate recording could ever underwrite: the transient, unindexed thrill of an amateur running a risk aloud.

Critics of the genre habitually arrive brandishing an argument about authenticity, and the argument is remarkably fragile. Singing somebody else's song is described as passive consumption, as though the cover version were a modern disgrace rather than the ordinary condition of music for most of recorded history. Standards had always existed in order to be reinterpreted, their authority residing in the accumulation of imperfect attempts rather than in one definitive rendition. The notion that a song belongs permanently to whoever recorded it first is a recent invention, roughly contemporary with the technology that made first recordings profitable.

What actually happens inside the booth is stranger than either the critics or the defenders admit. Participants select songs they cannot sing, deliberately, and the failure is the entertainment. A colleague of mine, an accountant of famous composure, performs one enormous ballad every December with an intensity that would embarrass a professional. Nobody ever discusses the performance afterwards at work, an omission everyone honours without negotiation, as though discretion were the price of admission. The booth operates as a small licensed exemption from ordinary self-presentation, and the licence expires at the door.

There is a generational shift worth recording, since the practice keeps mutating. Younger patrons increasingly film the performance, which introduces exactly the audience the room was designed to exclude. A recording that may later be circulated changes the whole calculation: risk returns, ambition retreats, and people select the safe song. Several booths in my district now advertise a no-filming policy in large letters, an intervention that would have been incomprehensible fifteen years ago and is now apparently a commercial advantage.

I am no advocate of nostalgia, and the wallpaper genuinely is appalling. But the booth preserves something that our better-documented culture has been steadily eliminating, which is a performance with no archive attached. You sing badly, everybody applauds insincerely, and the evidence evaporates before anyone thinks to preserve it for subsequent ridicule. If that arrangement now requires a printed policy on the door to survive, then the policy is not a quaint restriction. It is a small piece of infrastructure for the increasingly rare experience of doing something imperfectly in front of people who will not keep the file.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer finally claim about the karaoke booth?
It keeps alive a cover tradition older than the definitive recording.
It turns failure into the entertainment, which is what both camps miss.
It protects the chance to perform badly with no record left behind.
It sells a no-filming policy that has become a commercial advantage.

qs.evidence: It is a small piece of infrastructure for the increasingly rare experience of doing something imperfectly in front of people who will not keep the file.
qs.answer: It protects the chance to perform badly with no record left behind.
qs.why: Kalimat penutupnya menamai yang dijaga bilik itu: melakukan sesuatu dengan buruk di depan orang yang nggak akan menyimpan berkasnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sejalan dengan tesis dan sama lugasnya dengan kunci, tetapi salah cakupan. Opsi tradisi versi sampul adalah bantahan paragraf dua terhadap tuduhan keaslian. Opsi kegagalan sebagai hiburan adalah pengamatan paragraf tiga yang dipakai menyiapkan gagasan izin. Opsi menjual kebijakan tanpa rekaman mengambil keterangan paragraf empat dan menukar tujuannya dengan alat, sebab penutupnya menyebut kebijakan itu “infrastructure” bagi pengalaman itu, bukan produk yang dijual.

qs: What can be inferred about the effect of filming inside the booth?
Filming may encourage singers to attempt the most demanding songs they know.
Filming pushes singers towards choices that cannot embarrass them later.
Filming restores an honest audience, though one the booth had been dodging.
Filming matters less than how many people happen to be listening inside.

qs.evidence: A recording that may later be circulated changes the whole calculation: risk returns, ambition retreats, and people select the safe song.
qs.answer: Filming pushes singers towards choices that cannot embarrass them later.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menyebut tiga akibat berurutan, dan yang terakhir jelas: orang memilih lagu yang aman begitu rekamannya bisa disebarkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi lagu paling sulit membalik “ambition retreats, and people select the safe song”; opsi penonton yang jujur memuji apa yang teks sebut “exactly the audience the room was designed to exclude”; opsi jumlah pendengar di dalam mengabaikan sebab yang dinyatakan kalimat itu, yaitu rekaman yang mungkin diedarkan.

qs: What is the writer's tone in describing his colleague's December performance?
Faint unease at a colleague who takes one December evening too seriously.
Open admiration for an intensity that outdoes what professionals attempt.
Studied neutrality about an evening the office has agreed to leave unmentioned.
Fond amusement at a controlled man briefly abandoning his own composure.

qs.evidence: A colleague of mine, an accountant of famous composure, performs one enormous ballad every December with an intensity that would embarrass a professional.
qs.answer: Fond amusement at a controlled man briefly abandoning his own composure.
qs.why: Julukan “an accountant of famous composure” dipasang berhadapan dengan “one enormous ballad”, dan pembesaran itu ramah, bukan menghakimi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menamai nada dengan ketegasan yang sama. Opsi nggak nyaman bertabrakan dengan cara kalimatnya memasangkan “famous composure” dengan intensitas yang memalukan seorang profesional, yaitu lelucon simpatik. Opsi kagum membaca “would embarrass a professional” sebagai pujian, padahal itu ukuran kelebihannya. Opsi netral memindahkan kesepakatan diam kantor di kalimat berikutnya menjadi sikap penulis sendiri.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the point about a licence in the third paragraph?
Inside, you may drop the face you keep in public; outside, it returns.
Inside, you may keep the same face the office requires; outside, nothing alters.
Inside, you may drop the public face; outside, it may stay dropped for a while.
Inside, the group may lend you the exemption; outside, any member may recall it.

qs.evidence: The booth operates as a small licensed exemption from ordinary self-presentation, and the licence expires at the door.
qs.answer: Inside, you may drop the face you keep in public; outside, it returns.
qs.why: Kata “exemption” dan klausa “expires at the door” memasang batas tempat: di dalam wajah publik boleh dilepas, di luar berlaku lagi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “Inside …; outside …” yang sama, sehingga nggak ada yang lebih elegan. Opsi wajah kantor yang sama bertabrakan dengan “exemption from ordinary self-presentation”. Opsi izin yang bertahan sesudahnya bertabrakan dengan “the licence expires at the door”. Opsi izin yang bisa ditarik anggota menambahkan mekanisme yang nggak disebut, sebab yang teks sebut hanyalah kesepakatan diam untuk nggak membahasnya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Booth owners say the no-filming rule was introduced because customers demanded it."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Booth owners say the no-filming rule was introduced because customers demanded it.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Several booths in my district now advertise a no-filming policy in large letters, an intervention that would have been incomprehensible fifteen years ago and is now apparently a commercial advantage.
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang kebijakan itu dipasang dan tampak menguntungkan. Siapa yang meminta dan apa kata pemiliknya nggak pernah disebut.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” menambahkan atribusi yang nggak ada, dan “False” juga salah karena teks nggak membantah asal-usul aturannya.

topic: karaoke booths, cover versions and filming
author: Selia Mahendra
setting: a cultural commentary on karaoke

title: The Voice in Your Ear
text:
There is a voice that did not exist twenty years ago and now inhabits several million headphones. It is warm without being loud, confidential without being intimate, and it pauses before adjectives in a manner suggesting that the adjective was arrived at reluctantly. Everybody recognizes it instantly, and nobody has ever admitted to practising it. The uniformity is the interesting part, since no institution issued a directive and no examination certifies the delivery.

The origins are not mysterious, since broadcasting simply discovered an acoustic solution to a technological constraint. Public radio developed a register for the ear rather than the hall, and the register worked. The technology then distributed it to anybody possessing a microphone and an opinion. What arrived with it was a set of implied credentials. The voice signals that its proprietor has consulted the literature, has deliberated, and is far too reasonable to raise the volume. That is a considerable quantity of authority to obtain through breath control alone. Credibility, previously assembled from evidence and affiliation, became available as an acoustic property.

My objection concerns the transfer of that authority to content it has not earned. I have heard a supplement salesman discuss mitochondria in the same thoughtful cadence a historian reserves for the partition of an empire. My ear, conditioned by several thousand hours of respectable programmes, manufactured trust before my judgement had been consulted, and the trust was retracted within a minute. It should never have been extended, and the fact that it was extended tells me something unflattering about how I actually evaluate claims. Persuasion accomplished through timbre bypasses the machinery we normally reserve for evaluating propositions.

Defenders point out, fairly, that every medium develops a house style and that nobody complains about the conventions of the lecture theatre. The difference is intimacy, and intimacy alters the arithmetic of scepticism. A lecturer stands at a distance and is visibly performing a role. The voice in your ear at half past eleven imitates a companion thinking aloud, and the imitation disables the sceptical apparatus that visible performance retains switched on. Warmth is not a neutral delivery mechanism; it is an argument made before any arguments arrive, disguised as an absence of rhetoric.

I offer all this as a devoted listener holding four subscriptions and no intention of cancelling any of them. The register has genuinely improved public explanation, and I would not return to the era of the shouting broadcaster for any consideration. But I have instituted a modest private discipline, recommended here without much expectation of adoption. Once a week I read a transcript instead of listening, and roughly half the time the argument proves thinner than the voice implied. That is a humbling proportion for anybody who considers himself a careful thinker.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer maintain about this style of speaking?
The register has improved public explanation more than it has harmed it.
A soothing delivery persuades before any claim has been examined at all.
The uniformity is the real puzzle, since nobody was taught this delivery.
Listeners have learnt to allow for the warmth and judge the argument.

qs.evidence: Warmth is not a neutral delivery mechanism; it is an argument made before any arguments arrive, disguised as an absence of rhetoric.
qs.answer: A soothing delivery persuades before any claim has been examined at all.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menamai kerja kehangatan: argumen yang tiba sebelum argumen mana pun, menyamar sebagai ketiadaan retorika.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk klaim yang sama tegas dan sama panjangnya. Opsi perbaikan penjelasan publik adalah konsesi paragraf lima, “The register has genuinely improved public explanation”, yang langsung disusul kata “But”. Opsi keseragaman sebagai teka-teki adalah pengamatan pembuka, bukan klaim utamanya. Opsi pendengar yang udah pandai menyaring bertabrakan dengan pengakuan penulis sendiri, “manufactured trust before my judgement had been consulted”.

qs: What can be inferred from his reaction to the supplement salesman?
He may have examined the mitochondria claims before deciding what to think.
Thousands of hours of listening have taught him to distrust a warm voice.
The retraction within a minute shows his judgement was largely working.
His trust was manufactured by habit before any assessment took place.

qs.evidence: My ear, conditioned by several thousand hours of respectable programmes, manufactured trust before my judgement had been consulted, and the trust was retracted within a minute.
qs.answer: His trust was manufactured by habit before any assessment took place.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menaruh urutannya terang-terangan: telinga yang terbiasa memproduksi kepercayaan sebelum penilaiannya dimintai pendapat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi memeriksa klaim lebih dulu bertabrakan dengan urutan yang dinyatakan kalimat itu, sebab kepercayaan muncul sebelum penilaiannya dimintai pendapat; opsi belajar mencurigai suara hangat membalik akibat paparan itu, yang justru membuatnya mudah percaya; opsi penilaian yang bekerja normal mengabaikan kalimat berikutnya, “It should never have been extended”.

qs: What does the writer's weekly habit with transcripts reveal about his stance?
He has given the medium up, having found the arguments so consistently thin.
He counts himself among the listeners this register manages to fool.
He offers the discipline as a cure he expects other listeners to take up.
He treats the surviving half as proof that the register mostly works.

qs.evidence: Once a week I read a transcript instead of listening, and roughly half the time the argument proves thinner than the voice implied.
qs.answer: He counts himself among the listeners this register manages to fool.
qs.why: Dia menjalankan disiplin itu atas dirinya sendiri, dan menyebut proporsinya memalukan bagi orang yang menganggap dirinya berpikir cermat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi meninggalkan medium bertabrakan dengan empat langganan yang dia sebut di kalimat pembuka paragraf itu; opsi mengharap orang lain ikut bertabrakan dengan frasa “without much expectation of adoption”; opsi separuh yang lolos sebagai pembelaan bertabrakan dengan kalimat berikutnya, yang menyebut proporsi itu merendahkan dirinya.

qs: In the second paragraph, what is "a register for the ear"?
A formal list, though only of those the network permits near a microphone.
A device that may count how many headphones a programme has reached.
A way of speaking fitted to one situation rather than another.
The range of pitch a trained voice can comfortably produce.

qs.evidence: Public radio developed a register for the ear rather than the hall, and the register worked.
qs.answer: A way of speaking fitted to one situation rather than another.
qs.why: Frasa “rather than the hall” memasang lawannya sebagai tempat bicara, jadi yang dimaksud cara bicara yang disesuaikan dengan situasinya, bukan arti lazim kata itu sebagai daftar atau mesin pencatat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi daftar resmi dan opsi alat penghitung sama-sama memakai arti “register” yang paling umum, padahal kalimat ini memasangkannya dengan “for the ear rather than the hall”, yaitu cara berbicara; opsi rentang nada mempersempitnya menjadi urusan tinggi suara, sedangkan yang dibicarakan pilihan gaya untuk satu situasi.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer has cancelled the podcast subscriptions he used to hold."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer has cancelled the podcast subscriptions he used to hold.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I offer all this as a devoted listener holding four subscriptions and no intention of cancelling any of them.
qs.why: Dia menyebut masih punya empat langganan dan nggak berniat berhenti, jadi klaim ini bertentangan langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan kalimat itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena langganannya disebut jelas.

topic: the persuasive style of podcast narration
author: Tirta Anggraeni
setting: a cultural commentary on audio narration

title: Thursday Night for Saturday Morning
text:
The queue forms on Thursday evening for a shop that opens on Saturday, and by midnight it has acquired a social structure of remarkable complexity. There are veterans who bring folding chairs and share a thermos, and there are newcomers who underestimated the temperature and are suffering discreetly in fashionable jackets. Somewhere near the front sits a teenager remunerated for occupying a position on behalf of somebody arriving at dawn by taxi. Everybody understands the arrangement, and nobody objects noticeably.

Commentators reliably characterize the scene as evidence of hollow materialism, a verdict I consider simultaneously accurate and entirely beside the point. The shoes are not the reason anybody sleeps on a pavement. Were the objects the objective, the resale market would satisfy the appetite immediately and at moderate expense, since identical items reach the internet within hours. What the queue supplies cannot be dispatched by courier, and the participants understand this rather better than the columnists do. Scarcity organizes the entire performance, and scarcity is manufactured deliberately by whoever prints the announcement.

Consider what actually occurs overnight. Strangers compile an informal register of position and legitimacy, adjudicate disputes without any authority, and negotiate rotas for the lavatory of a neighbouring restaurant. They construct a temporary society whose entire purpose expires at ten in the morning. Nobody applies for permission, and a visitor from another century would recognize the pattern instantly, presumably enquiring which saint was involved. Improvised institutions of this kind are rarely documented, since they dissolve before any administrator notices their existence.

The manufacturers have of course noticed, and their response has been to industrialize the scarcity that produced the queue in the first place. Ballots, apps and timed releases now distribute the same objects with far less inconvenience, and the queues are dwindling accordingly. Efficiency has arrived and taken the ritual away with it. Convenience, once installed, discreetly dismantles the inconvenience through which strangers previously became acquaintances. A friend who has queued for eleven years reports that the ballot feels fairer and that he has acquired no new acquaintance whatever since its introduction. He delivered both halves of that sentence in an identical flat tone.

I have never queued for footwear and expect I never shall, my own irrationalities being quieter and considerably more extravagant. But I would resist the confident diagnosis that these gatherings represent consumerism at its emptiest. On the two occasions I passed at four in the morning, they resembled people manufacturing a community out of the only shared object available to them. That is no triumph of our culture, though it is certainly an achievement of theirs. Sociability apparently requires an obstacle, and our economy has become remarkably efficient at removing obstacles.
qs: How does the writer relate convenience to the social life of the queue?
Removing the difficulty leaves the friendships intact, since members meet elsewhere.
Removing the difficulty removes the thing that brought these strangers together.
Removing the difficulty exposes the shared object as the real bond all along.
Removing the difficulty creates a market in obstacles, the queue being the product.

qs.evidence: Sociability apparently requires an obstacle, and our economy has become remarkably efficient at removing obstacles.
qs.answer: Removing the difficulty removes the thing that brought these strangers together.
qs.why: Kalimat penutupnya memasang sebab dan arah sekaligus: pergaulan butuh hambatan, dan ekonomi kita makin cakap menghapus hambatan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “Removing the difficulty …” yang sama, jadi bentuknya nggak menunjuk kunci. Opsi pertemanan yang utuh bertabrakan dengan “Convenience, once installed, discreetly dismantles the inconvenience through which strangers previously became acquaintances”. Opsi objek bersama sebagai ikatan sebenarnya membalik paragraf dua, “The shoes are not the reason anybody sleeps on a pavement”. Opsi pasar hambatan membalik kalimat penutup, “remarkably efficient at removing obstacles”.

qs: What can be inferred from the friend's report about the ballot?
A fairer system can still cost the people inside it something they valued.
A fairer system can still leave the slower friendships to form somewhere else.
A fairer system can still be worth abandoning once the ritual has gone.
The manufacturers took the ritual away deliberately, and he says so plainly.

qs.evidence: A friend who has queued for eleven years reports that the ballot feels fairer and that he has acquired no new acquaintance whatever since its introduction.
qs.answer: A fairer system can still cost the people inside it something they valued.
qs.why: Satu kalimat memuat dua laporan yang nggak saling membatalkan: undiannya terasa lebih adil, dan kenalan baru nggak ada sama sekali.
qs.whyOthersFail: Dua pengecoh memakai penanda “adil namun tetap merugi” yang sama dengan kunci, jadi tanda itu nggak lagi menunjuk jawaban. Opsi pertemanan yang tumbuh di tempat lain bertabrakan dengan “he has acquired no new acquaintance whatever since its introduction”. Opsi pantas ditinggalkan menambahkan keinginan yang nggak dinyatakan, sebab dia justru melaporkan undiannya lebih adil. Opsi produsen yang sengaja menghapus ritual menambahkan tuduhan niat yang nggak ada dalam laporannya.

qs: Why does the writer point out the flatness of his friend's delivery?
To show the friend had grown bored with a subject raised too often.
To suggest the friend weighs neither half of the sentence at all.
To suggest the loss registers without ever being openly mourned.
To hint the friend resents a change he is too polite to attack.

qs.evidence: He delivered both halves of that sentence in an identical flat tone.
qs.answer: To suggest the loss registers without ever being openly mourned.
qs.why: Yang ditandai penulis adalah nada yang sama untuk dua hal yang nggak sama nilainya; kehilangan itu tercatat tanpa pernah diratapi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “To show/suggest/hint …” yang sama dan sama ringkasnya. Opsi bosan menjadikan kedataran itu ketidakpedulian, padahal yang jadi soal justru pasangan isinya, adil dan tanpa kenalan baru. Opsi nggak menimbang apa pun bertabrakan dengan sebelas tahun mengantre yang disebut di kalimat sebelumnya. Opsi jengkel menambahkan emosi yang nggak ada, sebab teks hanya melaporkan nada yang rata.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the point about the resale market?
Resale prices may put the shoes beyond most people in the queue.
The objects really are what they came for, though they seldom admit it.
The resale market is where the queue's real business is eventually done.
If people only wanted the shoes, they could simply buy them online.

qs.evidence: Were the objects the objective, the resale market would satisfy the appetite immediately and at moderate expense, since identical items reach the internet within hours.
qs.answer: If people only wanted the shoes, they could simply buy them online.
qs.why: Kalimat itu berbentuk pengandaian: kalau barangnya yang jadi tujuan, pasar sekunder udah menyelesaikannya segera dan dengan biaya sedang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi harga jual kembali menambahkan angka yang nggak disebut, sebab teks justru menyebutnya “at moderate expense”; opsi objek sebagai tujuan membalik “The shoes are not the reason anybody sleeps on a pavement”; opsi pasar jual kembali sebagai urusan sebenarnya memindahkan tempat kejadiannya, padahal kalimat itu memakai pasar itu sebagai uji pikiran.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer has never joined one of these queues himself."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer has never joined one of these queues himself.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: I have never queued for footwear and expect I never shall, my own irrationalities being quieter and considerably more extravagant.
qs.why: Dia menyatakan belum pernah mengantre untuk sepatu dan nggak berniat, jadi klaimnya benar.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan kalimat itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena posisinya disebut di paragraf terakhir.

author: Rendra Kusnadi
setting: a cultural commentary on release-day queues

title: The Candles Subsidize the Poetry
text:
The bookshop on my corner now devotes its entire display table to candles, and after a period of ugly resentment I have concluded that I do not mind, since the candles subsidize the poetry. This is not the sentence I anticipated composing when the display initially materialized. My initial reaction involved several remarks about the demise of literary culture that I would prefer not to have delivered publicly.

The economics are unforgiving and widely misunderstood, since a hardback yields the retailer a margin that would embarrass a grocer. The purchaser spending forty minutes deliberating in the establishment is frequently the purchaser who subsequently orders the item online for less. A candle carries a margin four times superior and has never been discounted by a warehouse, and the tote bags, the metal pins and the ceramic dishes are not evidence of surrender. They are the mechanism by which a room full of unprofitable objects continues to exist on a costly street. Retail arithmetic of this description is dull, unglamorous and entirely decisive.

What genuinely deserves scrutiny is a subtler substitution. Retailers discovering the profitability of ornament occasionally begin selecting books that photograph well, and the criterion relates only loosely to whether a volume has merit. Certain covers now advertise an aesthetic rather than a subject, and curation by photograph substitutes surface for judgement. My local shop resists this admirably, and the poetry section has expanded rather than contracted, though I have visited establishments elsewhere whose entire stock appeared to have been selected by somebody arranging a colour palette.

The staff constitute the variable determining which species of establishment you are standing in. In a genuine bookshop somebody glances up from the counter, enquires what you have been reading, and then dissuades you from your intended purchase in favour of something superior. That conversation is the actual product, and cannot be photographed, ranked or reproduced by an algorithm. Candles do not threaten that conversation; understaffing does, and understaffing is what happens when margins fail. Skill delivered conversationally remains the one commodity the warehouses have never managed to replicate.

So I have adjusted my objections, and I now buy a candle every December without embarrassment. It is a curious form of support, indirect and slightly ridiculous, in which I purchase an object I do not require to sustain an institution I could not replace. The alternative arrangement, in which the shop refuses all ornament and closes within two years to universal regret, would preserve my aesthetic principles perfectly. It would also eliminate the only establishment within walking distance where somebody argues with me about a novel. Purity of principle, in retailing as elsewhere, is generally financed by somebody else.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer conclude about the candles on sale?
The conversation with a knowledgeable assistant is arguably the real product.
Choosing stock for how it photographs is the substitution that deserves attention.
Purity of principle, in retailing as elsewhere, is largely financed by others.
Ornaments pay the rent that keeps unprofitable books on the shelves.

qs.evidence: They are the mechanism by which a room full of unprofitable objects continues to exist on a costly street.
qs.answer: Ornaments pay the rent that keeps unprofitable books on the shelves.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menyebut pernak-pernik sebagai mekanisme yang membuat ruangan penuh barang tak menguntungkan tetap berdiri di jalan mahal, persis klaim yang dipasang di kalimat pertama esai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi percakapan dengan pegawai adalah paragraf empat, yang menjelaskan apa yang dilindungi marjin, bukan klaim tentang lilinnya; opsi kurasi lewat foto dibuka “What genuinely deserves scrutiny is a subtler substitution”, jadi keberatan terpisah; opsi kemurnian yang dibiayai orang lain adalah pepatah penutup yang merangkum posisinya, sedangkan yang ditanya peran lilin.

qs: What can be inferred about the real threat to the bookshop?
Fewer candles might free the space the staff need for shelving books.
The conversation may survive whatever the margins do, being unreproducible.
Protecting the margins is how a shop protects its staff and their advice.
Understaffing is what drives customers to deliberate and then order online.

qs.evidence: Candles do not threaten that conversation; understaffing does, and understaffing is what happens when margins fail.
qs.answer: Protecting the margins is how a shop protects its staff and their advice.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menyusun rantainya: yang mengancam percakapan adalah kekurangan staf, dan kekurangan staf muncul ketika margin gagal.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi mengurangi lilin membalik fungsinya, sebab lilin justru “the mechanism by which a room full of unprofitable objects continues to exist”; opsi percakapan yang selalu bertahan bertabrakan dengan “understaffing is what happens when margins fail”; opsi kekurangan staf yang mendorong pembeli memesan daring membalik arah sebabnya di paragraf dua.

qs: What does the writer's admission about his first reaction contribute?
A wry admission that his earliest verdict had been badly overheated.
A quiet insistence that those first remarks have largely held up.
A dry complaint about people who took his first remarks seriously.
A rueful hint that he still half believes what he said in public.

qs.evidence: My initial reaction involved several remarks about the demise of literary culture that I would prefer not to have delivered publicly.
qs.answer: A wry admission that his earliest verdict had been badly overheated.
qs.why: Dia menyebut komentar sendiri soal matinya kebudayaan sastra sebagai hal yang lebih baik nggak pernah diucapkan di depan umum, dan kalimat pembuka esai menyebut periode itu “ugly resentment”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi bertahan pada ucapan awal bertabrakan dengan “I would prefer not to have delivered publicly”; opsi mengeluhkan orang lain memindahkan sasarannya, padahal yang disesalinya ucapannya sendiri; opsi masih separuh percaya bertabrakan dengan kesimpulan “I do not mind, since the candles subsidize the poetry”.

qs: In the second paragraph, what is "a margin that would embarrass a grocer"?
The blank edge a printer may leave around the text of a hardback.
What is left for the shop once the book itself has been paid for.
The room a retailer has to cut a price, though only until a sale stops paying.
The share of the cover price that a warehouse keeps for itself.

qs.evidence: The economics are unforgiving and widely misunderstood, since a hardback yields the retailer a margin that would embarrass a grocer.
qs.answer: What is left for the shop once the book itself has been paid for.
qs.why: Kata “yields the retailer” memaksa arti dagangnya, bukan arti lazim kata itu sebagai tepi halaman, dan paragraf itu melanjutkan dengan lilin yang marginnya empat kali lebih baik.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tepi halaman memakai arti kamus “margin” yang paling umum, padahal kalimat ini membandingkannya dengan marjin seorang pedagang bahan makanan; opsi ruang untuk memotong harga adalah turunan dari marjin, bukan marjinnya; opsi bagian gudang bertabrakan dengan kata “yields the retailer”, yang menempatkan bagian itu pada tokonya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer refuses to buy any of the shop's ornaments."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer refuses to buy any of the shop's ornaments.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: So I have adjusted my objections, and I now buy a candle every December without embarrassment.
qs.why: Dia justru membeli lilin setiap Desember tanpa malu, jadi klaim ini bertentangan.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan kalimat itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena kebiasaan belanjanya disebut.

topic: why independent bookshops sell candles and gifts
author: Maritza Sudibyo
setting: a cultural commentary on bookshop retailing

title: Ninety Seconds of Calm
text:
The photographs arrive in an endless quiet procession: a pale room, a solitary chair, a bowl containing nothing. Light falls across a floor that has clearly never encountered a satchel, a spillage or a deadline. The captions describe such interiors as calm, a euphemism chosen with commercial precision. What they mostly are is unoccupied, and the distinction is more consequential than the vocabulary of the captions permits us to notice. Terminology of that kind performs concealment rather than description, quietly and rather effectively.

I hold no grievance against restraint, which constitutes a genuine achievement in an overcrowded world, nor against the photographers who satisfy the appetite for it. The trouble is that these images have quietly hardened into instructions rather than depictions. A photograph of an empty surface documents a moment, whereas a thousand of them quietly legislate a standard for everybody else. Ordinary readers then apply that standard to interiors containing children, hobbies, elderly relatives and the accumulated paraphernalia of actual biographies. Judged against an empty surface every inhabited room fails, and comparison with an uninhabited photograph is a competition arranged so that nobody living can possibly win it.

Notice what the aesthetic conceals about expenditure, because the concealment is systematic rather than incidental. Emptiness requires storage, and storage requires either square metres or a monthly fee, so the visible absence of objects generally indicates the invisible presence of a second room. Meanwhile the household with fewer possessions and no storage is not photographed at all, since genuine scarcity does not resemble the aesthetic. It resembles a chair with a coat draped across it, photogenic to nobody and therefore unrepresented. The aesthetic of minimal ownership is expensive, and the outlay is precisely what the frame excludes. Invisibility of expenditure is the characteristic achievement of the entire genre.

There is also a temporal deception at work, since every one of these interiors was tidied immediately before the photograph and will be disordered within the hour, exactly like mine. What we are shown is not a way of living but a condition lasting ninety seconds, presented as a permanent state that other people have somehow achieved. Aspiration directed at a ninety-second condition produces a low but persistent sense of failure, which is an unusual arrangement to construct for oneself deliberately. Permanence is exactly what the medium cannot photograph, and exactly what its audience infers regardless of the caption.

My own compromise is inelegant, provisional and thoroughly unphotogenic, and I recommend it warmly to anybody contemplating a similar capitulation. One shelf in the sitting room remains clear, as a modest daily demonstration that domestic order is intermittently attainable. The remaining eleven accommodate everything else in a condition I would characterize, with some indulgence, as affectionate chaos. Visitors occasionally photograph the clear shelf, and never anything adjacent to it. Nobody has ever photographed the others, and I have come to regard that asymmetry as the most honest commentary anybody has offered on the entire genre and its glossy prescriptions.
qs: How does the writer relate these photographs to rooms that people live in?
They set a standard that no occupied room could ever satisfy.
They document one moment each, and the reader could supply the standard.
They record rooms that could pass for the ones most readers occupy.
They flatter inhabited rooms by showing what restraint can achieve.

qs.evidence: Judged against an empty surface every inhabited room fails, and comparison with an uninhabited photograph is a competition arranged so that nobody living can possibly win it.
qs.answer: They set a standard that no occupied room could ever satisfy.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menyebut perbandingannya sebagai kompetisi yang disusun agar nggak mungkin dimenangi siapa pun yang tinggal di dalam ruangan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “They …” yang sama, sama ringkas dan sama berhati-hati. Opsi satu momen per foto mengambil klausa “A photograph of an empty surface documents a moment” tetapi menghapus lanjutannya, “whereas a thousand of them quietly legislate a standard for everybody else”. Opsi kamar yang bisa lolos sebagai kamar pembaca bertabrakan dengan “What they mostly are is unoccupied”. Opsi menyanjung kamar berpenghuni membalik “every inhabited room fails”.

qs: What can be inferred about the cost of the empty look?
The bare look may show a household that genuinely owns very little.
Households with the fewest possessions are the ones photographed most.
The bare look usually signals money the picture keeps out of the frame.
The storage fee is the only real cost, though smaller than readers think.

qs.evidence: Emptiness requires storage, and storage requires either square metres or a monthly fee, so the visible absence of objects generally indicates the invisible presence of a second room.
qs.answer: The bare look usually signals money the picture keeps out of the frame.
qs.why: Rantainya dinyatakan penuh: kekosongan menuntut penyimpanan, penyimpanan menuntut meter persegi atau biaya bulanan, jadi barang yang tak terlihat menandakan ruang kedua yang tak terlihat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi rumah yang benar-benar sedikit barang bertabrakan dengan “genuine scarcity does not resemble the aesthetic”; opsi rumah paling sedikit barang paling sering difoto membalik “is not photographed at all”; opsi biaya penyimpanan yang kecil bertabrakan dengan “either square metres or a monthly fee” dan dengan kesimpulan bahwa estetika itu mahal.

qs: What is the writer's tone in reporting what visitors photograph?
Faintly put out that guests overlook the rest of the room, though politely.
Quietly amused, since the habit proves his point for him.
Drily pleased that visitors can perhaps tell which shelf took the effort.
Wryly disappointed that even his guests have absorbed the genre's rules.

qs.evidence: Visitors occasionally photograph the clear shelf, and never anything adjacent to it.
qs.answer: Quietly amused, since the habit proves his point for him.
qs.why: Kalimat berikutnya menyebut ketimpangan itu “the most honest commentary anybody has offered”, jadi kebiasaan tamu itu dia terima sebagai bukti yang menyenangkan bagi argumennya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tersinggung bertabrakan dengan penilaiannya sendiri, yang menyebut ketimpangan itu “the most honest commentary anybody has offered”; opsi bangga pada rak yang rapi membalik maksudnya, sebab yang lucu justru bahwa tamu memotret satu-satunya rak kosong; opsi kecewa pada tamu menambahkan celaan yang nggak ada.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the point about a ninety-second condition?
The picture records how such rooms look for most of an ordinary year.
The picture holds the order rather longer than the caption ever claims.
The picture freezes a brief tidy moment and sells it as daily life.
The picture was staged for the camera, so the room was never truly tidy.

qs.evidence: What we are shown is not a way of living but a condition lasting ninety seconds, presented as a permanent state that other people have somehow achieved.
qs.answer: The picture freezes a brief tidy moment and sells it as daily life.
qs.why: Kalimat itu memasang dua hal: durasinya sembilan puluh detik, dan penyajiannya sebagai keadaan permanen yang entah bagaimana dicapai orang lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “The picture …” yang sama, sehingga bentuknya sama-sama rapi dan masing-masing menggeser tepat satu unsur. Opsi sepanjang tahun dan opsi ketertiban yang bertahan lebih lama sama-sama bertabrakan dengan “will be disordered within the hour”. Opsi kamar yang tak pernah benar-benar rapi melampaui teks, yang justru menyebut kamar itu “tidied immediately before the photograph”, jadi rapi selama sembilan puluh detik; yang dipersoalkan kalimat itu adalah penyajiannya sebagai keadaan tetap.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Collections of these photographs contain more kitchens than sitting rooms."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Collections of these photographs contain more kitchens than sitting rooms.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The photographs arrive in an endless quiet procession: a pale room, a solitary chair, a bowl containing nothing.
qs.why: Teks nggak pernah menghitung jenis ruangan dalam foto-foto itu, jadi perbandingan jumlahnya nggak bisa dinilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” dan “False” sama-sama butuh hitungan yang nggak ada; kalimat terdekat hanya menyebut isi satu foto.

topic: minimalist interior photography and lived-in rooms
author: Kirana Danastri
setting: a cultural commentary on interior aesthetics

title: Salt Through Bread
text:
My grandmother commanded a dialect containing roughly four separate terms for the particular grey of the sky before rain, none of which I acquired properly. What survived in me was the music: a rising contour on interrogatives, the habit of addressing children in the plural, and a formidable noise of disapproval manufactured entirely at the rear of the throat. She died when I was nineteen, during the second week of a term I declined to interrupt. The dialect departed with her, in the sense that actually matters.

It survives in recordings, obviously, since a university project preserved forty hours of speakers from her generation. I have listened to portions of it inside a cramped booth with the volume wound excessively high. Every vowel is present, the grammar is intact, and something essential is nevertheless entirely absent: nobody in the recordings is reprimanding anybody. Preservation and transmission are separate operations, and the archive accomplishes only the first. Documentation preserves a language and cannot preserve the ordinary occasions that supplied its weight, which is no accusation against documentation but a characterization of what any language largely consists of.

My father, raised inside the dialect, resolved to educate us in the national language, and I decline to brand that decision a betrayal. He had witnessed an intelligent cousin humiliated in a government bureau over a provincial vowel. He performed a calculation with the intelligence available, and the calculation was sound. I have benefited from it in ways I had no occasion to register, which is roughly the definition of a successful sacrifice. Assimilation was an insurance policy, purchased at a premium nobody itemized at the outset. The cost remained invisible to him for decades and then arrived in a single afternoon, at his mother's funeral, where he delivered the address in a language she had never entirely trusted.

I have been trying to learn it now, at thirty-eight, from an application and an exceptionally patient neighbour. The progress is humiliating: my accent apparently resembles that of a tourist attempting a compliment, and I have twice deployed the affectionate form of a verb in circumstances that reduced a shopkeeper to helpless laughter. I persist regardless, expecting no fluency whatever, because the undertaking has generated something I had not anticipated. Humiliation, it appears, is the standard tuition fee for an inheritance recovered belatedly.

The something is not the language itself; it is a sudden and repeated recognition of my grandmother's phrasing inside my own Indonesian, structures I had assumed were mine emerging as translations she performed decades before my birth. Loss is less total than the vocabulary implies: she is distributed through my sentences like salt through bread, undetectable and structural. Every clumsy tutorial supplies me with fresh evidence that I never entirely failed to learn her at all. Inheritance of that kind requires no fluency whatsoever, which is fortunate, since fluency remains improbable.
qs: How does the writer relate the recordings to the survival of the dialect?
They pass the dialect on better than family speech ever managed to.
They keep the vowels alive but lose the grammar those speakers had.
They keep the forms alive but cannot pass on their daily use.
They hold the sounds but too few hours to carry a whole dialect.

qs.evidence: Preservation and transmission are separate operations, and the archive accomplishes only the first.
qs.answer: They keep the forms alive but cannot pass on their daily use.
qs.why: Kalimat itu memisahkan pelestarian dari penerusan dan menyebut arsipnya menyelesaikan yang pertama saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “They keep/hold X but Y” yang sama. Opsi lebih efektif daripada keluarga membalik pembagian “Preservation and transmission are separate operations, and the archive accomplishes only the first”. Opsi tata bahasa yang hilang bertabrakan dengan “the grammar is intact”. Opsi jumlah jam yang terlalu sedikit menukar jenis kekurangannya, sebab yang teks sebut hilang bukan banyaknya bahan melainkan kesempatan sehari-harinya, “nobody in the recordings is reprimanding anybody”.

qs: What can be inferred about the cost of his father's decision?
The price of that choice only became clear to him at the graveside.
He may have regretted the decision from the moment he made it.
He had weighed this particular cost beforehand and accepted it.
His cousin's humiliation was the price, though he paid it all along.

qs.evidence: The cost remained invisible to him for decades and then arrived in a single afternoon, at his mother's funeral, where he delivered the address in a language she had never entirely trusted.
qs.answer: The price of that choice only became clear to him at the graveside.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menaruh biayanya pada satu sore tertentu: nggak terlihat selama beberapa dekade, lalu tiba di pemakaman ibunya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menyesal sejak awal bertabrakan dengan “The cost remained invisible to him for decades”; opsi biaya yang udah diperhitungkan bertabrakan dengan “a premium nobody itemized at the outset”; opsi penghinaan sepupu membalik peran contoh itu, yang dipakai sebagai alasan keputusannya, bukan harganya.

qs: What is the writer's tone in describing his own progress with the dialect?
Quietly bitter, though only at a shopkeeper who laughed at a misused word.
Confident, though fluency may arrive only if the lessons continue.
Drily resigned, since the lessons have produced nothing he can use.
Self-mocking, yet with no hint of abandoning the attempt.

qs.evidence: my accent apparently resembles that of a tourist attempting a compliment, and I have twice deployed the affectionate form of a verb in circumstances that reduced a shopkeeper to helpless laughter
qs.answer: Self-mocking, yet with no hint of abandoning the attempt.
qs.why: Dia menertawakan aksennya sendiri, lalu kalimat berikutnya dibuka “I persist regardless”, jadi lelucon itu nggak berujung pada berhenti.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi getir menyalahkan pemilik toko, padahal penulis menyebut tawa itu bagian dari ceritanya sendiri; opsi yakin bertabrakan dengan “expecting no fluency whatever” dan “fluency remains improbable”; opsi pasrah bertabrakan dengan “I persist regardless” dan dengan hasil yang dia sebut tak terduga.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the image of salt through bread?
Her speech may be picked out easily in almost every sentence he writes.
Her way of speaking sits inside his own, invisible but holding it together.
Her dialect has gone from his speech, though its rhythm remains.
He reaches for her phrasing on purpose whenever he writes at length.

qs.evidence: she is distributed through my sentences like salt through bread, undetectable and structural
qs.answer: Her way of speaking sits inside his own, invisible but holding it together.
qs.why: Dua kata penutup kiasannya memutuskan arah bacanya: nggak terdeteksi, tetapi struktural, jadi bukan hiasan yang bisa ditunjuk.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi mudah dikenali bertabrakan dengan kata “undetectable” di kalimat yang sama; opsi dialek yang hilang bertabrakan dengan “Loss is less total than the vocabulary implies”; opsi sengaja meminjam frasanya bertabrakan dengan “structures I had assumed were mine”, yang menandai kemunculannya tanpa sengaja.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer stayed at university rather than going home when his grandmother died."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer stayed at university rather than going home when his grandmother died.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: She died when I was nineteen, during the second week of a term I declined to interrupt.
qs.why: Dia bilang nggak memotong masa kuliahnya waktu itu, jadi klaim ini parafrasa yang tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan “declined to interrupt”, dan “Not stated” gagal karena kejadiannya disebut jelas.

topic: losing and relearning a family dialect
author: Arum Setiabudi
setting: a reflective essay on language and family

title: Preparation and Postponement
text:
The desk reached me in March, second-hand, from a retired surveyor who observed its descent of the stairs with open scepticism. It offers a generous surface, three drawers requiring persuasion, and a scar along one edge resembling a coastline. The absence of such an object had supposedly explained the absence of the manuscript, and the reasoning was so comfortable that it escaped examination for years. Six months subsequently the desk is admirable and the volume remains approximately where it began.

What the desk eventually demonstrated was the difference between preparation and postponement. Preparation has an end; postponement is a renewable resource, and it renews itself most vigorously in the presence of stationery catalogues. My purchases include a lamp of considerable elegance, a chair recommended by physiotherapists, and a modest ceramic pot containing exactly those pencils that remain unused. Every acquisition felt like progress and functioned as delay, which is a difference the credit card statement cannot register, since consumption disguised as commitment is the characteristic vice of the ambitious amateur.

The mornings themselves prove stranger than the purchasing, since I arrive at the desk each day with real intent. Within four minutes I am investigating something adjacent and defensible: the etymology of a word I have not yet required, or the ferry timetable for an island the chapter may never reach. The research is real research, and that is exactly its usefulness, since no observer accuses an industrious writer of avoidance, least of all himself. Avoidance dressed as diligence is almost undetectable from the inside, because legitimacy, once acquired, protects an activity from examination indefinitely.

A neighbour who paints suggested a remedy of brutal simplicity, and I resented it immediately, which is generally a reliable indication. She records the single next physical action before departing the studio each evening, and permits herself no revision of that instruction in the morning. It removes the negotiation, she said, and the negotiation is what consumes the day. Negotiation flourishes wherever a decision has been left renegotiable overnight. The discipline was adopted in June, abandoned in July, and resumed recently with the sheepishness of a returning patient.

No conclusion about a wasted purchase is available here, partly because the purchase was not wasted. Some mornings the wide surface and the peculiar scar and the unused pencils assemble themselves into a room where work becomes conceivable. On such mornings nine hundred words appear and the whole cost seems vindicated. But the desk did not supply those mornings, and it merely made their absence more conspicuous, which may be the most any object can honestly promise, and is more than most of them deliver. Equipment cannot manufacture the appetite that the equipment was purchased to serve.
qs: Read as a whole, what point does this reflection settle on?
The purchase was not wasted, though the room only sometimes makes work possible.
Deciding the next action the night before removes the day's negotiation.
Real research may be the most reliable disguise a stalling writer has.
Getting ready for work can quietly become the way of avoiding it.

qs.evidence: What the desk eventually demonstrated was the difference between preparation and postponement.
qs.answer: Getting ready for work can quietly become the way of avoiding it.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menamai pembedaan yang dibawa seluruh esai, dan kalimat sesudahnya menutupnya: persiapan punya ujung, penundaan bisa diperbarui terus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pembelian yang nggak sia-sia adalah kelonggaran paragraf lima, yang tetap ditutup “the desk did not supply those mornings”; opsi memutuskan tindakan malam sebelumnya adalah resep tetangganya di paragraf empat; opsi riset sebagai kedok adalah mekanismenya di paragraf tiga, satu bukti untuk tesis yang dinyatakan “the difference between preparation and postponement”.

qs: What can be inferred about the morning research he describes?
The research is invented, which is exactly why nobody questions it.
An industrious writer is the least likely of all to be avoiding anything.
The work is genuine, which is exactly what makes it such good cover.
He knows he is stalling, which is exactly why the research stays adjacent.

qs.evidence: The research is real research, and that is exactly its usefulness, since no observer accuses an industrious writer of avoidance, least of all himself.
qs.answer: The work is genuine, which is exactly what makes it such good cover.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menyebut risetnya sungguhan dan justru itu kegunaannya, karena nggak ada pengamat yang menuduh penulis rajin sedang menghindar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi ditulis setegas kunci, dua di antaranya dengan rangka “which is exactly” yang sama. Opsi riset yang dikarang bertabrakan dengan “The research is real research”. Opsi penulis rajin yang paling kecil kemungkinan menghindar membalik kesimpulan kalimat itu, sebab kerajinan itulah yang melindungi penghindarannya, “no observer accuses an industrious writer of avoidance, least of all himself”. Opsi sadar sedang menunda bertabrakan dengan “Avoidance dressed as diligence is almost undetectable from the inside”.

qs: What does the writer suggest by noting his immediate resentment of the advice?
That the suggestion had probably struck something true in him.
That the neighbour had perhaps misjudged how his working day runs.
That he distrusts any advice offered with quite that much confidence.
That resentment is often his answer to a discipline proposed by others.

qs.evidence: A neighbour who paints suggested a remedy of brutal simplicity, and I resented it immediately, which is generally a reliable indication.
qs.answer: That the suggestion had probably struck something true in him.
qs.why: Klausa penutupnya menyebut rasa kesal itu “a reliable indication”, jadi yang ditandai adalah ketepatan nasihatnya, bukan kekeliruannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tetangga salah menilai bertabrakan dengan resep itu, yang kemudian dia pakai di bulan Juni; opsi nggak percaya pada nasihat yang terlalu yakin menambahkan sikap yang nggak disebut; opsi kebiasaan menolak nasihat orang lain mengubah kesaksian sekali menjadi kebiasaan, padahal kalimatnya menjadikan rasa dongkol itu sebagai penanda, “generally a reliable indication”.

qs: In the first paragraph, what are "three drawers requiring persuasion"?
Drawers he was talked into buying along with the desk itself.
Drawers that will open only for the surveyor who owned them.
Drawers that will not open at all unless they are coaxed.
Drawers he means to clear out on some later morning.

qs.evidence: It offers a generous surface, three drawers requiring persuasion, and a scar along one edge resembling a coastline.
qs.answer: Drawers that will not open at all unless they are coaxed.
qs.why: Frasa itu berdiri di antara dua keterangan fisik, permukaan yang luas dan bekas luka di tepinya, jadi yang dibujuk adalah lacinya, bukan orang, dan itu bukan arti lazim kata tersebut.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “Drawers …” yang sama dan sama presisinya. Opsi dibujuk membeli memakai arti “persuasion” yang paling umum, yaitu membujuk orang, padahal di kalimat ini yang dibujuk lacinya. Opsi hanya terbuka bagi pemilik lama menambahkan cerita yang nggak ada. Opsi berniat membereskan memindahkan tema penundaan dari paragraf dua ke deskripsi fisik meja ini.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer concludes that buying the desk was a mistake."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer concludes that buying the desk was a mistake.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: No conclusion about a wasted purchase is available here, partly because the purchase was not wasted.
qs.why: Dia menyatakan pembelian itu nggak sia-sia, jadi klaim ini bertentangan langsung.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan kalimat tersebut, dan “Not stated” gagal karena sikapnya soal pembelian itu ditulis jelas.

topic: buying a desk and the habit of putting off writing
author: Galih Ramadhan
setting: a reflective essay on procrastination

title: The Last Bus and Its Logic
text:
The final bus of the evening operates according to a logic entirely its own, and I have been scrutinizing that logic, unwillingly, for eleven months. It departs when the driver has concluded a conversation and materializes whenever the traffic permits. Its passengers number between four and nine, and each has performed the same calculation concerning the expense of a taxi. Nobody aboard is travelling for pleasure, and that shared condition produces a courtesy I have not encountered on any daytime service.

A woman boards two stops beyond mine, invariably bearing a plastic container of a dish she has prepared, and she has twice offered it to strangers. A student dozes with an alarm configured for his halt, rouses himself with the precision of an instrument, and appears briefly ashamed. A security guard concluding a shift reads paperbacks whose covers have been removed, and none of us converses. The arrangement is not unfriendly, merely economical with reserves that a working day has already depleted. It required several weeks of travelling before I recognized that the silence constitutes a species of consideration rather than its inversion. Reticence of that kind is an urban competence, acquired without instruction, rarely acknowledged and impossible to counterfeit.

What the route offers, at that hour, is an urban landscape with its performance suspended. Shopfronts that devote the daylight hours to insisting on their own importance become simply lit rectangles. A man sweeps the pavement outside a restaurant with the unhurried competence of an individual who has performed the operation four thousand times. Two adolescents argue about a film beneath a broken streetlight, and their disagreement is more genuinely engaged than anything I encountered in the office that afternoon, while nothing whatsoever is being staged for anybody, because the audience has departed. Municipal existence continues regardless of observation, indifferent to whether anybody remains available to admire it.

I did not select this route, and for the first several months I resented every minute of it, a resentment thoroughly documented in my messages to acquaintances. What dissolved it was not acceptance in any noble sense but a small technical discovery: the bus is the only interval in my day that no application can subdivide. The signal fails between the third and seventh halts, and nobody expects a reply from a passenger travelling at midnight. Unavailability, imposed externally, accomplished within eleven months what my own discipline had repeatedly failed to arrange.

I will move closer to the office eventually, and the arrangement will end, and I suspect I will miss it in the dishonest way one misses difficulty. Nevertheless, something has been rearranged in me by those eleven months, and it concerns attention rather than transport. The metropolis was invariably conducting itself in this manner after eleven, sweeping and arguing and offering sustenance to strangers. It required an inconvenient timetable and a failing signal to compel me to notice. Attention apparently requires an enclosure, and enclosures are increasingly hard to obtain voluntarily.
qs: How does the writer link the passengers' reason for travelling to their behaviour?
Because none of them wants to be there, they treat each other well.
Because each of them counted the fare, they behave like fellow economizers.
Because the working day has drained them, they are shorter with each other.
Because daytime crowds behave the same way, the hour makes little difference.

qs.evidence: Nobody aboard is travelling for pleasure, and that shared condition produces a courtesy I have not encountered on any daytime service.
qs.answer: Because none of them wants to be there, they treat each other well.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menunjuk sebabnya secara langsung: nggak seorang pun naik untuk bersenang-senang, dan kondisi bersama itulah yang menghasilkan kesopanan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “Because X, they Y” yang sama. Opsi sesama penghemat berhenti di perhitungan tarif dan melewatkan klausa “that shared condition produces a courtesy”. Opsi lebih pendek satu sama lain membalik arah paragraf dua, yang menyebut keheningan itu “a species of consideration rather than its inversion”. Opsi layanan siang hari yang sama bertabrakan dengan “I have not encountered on any daytime service”.

qs: What can be inferred about why his resentment faded?
It faded because he learnt patience rather than because anything changed.
It faded for practical reasons rather than because he grew any wiser.
It faded because the other passengers won him over rather than any discovery.
It faded once he stopped messaging acquaintances rather than for any other reason.

qs.evidence: What dissolved it was not acceptance in any noble sense but a small technical discovery: the bus is the only interval in my day that no application can subdivide.
qs.answer: It faded for practical reasons rather than because he grew any wiser.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menolak satu penjelasan lalu memberi gantinya: bukan penerimaan yang mulia, melainkan penemuan teknis kecil soal jeda yang nggak bisa dipotong aplikasi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh memakai penanda anti-epifani yang sama dengan kunci, yaitu bentuk “X rather than Y” yang menolak pencerahan, jadi tanda itu nggak lagi menunjuk jawaban. Opsi belajar sabar ditolak kalimatnya sendiri, “not acceptance in any noble sense but a small technical discovery”. Opsi penumpang yang memenangkan hatinya adalah pengamatan paragraf dua, bukan sebab lunturnya rasa dongkol. Opsi berhenti mengirim pesan membalik urutannya, sebab pesan-pesan itu bukti rasa dongkolnya, bukan penyebabnya.

qs: What does the writer admit about the nostalgia he expects to feel?
That he will perhaps regret losing the cheapest journey available.
That he means to keep the commute for as long as he possibly can.
That fondness for past hardship is never quite honest.
That he will miss the difficulty, though not the bus itself.

qs.evidence: I will move closer to the office eventually, and the arrangement will end, and I suspect I will miss it in the dishonest way one misses difficulty.
qs.answer: That fondness for past hardship is never quite honest.
qs.why: Kata “dishonest” dipasang pada cara merindukannya, jadi yang diakui adalah bahwa kerinduan pada kesulitan lampau nggak pernah sepenuhnya jujur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menyesali tarif murah memindahkan perhitungan taksi paragraf satu ke pengakuan ini; opsi mempertahankan perjalanan bertabrakan dengan “I will move closer to the office eventually”; opsi kehilangan kesulitan benar separuh tetapi melewatkan kata yang menjadi inti pengakuannya, “in the dishonest way one misses difficulty”.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the remark about shopfronts?
By night the shops stop advertising themselves and are simply lit shapes.
The shops look rather more impressive, perhaps, once the day has ended.
The shops keep pressing their importance, though nobody is left to hear.
During business hours these shops are little more than lit rectangles.

qs.evidence: Shopfronts that devote the daylight hours to insisting on their own importance become simply lit rectangles.
qs.answer: By night the shops stop advertising themselves and are simply lit shapes.
qs.why: Kalimat itu memasang dua waktu: siang dipakai menegaskan kepentingan sendiri, malam tinggal persegi bercahaya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tampak lebih mengesankan membalik kata “simply lit rectangles”; opsi tetap mendesakkan kepentingannya bertabrakan dengan “devote the daylight hours”, sebab desakan itu berhenti di malam; opsi persegi bercahaya pada jam kerja menukar kedua waktunya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The mobile signal is unreliable along part of the route."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The mobile signal is unreliable along part of the route.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The signal fails between the third and seventh halts, and nobody expects a reply from a passenger travelling at midnight.
qs.why: Teks menyebut sinyal mati di antara pemberhentian ketiga dan ketujuh, jadi klaimnya parafrasa yang benar.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan kalimat itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena kegagalan sinyalnya disebut jelas.

topic: riding the last bus home and noticing the night city
author: Ayu Prameswari
setting: a reflective essay on a nightly commute

title: The Pencil and the Metronome
text:
My piano teacher possessed a metronome she never used and a pencil she employed constantly, remorselessly. Its tap against the music stand remains audible to me three decades afterwards. She taught in a front room that smelled of camphor, above a tailor's premises, and her instruction consisted virtually entirely of interrogation. What did I intend by that phrase, and had I observed the composer's marking, and why had I accelerated precisely where a competent musician would have waited.

I was not a gifted pupil and she never suggested otherwise, which I regard now as an extraordinary act of respect. Other adults were busily assuring me of talents I did not possess. She told me instead that my hands were adequate, my patience insufficient, and my listening capable of improvement, and attached a timetable to each judgement. Nothing in the arrangement was cruel; it was merely the first honest account of myself anybody had offered. Accurate description, delivered without cruelty, is a rarer gift than encouragement, and considerably less popular.

The lessons themselves were predominantly failure, arranged deliberately: she would set a passage marginally beyond my capacity and attend to my collapse in the fourth bar. Then she enquired which finger had betrayed the intention, and the question assumed an intention, which was flattering, and it assumed the collapse was analysable rather than shameful, which was liberating. Across four years I mastered perhaps eleven compositions adequately, none brilliantly. I also learned that difficulty is information, tasting considerably better than reassurance once you develop the palate, since diagnosis converts humiliation into data.

I abandoned the instrument at fifteen for reasons that seemed urgent and now seem administrative, and two decades elapsed without a keyboard. When I seated myself anew, in a rented flat with a borrowed piano, my hands recalled a Bach invention I could not have named. They recalled her corrections equally well, and a phrase would begin accelerating before some interior authority declined, the refusal arriving in the tempo of a pencil tapping on wood. Muscular memory apparently preserves instruction, unprompted, long after the instructor has been forgotten.

She died before any of this could be communicated to her, which is the ordinary shape of such stories and not a tragedy requiring commentary. What survives is not the eleven compositions. It is a particular attention, transferable to arguments, to recipes, to the sentences of this paragraph, asking what you intended and whether the acceleration was earned. I inherited a method rather than a skill, and the method has outlasted virtually everything else instructed in that decade. Methods migrate between unrelated domains, whereas repertoire remains stubbornly where it was acquired.
qs: Read as a whole, which lasting result of those lessons does the writer identify?
A way of paying attention that he still applies well outside music.
A way of questioning music that never transferred to anything else.
A tolerance for failure, since diagnosis turns humiliation into data.
A physical memory of her corrections that returned when he sat down.

qs.evidence: I inherited a method rather than a skill, and the method has outlasted virtually everything else instructed in that decade.
qs.answer: A way of paying attention that he still applies well outside music.
qs.why: Paragraf penutup menyebut yang bertahan bukan sebelas komposisinya melainkan “a particular attention, transferable to arguments, to recipes”, lalu kalimat ini menamainya metode yang melampaui semuanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk frasa nomina yang sama padatnya, dan dua di antaranya menawarkan “cara memperhatikan” sehingga bentuknya nggak menunjuk kunci. Opsi cara bertanya yang nggak pernah berpindah bertabrakan dengan “transferable to arguments, to recipes” dan dengan “Methods migrate between unrelated domains”. Opsi toleransi pada kegagalan adalah pelajaran paragraf tiga. Opsi ingatan otot adalah paragraf empat, yang menerangkan bagaimana koreksinya kembali, bukan apa yang bertahan sebagai warisan.

qs: What can be inferred about how she chose the passages he practised?
The passages were mostly chosen to sit inside his existing reach.
She was mildly surprised each time the collapse arrived in the fourth bar.
The failure was arranged deliberately as part of the teaching.
The fourth bar is where a pupil of that age may break down anyway.

qs.evidence: she would set a passage marginally beyond my capacity and attend to my collapse in the fourth bar
qs.answer: The failure was arranged deliberately as part of the teaching.
qs.why: Kata “marginally beyond my capacity” dan “attend to” memasang kegagalannya sebagai hal yang diukur lebih dulu, lalu ditunggu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi dalam jangkauan membalik “marginally beyond my capacity”; opsi guru yang terkejut bertabrakan dengan “arranged deliberately” dan dengan kata “attend to my collapse”; opsi bar keempat sebagai kebetulan umum menambahkan klaim perkembangan yang nggak ada di teks.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards her honesty about his ability?
Wounded, since the verdict followed him for years afterwards.
Grateful, since he now reads that refusal to flatter as respect.
Admiring, since he thinks few teachers dare to praise that precisely.
Doubtful, since a teacher who calls a child ungifted is often tired.

qs.evidence: I was not a gifted pupil and she never suggested otherwise, which I regard now as an extraordinary act of respect.
qs.answer: Grateful, since he now reads that refusal to flatter as respect.
qs.why: Klausa penutupnya menilai kejujuran itu sebagai tindakan penghormatan yang luar biasa, dan kata “extraordinary” membuatnya hangat, bukan netral.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menamai sikap dengan ketegasan yang sama, dan dua di antaranya bernada positif sehingga arah nada nggak lagi menunjuk kunci. Opsi terluka bertabrakan dengan kata “respect” di klausa penutup kalimat itu. Opsi memuji ketepatan pujiannya bertabrakan dengan “I was not a gifted pupil and she never suggested otherwise”, sebab yang dia hargai justru penolakan untuk memuji. Opsi meragukan penilaiannya bertabrakan dengan pengakuannya sendiri di klausa pertama.

qs: What does the writer mean by "once you develop the palate"?
Once you acquire a taste for being told what went wrong.
Once a pupil's mouth has grown less sensitive to flavour.
Once you can hear what a competent musician would do instead.
Once a teacher's corrections have stopped stinging so much.

qs.evidence: I also learned that difficulty is information, tasting considerably better than reassurance once you develop the palate, since diagnosis converts humiliation into data.
qs.answer: Once you acquire a taste for being told what went wrong.
qs.why: Klausa penutupnya menyebut diagnosis mengubah rasa terhina menjadi data, jadi selera yang dimaksud adalah selera terhadap keterangan soal kesalahan sendiri, bukan arti lazim kata itu di mulut.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “Once …” yang sama dan sama presisinya. Opsi mulut yang kurang peka memakai arti harfiah “palate”, padahal kalimat ini memakai kiasan selera atas informasi kesulitan. Opsi mendengar apa yang dilakukan musisi kompeten memakai frasa paragraf satu tentang percepatan, bukan kiasan ini. Opsi koreksi yang tak lagi menyakitkan menghapus bagian aktifnya, yaitu selera yang harus dikembangkan lebih dahulu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "He gave up the instrument at fifteen because his teacher had moved away."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: He gave up the instrument at fifteen because his teacher had moved away.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: I abandoned the instrument at fifteen for reasons that seemed urgent and now seem administrative, and two decades elapsed without a keyboard.
qs.why: Teks menyebut usianya dan menyebut alasannya terasa administratif, tapi sebab yang sebenarnya nggak pernah dirinci.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” menambahkan sebab yang nggak ada di teks, dan “False” juga salah karena nggak ada kalimat yang membantahnya.

author: Wisnu Aditama
setting: a reflective essay on childhood lessons

title: A Collection of Borrowed Equipment
text:
The notebook is not a diary, and I have wearied of clarifying the distinction at dinner parties. A diary records whatever occurred to its author, a subject of limited interest even to the author. This volume records sentences composed by other people: a phrase from a court report, an argument overheard in a queue. It also holds three expressions a colleague employed about her father that have not ceased operating inside my head since February. It is a collection of borrowed equipment, assembled without a system and consulted without ceremony.

The practice is ancient and thoroughly unoriginal, which constitutes a substantial portion of its appeal. Readers have maintained such volumes for centuries, and the surviving examples reveal what the polished essays conceal, namely which sentences a particular mind judged unaccountably sticky. My own contains four separate entries concerning weather characterized in unflattering terms, which reveals more about my instincts than any personality inventory has managed. The collection registers what I return to, and I merely operate the pen. Preference reveals itself statistically, in repetition, rather than in any declaration of taste, and the statistics are unflattering.

What surprised me was the effect upon attention rather than upon composition, an unforeseen consequence of mere accumulation. Transporting a receptacle for other people's sentences converts ordinary listening into a variety of harvesting, and the conversion is not entirely benign. There are afternoons when I catch myself anticipating that an acquaintance will phrase her grief memorably. That is a shabby discovery to register about oneself, and I possess no defence except that the noticing continues regardless. Collectors are invariably compromised by their collections, and acquisition alters perception irreversibly, as any curator will concede.

The retrieval, meanwhile, works nothing like a filing system and everything like a rummage. I consult the collection expecting to locate the entry I require, and instead encounter an unrelated one that dismantles the paragraph I had intended, which is not a malfunction, and after seven years I have ceased characterizing it as one. A commonplace book is not a database but an unhurried companion with its own opinions, and it has been arguing with my intentions since a summer when I owned considerably fewer of them. Disorder of that description performs a service no indexation could conceivably supply.
