I have devised no arrangements for what becomes of it, and the omission is deliberate rather than careless. An executor will eventually examine four hundred pages of other people's remarks, and will glean very little about my biography and rather a great deal about my ear. That seems the appropriate proportion, and anything genuinely mine in there arrived by accident, in the margins, in handwriting I can barely decipher. It habitually takes the form of an objection to something I had transcribed approvingly the year before. Attribution, in the end, matters less than the accumulated evidence of an ear at work.
qs: How does the writer describe the relationship between himself and the notebook?
The notebook shows his preferences more reliably than he can state them.
He selects the sentences, though the notebook keeps only his approvals.
The notebook records his days while he supplies all of the opinions.
He set out to record his own taste, and the notebook has obliged him.

qs.evidence: The collection registers what I return to, and I merely operate the pen.
qs.answer: The notebook shows his preferences more reliably than he can state them.
qs.why: Kalimat itu memberi peran mencatat kepada koleksinya dan menyisakan pekerjaan mekanis bagi penulisnya, lalu kalimat sesudahnya menambahkan bahwa preferensi tampak secara statistik, dalam pengulangan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi dia yang memilih membalik “The collection registers what I return to, and I merely operate the pen”; opsi buku yang mencatat hari-harinya bertabrakan dengan kalimat pembuka, “The notebook is not a diary”; opsi berniat merekam seleranya sendiri bertabrakan dengan “assembled without a system” dan dengan preferensi yang muncul secara statistik.

qs: What can be inferred from the afternoons he describes in the third paragraph?
He has grown more attentive to his friends than he used to be.
His friends have worked out that their remarks get written down.
The habit has begun to shape the way he listens to other people.
He now avoids conversations that offer him nothing worth keeping.

qs.evidence: There are afternoons when I catch myself anticipating that an acquaintance will phrase her grief memorably.
qs.answer: The habit has begun to shape the way he listens to other people.
qs.why: Kalimat sebelumnya menyebut kebiasaan membawa wadah kalimat orang lain mengubah pendengaran biasa menjadi semacam pemanenan, dan kalimat ini contohnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi sama lugasnya dan sama-sama sejalan dengan tesis bahwa mengumpulkan mengubah pengumpulnya. Opsi lebih perhatian kepada kawan membalik nilai pengakuannya, sebab kalimat sesudahnya menyebutnya “a shabby discovery”. Opsi kawan-kawannya yang tahu nggak pernah disinggung teks. Opsi menghindari percakapan tertentu bertabrakan dengan klausa “the noticing continues regardless”.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards this discovery about himself?
Quietly pleased at an instinct most collectors would frankly envy.
Honest discomfort, offered without any attempt at an excuse.
Ruefully resigned, since the noticing does nobody any real harm.
Wryly detached, as though the discovery concerned somebody else.

qs.evidence: That is a shabby discovery to register about oneself, and I possess no defence except that the noticing continues regardless.
qs.answer: Honest discomfort, offered without any attempt at an excuse.
qs.why: Dua tanda dipasang berdampingan: kata “shabby” untuk temuan itu, dan pengakuan nggak punya pembelaan apa pun.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi merasa senang bertabrakan dengan kata “shabby”; opsi nggak merugikan siapa pun justru menyediakan pembelaan yang klausa “I possess no defence” tolak, dan bertabrakan dengan “not entirely benign”; opsi berjarak bertabrakan dengan frasa “about oneself”, yang menaruh temuan itu pada dirinya sendiri.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the description of the book as a companion?
The notebook behaves like a slow friend who disagrees with him.
The notebook works much as a well-kept database might in the end.
The notebook confirms whatever he had intended to write next.
The notebook has grown more agreeable, though his intentions multiplied.

qs.evidence: A commonplace book is not a database but an unhurried companion with its own opinions, and it has been arguing with my intentions since a summer when I owned considerably fewer of them.
qs.answer: The notebook behaves like a slow friend who disagrees with him.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menolak satu perbandingan lalu memasang gantinya: bukan basis data, melainkan kawan yang nggak tergesa dan berpendapat sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi basis data persis yang ditolak kalimat itu, “not a database but an unhurried companion”; opsi menegaskan niat menulisnya bertabrakan dengan “dismantles the paragraph I had intended”; opsi makin akur membalik kata “arguing with my intentions”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The notebook is a record of the writer's own daily experiences."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The notebook is a record of the writer's own daily experiences.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The notebook is not a diary, and I have wearied of clarifying the distinction at dinner parties.
qs.why: Teks menegaskan itu bukan buku harian, jadi klaim ini bertentangan langsung dengan kalimat pertamanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan kata “not a diary”, dan “Not stated” gagal karena perbedaannya justru dijelaskan.

topic: keeping a commonplace notebook of other people's sentences
author: Larissa Danuwira
setting: a reflective essay on notebooks and attention

title: The Arithmetic in the Margins
text:
My father produced each item in block capitals, from the earliest postcard through to the concluding inventory of the toolshed, and I assumed for three decades that the habit reflected idiosyncratic taste. It reflected nothing of the sort, since relentless correction at school for an irregular script had been resolved by abandoning the lower case entirely. He never divulged the decision, which reached me only through an aunt, three months after the funeral, in a kitchen crowded with unwashed crockery.

The letters themselves were not affectionate in any recognizable idiom, and no plausible reading extracts tenderness from their surfaces. He reported on the roof channels, the outlay on cement, the performance of a second-hand water pump he mistrusted throughout. Sentences began with the item and concluded with the expense, and read at twenty they demonstrated that my father had no message whatever to convey. Read at forty-one, they establish that the channels were the ostensible subject and simultaneously beside the point. Emotional information, in his correspondence, invariably travelled disguised as household maintenance, and the disguise was never once lifted.

What I had failed to observe, across two decades of dutiful reading, was the arithmetic in the margins. Every missive harbours a minute calculation in the left-hand corner, invariably the same shape: an amount, a subtraction, a remainder. It required my sister to decode what had been present for two decades. He was establishing, monthly, precisely what remained once the household expenditure had been discharged. That surplus could then be dispatched towards a daughter at university plus a son who had elected an unremunerative discipline. The surplus was the affectionate portion, expressed in the only notation he entirely trusted. Provision constituted the available vocabulary for affection, and the vocabulary proved adequate once somebody consented to translate it.

His handwriting survives across twenty-three letters plus one recipe, and not a single envelope has been discarded. This is not sentiment of the manageable variety, but something closer to evidence, retained against the temptation to reconstruct him as warmer or colder than he actually was, since both revisions remain available and both would be comprehensively false. Sentimentality simplifies a father into caricature, whereas documentation resists that simplification entirely.

He signed each item with his complete name, including the postcards, a habit formerly comic and now legible as something else entirely. A man corrected for his handwriting was unlikely to tolerate any ambiguity about the identity of the speaker. Legibility, for a man once humiliated over his penmanship, was never a neutral preference but a modest daily refusal. I compose in a minute illegible cursive that nobody can decipher, its author included, and no schoolmaster has ever once corrected it, which summarizes the entire inheritance within a single line. He purchased my carelessness, and he performed the calculation in the corner monthly for eleven years without once disclosing the arrangement to anybody.
qs: Read as a whole, what understanding of his father’s letters does the writer arrive at?
The letters were kept as evidence rather than as objects of sentiment.
His father's care showed up in figures rather than in any words.
The block capitals came from school corrections rather than from taste.
His own illegible hand was bought rather than chosen for himself.

qs.evidence: Emotional information, in his correspondence, invariably travelled disguised as household maintenance, and the disguise was never once lifted.
qs.answer: His father's care showed up in figures rather than in any words.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menamai pola seluruh esainya, dan paragraf tiga menutupnya dengan menyebut sisa hitungan sebagai bagian yang penuh kasih, dinyatakan dalam notasi yang paling dia percaya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai rangka “X rather than Y” yang sama, jadi bentuknya nggak menunjuk kunci. Opsi surat sebagai bukti adalah pendirian paragraf empat tentang cara menyimpannya. Opsi huruf kapital adalah penjelasan paragraf satu tentang kebiasaan menulisnya. Opsi tulisan tangannya sendiri adalah baris penutup yang merangkum warisannya, sedangkan yang ditanya apa yang akhirnya dia pahami dari surat-surat itu, “Emotional information … travelled disguised as household maintenance”.

qs: What can be inferred about how long the margins went unread?
His sister supplied an explanation the letters may not really support.
The calculations were added to the letters only in the final years.
He had been looking at the evidence for years without reading it.
He had half-understood the margins, though only after his sister spoke.

qs.evidence: It required my sister to decode what had been present for two decades.
qs.answer: He had been looking at the evidence for years without reading it.
qs.why: Kalimat itu memasang dua hal sekaligus: bahannya udah ada selama dua dekade, dan pembacaannya baru datang dari kakaknya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penjelasan yang nggak didukung bertabrakan dengan hitungan yang memang ada di setiap surat; opsi hitungan yang baru ditambahkan di tahun terakhir bertabrakan dengan “Every missive harbours a minute calculation”; opsi separuh mengerti lebih dulu bertabrakan dengan “It required my sister to decode what had been present for two decades”.

qs: How has the writer's view of his father's full signature changed?
What once seemed funny is perhaps funnier now that he knows why.
What once seemed funny now reads as a claim to be recognized.
What once seemed touching now looks like ordinary business practice.
What once seemed funny now looks like fussiness, though a mild sort.

qs.evidence: A man corrected for his handwriting was unlikely to tolerate any ambiguity about the identity of the speaker.
qs.answer: What once seemed funny now reads as a claim to be recognized.
qs.why: Kalimat itu menjelaskan tanda tangan lengkap itu sebagai penolakan atas keraguan tentang siapa yang berbicara, dan kalimat sesudahnya menyebutnya penolakan kecil sehari-hari.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi makin lucu bertabrakan dengan “now legible as something else entirely”; opsi dulu mengharukan menukar penilaian awalnya, yang teks sebut “formerly comic”; opsi kerewelan administratif melewatkan sebab yang diberikan kalimat berikutnya, yaitu penolakan atas ambiguitas tentang siapa yang berbicara.

qs: Which statement comes closest in meaning to the final sentence about carelessness?
His father wrote badly, perhaps because nobody corrected him at school.
The arrangement was explained to the family once the letters stopped.
He paid for his own education, though across eleven years of letters.
His freedom to write badly was paid for quietly by his father.

qs.evidence: He purchased my carelessness, and he performed the calculation in the corner monthly for eleven years without once disclosing the arrangement to anybody.
qs.answer: His freedom to write badly was paid for quietly by his father.
qs.why: Kata “purchased” memasang ayahnya sebagai pembayar dan kelalaian penulis sebagai barang yang dibeli, lalu klausa penutupnya menambahkan bahwa pengaturan itu nggak pernah diberitahukan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi ayah nggak pernah dikoreksi bertabrakan dengan “relentless correction at school”; opsi pengaturan yang dijelaskan kepada keluarga bertabrakan dengan “without once disclosing the arrangement to anybody”; opsi membayar pendidikannya sendiri membalik arah uangnya, sebab surplus itu dikirim kepada anak-anaknya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer learnt the reason for the capital letters from a relative."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer learnt the reason for the capital letters from a relative.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: He never divulged the decision, which reached me only through an aunt, three months after the funeral, in a kitchen crowded with unwashed crockery.
qs.why: Alasan huruf kapital itu sampai kepadanya lewat bibinya, jadi klaim ini parafrasa yang tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” bertentangan dengan kalimat itu, dan “Not stated” gagal karena sumber informasinya disebut.

topic: a father's letters and the calculations in their margins
author: Ilham Setyanto
setting: a reflective essay on family letters

title: The Comfort of the Single Number
text:
Each week a headline proclaims that researchers have finally settled something of importance. The verb is revealing: to settle a dispute is to conclude an argument and restore the furniture to its accustomed position. Yet the studies that lie beneath such headlines seldom conclude anything whatever. They narrow a range, adjust a probability, and bequeath to the following investigator a marginally sharper question. What reaches the public, however, is a solitary figure, stripped of the modest brackets that formerly enclosed it.

Those brackets are not ornament, since a confidence interval registers how far a measurement might wander were the same study repeated. Suppose a bulletin asserts that a treatment diminishes risk by twelve per cent, the interval extending from three to twenty-one. The candid summary is therefore that the effect is probably genuine and probably rather slight. Editors dislike such a sentence, which possesses no shape you can insert into a coloured panel above a photograph. So the brackets are silently deleted, and the twelve survives alone, appearing far sturdier than it ever was.

The practice is not merely negligence, because audiences reward certainty and pay remarkably little for honest doubt. So do funding bodies, ministers, and committees obliged to determine something before Friday afternoon. A researcher announcing mixed evidence invariably sounds weaker than a colleague announcing unambiguous evidence. That holds even where the cautious speaker is describing the world considerably more faithfully. Uncertainty, in short, is expensive to articulate and cheap to disregard, and the market for it remains thin.

A further penalty exists, and it descends upon the sciences rather than upon the newspapers that shorten them. If every finding is proclaimed a settlement, every subsequent revision begins to resemble a scandal. The public thereby absorbs a peculiar lesson concerning the very institutions it is invited to trust. It concludes that researchers constantly alter their opinions, as though revising a judgement under fresh evidence were a defect of character rather than the entire method. Confidence erodes, then, not because the science was mistaken, but because it was oversold from the outset.

None of this argues for retreat into fog, and the scientist sheltering behind qualifications fails in the contrary direction. The valuable discipline is to state what is known, to state how firmly it is known, and to hold both claims within a single sentence. That is considerably harder than it sounds, and it will never sit comfortably atop a crowded page. Audiences, however, are not infants, and a declared range is no confession of failure. It is simply the shape that an honest answer has always assumed.
qs: Read as a whole, which argument does the essay ultimately press about single figures?
Trust erodes from overselling, though the newspapers carry most of the blame.
Deleting the stated range flatters readers and slowly wears away trust.
The bare figure deceives, so honest work should hedge nearly every claim.
Overselling costs trust, and audiences must be taught to read ranges first.

qs.evidence: Confidence erodes, then, not because the science was mistaken, but because it was oversold from the outset.
qs.answer: Deleting the stated range flatters readers and slowly wears away trust.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang kepercayaan runtuh bukan karena sainsnya salah tapi karena dijual kelewat yakin. Yang dijual kelewat yakin adalah angka tunggal tanpa rentangnya, dan itu isi kunci ini.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh menerima tesis bahwa penjualan-kelewat-yakin merusak kepercayaan, tapi salah sasaran atau derajat. Opsi kesalahan surat kabar dipatahkan “it descends upon the sciences rather than upon the newspapers that shorten them”; opsi melindungi diri dengan kualifikasi dipatahkan “the scientist sheltering behind qualifications fails in the contrary direction”; opsi pembaca harus dilatih dulu dipatahkan “Audiences, however, are not infants”.

qs: What does the essay suggest about the editors who remove the brackets?
They may act partly out of contempt for readers weak at sums.
They are meeting a demand for tidy claims rather than inventing figures.
They keep the range but shift it out of the headline into the body text.
They perhaps take a stated range to be a way of dodging a verdict.

qs.evidence: Editors dislike such a sentence, which possesses no shape you can insert into a coloured panel above a photograph.
qs.answer: They are meeting a demand for tidy claims rather than inventing figures.
qs.why: Alasan yang dikasih teks buat editor cuma soal bentuk yang bisa dipasang di panel berwarna, dan paragraf berikutnya bilang pembaca memang membayar mahal buat kepastian. Jadi editor melayani permintaan, bukan mengarang angka.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi merendahkan pembaca bertabrakan dengan “Audiences, however, are not infants” dan dengan sebab yang diberikan, yaitu permintaan pasar; opsi rentang yang dipindah ke badan berita bertabrakan dengan “the brackets are silently deleted”; opsi menganggap rentang sebagai penghindaran keputusan adalah reaksi pendengar dan lembaga dana, bukan editornya.

qs: How would you describe the writer's tone in the third paragraph?
Drily ironic about the low market value of honest hesitation.
Coolly neutral, listing incentives while appraising none of them.
Quietly indignant on behalf of researchers who report mixed evidence.
Wryly forgiving of editors who must, after all, fill a page by Friday.

qs.evidence: Uncertainty, in short, is expensive to articulate and cheap to disregard, and the market for it remains thin.
qs.answer: Drily ironic about the low market value of honest hesitation.
qs.why: Paragraf itu ngomongin keraguan pakai bahasa dagang: mahal diucapkan, murah diabaikan, pasarnya tipis. Itu ironi yang kering, bukan kemarahan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi netral bertabrakan dengan penilaian yang jelas di “expensive to articulate and cheap to disregard”; opsi memaafkan editor memindahkan tenggat hari Jumat, yang di paragraf itu milik komite, bukan editor; opsi geram atas nama peneliti melebihi nada paragraf itu, yang mendeskripsikan insentif dengan getir, bukan membela pihak.

qs: In the second paragraph, what do the "brackets" stand for?
The pair of marks an editor deletes around a printed remark.
The span inside which a repeated measurement would probably fall.
The range of earnings within which one rate of tax applies.
The margin by which one measurement exceeded an earlier one.

qs.evidence: Those brackets are not ornament, since a confidence interval registers how far a measurement might wander were the same study repeated.
qs.answer: The span inside which a repeated measurement would probably fall.
qs.why: Kalimatnya langsung menyamakan tanda kurung itu dengan confidence interval, yaitu seberapa jauh hasil bisa bergeser kalau studinya diulang. Jadi yang dimaksud rentang angkanya, bukan tanda bacanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh adalah definisi yang sama presisinya untuk makna lain kata itu, dan masing-masing dipatahkan satu isyarat. Opsi tanda baca yang dihapus dan opsi lapisan tarif pajak gugur karena kalimat itu memasangkan kata itu dengan “a confidence interval registers how far a measurement might wander”; opsi selisih dua pengukuran gugur karena frasa penentunya “were the same study repeated”, yaitu pengukuran yang sama diulang, bukan dibandingkan dengan pengukuran lain.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Audiences usually receive one bare figure, with the surrounding range removed."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Audiences usually receive one bare figure, with the surrounding range removed.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: What reaches the public, however, is a solitary figure, stripped of the modest brackets that formerly enclosed it.
qs.why: Teks bilang yang sampai ke publik cuma satu angka, dilepas dari tanda kurung yang tadinya nemenin. Klaimnya cuma ganti pilihan kata, isinya sama, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh teks yang nyatakan kebalikannya, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” juga gagal karena kalimat itu terang-terangan nyebut angka tunggal tanpa rentangnya.

author: Adila Rahmawati
setting: the science pages of the daily press

title: How a Journey Became an Ascent
text:
Keywords seldom arrive fully formed; they are assembled gradually, out of older quarrels, and then presented to subsequent generations as plain common sense. The term progress supplies a particularly instructive instance of the process. During the seventeenth century it still bore its literal sense of a journey, a royal procession advancing from one town to the next. Only afterwards did it acquire the meaning of ascent, a movement upward through time, in which each century supposedly surpassed the one preceding it.

The transformation depended upon two borrowed ideas that had remarkably little to do with each other. The first emerged from the workshop, where instruments and techniques genuinely did accumulate, so that a later craftsman commenced where an earlier one had halted. The second descended from theology, which had long conceived history as a single narrative possessing a destination. Once the accumulating workshop was fitted into the theological narrative, a formidable hybrid emerged. History could now be depicted as an upward road, furnished with measurable milestones and no serious prospect of return.

Nineteenth-century writers found this hybrid extremely convenient, and they applied it far beyond the workshop. Legal codes, languages, diets, and entire societies were arranged along the same imagined road. Those situated near its terminus recognized themselves as advanced, and the arrangement conveniently justified whatever they were already undertaking. The term had thereby become an argument, although it continued to resemble a mere description. Such is the hushed power of a keyword: it settles a contest before the contest has been declared.

Historians of ideas therefore treat such vocabulary as evidence rather than as neutral instruments. When a nineteenth-century official records that a province is making progress, the sentence documents his standards, not the province's condition. Reading it as a fact repeats his verdict; reading it as a claim exposes that verdict to inspection. The distinction matters most where the vocabulary still feels natural, because a word that feels natural is a word that has ceased to be examined. Few terms feel more natural presently than the one traced here.

This is not an argument that nothing improves, which would be a foolish position to defend. Water supplies improve, techniques sharpen, and certain cruelties genuinely recede within a single lifetime. The argument is narrower and considerably more awkward than that. It concerns the transition from numerous separate improvements, each with its own measure, to a solitary upward line along which everything is supposed to travel together. That line was drawn by particular individuals for particular purposes, and it can be redrawn.
qs: What is the relationship between the workshop idea and the theological idea in this account?
Accumulation came from the workshop and direction from theology, and the two fused.
Accumulation came from theology and direction from the workshop, and the two fused.
Theology took in the workshop's gains, though the milestones were quietly given up.
Each kept a separate measure, while the upward road came from a third quarrel.

qs.evidence: Once the accumulating workshop was fitted into the theological narrative, a formidable hybrid emerged.
qs.answer: Accumulation came from the workshop and direction from theology, and the two fused.
qs.why: Teks bilang bengkel itulah tempat alat dan teknik benar-benar menumpuk, sementara teologi yang sejak lama membayangkan sejarah sebagai satu cerita dengan tujuan. Begitu keduanya dipasang jadi satu, muncul hibrida jalan menanjak itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk dua-arah yang sama, jadi bentuk yang rapi nggak menandai kunci. Opsi peran yang dibalik gugur karena teologi lah yang “had long conceived history as a single narrative possessing a destination”; opsi milestone yang dilepas gugur karena hibridanya justru “furnished with measurable milestones”; opsi ukuran yang tetap terpisah gugur karena kata “hybrid” di kalimat yang sama.

qs: What does the article imply about words that feel entirely natural to us?
Their very steadiness may be what disqualifies them as historical evidence.
They lose their force precisely once a historian traces where they began.
They pass unexamined because they carry no verdict, only a description.
They are questioned least and therefore stand most in need of inspection.

qs.evidence: The distinction matters most where the vocabulary still feels natural, because a word that feels natural is a word that has ceased to be examined.
qs.answer: They are questioned least and therefore stand most in need of inspection.
qs.why: Kalau kata yang terasa wajar adalah kata yang berhenti diperiksa, justru di situlah pemeriksaan paling dibutuhkan. Teks bilang bedanya paling penting tepat ketika kosakatanya masih terasa wajar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh memakai inversi yang sama dengan kunci, jadi bentuknya nggak lagi membocorkan. Opsi keteguhan yang mendiskualifikasi sebagai bukti dipatahkan “treat such vocabulary as evidence rather than as neutral instruments”; opsi kehilangan daya setelah dilacak menambah akibat yang nggak dinyatakan, sebab yang dijanjikan teks hanya “exposes that verdict to inspection”; opsi tanpa putusan dipatahkan “The term had thereby become an argument, although it continued to resemble a mere description”.

qs: Which description best fits the writer's stance towards nineteenth-century usage?
Sceptical and unsparing, treating the usage as a deliberate imposture.
Sceptical of the craftsmen's claims rather than of the writers who borrowed them.
Sceptical but measured, granting the term's use while exposing its interest.
Measured and largely approving, since one road at least made comparison possible.

qs.evidence: Those situated near its terminus recognized themselves as advanced, and the arrangement conveniently justified whatever they were already undertaking.
qs.answer: Sceptical but measured, granting the term's use while exposing its interest.
qs.why: Kata “conveniently justified whatever they were already undertaking” itu tuduhan kepentingan, tapi penulis tetap ngaku hibridanya “extremely convenient” dan berguna. Jadi curiga yang terukur.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh setuju bahwa pemakaian abad ke-19 itu berkepentingan, tapi salah derajat atau salah sasaran. Opsi penipuan yang disengaja terlalu keras, sebab teks mengakui alatnya “genuinely did accumulate” dan menyebut daya kata kunci itu “hushed”; opsi menyalahkan pengrajin salah sasaran karena yang dipersoalkan penulis yang memakai jalan itu, bukan bengkelnya; opsi cenderung setuju dipatahkan “the arrangement conveniently justified whatever they were already undertaking”.

qs: Which sentence best restates the final paragraph's argument?
Separate gains are real, while the single ascent they compose was inevitable.
Separate gains are real, while folding them into one ascent remains a choice.
Separate gains are doubtful, while the one ascent they compose is measurable.
One ascent is real, while the separate gains beneath it are largely borrowed.

qs.evidence: It concerns the transition from numerous separate improvements, each with its own measure, to a solitary upward line along which everything is supposed to travel together.
qs.answer: Separate gains are real, while folding them into one ascent remains a choice.
qs.why: Paragraf akhir ngaku ada perbaikan nyata, lalu mempersoalkan langkah dari banyak perbaikan berukuran sendiri-sendiri jadi satu garis naik yang harus dilalui semuanya. Itu isi kunci ini.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk kontras dua-arah yang sama, dan tiap pengecoh menggeser tepat satu elemen klaim sumbernya. Opsi jalan yang tak terelakkan menggeser derajat dan dipatahkan “That line was drawn by particular individuals for particular purposes, and it can be redrawn”; opsi perbaikan yang diragukan menggeser klaim yang justru diakui, “Water supplies improve, techniques sharpen”; opsi tanjakan nyata dan perbaikan pinjaman membalik arah pengakuannya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "In the seventeenth century the word already meant an upward movement through time."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: In the seventeenth century the word already meant an upward movement through time.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: During the seventeenth century it still bore its literal sense of a journey, a royal procession advancing from one town to the next.
qs.why: Teks bilang di abad ke-17 kata itu masih berarti perjalanan harfiah, dan makna naik-ke-atas baru datang belakangan. Klaimnya jadi kebalikan langsung, alias False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bakal nabrak kalimat tentang prosesi kerajaan itu. “Not stated” juga salah karena kronologinya disebut terang-terangan.

author: Bram Setiadi
setting: a study in the history of ideas

title: Rehearsed Surprise
text:
The encore is the least spontaneous spontaneous act in all of public life. Everyone in the auditorium is aware it is imminent, including the performer who has already selected the piece. The applause that summons it is not a request but a cue, delivered punctually by an audience that has learnt its part. And yet the fiction holds: the player appears briefly astonished, the hall performs its delight, and something authentic somehow survives the entire transparent arrangement.

Part of the explanation resides in what the printed programme simply cannot accomplish. A concert is a formal object, timed and published, and its architecture must be honoured from the opening note. The encore sits outside that architecture, which is precisely why it may be brief, eccentric, or sentimental without reproach. Here the cellist offers a folk tune from her grandmother's village; there the pianist supplies ninety seconds of something composed for a forgotten film. Nothing is at stake, and the absence of stakes constitutes the entire point, since this is the one moment when the evening is permitted to be merely likeable.

The ritual also settles a debt that the printed programme leaves permanently outstanding. For two hours the audience has been silent, obedient, and largely invisible in the darkness. Nobody has spoken; nobody has been observed; the transaction has proceeded in a single direction. The encore inverts that arrangement briefly, because the clamour of the auditorium now produces the music rather than merely accompanying it. The performer, for one piece, is responding rather than delivering. The gesture, however slight, converts an audience from a collection of ticket holders into a body that has accomplished something collectively.

Cynics observe how thoroughly the whole affair is managed, and they are not mistaken. Encores are timed against the final train; the folk tune has been performed in eleven cities this month; the astonishment on the performer's countenance is a rehearsed skill like any other. But this objection confuses ritual with outright deception. Nobody attends a wedding supposing the vows were composed that morning, and the rehearsed quality of the phrases is precisely what permits them to carry weight.

What would be forfeited if the encore were simply printed in the programme, honestly and in advance? Something modest, certainly, but not nothing at all. The listener would still hear the folk tune, yet would no longer have summoned it, and the distinction between receiving and requesting is the distinction the ritual protects. An audience that never requests anything eventually ceases to expect a response. That may explain why the pretence survives every generation of critics who patiently expose it.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer establish about the encore?
Its staged quality works, though only if the hall forgets the staging.
Its openly staged quality is what lets it do real work for a hall.
Its staged quality matters because a programme cannot hold short pieces.
Its staged quality repays a debt, and that repayment is its whole value.

qs.evidence: But this objection confuses ritual with outright deception.
qs.answer: Its openly staged quality is what lets it do real work for a hall.
qs.why: Penulis ngakuin semua orang tahu encore-nya bakal datang, lalu bilang keberatan para sinis keliru menyamakan ritual dengan penipuan. Jadi justru sifat yang dipentaskan terbuka itu yang bikin encore bekerja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sepakat bahwa yang bekerja adalah sifat panggungnya yang terbuka, tapi salah satu unsurnya digeser. Opsi penonton yang lupa dipatahkan “Everyone in the auditorium is aware it is imminent”; opsi program cetak dan opsi utang yang dibayar masing-masing mengambil satu alasan pendukung yang dibuka “Part of the explanation resides in” dan menjadikannya seluruh nilai, padahal keberatan sinislah yang dijawab “this objection confuses ritual with outright deception”.

qs: What can be inferred about the audience's silence during the main programme?
It leaves the hall passive, which the encore then briefly reverses.
It shows that convention asks more discipline of listeners than of players.
It is the attention that the printed architecture is designed to earn.
It is broken only by applause the performer has quietly requested.

qs.evidence: For two hours the audience has been silent, obedient, and largely invisible in the darkness.
qs.answer: It leaves the hall passive, which the encore then briefly reverses.
qs.why: Dua jam duduk diam, patuh, dan nyaris nggak kelihatan itu posisi pasif, dan teks bilang encore “inverts that arrangement briefly” karena keriuhan penonton yang memunculkan musiknya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Disiplin yang lebih berat di sisi penonton gugur karena teks juga menempelkan disiplin ke pemain: penontonnya “has learnt its part” dan keheranan pemain disebut “a rehearsed skill like any other”. Perhatian yang layak diraih gugur karena keheningan itu digambarkan sebagai transaksi satu arah tempat nggak ada yang bicara atau diperhatikan. Dan permintaan pemain gugur karena tepuk tangannya disebut “not a request but a cue” yang datang dari penonton.

qs: How does the writer handle the cynics' objection?
By granting the facts while narrowing his own claim to fit them.
By granting the facts while blaming the cynics' taste rather than their logic.
By granting the facts while rejecting the conclusion drawn from them.
By granting the facts while denying that the astonishment is rehearsed.

qs.evidence: Cynics observe how thoroughly the whole affair is managed, and they are not mistaken.
qs.answer: By granting the facts while rejecting the conclusion drawn from them.
qs.why: Penulis bilang para sinis “are not mistaken” soal faktanya, lalu bilang keberatan itu “confuses ritual with outright deception”. Faktanya diterima, simpulannya ditolak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk “mengakui faktanya sambil …”, jadi bentuknya nggak menandai kunci; tiap pengecoh menggeser satu langkah. Opsi mempersempit klaim sendiri dipatahkan “this objection confuses ritual with outright deception”, yang menolak simpulannya alih-alih mengecilkan klaim; opsi menyalahkan selera menukar sasaran, sebab yang dibantah adalah penyimpulannya; opsi keheranan yang nggak dilatih dipatahkan “a rehearsed skill like any other”.

qs: In the second paragraph, what does "architecture" refer to?
The design of the hall, though only where the concert is given.
The published shape of the evening, timed and fixed in advance.
The pattern of applause the audience has learnt to deliver.
The order in which the printed pieces may grow more difficult.

qs.evidence: The encore sits outside that architecture, which is precisely why it may be brief, eccentric, or sentimental without reproach.
qs.answer: The published shape of the evening, timed and fixed in advance.
qs.why: Kalimat sebelumnya bilang konser itu “a formal object, timed and published, and its architecture must be honoured from the opening note”. Jadi yang dimaksud susunan acara yang udah dipatok, bukan bangunannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi rancangan gedung memakai arti “architecture” yang paling umum, padahal kalimat ini menyebutnya “a formal object, timed and published”; opsi urutan tingkat kesulitan menambahkan pola yang nggak disebut; opsi pola tepuk tangan adalah isyarat penonton di paragraf satu, bukan bentuk resmi malam itu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The applause before an encore functions as a signal rather than a genuine plea."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The applause before an encore functions as a signal rather than a genuine plea.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The applause that summons it is not a request but a cue, delivered punctually by an audience that has learnt its part.
qs.why: Teks bilang tepuk tangan itu bukan permintaan tapi isyarat yang datang tepat waktu. Klaimnya sama, cuma pakai kata lain, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” perlu teks yang bilang tepuk tangan itu permohonan sungguhan, dan itu justru yang dibantah. “Not stated” gagal karena kalimatnya jelas.

topic: the ritual of the concert encore
author: Citra Wibowo
setting: a concert hall after the printed programme ends

title: Nine Metres Behind the Depot
text:
There is a strip of neglected ground behind the bus depot that belongs to nobody in particular. It measures nine metres across, is fenced along one flank, and appears on the district survey as an unshaded interval between two numbered plots. I have trudged past it for eleven years, and recently I began pausing there, largely because I had exhausted my pretexts for hurrying.

Nothing whatever has been designed here, and that is the initial circumstance any attentive observer registers. Buddleia has colonized the brickwork, willowherb the gravel, and a fig has established itself beneath a leaking downpipe. Somebody deposited two crates, which were subsequently adopted as a seat and then abandoned again to the weather. Cigarette stubs trace a rough circle, which suggests that individuals congregate here in twos and threes, beyond the sightlines of the depot itself. None of this was planned by anyone, yet it possesses an unmistakable order, and that order was inscribed by use rather than by drawing.

Architects possess a term for such locations, and the term amounts to a modest professional confession. They are termed residual, as though the metropolis were an arithmetical calculation and these were the figures remaining once the sum had been completed. The label is accurate and faintly clinical: residual space is whatever the drawings could not absorb, and every scheme generates some, however meticulous the planner has been. An urban fabric containing no residual ground would be a settlement in which every square metre had been assigned a purpose by an individual who does not reside there.

I shall not pretend that the strip behind the depot is attractive, because it is not, and the assertion would be sentimental nonsense. In humid conditions it smells distinctly of diesel and rotting cardboard. But it is the only ground within a kilometre where a pedestrian may loiter without purchasing anything, awaiting anything, or being ushered politely along. Its value consists precisely in its lack of function, and function is the one commodity that improvement unfailingly imports.

In April the fence was renewed, the brambles were cut back and the crates vanished. A notice announced a forthcoming scheme of tidying, comprising three trees and a paved path. I discovered that I minded considerably more than I could justify to anybody who enquired. Three mature trees are preferable to none, and a paved path is unquestionably preferable to February mud. Nevertheless, once the path materializes, the strip will ultimately have been granted a function. Those who once gathered there in twos and threes will migrate to some further gap that the plan has not yet registered.
qs: What is the relationship between the absence of a plan and the order the writer finds?
The order grew out of repeated use because nothing had been drawn first.
The order may be the writer's own reading of ground that has none.
The order came from the survey, though it only fixed the strip's edges.
The order is the remnant of a scheme the depot abandoned years ago.

qs.evidence: None of this was planned by anyone, yet it possesses an unmistakable order, and that order was inscribed by use rather than by drawing.
qs.answer: The order grew out of repeated use because nothing had been drawn first.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang nggak ada yang merencanakan apa pun di situ, tapi tempatnya punya tatanan yang jelas, dan tatanan itu ditulis oleh pemakaian bukan oleh gambar. Jadi ketiadaan rancangan justru syaratnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tafsiran penulis bertabrakan dengan “it possesses an unmistakable order”, yang dinyatakan sebagai temuan, bukan bacaan; opsi berasal dari survei bertabrakan dengan “inscribed by use rather than by drawing”; opsi sisa rencana lama menambahkan riwayat yang nggak ada.

qs: What does the passage imply about the notice announcing the scheme?
The strip will gain a keeper, which is what the crates were said to lack.
The trees will be resented, though not for any charm the brambles had.
The gatherers will stay on, though the plan has never registered them.
The strip will acquire a function, which is what it was valued for lacking.

qs.evidence: A notice announced a forthcoming scheme of tidying, comprising three trees and a paved path.
qs.answer: The strip will acquire a function, which is what it was valued for lacking.
qs.why: Penulis udah bilang nilai tempat itu justru ada pada ketiadaan fungsi, dan fungsi adalah barang yang selalu dibawa masuk oleh penataan. Jadi pemberitahuan itu memastikan nilai tadi bakal hilang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh memakai tanda yang sama dengan kunci, yaitu penolakan hiburan berbentuk “X, yang justru bukan Y”, tapi isinya salah. Opsi penjaga bagi tanah itu salah objek karena yang dinilai berharga adalah ketiadaan fungsi, “Its value consists precisely in its lack of function”; opsi pohon yang dibenci dipatahkan “Three mature trees are preferable to none”; opsi orang-orang yang tetap tinggal dipatahkan kalimat penutup, “will migrate to some further gap that the plan has not yet registered”.

qs: Which phrase best characterizes the writer's attitude in the final paragraph?
Regretful, though confident the objection could be defended in public.
Regretful about a change the writer cannot quite argue against.
Regretful, and openly indignant at whoever ordered the tidying.
Regretful, though chiefly for the crates and the vanished brambles.

qs.evidence: I discovered that I minded considerably more than I could justify to anybody who enquired.
qs.answer: Regretful about a change the writer cannot quite argue against.
qs.why: Penulis nulis “I minded considerably more than I could justify to anybody who enquired”. Itu kesal yang diakui sekaligus nggak bisa dibela, alias penyesalan setengah malu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi kini membuka dengan kata yang sama, jadi bentuknya nggak menandai kunci dan yang membedakan derajat serta sasarannya. Opsi keberatan yang bisa dibela dan opsi kemarahan terbuka dipatahkan satu frasa yang sama, “I minded considerably more than I could justify to anybody who enquired”; opsi menyesali krat dan bramble salah objek, sebab yang dinilai berharga adalah ketiadaan fungsi dan penulis justru menolak menyebut tempat itu menarik.

qs: Which sentence most closely restates the writer's explanation of the term used by architects?
It marks ground no drawing took in, though only where a planner was careless.
It marks ground that no drawing took in, however careful the planner.
It marks ground a drawing deliberately left out, though for people to use.
It marks ground the surveys did take in, though no owner was ever settled.

qs.evidence: The label is accurate and faintly clinical: residual space is whatever the drawings could not absorb, and every scheme generates some, however meticulous the planner has been.
qs.answer: It marks ground that no drawing took in, however careful the planner.
qs.why: Teks menjelaskan istilahnya: ruang residual adalah apa pun yang nggak bisa diserap gambar rancangan, dan tiap skema menghasilkan sebagiannya “however meticulous the planner has been”. Kunci menyatakan itu dengan kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk kontras yang sama, jadi kuncinya nggak bisa ditebak dari bentuknya, dan tiap pengecoh menggeser tepat satu elemen. Opsi perencana yang lalai dipatahkan “however meticulous the planner has been”; opsi ruang yang sengaja disisihkan dipatahkan “whatever the drawings could not absorb”; opsi tanah yang justru terdaftar memindahkan “an unshaded interval between two numbered plots” dari paragraf satu ke penjelasan istilahnya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer had been stopping at the strip regularly for the whole of the eleven years."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer had been stopping at the strip regularly for the whole of the eleven years.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: I have trudged past it for eleven years, and recently I began pausing there, largely because I had exhausted my pretexts for hurrying.
qs.why: Teks nyebut dua keterangan waktu yang beda: sebelas tahun itu lama dia berjalan lewat, sementara kebiasaan berhenti baru dimulai belakangan (“recently I began pausing there”). Jadi klaim bahwa dia rutin berhenti sepanjang sebelas tahun itu dikontradiksi teks, bukan cuma nggak disebut — kuncinya False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” cuma jalan kalau kamu menyamakan dua keterangan waktu yang sengaja dipisah penulis: berjalan lewat selama sebelas tahun vs mulai berhenti baru-baru ini. “Not stated” juga gagal karena teks nggak diam soal ini: kata “recently I began” jelas menempatkan kebiasaan berhenti di akhir rentang sebelas tahun, jadi durasinya terbantah, bukan dibiarkan kosong.

topic: leftover urban ground and its uses
author: Dania Prakoso
setting: a narrow strip of land behind a bus depot

title: The Look of Letting Go
text:
Rewilding arrived in public debate with an unusually attractive promise: step back, spend less, and permit a landscape to repair itself. The promise is not hollow, and several estates now support more insects, birds, and standing water than they did throughout a century of drainage. Yet the word conveys a second cargo, quieter and harder to defend, concerning what a repaired landscape ought to resemble. That second cargo is aesthetic rather than ecological, and it accounts for much of the controversy that follows any announcement.

Consider the thorn scrub that appears within four years of a fence coming down. Ecologically it is admirable, since it shelters seedlings, sustains finches, and retains the soil throughout winter rain. Visually it reads as neglect. Tidiness has functioned as a moral quality in the countryside for generations, and a straight-cut hedge has signified a household in respectable standing. The objection lodged at the parish meeting is rarely about biodiversity at all, whatever vocabulary is employed, and it will not be answered by a further leaflet crowded with species counts.

Advocates entertain their own version of the same confusion, and it deserves equal scrutiny. Photographs in the brochures display broad grassland, a distant herd, and a horizon uninterrupted by fences or sheds. This is not what most restored ground resembles in year six, when the scrub is impenetrable and the paths are muddy and closed. Marketing an image of open emptiness will produce visitors who feel cheated by the thicket that ecology genuinely requires. A promise made in pictures will be judged in pictures.

A further difficulty exists, which the more candid projects now concede in their annual reports. Permitting a landscape to decide for itself sounds like an absence of decisions, yet somebody determined which fences fell, which grazing animals arrived, and which year counted as the point of departure. Nothing in Britain has remained beyond human management long enough for a genuinely hands-off baseline to exist. The choice is between visible management and management that has been made to look like nature.

None of this constitutes a case against the practice, which on the evidence assembled so far does more good than harm. It is a case against the vocabulary of stepping back, which promises humility and delivers an unexamined preference. Declare instead that a particular stretch of ground is being managed for insects rather than for appearance, and that it will appear untidy for a decade. That sentence forfeits the romance. It also survives contact with the parish meeting, which the romance never does.
qs: What is the relationship between the two objections the essay examines?
Both grow out of expectations about appearance rather than out of ecology.
The first concerns appearance, while the second concerns the cost of grazing.
The second may answer the first by showing what the ground will look like.
Both might fall away if the species counts were explained locally.

qs.evidence: The objection lodged at the parish meeting is rarely about biodiversity at all, whatever vocabulary is employed, and it will not be answered by a further leaflet crowded with species counts.
qs.answer: Both grow out of expectations about appearance rather than out of ecology.
qs.why: Penolak menganggap belukar itu tanda terbengkalai; pendukung menjual foto padang terbuka. Dua-duanya soal tampilan, dan teks bilang keberatan rapat paroki “is rarely about biodiversity at all”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keberatan kedua yang menjawab yang pertama bertabrakan dengan kalimat “Advocates entertain their own version of the same confusion”, yang menempatkan keduanya pada akar yang sama; opsi hitungan spesies bertabrakan dengan “will not be answered by a further leaflet crowded with species counts”; opsi biaya penggembalaan menambahkan pokok yang nggak dibahas.

qs: What does the essay imply about a visitor arriving in the sixth year?
Such a visitor is likely to feel cheated, though mainly by the closed muddy paths.
Such a visitor is likely to feel cheated until a leaflet of counts explains the scrub.
Such a visitor is likely to feel misled by ground the brochures left out.
Such a visitor is likely to blame the ecology rather than the promising photographs.

qs.evidence: Marketing an image of open emptiness will produce visitors who feel cheated by the thicket that ecology genuinely requires.
qs.answer: Such a visitor is likely to feel misled by ground the brochures left out.
qs.why: Teks bilang menjual citra kekosongan terbuka bakal menghasilkan pengunjung yang merasa dikibulin oleh belukar yang justru dibutuhkan ekologi, dan tahun keenam persis saat belukarnya rapat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh memakai tanda kekecewaan yang sama dengan kunci, jadi register nggak lagi menandainya, tapi masing-masing salah objek. Opsi jalan berlumpur dipatahkan “visitors who feel cheated by the thicket that ecology genuinely requires”; opsi leaflet yang menjelaskan dipatahkan “it will not be answered by a further leaflet crowded with species counts”; opsi menyalahkan ekologinya dipatahkan “A promise made in pictures will be judged in pictures”.

qs: What is the writer's attitude towards the phrase about stepping back?
Approving, since the phrase names the restraint the practice really asks.
Critical, treating it as wording that dresses a decision up as restraint.
Wry, treating it as harmless brochure language nobody reads closely.
Guarded, since stepping back works on some stretches and not on others.

qs.evidence: It is a case against the vocabulary of stepping back, which promises humility and delivers an unexamined preference.
qs.answer: Critical, treating it as wording that dresses a decision up as restraint.
qs.why: Teks bilang ini “a case against the vocabulary of stepping back, which promises humility and delivers an unexamined preference”. Jadi frasanya dituduh menyamarkan keputusan sebagai penahanan diri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pujian gugur karena frasanya disebut menjanjikan kerendahan hati tapi menyerahkan selera yang nggak pernah diperiksa. Bahasa brosur tak berbahaya gugur karena justru dari kosakata itu teks menarik seluruh persoalannya. Dan sikap berjaga soal hasil yang berbeda-beda gugur karena pilihannya dirumuskan sebagai “visible management” lawan pengelolaan yang dibuat tampak seperti alam.

qs: In the second paragraph, what does "reads" describe?
Somebody works through a printed notice fixed to the parish fence.
A gauge set in the scrub yields a value fit to be recorded.
The soil's state is inferred from the pattern of the winter rain.
People looking at the scrub take what they see to mean neglect.

qs.evidence: Visually it reads as neglect.
qs.answer: People looking at the scrub take what they see to mean neglect.
qs.why: Kata “Visually” di depannya menaruh kalimat itu di ranah penafsiran pandangan mata: belukar yang secara ekologi bagus tetap terbaca sebagai terbengkalai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi sama-sama definisi tegas dan sama presisinya, tiga di antaranya untuk makna lain kata itu. Opsi membaca papan pengumuman dan opsi angka pada alat ukur gugur karena kalimatnya berbunyi “Visually it reads as neglect”, yaitu bagaimana mata orang menafsirkan, bukan menelusuri tulisan atau skala; opsi keadaan tanah memindahkan kata itu ke penyimpulan dari hujan, padahal subjeknya belukar yang dilihat.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Thorn scrub takes roughly twenty years to appear once a fence is removed."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Thorn scrub takes roughly twenty years to appear once a fence is removed.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Consider the thorn scrub that appears within four years of a fence coming down.
qs.why: Teks nyebut belukar berduri muncul dalam empat tahun setelah pagar dilepas. Klaim dua puluh tahun nukar angkanya, jadi kontradiksi langsung alias False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nabrak angka empat tahun di teks. “Not stated” salah karena tenggat waktunya justru disebut jelas.

topic: rewilding and the aesthetics of untidiness
author: Ellis Nurhadi
setting: estates and parish meetings in the British countryside

title: The Arithmetic of Disagreement
text:
A study that fails to reproduce an earlier result is customarily described as a failed replication, and the phrase quietly assigns blame. Something has gone wrong, the reader assumes, either in the original laboratory or in the one that followed it. Yet the arithmetic of sampling guarantees that some proportion of well-conducted studies will disagree, even where the underlying effect is perfectly stable. Disagreement is therefore not a symptom of incompetence but a predictable feature of measurement under variation. The vocabulary of failure nevertheless has consequences for reputations, for funding, and for the willingness of laboratories to publish inconvenient outcomes.

Pre-registration was introduced to address a narrower problem, namely the flexibility that a researcher retains after the data have arrived. Analytical choices are numerous: which participants to exclude, which measure to privilege, which comparison to report as the principal one. Each decision is defensible in isolation, and their combination can manufacture a convincing result from noise alone. By recording the intended analysis in advance, the investigator surrenders that flexibility and converts an ambiguous exercise into a genuine test. Nothing in the procedure prevents a foolish hypothesis from being tested, and nothing guarantees that the test will prove interesting.

The reform has been widely adopted, and its consequences are instructive rather than triumphant. Registered studies report smaller effects and null findings far more frequently than their unregistered predecessors. Critics interpret this as evidence that the literature was previously inflated, which is plausible but not the only available reading. Registration also discourages the exploratory work from which unexpected hypotheses have historically emerged. A discipline that registers everything may become reliable and simultaneously rather dull, and whether that trade is acceptable depends upon what a particular field most urgently lacks.

Two objectives are being conflated here, and separating them clarifies the disagreement considerably. Exploration generates candidate explanations; confirmation determines whether a candidate survives an honest attempt to refute it. Both are indispensable, and neither can substitute for the other without damage to the enterprise. Confirmation without prior exploration examines hypotheses that nobody had reason to entertain, while exploration without subsequent confirmation accumulates suggestions that nobody has tested. The methodological error lies not in exploring but in presenting exploration as though it had been confirmation.

For the reader outside the field, one practical inference follows from all of this. A single striking finding, however elegantly presented, warrants provisional interest rather than belief. The question worth asking is not whether a result is significant but whether anybody has yet attempted to reproduce it, and with what outcome. Until that question has an answer, the finding remains a hypothesis wearing formal clothing, and provisional interest is an underrated posture that costs remarkably little to maintain.
qs: Read as a whole, what does this article claim about disagreement between analysts?
The real fault is presenting exploratory work as a completed test.
The real fault is the phrase failed replication and the blame it assigns.
Sampling variation explains most disagreement between published studies.
Registration costs a discipline more in dullness than it can return.

qs.evidence: The methodological error lies not in exploring but in presenting exploration as though it had been confirmation.
qs.answer: The real fault is presenting exploratory work as a completed test.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang kesalahan metodologisnya bukan menjelajah, tapi menyajikan penjelajahan seolah-olah itu konfirmasi. Kunci ini nyatain hal yang sama pakai kata lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Kosakata “failed replication” gugur karena teks menaruhnya sebagai pembuka soal reputasi, sementara kata “The methodological error” dipasang di tempat lain. Variasi sampling gugur karena teks cuma bilang variasi itu menjamin “some proportion” studi berbeda, bukan sebagian besar. Dan kebosanan gugur karena teks menggantungnya: “whether that trade is acceptable depends upon what a particular field most urgently lacks”.

qs: What does the article imply about a researcher who makes several defensible choices?
Such a researcher may usually be caught by reviewers before publication.
Such a researcher has perhaps excluded participants for improper reasons.
Such a researcher may reach a convincing result without meaning to deceive.
Such a researcher will notice the combined effect while the choices are made.

qs.evidence: Each decision is defensible in isolation, and their combination can manufacture a convincing result from noise alone.
qs.answer: Such a researcher may reach a convincing result without meaning to deceive.
qs.why: Teks bilang tiap keputusan bisa dibela sendiri-sendiri, tapi gabungannya bisa memproduksi hasil yang meyakinkan dari derau belaka. Jadi hasil palsu bisa muncul tanpa niat menipu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tertangkap penelaah menambahkan pengawasan yang nggak dibahas paragraf itu; opsi mengeluarkan peserta dengan alasan nggak pantas bertabrakan dengan “Each decision is defensible in isolation”; opsi menyadari efek gabungan saat memilih bertabrakan dengan sebab yang membuat pra-registrasi perlu, yaitu keluwesan yang tersisa setelah data datang.

qs: Which phrase best describes the author's assessment of the reform?
Qualified approval, setting a cost beside the gain it acknowledges.
Guarded scepticism, doubting that registration altered practice much.
Dry regret that a reliable literature has largely been bought with dullness.
Mild impatience with critics who may read null findings as vindication.

qs.evidence: The reform has been widely adopted, and its consequences are instructive rather than triumphant.
qs.answer: Qualified approval, setting a cost beside the gain it acknowledges.
qs.why: Akibat reformasi disebut “instructive rather than triumphant”, lalu untung dan harganya ditaruh berdampingan. Itu persetujuan yang ditahan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penyesalan getir hanya mengambil separuh timbangan dan mengabaikan “Registered studies report smaller effects” sebagai capaian; opsi nggak sabar pada kritikus bertabrakan dengan “which is plausible”, yang justru memberi mereka sebagian kebenaran; opsi skeptis atas dampak reformasi bertabrakan dengan “The reform has been widely adopted”.

qs: Which statement best restates the advice given to non-specialist readers?
Ask whether the analysis was registered, though before any data arrived.
Ask whether anyone has repeated the finding, not whether it impresses.
Prefer results from large laboratories, whose samples are usually bigger.
Ask which participants were excluded, perhaps before the main comparison.

qs.evidence: The question worth asking is not whether a result is significant but whether anybody has yet attempted to reproduce it, and with what outcome.
qs.answer: Ask whether anyone has repeated the finding, not whether it impresses.
qs.why: Teks bilang pertanyaan yang layak diajukan bukan apakah hasilnya signifikan, tapi apakah udah ada yang mencoba mengulangnya dan dengan hasil apa. Itu isi kunci ini.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menanyakan registrasi memakai pokok paragraf dua, sedangkan nasihat pembacanya berbunyi “whether anybody has yet attempted to reproduce it”; opsi peserta yang dikeluarkan juga dari paragraf dua; opsi laboratorium besar menambahkan kriteria yang nggak pernah disebut teks.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Studies with a pre-declared analysis more often produce modest or empty results."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Studies with a pre-declared analysis more often produce modest or empty results.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Registered studies report smaller effects and null findings far more frequently than their unregistered predecessors.
qs.why: Teks bilang studi teregistrasi lebih sering melaporkan efek yang lebih kecil dan temuan nol. Klaimnya ganti kata jadi “modest or empty”, isinya identik, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh pernyataan berlawanan yang nggak ada di teks. “Not stated” gagal karena perbandingan itu justru disebut jelas.

topic: replication and pre-registration in empirical research
author: Farah Kusnadi
setting: the methodological literature of the empirical sciences

title: Four Bars, Eleven Weeks
text:
The passage occupies four bars and has defeated me for eleven weeks, which is longer than I care to concede. It is not rapid, and nothing within it exceeds the reach of an ordinary hand or the patience of an ordinary pupil. The difficulty is a shift, a migration of the left hand from one position to another, executed while the bow continues without interruption. Performed correctly it is inaudible; performed incorrectly it announces itself to the entire structure like a dropped tray. My teacher calls the join a seam, which is a generous term for what is currently a hole.

Practice, properly understood, is not repetition, although repetition is what an observer would notice; repetition merely reinforces whatever the hand is already performing, including the error. What the labour actually requires is diagnosis, and diagnosis is sluggish, unglamorous, and occasionally humiliating in a manner no audience ever witnesses. I have discovered that my thumb releases a fraction of a beat too late, that my elbow anticipates the movement, and that I hold my breath throughout. None of these observations arrived through effort; each arrived through attention, which is a different faculty altogether. Attention, unlike effort, cannot be increased by wanting it more, which is the discovery nobody advertises.

There is a peculiar consolation in difficulties of this kind, and it bears no relation to music whatever. The seam is unmoved by my intentions, my fatigue, or the general quality of my week. It responds to precisely one variable, which is whether the thumb releases at the appropriate instant, and to no other consideration whatsoever. Such indifference is restful after a day spent among colleagues whose responses depend on everything except accuracy. Nothing else in my day offers a verdict that cannot be negotiated, postponed or flattered.

Progress, when it eventually arrives, is unrecognizable as such from the inside, and frequently invisible from without. On Tuesday the shift succeeded twice, and I assumed the successes were accidental, because they felt like nothing at all. That is apparently the sensation of a movement becoming automatic: the effort disappears an instant before the achievement registers. Mastery, in other words, is experienced as an absence rather than as an accomplishment, which explains why nobody boasts convincingly about it.

I shall not pretend the four bars have been conquered, because on Thursday the seam reopened without warning; something has nevertheless altered in how I regard the eleven weeks. The passage was never the objective; it was the instrument through which a particular kind of attention was constructed. The bars will be succeeded by other bars, each concealing its own hole, and the attention will be waiting for them. That, I suspect, is what practising has invariably been for, whatever the concert programme claims.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer conclude about the eleven weeks of work?
Eleven weeks of repetition may finally have made the shift reliable.
The value of the struggle lay in building a capacity for close notice.
Difficult passages are perhaps best defeated by longer practice sessions.
Mastery feels like nothing, so progress cannot be judged from inside.

qs.evidence: The passage was never the objective; it was the instrument through which a particular kind of attention was constructed.
qs.answer: The value of the struggle lay in building a capacity for close notice.
qs.why: Penulis bilang bagian empat bar itu bukan tujuannya, melainkan alat buat membangun semacam perhatian yang akan menunggu bar-bar berikutnya. Jadi hasil sebenarnya kemampuan mengamati.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pengulangan yang akhirnya berhasil bertabrakan dengan “on Thursday the seam reopened without warning” dan dengan “repetition merely reinforces whatever the hand is already performing”; opsi sesi latihan yang lebih panjang bertabrakan dengan kalimat yang sama; opsi penguasaan yang terasa kosong adalah pengamatan paragraf empat, bukan pokoknya.

qs: What can be inferred about the relation between trying hard and improving?
Wanting to improve more strongly may sharpen what a player notices.
Improvement follows from the number of hours the passage is repeated.
Working harder is not the same thing as noticing accurately.
Once an error is located the hand mostly stops repeating it.

qs.evidence: None of these observations arrived through effort; each arrived through attention, which is a different faculty altogether.
qs.answer: Working harder is not the same thing as noticing accurately.
qs.why: Teks bilang pengamatan itu nggak datang dari usaha melainkan dari perhatian, dan perhatian disebut kemampuan yang lain sama sekali. Jadi kerja keras nggak otomatis sama dengan mengamati dengan tepat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keinginan yang mempertajam perhatian bertabrakan langsung dengan “Attention, unlike effort, cannot be increased by wanting it more”; opsi jumlah jam bertabrakan dengan penolakan pengulangan di paragraf dua; opsi kesalahan yang berhenti setelah ditemukan bertabrakan dengan seam yang terbuka lagi pada hari Kamis.

qs: What attitude does the writer express towards the seam's indifference?
Relief, because the standard at least rewards effort honestly spent.
Relief, though mixed with resentment that the week counts for nothing.
Relief, because the verdict can be neither flattered nor negotiated.
Relief, though tinged with regret that nobody witnesses the diagnosis.

qs.evidence: Such indifference is restful after a day spent among colleagues whose responses depend on everything except accuracy.
qs.answer: Relief, because the verdict can be neither flattered nor negotiated.
qs.why: Kata “restful” dipasang setelah kontras dengan rekan kerja yang responsnya bergantung pada segala hal kecuali ketepatan. Itu rasa lega.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyebut rasa lega yang sama, jadi yang harus dibaca adalah alasannya. Opsi usaha yang dihargai dipatahkan “It responds to precisely one variable, which is whether the thumb releases at the appropriate instant”; opsi dongkol dipatahkan kata yang dipakai penulis sendiri, “Such indifference is restful”; opsi sesal karena tak ada yang menyaksikan memindahkan “humiliating in a manner no audience ever witnesses” dari paragraf dua ke kalimat ini.

qs: When his teacher calls the join a “seam”, what does the word mean here?
A line of stitching where two pieces of cloth are joined.
A narrow crack in the varnished body of the instrument.
The point at which the bow reverses without a break in sound.
The join between two hand positions that should be inaudible.

qs.evidence: My teacher calls the join a seam, which is a generous term for what is currently a hole.
qs.answer: The join between two hand positions that should be inaudible.
qs.why: Kata itu dipakai buat sambungan perpindahan tangan yang, kalau benar, nggak kedengaran. Guru pakai istilah itu buat titik rawan tadi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi sama-sama definisi ringkas dan setara presisinya. Opsi jahitan kain adalah makna kamus yang paling umum, dipatahkan pemakaiannya untuk “a migration of the left hand from one position to another”; opsi arah busur dipatahkan “the bow continues without interruption”; opsi celah pada badan instrumen menambahkan kerusakan benda yang nggak pernah disebut.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer regarded Tuesday's two successful shifts as proof of secure progress."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer regarded Tuesday's two successful shifts as proof of secure progress.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: On Tuesday the shift succeeded twice, and I assumed the successes were accidental, because they felt like nothing at all.
qs.why: Teks bilang penulis nganggep dua keberhasilan itu kebetulan, bukan bukti kemajuan. Klaimnya membalik sikap itu, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nabrak kata “accidental” di kalimat yang sama. “Not stated” salah karena sikap penulis soal hari Selasa disebut jelas.

author: Gita Halimah
setting: a domestic practice room with a cello

title: What the Glass Actually Does
text:
No building material has been required to shoulder more ideology than glass, and none has borne it so uncomplainingly. Since the nineteen-twenties, architects have presented the transparent facade as a moral proposition: nothing concealed, nothing forbidden, the interior offered candidly to the street. The vocabulary survives in the marketing of every recent headquarters, where openness is promised as though it were a structural property of the cladding. Enquiry into what the glass actually does, as distinct from what the brochure claims it signifies, is overdue.

Consider the tower from the pavement at four o'clock on a bright afternoon in June, when the facade is not transparent at all but a mirror, returning the sky, the traffic, and the pedestrian's own reflection at maximum brightness. Transparency, in the literal sense, requires a contrast in illumination, and by daylight the exterior is invariably brighter than the interior behind it. The building becomes visually accessible only after dark, when virtually nobody is watching and its occupants have departed. The heavily advertised openness is therefore scheduled for the hours in which it cannot be exercised.

Inside, the arrangement inverts, since the occupants may be observed continuously by anybody with an appetite for observing them. Glazed partitions abolish the enclosed office, and with it the possibility of a discussion nobody overhears. This is presented as a flattening of hierarchy, and in one narrow respect it genuinely is. But the senior staff have retreated upward to a storey with fewer visitors, while the transparency operates most severely upon those with the least authority. Visibility, distributed unevenly, is merely supervision under a more agreeable name.

A thermal contradiction also exists, recorded in the performance figures investors rarely quote and brochures never mention. A glazed envelope admits heat in summer and surrenders it in winter, forcing the mechanical plant to work continuously against the weather. Occupants, meanwhile, complain of glare and draughts in the same quarterly comfort survey, year after year. The building appearing weightless consumes more energy than the heavy masonry it replaced, and lightness, it turns out, is an appearance supported by machinery in the basement.

None of this amounts to an argument against glass, which remains structurally essential and frequently exquisite in the right hands. The argument concerns the metaphor, and metaphors are not innocent when recruited to characterize institutions. A company does not become candid by installing a glazed wall, any more than a person becomes honest by removing a curtain. Candour is a practice, patiently maintained and occasionally extravagant, and leaves no trace in an elevation drawing. The tower, meanwhile, reflects the street back at itself, perhaps the most accurate act it has ever performed.
qs: What is the relationship between glazed partitions and workplace hierarchy?
The partitions expose senior staff while leaving junior work unobserved.
The partitions flattened rank as promised, while adding glare as the only cost.
The partitions spread observation evenly, while abolishing the enclosed office.
The partitions expose junior staff while leaving seniority largely untouched.

qs.evidence: Visibility, distributed unevenly, is merely supervision under a more agreeable name.
qs.answer: The partitions expose junior staff while leaving seniority largely untouched.
qs.why: Teks bilang staf senior mundur ke lantai dengan lebih sedikit pengunjung, sementara transparansinya bekerja paling keras pada yang paling sedikit wewenangnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbentuk relasi dua-arah yang setara presisinya, jadi kunci nggak menonjol. Opsi senior yang paling terpantau dipatahkan “the transparency operates most severely upon those with the least authority”; opsi hierarki yang benar-benar mendatar berhenti pada konsesi “in one narrow respect it genuinely is” dan mengabaikan “But” sesudahnya; opsi pengawasan merata dipatahkan “Visibility, distributed unevenly”.

qs: Someone stops in front of such a tower on a bright June afternoon. What will the facade show?
A daytime passer-by will see one dim floor, the coating allowing only a partial view.
A daytime passer-by will see the offices, since glazing turns transparent in strong sunlight.
A daytime passer-by will see nothing at all, the glass staying opaque until the lamps come on.
A daytime passer-by will see the sky, the traffic and his own reflection instead of the interior.

qs.evidence: Consider the tower from the pavement at four o'clock on a bright afternoon in June, when the facade is not transparent at all but a mirror, returning the sky, the traffic, and the pedestrian's own reflection at maximum brightness.
qs.answer: A daytime passer-by will see the sky, the traffic and his own reflection instead of the interior.
qs.why: Paragraf dua memberi syarat fisiknya: transparansi butuh selisih cahaya, dan “by daylight the exterior is invariably brighter than the interior behind it”, sehingga pada sore Juni yang terang fasadnya menjadi cermin yang memantulkan langit, lalu lintas, dan pejalan itu sendiri.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi melihat kantor di baliknya membalik syarat cahaya itu. Opsi nggak melihat apa pun karena kacanya gelap salah jenis: teks bilang fasadnya bukan tembus pandang melainkan cermin — ada yang terlihat, hanya bukan bagian dalamnya. Opsi satu lantai terlihat samar menawar pertengahan yang nggak ada di teks, yang menulis “not transparent at all”, bukan sebagian.

qs: The remark about openness being scheduled is best described as which of these?
An admiring note on a facade that repays its visitors after dark.
A sardonic remark exposing the gap between the claim and the effect.
A neutral summary of the hours in which the glass turns clear.
A wry concession that the promise was always partly figurative.

qs.evidence: The heavily advertised openness is therefore scheduled for the hours in which it cannot be exercised.
qs.answer: A sardonic remark exposing the gap between the claim and the effect.
qs.why: Frasa “heavily advertised” ditaruh persis di sebelah “cannot be exercised”. Kalimat itu menohok jarak antara janji dan hasilnya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Pujian gugur karena setelah gelap penghuninya udah pergi dan “virtually nobody is watching”. Rangkuman netral gugur karena kata “heavily advertised” udah menilai.
