Dan pengakuan bahwa janjinya kiasan gugur karena teks bilang keterbukaan dijanjikan “as though it were a structural property of the cladding”, jadi dituntut secara harfiah.

qs: Which sentence most closely restates the writer's point about candour?
Glazing cannot make a company candid, while an open curtain does make a person honest.
Glazing cannot make a company candid, though the glass does make concealment harder.
Glazing cannot make a company candid, any more than an open curtain makes a person honest.
Glazing cannot make a company candid, though candour needs no upkeep once announced.

qs.evidence: A company does not become candid by installing a glazed wall, any more than a person becomes honest by removing a curtain.
qs.answer: Glazing cannot make a company candid, any more than an open curtain makes a person honest.
qs.why: Kalimatnya memasang dua penyangkalan sejajar: perusahaan nggak jadi terus terang karena memasang dinding kaca, sama seperti orang nggak jadi jujur karena membuka tirai. Kunci menyatakan ulang keduanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk dua-bagian yang sama dan tiap pengecoh menggeser tepat satu elemen. Opsi tirai yang tetap membuat orang jujur mempertahankan separuh analogi yang justru sedang disangkal; opsi kaca yang mempersulit penyembunyian dipatahkan paragraf dua, “by daylight the exterior is invariably brighter than the interior behind it”; opsi keterusterangan yang nggak perlu dirawat dipatahkan “Candour is a practice, patiently maintained”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "A fully glazed skin loses warmth during the colder months."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: A fully glazed skin loses warmth during the colder months.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A glazed envelope admits heat in summer and surrenders it in winter, forcing the mechanical plant to work continuously against the weather.
qs.why: Teks bilang selubung berkaca menyerahkan panas pada musim dingin. Klaimnya cuma ganti “surrenders it in winter” jadi kehilangan panas di bulan-bulan dingin, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” perlu pernyataan bahwa kaca menahan panas di musim dingin, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena perilaku termalnya disebut langsung.

topic: glass facades and claims of institutional openness
author: Haris Danuwijaya
setting: a newly completed corporate tower

title: The Argument in the Margin
text:
A secondhand bookshop offers two physically indistinguishable categories: volumes read and volumes merely owned. The contrast declares itself in the margins, where a previous reader has argued, agreed, complained, or occasionally lost patience altogether. Such annotation is currently unfashionable, and librarians discourage it for entirely defensible reasons, yet the practice reveals more about attention than any survey of borrowing figures. It is nevertheless the most honest record we possess of what reading was once like.

Marginal writing was not invariably eccentric behaviour, and for several centuries it was the expected response to a text of any consequence. Renaissance readers were trained to extract sentences, compare them with sentences from elsewhere, and compose a personal digest for later reference. The margin functioned as a workshop rather than as a comment column, and a blank margin, under that regime, indicated inattention instead of respect. Ownership without engagement was regarded as a species of waste, and waste of an especially bourgeois sort.

Something altered with the mass-produced paperback, and the alteration was economic rather than intellectual in origin. A cheap book is disposable, and a disposable object does not invite the commitment that writing in it implies. Publishers, for their part, never encouraged clients to deface the merchandise, and the library, an institution devoted to shared property, necessarily prohibited the practice altogether. Annotation retreated into the private notebook, invisible to everybody except its author; the habit survived, though its evidence did not.

The digital margin was expected to restore what the paperback removed, and in certain respects it has. Highlighting is now recorded, aggregated, and returned to publishers as a portrait of collective attention, or of collective haste. But an aggregated margin remains a peculiar artefact, reporting where readers paused without reporting why. The most frequently marked sentence in a novel may be its wisest observation or merely its most quotable one, and volume has thereby replaced argument.

I own a copy of a nineteenth-century essay collection in which an earlier reader has written one word forty times. The word is nonsense, appearing beside every passage in which the author praises his own moderation, forty times over. I know nothing further about this reader, not even a name, yet I know precisely where his patience failed him. No aggregated highlight will ever convey that, because the aggregate has no temper and cannot be exasperated by anybody. Reading, at its best, is an argument conducted with somebody absent, and arguments require somewhere to be inscribed.
qs: Read as a whole, what does this commentary argue about writing in the margins?
Renaissance readers perhaps made better digests than paperback owners now.
Notes in margins preserve evidence of engagement that other records lose.
Aggregated highlighting has largely restored what the paperback removed.
Libraries should relax the rules that keep readers out of the margins.

qs.evidence: It is nevertheless the most honest record we possess of what reading was once like.
qs.answer: Notes in margins preserve evidence of engagement that other records lose.
qs.why: Penulis nyebut catatan pinggir sebagai rekaman paling jujur yang kita punya soal bagaimana orang dulu membaca, dan bilang praktik itu mengungkap lebih banyak soal perhatian daripada angka peminjaman.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pembaca Renaisans yang lebih baik menambahkan perbandingan mutu yang nggak dibuat teks; opsi penyorotan agregat bertabrakan dengan “volume has thereby replaced argument”; opsi aturan perpustakaan yang harus dilonggarkan bertabrakan dengan “librarians discourage it for entirely defensible reasons”.

qs: What does the commentary imply about the effect of cheap paperbacks?
Cheap volumes were annotated more heavily than the expensive editions before them.
Publishers widened the margins of paperbacks to invite private comment.
Low price reduced the sense that a volume deserved lasting investment.
Low price persuaded libraries to allow writing in their shared copies.

qs.evidence: A cheap book is disposable, and a disposable object does not invite the commitment that writing in it implies.
qs.answer: Low price reduced the sense that a volume deserved lasting investment.
qs.why: Buku murah disebut sekali pakai, dan barang sekali pakai nggak memancing komitmen. Jadi harga murah menurunkan rasa bahwa buku itu layak diperlakukan serius.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang buku murah itu sekali pakai dan barang sekali pakai nggak memancing komitmen, jadi anotasinya surut, bukan bertambah. Penerbit disebut nggak pernah menganjurkan pembeli mencoret dagangannya. Dan perpustakaan justru melarang praktik itu sepenuhnya.

qs: How does the writer regard the aggregated record of highlighting?
Warily hopeful, since the aggregate at least may record where readers paused.
Curious, treating the aggregate as new evidence, though of a thin sort.
Sharply annoyed at readers who mark only the most quotable sentences.
Sceptical, treating quantity as a poor substitute for reasoning.

qs.evidence: The most frequently marked sentence in a novel may be its wisest observation or merely its most quotable one, and volume has thereby replaced argument.
qs.answer: Sceptical, treating quantity as a poor substitute for reasoning.
qs.why: Penulis bilang kalimat yang paling sering ditandai bisa jadi yang paling bijak atau cuma yang paling gampang dikutip, lalu menutup dengan “volume has thereby replaced argument”. Itu sikap skeptis.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penuh harap dan opsi penasaran keduanya berhenti pada konsesi “in certain respects it has” dan melewatkan penilaian “without reporting why” serta “the aggregate has no temper”; opsi kesal pada pembaca memindahkan sasaran keberatannya dari agregat ke orang.

qs: In the second paragraph, what does "workshop" suggest about the margin?
A room in which volumes are bound and mended rather than read.
A place where material was worked upon rather than merely judged.
A short course in which readers were trained rather than examined.
A column beside the text set aside for a reader's comments.

qs.evidence: The margin functioned as a workshop rather than as a comment column, and a blank margin, under that regime, indicated inattention instead of respect.
qs.answer: A place where material was worked upon rather than merely judged.
qs.why: Kata itu dikontraskan sama “comment column”, dan konteksnya soal mengekstrak lalu menyusun ulang bahan. Jadi maknanya tempat mengerjakan, bukan tempat menilai.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah definisi setara presisinya, tiga di antaranya untuk makna lain kata itu. Opsi ruang penjilidan memakai arti paling harfiah dan nggak berhubungan dengan margin; opsi kursus singkat memakai makna kedua yang juga lazim; opsi kolom komentar persis yang ditolak kalimat itu, “as a workshop rather than as a comment column”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The earlier reader wrote the same word in several other books as well."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The earlier reader wrote the same word in several other books as well.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: I own a copy of a nineteenth-century essay collection in which an earlier reader has written one word forty times.
qs.why: Teks cuma cerita satu jilid dan satu kata yang muncul empat puluh kali di dalamnya. Apa pembaca itu nulis kata yang sama di buku lain nggak pernah disentuh, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nambahin buku yang nggak pernah ada di teks. “False” juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal apa pun soal koleksi pembaca itu; dia cuma diam.

topic: annotation and the history of reading
author: Ilham Sudibyo
setting: a secondhand bookshop and a private shelf

title: What a Photograph Counts
text:
The camera trap has transformed the study of secretive mammals, and it has also transformed what conservation science means by a number. A device fixed to a tree records whatever passes an infrared beam, at any hour, for months without supervision. The resulting archive is enormous, inexpensive by the standards of fieldwork, and almost entirely free of the observer's presence, and it is also, in an important sense, not a census. The distinction is routinely lost between the laboratory and the press release.

An image records a detection, not an animal, and the difference is not merely pedantic. Ten photographs may represent ten individuals, one individual returning ten times, or any arrangement between those extremes. Species bearing distinctive coats, such as the tiger, permit individuals to be identified and counted with reasonable confidence. For a uniformly coloured animal, no such identification is feasible, and abundance must be inferred from a model rather than observed. The model requires assumptions about movement, and those assumptions are precisely what the photographs cannot supply.

Placement introduces a second difficulty, which is less often acknowledged in published summaries. Cameras are positioned on trails, because trails deliver detections and empty forest does not, so animals that avoid trails are underrepresented while those that patrol them are overrepresented. The archive documents the intersection of two behaviours: the animal's use of paths and the researcher's expectation about paths. Corrections exist, they are ingenious, and they depend upon further assumptions of their own.

None of this undermines the method, which has produced findings unobtainable by any other means. Populations previously characterized as extinct have been photographed; nocturnal behaviour long assumed has ultimately been documented. The proper conclusion is narrower and more useful than either enthusiasm or dismissal. A detection rate is a robust measure of change at one location over time, and a fragile measure of quantity at any single moment. Comparisons across years, at identical stations, are therefore far safer than comparisons across landscapes.

The practical hazard lies downstream, in the sentence that reaches a ministry or a newspaper. Somewhere between the model and the summary, an estimate loses its interval and acquires an air of authority it never possessed. Policy is then constructed upon a figure whose uncertainty has been discreetly discarded during translation. Those who generate such figures cannot control that process, but they can refuse to characterize a detection rate as a population. That refusal is unexciting, and it is the whole of the discipline.
qs: Read as a whole, what argument does this article press about counting from photographs?
Detection rates track change well, though trail bias is the deeper fault.
Detection rates track change well, and may yield counts from a large archive.
Detection rates track change well, and best across whole landscapes at that.
Detection rates track change well, though they measure quantity poorly.

qs.evidence: A detection rate is a robust measure of change at one location over time, and a fragile measure of quantity at any single moment.
qs.answer: Detection rates track change well, though they measure quantity poorly.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang laju deteksi adalah ukuran kuat untuk perubahan di satu lokasi sepanjang waktu, dan ukuran yang rapuh untuk jumlah pada satu saat. Kunci ini menyatakan kedua sisi itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi membuka dengan klaim yang sama, jadi tesis yang tertebak dari soal lain nggak cukup; klausa keduanya yang harus dibaca. Opsi bias jalur sebagai cacat terdalam menaikkan satu dari dua kesulitan menjadi inti dan dipatahkan “None of this undermines the method”; opsi arsip besar yang menghasilkan hitungan dipatahkan “abundance must be inferred from a model rather than observed”; opsi perbandingan antar-lanskap dipatahkan “Comparisons across years, at identical stations, are therefore far safer than comparisons across landscapes”.

qs: What can be inferred about abundance estimates for uniformly coloured species?
They rest on premises the tiger's markings would also fail to settle.
They rest on premises a larger archive would eventually be able to supply.
They rest on premises the images themselves are unable to confirm.
They rest on premises about the coat pattern rather than about movement.

qs.evidence: The model requires assumptions about movement, and those assumptions are precisely what the photographs cannot supply.
qs.answer: They rest on premises the images themselves are unable to confirm.
qs.why: Model butuh asumsi soal pergerakan, dan justru asumsi itu yang nggak bisa disediakan foto. Jadi angkanya berdiri di atas anggapan dasar yang nggak terbukti dari gambar.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi membuka dengan pengakuan keterbatasan yang sama, jadi tandanya nggak menandai kunci. Opsi corak macan yang juga gagal dipatahkan “permit individuals to be identified and counted with reasonable confidence”; opsi arsip lebih besar dipatahkan “those assumptions are precisely what the photographs cannot supply”; opsi anggapan dasar tentang corak dipatahkan “The model requires assumptions about movement”.

qs: What tone does the closing sentence convey?
Understated conviction about an unglamorous professional duty.
Understated resignation about a translation nobody in the field controls.
Understated pride in a refusal the ministry will eventually notice.
Understated reproach aimed at the newspaper that dropped the interval.

qs.evidence: That refusal is unexciting, and it is the whole of the discipline.
qs.answer: Understated conviction about an unglamorous professional duty.
qs.why: Penulis nyebut penolakan itu “unexciting” lalu langsung bilang itulah seluruh disiplinnya. Yakin, tapi ditahan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sama-sama tertahan seperti kunci dan sama-sama nyambung dengan tesis, jadi yang membedakan hanya sasaran dan derajatnya. Opsi pasrah dipatahkan “they can refuse to characterize a detection rate as a population”, yang menaruh kewajiban; opsi bangga karena akan diperhatikan dipatahkan dua frasa, “cannot control that process” dan “That refusal is unexciting”; opsi teguran kepada surat kabar salah sasaran, sebab kalimat penutup bicara tentang penolakan si peneliti.

qs: Which statement best restates what happens to a figure during translation?
Its interval is widened somewhere downstream, while its authority stays as it was.
Its interval falls away somewhere downstream, while its authority grows unearned.
Its interval falls away inside the ministry, while the model is recalculated there.
Its interval falls away downstream, while the added photographs earn the authority.

qs.evidence: Somewhere between the model and the summary, an estimate loses its interval and acquires an air of authority it never possessed.
qs.answer: Its interval falls away somewhere downstream, while its authority grows unearned.
qs.why: Teks bilang di suatu titik antara model dan rangkuman, estimasinya kehilangan intervalnya dan memperoleh kesan berwibawa yang sebenarnya nggak pernah dia punya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai kontras dua-arah yang sama dan tiap pengecoh menggeser tepat satu elemen. Opsi interval yang diperlebar membalik “loses its interval”; opsi dihitung ulang di kementerian menambahkan langkah yang nggak disebut, sebab yang disebut hanya penerjemahan menjadi rangkuman; opsi wibawa yang diperoleh dari tambahan foto dipatahkan “an air of authority it never possessed”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Species that keep away from paths appear more often in the archive than those using them."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Species that keep away from paths appear more often in the archive than those using them.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Cameras are positioned on trails, because trails deliver detections and empty forest does not, so animals that avoid trails are underrepresented while those that patrol them are overrepresented.
qs.why: Teks bilang hewan yang menghindari jalur justru kurang terwakili, sementara yang sering lewat jalur kelebihan wakil. Klaimnya membalik arah itu, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertentangan langsung sama kalimat penempatan kamera. “Not stated” salah karena arah biasnya disebut jelas.

author: Jelita Marpaung
setting: a forest monitoring programme

title: The Word on the Sleeve
text:
The recording industry has spent fifty years promoting a term it never defined, and the term is authentic. Gut strings, lower pitch, smaller ensembles, no vibrato: the apparatus of historical performance is now familiar even to listeners who could not name a single instrument in it. The claim attached to the apparatus is considerably more ambitious than the apparatus itself. It asserts that a particular set of choices restores an intention, and intention is precisely what no instrument preserves.

Consider what survives from a performance given in seventeen fifty: a manuscript, sometimes an instrument, occasionally a description written by somebody in the audience. What does not survive is the room as it sounded when full, the expectations of listeners who had heard nothing similar that week, or the silence against which the music was measured. A contemporary audience arrives having heard ten thousand hours of recorded sound, and no arrangement of gut strings subtracts that experience. Restoring the acoustic apparatus therefore restores a fraction, and the missing fraction is the listener.

Advocates reply, reasonably, that partial recovery is preferable to none, and the reply would be conclusive if the movement had described itself modestly, which for its first two decades it did not. Recordings were marketed as definitive; conductors who used later instruments were treated as vandals; a scholarly disagreement about ornament acquired the vocabulary of a moral controversy. The confidence was disproportionate to the evidence, which consisted largely of treatises written by teachers complaining about their pupils. Complaint is evidence of practice, but only of unusual practice, and unusual practice makes poor doctrine.

The strongest defence of the movement concerns nothing so grand as fidelity to the past. Reduced forces expose inner voices that a large ensemble buries; unfamiliar tuning unsettles a listener into attention; a quieter instrument compels a distinct kind of phrasing. These are aesthetic gains, available presently, and they require no claim about intention whatever. The movement produced its finest results precisely when it behaved as an experiment rather than as a restoration.

The vocabulary has softened in recent years, and historically informed has replaced authentic on most sleeves. The retreat is welcome, though conceded gradually and with little acknowledgement of what preceded it. What remains is a body of performance practice considerably more inventive than the doctrine that once justified it. That is a familiar pattern in the arts: the argument ages badly while the work it licensed continues to reward attention. Somebody should tell the sleeve notes.
qs: What is the relationship between restored instruments and a restored performance?
The equipment can be recovered, but the ear that first received it cannot.
The intention can be recovered, but only the equipment carries it forward.
The room can be recovered, but the manuscript played from it cannot.
The first hearing can be recovered, but the instruments themselves cannot.

qs.evidence: Restoring the acoustic apparatus therefore restores a fraction, and the missing fraction is the listener.
qs.answer: The equipment can be recovered, but the ear that first received it cannot.
qs.why: Teks bilang memulihkan perangkat akustik cuma memulihkan sebagian, dan bagian yang hilang justru pendengarnya. Alatnya bisa dibalikin, telinga penonton lama nggak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk “X bisa dipulihkan, tapi Y nggak” yang setara presisinya. Opsi niat yang bisa dipulihkan dipatahkan “intention is precisely what no instrument preserves”; opsi ruang yang bisa dipulihkan membalik daftar yang bertahan, “a manuscript, sometimes an instrument”; opsi pendengaran pertama yang bisa dipulihkan membalik kunci dan dipatahkan “the missing fraction is the listener”.

qs: What does the essay imply about the historical sources used by the movement?
They consist mainly of descriptions, though written by listeners present.
They record complaints, which are a partial guide to ordinary habit.
They may have been strong enough to justify the movement's early confidence.
They describe the practice that teachers of the period thought normal.

qs.evidence: The confidence was disproportionate to the evidence, which consisted largely of treatises written by teachers complaining about their pupils.
qs.answer: They record complaints, which are a partial guide to ordinary habit.
qs.why: Sumbernya disebut sebagian besar traktat guru yang mengeluhkan murid, dan teks nambahin bahwa keluhan cuma bukti praktik yang nggak lazim. Jadi panduannya sebagian saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi deskripsi penonton bertabrakan dengan “consisted largely of treatises written by teachers”; opsi bukti yang cukup kuat bertabrakan dengan “The confidence was disproportionate to the evidence”; opsi praktik yang dianggap normal membalik “only of unusual practice”.

qs: What effect does the closing sentence create?
A wry summary of all the movement has actually achieved.
A wry warning about where early-music marketing may be heading.
A wry admission that the writer once believed the doctrine too.
A wry deflation after a paragraph of serious argument.

qs.evidence: Somebody should tell the sleeve notes.
qs.answer: A wry deflation after a paragraph of serious argument.
qs.why: Setelah paragraf serius soal argumen yang menua buruk, kalimat pendek soal “sleeve notes” itu sengaja mengempeskan nada.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyebut nada geli yang sama, jadi yang harus dibaca adalah apa yang dilakukan kalimatnya. Opsi ringkasan dipatahkan bentuk kalimatnya sendiri, “Somebody should tell the sleeve notes”, yang memangkas alih-alih merangkum; opsi peringatan arah pemasaran menambahkan ramalan yang nggak dibuat; opsi pengakuan pribadi menambahkan sikap penulis terhadap dirinya yang nggak ada di teks.

qs: What does "vandals" convey about conductors using later instruments?
That they may have damaged some surviving historical instruments.
That their readings were treated as old-fashioned taste, though sincere.
That they were thought careless about ornament without meaning harm.
That they were accused of destroying something rather than reading it.

qs.evidence: Recordings were marketed as definitive; conductors who used later instruments were treated as vandals; a scholarly disagreement about ornament acquired the vocabulary of a moral controversy.
qs.answer: That they were accused of destroying something rather than reading it.
qs.why: Kalimat yang sama bilang perselisihan ilmiah soal ornamen memperoleh kosakata kontroversi moral. Jadi kata itu menuduh perusakan, bukan menggambarkan tafsir yang berbeda.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi merusak instrumen memakai arti harfiah “vandals”, padahal kalimat itu memasangkannya dengan sengketa hiasan yang memperoleh “the vocabulary of a moral controversy”; opsi dianggap kuno melemahkan tuduhannya menjadi soal selera; opsi lalai tanpa niat jahat bertabrakan dengan kata “vandals” itu sendiri.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The label on most record sleeves has changed to a more cautious phrase."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The label on most record sleeves has changed to a more cautious phrase.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: The vocabulary has softened in recent years, and historically informed has replaced authentic on most sleeves.
qs.why: Teks bilang “historically informed” udah menggantikan “authentic” di sebagian besar sampul. Klaimnya cuma merangkum itu dengan kata lain, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh pernyataan bahwa istilahnya tetap, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena pergantian istilahnya disebut langsung.

topic: historical performance and claims of authenticity
author: Kanaya Prabowo
setting: the recorded classical repertoire

title: Forty-One Years, One Line a Day
text:
My grandfather maintained a meteorological diary for forty-one years, in identical notebooks, inscribing a solitary line each morning before the household stirred. Temperature, wind, cloud, and a single adjective of his own election, entered before breakfast and never revised thereafter. He possessed no scientific training, and never submitted a solitary observation to any institution that might conceivably have solicited it. I inherited eleven notebooks and comprehended virtually nothing of their significance until I attempted the same discipline myself.

A diary of this kind chastens the ordinary human appetite for vindication, which is its chief and unadvertised utility. On the fourth morning I recorded that rain was probable, and by midday I desired it. The desire had no connection with rain; it concerned the sentence I had composed, and the distinction required several weeks to clarify itself. My grandfather's entries contain no predictions whatever, which I had originally construed as a deficiency of ambition. It was, I now believe, a deliberate refusal, since a diarist who forecasts nothing possesses nothing to defend.

The notebooks acquire their value only in aggregate, and the aggregate was never his intention, nor could it have been. Read consecutively, they reveal the first frost arriving progressively later across four decades, and the adjectives contracting as his handwriting deteriorated. Neither pattern was perceptible to the diarist holding the pen on any particular Tuesday, accumulating evidence he could not himself interpret. The pattern belongs to the series, not to any entry within it.

I have attempted to justify to a colleague why the notebooks are not merely sentimental objects of family piety. She enquired, quite reasonably, what they establish, and I could not respond in the requisite form. Proof was never the transaction she imagined; they establish nothing in isolation, constituting instead one household's forty-one years of sustained attention, a distinct category of object altogether. A single record proves little and doubts nothing; a long record cannot help doubting the year it happens to occupy.

Nineteen months into my own notebook, I find the adjectives already repeating themselves. I no longer record that rain is probable, and I do not lament the sensation of vindication. What supplanted it is duller and more durable: a mild curiosity concerning what the series will eventually articulate. It will not articulate it to me, of course, since forty-one years is an implausible interval to await a single sentence, and that, presumably, was the arrangement he accepted when he opened the first notebook.
qs: Read as a whole, which lesson does the writer draw from the notebooks?
A single careful entry can carry more weight than a long series.
Patient records gain meaning only as a series, beyond any one observer.
The diaries matter chiefly as objects of family piety and memory.
Sustained records are wasted unless an institution collects them.

qs.evidence: Neither pattern was perceptible to the diarist holding the pen on any particular Tuesday, accumulating evidence he could not himself interpret.
qs.answer: Patient records gain meaning only as a series, beyond any one observer.
qs.why: Polanya cuma muncul kalau catatannya dibaca berderet, dan orang yang memegang pena pada Selasa mana pun nggak bisa melihatnya. Jadi maknanya milik serinya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Satu entri gugur karena teks bilang “A single record proves little and doubts nothing”. Kesalehan keluarga gugur karena penulis persis menolak sebutan itu di paragraf keempat. Dan lembaga gugur karena kakeknya nggak pernah menyerahkan satu pengamatan pun, dan catatannya tetap disebut berharga.

qs: What does the writer conclude about the absence of forecasts in the diaries?
It protected the observer from wanting the weather to confirm him.
It followed from his lack of any training rather than from a decision.
It was meant to keep the notebooks usable by later researchers.
It shows he had lost interest in what the next morning would bring.

qs.evidence: It was, I now believe, a deliberate refusal, since a diarist who forecasts nothing possesses nothing to defend.
qs.answer: It protected the observer from wanting the weather to confirm him.
qs.why: Kalau kamu nggak meramal, kamu nggak punya apa pun buat dibela. Itu yang bikin penulis nyimpulin kakeknya terlindung dari keinginan dibenarkan cuaca.
qs.whyOthersFail: Penulis menyebutnya penolakan yang disengaja, jadi bukan akibat ketiadaan pelatihan. Kegunaan buat peneliti nggak pernah jadi niatnya — agregatnya sendiri bukan tujuannya. Dan catatannya tetap ditulis tiap pagi selama empat puluh satu tahun, jadi bukan tanda kehilangan minat.

qs: How does the writer characterize the change in the writer's own attitude?
As an exchange of vindication he still quietly resents.
As an exchange of vindication for something duller and steadier.
As an exchange of vindication forced on him by a colleague.
As an exchange of vindication he cannot quite account for.

qs.evidence: What supplanted it is duller and more durable: a mild curiosity concerning what the series will eventually articulate.
qs.answer: As an exchange of vindication for something duller and steadier.
qs.why: Yang menggantikan sensasi dibenarkan disebut “duller and more durable”, yaitu rasa penasaran ringan soal apa yang akan dikatakan serinya. Itu pertukaran, bukan kehilangan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menamai pertukaran yang sama, yakni sensasi dibenarkan, jadi kata itu nggak lagi menandai kunci dan yang membedakan isi penggantinya. Opsi masih kesal dipatahkan “I do not lament the sensation of vindication”; opsi dipaksa pertanyaan rekan salah sebab, karena pertanyaan itu hanya soal apa yang dibuktikan notebook, sementara pergeserannya “required several weeks to clarify itself”; opsi tak bisa dijelaskan dipatahkan kalimat yang menyebut penggantinya terang-terangan, “a mild curiosity concerning what the series will eventually articulate”.

qs: Which sentence best restates the contrast drawn between short and long records?
One entry can perhaps be trusted further, though not across decades.
A long series removes doubt, though any single year would raise it.
One entry settles nothing, whereas a long series questions the present year.
Short and long records do the same work, only at a different scale.

qs.evidence: A single record proves little and doubts nothing; a long record cannot help doubting the year it happens to occupy.
qs.answer: One entry settles nothing, whereas a long series questions the present year.
qs.why: Kalimatnya bilang catatan tunggal nggak membuktikan dan nggak meragukan apa pun, sementara catatan panjang otomatis meragukan tahun yang sedang berjalan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi satu entri yang lebih dapat dipercaya membalik “A single record proves little”; opsi rangkaian panjang yang menghapus keraguan membalik “a long record cannot help doubting the year it happens to occupy”; opsi keduanya sama hanya beda skala menghapus kontras yang justru menjadi isi kalimat itu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Across the four decades the first frost appeared progressively later in the season."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Across the four decades the first frost appeared progressively later in the season.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Read consecutively, they reveal the first frost arriving progressively later across four decades, and the adjectives contracting as his handwriting deteriorated.
qs.why: Teks bilang embun beku pertama datang makin telat sepanjang empat dekade. Klaimnya cuma ganti pilihan kata, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh arah sebaliknya, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena polanya disebut jelas di kalimat itu.

topic: a private weather diary and the value of long records
author: Laras Mahendra
setting: an inherited set of notebooks

title: Forty Encounters a Week
text:
Housing research has produced few findings as robust, or as regularly ignored, as the relationship between circulation and acquaintance. Residents who pass one another on foot, at a predictable hour, in a space narrow enough to require acknowledgement, recognize one another's faces. Residents who arrive by lift, from a basement, into a corridor with sixteen identical doors, do not. The distinction has been demonstrated repeatedly, in four countries, employing three separate methods and yielding one conclusion, since the decisive variable is not community spirit but the geometry of the route.

The mechanism is unremarkable once stated, and the literature has described it since the nineteen-sixties without appreciable dissent; recognition requires repetition, and repetition requires a shared route. A staircase serving six flats generates roughly forty encounters a week for each household; a lift serving ninety flats generates a similar number of strangers. Encounters need not be conversations, and residents in the studied blocks rarely reported friendship. They reported something weaker and more valuable, namely the ability to distinguish a neighbour from an intruder.

The finding has an awkward corollary planning authorities dislike quoting: staircase access is costly, consuming floor area that produces no rent and limiting the height of an economic structure. Lift-and-corridor arrangements are more economical for every party except the resident, whose costs appear years later and in forms nobody attributes to a drawing. Absence of acquaintance is not itemized in a development appraisal, nor in any subsequent valuation. It arrives instead as reported anxiety, as unattended shared space, and as maintenance disputes no committee can settle.

Two qualifications intrude before the finding is applied too enthusiastically. First, the studies compare structures, not residents, and households choosing a staircase block may differ from those allocated a tower. Second, acquaintance is not uniformly desirable, and several respondents described the staircase as terrain they could not cross unobserved. Visibility protects and constrains simultaneously, which is why the same arrangement is described as neighbourly by one household and oppressive by the next.

The policy implication is modest and therefore unattractive to announce at a ribbon-cutting. Nothing in the evidence recommends demolishing towers or prohibiting lifts, and any such proposal would be absurd. It recommends that circulation be treated as a social instrument rather than as a technical residue, and costed accordingly. Costing it, however, requires a vocabulary appraisals do not currently possess. A staircase is not a corridor standing on end; it is the cheapest social programme a building can contain, and it is usually deleted first.
qs: Read as a whole, which finding does this report establish about recognition between residents?
Whether neighbours recognize each other depends chiefly on how they move about.
Community spirit may matter more to recognition than the shape of a route.
Corridor residents usually report more friendships than staircase households.
The finding has been contested by researchers in each of the four countries.

qs.evidence: the decisive variable is not community spirit but the geometry of the route
qs.answer: Whether neighbours recognize each other depends chiefly on how they move about.
qs.why: Teks bilang penentunya bukan semangat kebersamaan, tapi bentuk jalur pergerakan. Kunci ini merumuskan ulang temuan itu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Teks bilang variabel penentunya bukan semangat kebersamaan tapi geometri jalur, jadi urutannya kebalik di pengecoh pertama. Pertemanan justru jarang dilaporkan penghuni mana pun, dan yang bertambah cuma kemampuan mengenali wajah. Dan temuan itu disebut berulang kali terbukti di empat negara tanpa perbedaan pendapat berarti.

qs: A block of flats is redrawn to bring its costs down. Which element does this evidence expect to go first?
The lift will go, because one staircase can serve ninety flats just as well.
The staircase access will go, since the floor area it consumes produces no rent.
A storey will go, since staircase access is what limits the height in the first place.
The shared landings will go, once the maintenance disputes about them are settled.

qs.evidence: staircase access is costly, consuming floor area that produces no rent and limiting the height of an economic structure
qs.answer: The staircase access will go, since the floor area it consumes produces no rent.
qs.why: Paragraf tiga menyebut biayanya: akses tangga memakan luas lantai yang nggak menghasilkan sewa, dan kalimat penutup mengunci prediksinya — tangga “is usually deleted first”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi lift dibuang bertabrakan dengan alasan ekonominya: susunan lift dan koridor justru lebih murah bagi setiap pihak kecuali penghuni. Opsi satu lantai dibuang membalik hubungan di teks: akses tanggalah yang membatasi ketinggian, jadi menghapus tangga membuka lantai, bukan sebaliknya. Opsi ruang bersama dibuang setelah sengketa perawatan selesai memakai akibat sebagai sebab, dan teks menyebut sengketa itu justru “no committee can settle”.

qs: What attitude is conveyed by the article's final sentence?
Weary acceptance of an order of cuts nobody is going to change.
Pointed regret at a predictable order of budget reductions.
Sharp blame directed at the residents who chose the cheaper block.
Confident regret, since appraisals will soon acquire the missing words.

qs.evidence: A staircase is not a corridor standing on end; it is the cheapest social programme a building can contain, and it is usually deleted first.
qs.answer: Pointed regret at a predictable order of budget reductions.
qs.why: Frasa “usually deleted first” itu sindiran pahit: hal paling murah dan paling bernilai sosial justru yang pertama dipangkas.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh sama-sama menyesali hal yang sama dengan kunci, jadi yang menentukan derajat dan sasarannya. Opsi menerima dengan lelah dipatahkan usulan yang dinyatakan, “It recommends that circulation be treated as a social instrument rather than as a technical residue, and costed accordingly”; opsi menyalahkan penghuni salah sasaran karena “the studies compare structures, not residents”; opsi optimisme dipatahkan “requires a vocabulary appraisals do not currently possess”.

qs: As the housing literature uses it in the opening paragraph, what does “circulation” denote?
The number of households a report may be expected to reach.
The movement of residents along the routes inside a building.
The flow of air through corridors and stairwells, though not people.
The rate at which tenants move into and out of a block.

qs.evidence: Residents who pass one another on foot, at a predictable hour, in a space narrow enough to require acknowledgement, recognize one another's faces.
qs.answer: The movement of residents along the routes inside a building.
qs.why: Paragraf itu menjelaskan kata tadi lewat penghuni yang saling lewat dengan kaki pada jam yang bisa diduga, di ruang yang sempit. Jadi maksudnya pergerakan orang di jalur bangunan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi jangkauan laporan dan opsi aliran udara sama-sama memakai arti “circulation” yang lazim di luar arsitektur, padahal kalimat ini menghubungkannya dengan penghuni yang “pass one another on foot”; opsi laju pindah penghuni memakai arti pergantian penyewa, bukan rute di dalam bangunan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Residents of the blocks studied usually described their neighbours as friends."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Residents of the blocks studied usually described their neighbours as friends.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Encounters need not be conversations, and residents in the studied blocks rarely reported friendship.
qs.why: Teks bilang penghuni jarang melaporkan pertemanan. Klaimnya membalik frekuensi itu jadi “biasanya”, jadi False.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nabrak kata “rarely”. “Not stated” salah karena laporan soal pertemanan disebut langsung.

author: Mahesa Rizkiawan
setting: housing blocks in a comparative study

title: The Composite Bear
text:
A polar bear crosses the ice, and the music informs you she is exhausted before the narrator confirms it. The sequence is exquisite, extravagant, and constructed from footage gathered over fourteen months by six camera teams in three locations. The bear on screen is therefore not a bear but a composite, assembled to depict an existence that no single animal was filmed living. This is not a scandal, though it is periodically reported as one.

Every documentary compresses, and compression requires decisions that cannot be made neutrally. A hunt that failed eleven times and succeeded once will be shown succeeding, because failure eleven times is unwatchable. Predation is filmed and edited to conclude; the protracted tedium that surrounds it is excised entirely. Viewers consequently acquire an impression of the wild as continuously eventful, which inverts what a field biologist reports. The genre's honesty problem is not deception about individual shots but a systematic exaggeration of incident.

The narration performs a second kind of editing, and it operates on motive rather than on time. Animals are accorded intentions, kinship, courage, and occasionally grief, because a sequence without a protagonist is arduous to sustain for fifty minutes. Ascribing purpose is not simply an error, since much animal behaviour genuinely is purposive. The difficulty is that the ascribed purposes are invariably legible to us: the devoted parent, the ageing rival, the resourceful outsider. We recognize the plot before we recognize the species.

Defenders of the genre make an argument from consequence, and it deserves to be taken seriously. These programmes have generated more public support for conservation than the entire peer-reviewed literature combined. An audience moved by a composite bear will still sign a petition about actual ice. The objection is not that the argument is erroneous but that it has never been examined by the individuals who make it most often.

A modest reform would demand almost nothing of the genre and would repair much of the difficulty. Several recent series now append a brief account of how a sequence was obtained, and the appendix is frequently the most admired segment. Audiences are not damaged by learning that patience, luck, and fourteen months preceded ninety seconds of ice. They are damaged by an impression, silently acquired, that the wild is a domain where something invariably occurs. The remedy is precisely the practice the genre has invariably excelled at, which is exhibiting the labour.
qs: What relationship does the writer draw between editing and misleading the viewer?
Individual shots may be staged, though the narration is written to cover it.
The narration corrects the exaggeration that the editing has introduced.
Individual shots are truthful, yet their assembly overstates how much occurs.
Assembly is largely neutral, though each footage decision can be defended.

qs.evidence: The genre's honesty problem is not deception about individual shots but a systematic exaggeration of incident.
qs.answer: Individual shots are truthful, yet their assembly overstates how much occurs.
qs.why: Teks bilang masalah kejujuran genre ini bukan penipuan pada tiap bidikan, melainkan pembesaran kejadian yang sistematis. Itu isi kunci ini.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi bidikan yang direkayasa bertabrakan dengan “not deception about individual shots”; opsi narasi yang memperbaiki bertabrakan dengan paragraf tiga, yang menyebut narasi menambah penyuntingan kedua atas motif; opsi perakitan yang netral bertabrakan dengan “compression requires decisions that cannot be made neutrally”.

qs: What can be inferred about how viewers perceive predation?
They will assume hunting succeeds far more often than it truly does.
They may take the tedium around a hunt to be part of what they saw.
They perhaps notice the failures that the edit has quietly removed.
They will tend to lose interest long before a hunt reaches its end.

qs.evidence: A hunt that failed eleven times and succeeded once will be shown succeeding, because failure eleven times is unwatchable.
qs.answer: They will assume hunting succeeds far more often than it truly does.
qs.why: Kalau perburuan yang gagal sebelas kali dan berhasil sekali selalu ditayangkan berhasil, penonton bakal menyimpulkan tingkat keberhasilannya jauh lebih tinggi daripada kenyataannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kebosanan yang ikut terlihat bertabrakan dengan “the protracted tedium that surrounds it is excised entirely”; opsi menyadari kegagalan bertabrakan dengan kalimat yang sama; opsi kehilangan minat membalik alasan penyuntingannya, sebab justru perburuan disunting agar berakhir.

qs: The remark about recognizing the plot chiefly serves to do which of these?
Praise the narrators who make an ageing rival's grief legible.
Concede that viewers cannot identify the species on screen.
Expose how narrative convention overrides observation of the animal.
Recommend that narration be dropped wherever motive is ascribed.

qs.evidence: We recognize the plot before we recognize the species.
qs.answer: Expose how narrative convention overrides observation of the animal.
qs.why: Kalimat pendek itu menohok: yang kita kenali dulu adalah pola cerita, bukan hewannya. Fungsinya membongkar dominasi konvensi naratif.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh bertumpu pada tesis yang sama, yaitu motif yang mudah dibaca, tapi salah fungsi. Opsi memuji narator membalik keberatannya, sebab keterbacaan itulah yang dipersoalkan, “the ascribed purposes are invariably legible to us”; opsi penonton yang tak mengenali spesies melampaui kalimatnya, yang hanya menyusun urutan, “before we recognize the species”; opsi menghapus narasi dipatahkan reformasi yang benar-benar diusulkan, “The remedy is precisely the practice the genre has invariably excelled at, which is exhibiting the labour”.

qs: Which statement best restates the writer's response to the argument from consequence?
The claim may be false, though petitions perhaps follow beauty not science.
The claim may have been tested, though largely by film-makers who use it.
The claim matters less than how the finished sequence looks on screen.
The claim may well be sound, yet its defenders leave it untested.

qs.evidence: The objection is not that the argument is erroneous but that it has never been examined by the individuals who make it most often.
qs.answer: The claim may well be sound, yet its defenders leave it untested.
qs.why: Penulis nggak bilang argumennya salah; dia bilang argumen itu nggak pernah diuji sama orang yang paling sering memakainya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi klaim yang salah bertabrakan dengan “The objection is not that the argument is erroneous”; opsi klaim yang udah diuji bertabrakan dengan lanjutan kalimat itu, “it has never been examined by the individuals who make it most often”; opsi tampilan akhir di layar menambahkan pokok yang nggak dibahas.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The six camera teams worked in the three locations at the same time."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The six camera teams worked in the three locations at the same time.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The sequence is exquisite, extravagant, and constructed from footage gathered over fourteen months by six camera teams in three locations.
qs.why: Teks nyebut enam tim, tiga lokasi, dan empat belas bulan, tapi nggak pernah bilang apa mereka kerja serentak atau bergantian. Jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” nambahin keterangan waktu yang nggak ada. “False” juga salah karena teks nggak menyangkal kerja serentak; dia cuma nggak menyinggungnya.

author: Nadira Wisesa
setting: a wildlife series and its production

title: A Genius, Not Genius
text:
Before the middle of the eighteenth century, a person did not have genius; a person had a genius, in the way that a place had one. The term denoted an attendant spirit, external and local, which visited and might depart, unannounced. Within two generations the grammar had inverted, and genius had become an interior property, unevenly distributed, possessed by particular individuals from birth. The change appears minor on the page and proved consequential in virtually every institution touching the arts.

The older arrangement carried an implication we have largely lost, and lost unnoticed. If inspiration arrived from outside, the maker was a channel, and craft consisted in being reliably available. Workshops therefore trained pupils in procedure, and a competent pupil might be trusted with a commission bearing the master's name. Nobody found this fraudulent, because the work was understood as the product of a method rather than of a personality, and attribution mattered for payment and not for authenticity, a distinction subsequently inverted.

Romantic writers reversed the polarity deliberately, and their motives were partly commercial, partly polemical. A market in printed works required something to distinguish one supplier from another, and interior genius performed that task admirably. It also solved a difficulty about rules, since a figure exceeding the rules cannot be judged by them. Originality became the criterion, the biography became evidence, and the childhood of the artist acquired a significance it had never previously held, and every subsequent complaint about difficult art descends from that settlement, unmistakably.

The consequences for the individuals so described were less enviable than the vocabulary suggests, considerably less. A property held from birth cannot be acquired, nor legitimately explained by effort. Practice therefore had to be concealed, and letters from the period display an increasing anxiety about appearing to have worked. The concealment was not hypocrisy so much as an occupational requirement, professionally enforced, and a doctrine devised to elevate the artist obliged the artist to lie about the mornings, daily.

The category has proved unusually durable, and continues to organize prizes, curricula, and the marketing of biographies. Its costs are apparent in what it excludes: collaborative labour, revision, and every tradition in which a name is not the unit of value. None of this establishes that talent is evenly distributed, which would be a separate argument, unpromising and unnecessary. It establishes only that a particular explanation of talent was constructed at a particular moment, by identifiable interests. Attendant spirits, whatever their other faults, at least did not have to pretend they were self-made.
qs: What is the relationship between the older idea of genius and workshop practice?
Treating inspiration as external made attribution a test of authenticity.
Treating inspiration as interior made shared production respectable in workshops.
Treating inspiration as external barred pupils from work bearing the master's name.
Treating inspiration as external made shared production quite respectable.

qs.evidence: Nobody found this fraudulent, because the work was understood as the product of a method rather than of a personality
qs.answer: Treating inspiration as external made shared production quite respectable.
qs.why: Teks bilang nggak ada yang menganggap itu penipuan karena karyanya dipahami sebagai hasil metode, bukan kepribadian. Jadi ilham dari luar bikin kerja bersama sah-sah saja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk sebab-akibat yang sama dan setara presisinya. Opsi atribusi sebagai uji keaslian dipatahkan “attribution mattered for payment and not for authenticity”; opsi ilham interior yang membuat kerja bersama terhormat menukar arah perubahan, sebab genius interior justru datang dua generasi kemudian; opsi murid yang dilarang dipatahkan “might be trusted with a commission bearing the master's name”.

qs: What does the essay imply about artists writing letters in that period?
They may have treated revision as the most admirable part of the work.
They were instructed by patrons, though never to mention any effort.
They had reason to understate the hours their work required.
They described their childhoods in order to attract commissions.

qs.evidence: Practice therefore had to be concealed, and letters from the period display an increasing anxiety about appearing to have worked.
qs.answer: They had reason to understate the hours their work required.
qs.why: Latihan harus disembunyikan dan surat-surat memperlihatkan kecemasan kelihatan bekerja. Jadi mereka punya alasan mengecilkan jam kerjanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi revisi yang dipuji bertabrakan dengan “Practice therefore had to be concealed”; opsi perintah dari pelindung menambahkan pelaku yang nggak disebut, sebab teks menyebutnya “an occupational requirement”; opsi masa kecil dalam surat memindahkan biografi paragraf tiga ke surat-surat paragraf empat.

qs: What does the closing sentence achieve?
It ends the argument on a note of deliberate irony.
It proposes, though half in earnest, a revival of the older belief.
It admits the essay may have proved less than it intended.
It credits Romantic writers with commercial ingenuity.

qs.evidence: Attendant spirits, whatever their other faults, at least did not have to pretend they were self-made.
qs.answer: It ends the argument on a note of deliberate irony.
qs.why: Penulis muji roh pendamping cuma buat nyindir doktrin yang bikin seniman harus pura-pura mandiri. Itu ironi yang disengaja.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menganjurkan kebangkitan kepercayaan lama bertabrakan dengan paragraf lima, yang hanya menyatakan bahwa penjelasan itu dibangun oleh kepentingan tertentu; opsi mengakui kekurangan bukti bertabrakan dengan “It establishes only that”, yang justru menegaskan klaimnya; opsi memuji kecerdikan komersial memindahkan penilaian paragraf tiga.

qs: Where genius is said to have become an interior “property”, what does that word mean?
A quality belonging to a person rather than an owned possession.
A building or plot held under legal title rather than leased.
An object handled on stage rather than kept in a workshop.
A right of ownership transferred along with a commission.

qs.evidence: Within two generations the grammar had inverted, and genius had become an interior property, unevenly distributed, possessed by particular individuals from birth.
qs.answer: A quality belonging to a person rather than an owned possession.
qs.why: Kata itu dipakai bareng “interior” dan “possessed from birth”, jadi maksudnya sifat yang melekat pada orang, bukan harta yang dimiliki.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah definisi yang sama presisinya, tiga untuk makna lain kata itu. Kata itu berdiri di sebelah “interior” dan “possessed by particular individuals from birth”, jadi yang dimaksud sifat yang melekat pada orang; tanah bersertifikat, perlengkapan panggung, dan pengalihan hak semuanya sah dalam kamus tetapi nggak dapat dimiliki sejak lahir.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The idea of inborn genius served a commercial need to tell rival producers apart."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The idea of inborn genius served a commercial need to tell rival producers apart.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: A market in printed works required something to distinguish one supplier from another, and interior genius performed that task admirably.
qs.why: Teks bilang pasar cetak butuh pembeda antar pemasok, dan gagasan genius batiniah menjalankan tugas itu. Klaimnya sama, cuma pilih kata lain, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh bantahan atas motif komersial, dan itu nggak ada. “Not stated” gagal karena fungsi komersialnya disebut langsung.

topic: the invention of the modern idea of genius
author: Oka Prasetyo
setting: the European arts between two centuries

title: Eight Metres of Patience
text:
The bog begins where the path stops pretending to be a path, somewhere short of the ridge. The surface sinks by a couple of centimetres and then refuses, the experience of standing on eight metres of accumulated vegetation that never fully decayed. Sphagnum moss grows at the surface and dies beneath it, and the waterlogging excludes the oxygen that would normally complete the transaction. What results is neither soil nor lake but an archive, laid down at approximately one millimetre a year, in strict chronological order.

That figure is the entire difficulty of peatland restoration, and no quantity of enthusiasm removes it. A drainage ditch cut in nineteen sixty-three took an afternoon; the surface it lowered will require several centuries to recover its former height. Contractors can block the ditches, reintroduce the moss, and monitor the water table; every such intervention is valuable, and none of them alters the millimetre. The vocabulary of projects, with its milestones and reporting cycles, conflicts with a process indifferent to funding rounds.

I have visited the same hectare in four consecutive Novembers, and the honest assessment is that virtually nothing visible has altered. The pools are marginally wider, a cotton-grass has colonized a formerly bare bank of peat, and one dead pine, drowned by the rising water, has toppled. To a funder they represent disappointing deliverables, unquantifiable and unphotographable. To the bog they are the opening clauses of an extremely long sentence whose grammar is not ours to hurry.

The temptation to convert this slowness into consolation is one I intend to resist. Slowness is not a virtue here; it is merely the rate at which repair becomes possible, and rates are not moral qualities. It follows that the individuals who drained this ground will never witness it healed, and neither shall we. Restoration on this timescale is an act performed for strangers, which is uncomfortable rather than encouraging, and the discomfort is the accurate response.

What the bog offers is a challenge to a habit of attention formed elsewhere. Standing on it, you cannot perceive the process you are standing on, and the wish to declare the visit uneventful is powerful. The uneventfulness is the event. Carbon that would otherwise occupy the atmosphere is instead beneath my boots, held there by waterlogging and by nothing else, and the arrangement persists only while the water remains. Everything the site requires from us is a matter of leaving the water alone, a strangely difficult instruction to present as work.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer conclude about restoring the bog?
Blocking the drainage ditches restores the surface to its old height within a decade.
Repair here runs at a rate that funding rounds and reporting cycles cannot match.
Four Novembers of change suggest the restoration may already be working.
The slowness is arguably a consoling lesson, though a demanding one.

qs.evidence: The vocabulary of projects, with its milestones and reporting cycles, conflicts with a process indifferent to funding rounds.
qs.answer: Repair here runs at a rate that funding rounds and reporting cycles cannot match.
qs.why: Teks bilang kosakata proyek, dengan milestone dan siklus pelaporannya, nggak nyambung sama proses yang cuma jalan satu milimeter setahun. Itu inti keluhannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi memblokir parit yang memulihkan permukaan dalam sedasawarsa bertabrakan dengan “will require several centuries to recover its former height”; opsi empat November sebagai bukti keberhasilan bertabrakan dengan “virtually nothing visible has altered”; opsi kelambanan sebagai pelajaran yang menghibur bertabrakan dengan “The temptation to convert this slowness into consolation is one I intend to resist”.

qs: The writer plans a fifth November on the same hectare. What should he expect to see?
A fifth November will show the surface measurably nearer its former height.
A fifth November will show growth ample enough to photograph for a funder.
A fifth November will show almost nothing visibly altered.
A fifth November will show the moss gone and the intervention plainly failed.

qs.evidence: I have visited the same hectare in four consecutive Novembers, and the honest assessment is that virtually nothing visible has altered.
qs.answer: A fifth November will show almost nothing visibly altered.
qs.why: Empat November berturut-turut memberi dasar prediksinya: penilaian jujur penulis adalah “virtually nothing visible has altered”, dan gambut hanya bertambah sekitar satu milimeter setahun, jadi November kelima pun nggak akan terlihat berubah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi permukaan terukur mendekati tinggi lamanya bertabrakan dengan “several centuries” yang dibutuhkan. Opsi lumut hilang dan intervensi gagal bertabrakan dengan perubahan kecil yang memang tercatat: kolam sedikit melebar dan cotton-grass menjajah satu tebing gambut. Opsi pertumbuhan cukup untuk difoto pendonor dipatahkan penilaian teks sendiri, “unquantifiable and unphotographable”.

qs: What is the writer's attitude to the slowness of the process?
Unsentimental, treating the rate as a fact rather than a lesson.
Unsentimental, refusing the comfort that a ditch may quickly be undone.
Unsentimental, refusing consolation because the ground is beyond repair.
Unsentimental, though reproachful towards whoever cut the ditches.

qs.evidence: The temptation to convert this slowness into consolation is one I intend to resist.
qs.answer: Unsentimental, treating the rate as a fact rather than a lesson.
qs.why: Penulis menamai godaan mengubah kelambatan jadi penghiburan, bilang dia menolaknya, lalu menegaskan “rates are not moral qualities”. Jadi laju itu diperlakukan sebagai fakta, bukan pelajaran moral.
qs.whyOthersFail: Ketiga pengecoh juga menolak hiburan, jadi tanda anti-penghiburan nggak lagi menunjuk kunci; yang membedakan apa yang ditolak. Opsi parit yang bisa cepat dibalik dan opsi tanah yang tak dapat diperbaiki dipatahkan frasa yang sama, “the rate at which repair becomes possible”, yang menyebut pemulihan mungkin tetapi lambat; opsi mencela pembuat parit menambahkan tuduhan, padahal mereka disebut hanya sebagai orang yang nggak akan menyaksikan hasilnya.

qs: Which sentence best restates the point about a visit feeling uneventful?
A visit may feel quiet because the pools have widened only slightly.
The site is genuinely inactive until somebody blocks the drainage ditches again.
Nothing appearing to happen is precisely what the site's function looks like.
Anyone standing on the bog may expect dramatic change, though not soon.

qs.evidence: The uneventfulness is the event.
qs.answer: Nothing appearing to happen is precisely what the site's function looks like.
qs.why: “The uneventfulness is the event” artinya justru ketiadaan kejadian itulah kerja rawa: karbon tetap tersimpan selama airnya nggak diganggu.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kolam yang sedikit melebar mengambil detail paragraf tiga, bukan makna kalimat “The uneventfulness is the event”; opsi rawa yang benar-benar nggak aktif bertabrakan dengan karbon yang tertahan di bawah sepatunya; opsi mengharap perubahan dramatis bertabrakan dengan laju satu milimeter setahun.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Cutting the drainage ditch in nineteen sixty-three was itself a task of several centuries."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Cutting the drainage ditch in nineteen sixty-three was itself a task of several centuries.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: A drainage ditch cut in nineteen sixty-three took an afternoon; the surface it lowered will require several centuries to recover its former height.
qs.why: Teks bilang parit itu digali dalam satu sore. Yang butuh beberapa abad adalah pemulihannya, bukan penggaliannya, jadi klaimnya salah.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” cuma jalan kalau kamu menukar dua angka waktu itu. “Not stated” gagal karena kedua durasi disebut jelas di kalimat yang sama.

topic: peatland restoration and the timescale of repair
author: Panji Kusumo
setting: a drained upland bog under slow restoration

title: The Acoustics of Applause
text:
Applause has attracted less scholarly attention than the music it interrupts, which is odd, since it is the only sound in a concert hall produced by the audience deliberately. A recent series of measurements in four European halls treated it as an acoustic phenomenon rather than a social one, recording onset, duration, and decay across two hundred and eleven performances. The resulting data set is small but suggestive. It indicates that applause behaves less like noise than like a collective instrument with predictable properties.

The most consistent finding concerns latency. In halls with a reverberation time above two seconds, the interval between the final chord and the first clap extended by roughly four hundred milliseconds compared with drier rooms. The investigators attribute this to ambiguity: where the sound persists, listeners cannot determine when the performance has ended, and nobody wishes to be the individual who applauds into a note. The measurements were taken at the same height in each room. Latency, on this reading, is not reverence but uncertainty rendered audible.

A second finding is harder to interpret and correspondingly more interesting. Duration correlated only weakly with any independent measure of the performance, including critical reception and ticket resale prices. It correlated strongly, however, with the proportion of the audience seated in the stalls rather than in the upper tiers. The authors propose a mechanism involving sightlines and mutual visibility, since clapping is partly imitative and imitation requires observing what others do. Whether the effect survives replication in halls with different geometries remains unestablished.

The methodological limitations deserve emphasis, because the study has been reported more confidently than it was written. Four halls is a small sample, all four are in cities with comparable concert-going conventions, and the microphone arrays were positioned for convenience rather than for uniformity. The authors state these constraints plainly in a section that few summaries have troubled to read. They do not pretend otherwise. Their claim concerns measurement, not musical value, and the distinction has been widely collapsed.

What the work does establish is that a behaviour dismissed as simple convention possesses a physics, and that the physics changes from hall to hall. If latency is produced by reverberation rather than by feeling, then a hall partly composes the response it receives. Architects have long known that a room shapes what performers do; the suggestion here is that it shapes what listeners do as well. That is a narrower conclusion than the headlines permitted, and a more durable one.
qs: What relationship does the study report between a hall's acoustics and its applause?
Longer reverberation lengthens the delay before an audience begins to clap.
Longer reverberation shortens the delay before an audience begins to clap.
Longer reverberation lengthens the applause once an audience begins to clap.
Longer reverberation lengthens the delay only where the stalls are full.

qs.evidence: In halls with a reverberation time above two seconds, the interval between the final chord and the first clap extended by roughly four hundred milliseconds compared with drier rooms.
qs.answer: Longer reverberation lengthens the delay before an audience begins to clap.
qs.why: Di aula dengan reverberasi di atas dua detik, jeda antara akord terakhir dan tepuk pertama memanjang sekitar empat ratus milidetik. Itu persis hubungan yang ditanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyebut reverberasi sebagai sebab dan setara presisinya, jadi tiap pilihan menuntut satu angka dari teks. Opsi jeda yang memendek dipatahkan “extended by roughly four hundred milliseconds compared with drier rooms”; opsi tepuk yang memanjang dipatahkan “Duration correlated only weakly with any independent measure”, sebab durasi terkait proporsi penonton di stalls; opsi hanya bila stalls penuh menambahkan syarat yang nggak ada pada temuan latensi.

qs: What can be inferred about the finding concerning the stalls?
Its explanation is provisional, though the stalls plainly feel the music more.
Its explanation is provisional and still awaits testing in other buildings.
Its explanation is provisional because sightlines were ruled out as a factor.
Its explanation is provisional, since resale prices tracked duration closely.

qs.evidence: Whether the effect survives replication in halls with different geometries remains unestablished.
qs.answer: Its explanation is provisional and still awaits testing in other buildings.
qs.why: Teks bilang apakah efeknya selamat dalam replikasi di aula bergeometri lain “remains unestablished”. Jadi mekanismenya masih dugaan yang menunggu uji ulang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi membuka dengan pengakuan kehati-hatian yang sama, jadi register nggak menandai kunci. Opsi penonton stalls yang lebih tergerak dipatahkan “Their claim concerns measurement, not musical value”; opsi garis pandang yang disingkirkan membalik mekanisme yang justru diusulkan penulis studi; opsi harga tiket sekunder dipatahkan “correlated only weakly with any independent measure of the performance, including critical reception and ticket resale prices”.

qs: How does the article characterize the authors' own handling of their limits?
As frank, and confident that four halls suffice for a general claim.
As frank, though chiefly to blame summaries for misreading the work.
As candid, with the weaknesses of the sample stated openly.
As frank to the point of advancing no claim of their own at all.

qs.evidence: The authors state these constraints plainly in a section that few summaries have troubled to read.
qs.answer: As candid, with the weaknesses of the sample stated openly.
qs.why: Teks bilang penulis studi menyatakan kendala itu terang-terangan di bagian yang jarang dibaca ringkasan, dan nambahin “They do not pretend otherwise”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyebut keterusterangan yang sama, jadi yang harus dibaca adalah apa yang dilakukan penulis studi dengan kendalanya. Opsi empat aula udah cukup dipatahkan “Four halls is a small sample”, yang mereka nyatakan sendiri; opsi menyalahkan ringkasan memindahkan penilaian artikel ini kepada penulis studi; opsi tak mengajukan klaim apa pun dipatahkan “Their claim concerns measurement, not musical value”.

qs: In the claim that applause possesses a “physics”, what does that word denote?
The branch of science in which the investigators may have trained.
A set of measurable regularities that a room imposes on sound.
The microphone array used to record onset, though also decay.
The formula by which a reverberation time is calculated.

qs.evidence: What the work does establish is that a behaviour dismissed as simple convention possesses a physics, and that the physics changes from hall to hall.
qs.answer: A set of measurable regularities that a room imposes on sound.
qs.why: Kalimatnya bilang perilaku yang dianggap konvensi belaka ternyata punya “a physics” yang berubah dari aula ke aula. Jadi maksudnya keteraturan terukur yang dipaksakan ruangan, bukan cabang ilmunya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi cabang ilmu memakai arti “physics” yang paling umum, padahal kalimat berikutnya menjelaskannya sebagai “the physics changes from hall to hall”; opsi susunan mikrofon adalah alat ukurnya, bukan keteraturan yang diukur; opsi rumus waktu dengung mempersempitnya pada satu besaran, sedangkan teks memakainya untuk perilaku ruangan atas tepuk tangan.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The four halls in the study were all located in the same country."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The four halls in the study were all located in the same country.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Four halls is a small sample, all four are in cities with comparable concert-going conventions, and the microphone arrays were positioned for convenience rather than for uniformity.
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang keempatnya di kota dengan kebiasaan berkonser yang mirip, dan bahwa aulanya Eropa. Negara yang sama sekali nggak disebut, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” butuh pernyataan negara yang nggak ada. “False” juga butuh bukti bahwa negaranya berbeda, dan itu sama-sama nggak ada.

topic: measuring applause as an acoustic rather than social event
author: Ratna Sembiring
setting: a study across four European concert halls

title: Two Translations Too Many
text:
Every forecast reaching the public has been translated twice, and both translations lose something the audience is never informed about. The first converts a distribution into a number, because a distribution cannot be spoken aloud in fourteen seconds. The second converts the number into a verb: rain will fall, cases will rise, the deficit will widen. By the time the sentence arrives, the uncertainty constituting the actual finding has been filed away as a technicality.

Practitioners defend the compression on grounds of comprehension, and the defence is not absurd. Probability is genuinely arduous, percentages are misread routinely, and a forecaster insisting on intervals will be replaced by one who does not. Yet the empirical support for the assumption is thinner than its confidence suggests, and thinner than practitioners tend to concede. Studies of flood warnings and of medical prognosis both indicate that lay audiences handle stated ranges tolerably well, and that what they resent is not complexity but the discovery, afterwards, that complexity was withheld.

The cost of withholding it falls due at the first failed prediction, invariably in public. A hurricane that turns aside, an epidemic curve that flattens early, a recession forecast for a quarter that instead produced growth: each is entirely compatible with a competent probabilistic statement, and entirely incompatible with the flat declarative in which it was delivered. The forecaster is then accused of error when the genuine fault was rhetorical, a distinction nobody rewards. Trust erodes not because the science was wrong but because the grammar promised more than the science ever offered.

One obvious objection holds that hedged language invites paralysis. If the public is informed a storm might arrive, some proportion will decline to evacuate, and that proportion may include individuals who die. This is a serious argument deserving better than the slogan it has become. Nothing about stating a range requires abandoning a recommendation; the two operate at distinct levels of the same utterance. A warning can specify a seventy per cent chance and still instruct everybody to leave, provided the instruction is framed as a decision rather than as a description.

The situation demands a division of labour institutions have been reluctant to attempt. Scientists should report distributions, including the awkward extremes; communicators should convert distributions into decisions without pretending they are certainties; and audiences should be permitted to observe the seam between the two. The alternative, refined over several decades, is a public trained to treat every confident forecast as an overstatement and to discount accordingly. That habit is rational, it was taught deliberately, and it will be expensive to unteach.
qs: Read as a whole, what does this essay advance about reporting uncertainty?
Removing uncertainty damages trust, so forecasts should drop recommendations.
Removing uncertainty from forecasts damages trust when a prediction fails.
Removing uncertainty damages trust, and audiences do best with plain verbs.
Removing uncertainty damages trust, though the fault lies with the science itself.

qs.evidence: Trust erodes not because the science was wrong but because the grammar promised more than the science ever offered.
qs.answer: Removing uncertainty from forecasts damages trust when a prediction fails.
qs.why: Kalimat kuncinya bilang kepercayaan runtuh bukan karena sainsnya keliru, tapi karena tata bahasanya menjanjikan lebih dari yang pernah ditawarkan sains.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi membuka dengan tesis yang sama, jadi tesis yang tertebak dari soal lain nggak cukup dan klausa keduanya harus dibaca. Opsi menghapus rekomendasi dipatahkan “Nothing about stating a range requires abandoning a recommendation”; opsi kata kerja lugas dipatahkan “lay audiences handle stated ranges tolerably well”; opsi kesalahan pada sainsnya dipatahkan “the genuine fault was rhetorical”.

qs: What does the essay imply about the claim that audiences cannot cope with uncertainty?
It is an assumption the flood-warning studies were designed to confirm.
It is an assumption strong enough to rule out instructions in warnings.
It is an assumption that holds for prognosis but not for flood warnings.
It is an assumption that the available evidence does not support.

qs.evidence: Studies of flood warnings and of medical prognosis both indicate that lay audiences handle stated ranges tolerably well, and that what they resent is not complexity but the discovery, afterwards, that complexity was withheld.
qs.answer: It is an assumption that the available evidence does not support.
