qs.why: Dua bidang studi yang dikutip nunjukin orang awam cukup sanggup membaca rentang. Jadi asumsi bahwa publik nggak sanggup itu justru nggak didukung bukti.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyebutnya asumsi, jadi bentuknya nggak menandai kunci. Opsi studi yang mengonfirmasinya dipatahkan “lay audiences handle stated ranges tolerably well”; opsi meniadakan instruksi dipatahkan “A warning can specify a seventy per cent chance and still instruct everybody to leave”; opsi berlaku untuk prognosis saja dipatahkan kata “both” pada “Studies of flood warnings and of medical prognosis both indicate”.

qs: How does the writer treat the objection about paralysis?
As something communicators may have invented without evidence.
As a decisive reason to keep every forecast flatly declarative.
As a genuine argument that has degenerated into a slogan.
As a real risk, though one that stating a range would worsen.

qs.evidence: This is a serious argument deserving better than the slogan it has become.
qs.answer: As a genuine argument that has degenerated into a slogan.
qs.why: Penulis nyebut keberatan itu “a serious argument deserving better than the slogan it has become”. Diakui seriusnya, ditolak wujudnya sekarang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keberatan yang dikarang tanpa bukti bertabrakan dengan “This is a serious argument”; opsi alasan menjaga kalimat tegas bertabrakan dengan kalimat berikutnya, yang menyatakan rentang dan instruksi bekerja pada tingkat berbeda; opsi risiko yang diperburuk oleh rentang bertabrakan dengan contoh peringatan tujuh puluh persen yang tetap memerintahkan mengungsi.

qs: What does "compression" mean in the second paragraph?
The reduction of a complex finding into a brief statement.
The physical squeezing of air inside a storm system.
The shortening of a forecast's horizon to one quarter.
The cutting of a broadcast down to fourteen seconds.

qs.evidence: Practitioners defend the compression on grounds of comprehension, and the defence is not absurd.
qs.answer: The reduction of a complex finding into a brief statement.
qs.why: Yang dibela praktisi adalah dua penerjemahan di paragraf pertama: distribusi jadi satu angka, lalu angka jadi satu kata kerja. Jadi kata itu berarti pemadatan temuan rumit jadi pernyataan singkat.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah definisi ringkas yang setara presisinya, tiga untuk makna lain kata itu. Opsi pemampatan udara memakai arti fisisnya; opsi cakrawala satu kuartal memakai contoh resesi dari paragraf tiga; opsi pemotongan siaran memakai angka “fourteen seconds” dari paragraf satu, padahal yang dimampatkan adalah temuannya, yakni “converts a distribution into a number”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer regards the public's habit of discounting confident forecasts as a reasonable one."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer regards the public's habit of discounting confident forecasts as a reasonable one.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: That habit is rational, it was taught deliberately, and it will be expensive to unteach.
qs.why: Kalimat terakhir menyebut kebiasaan itu rasional, walau mahal untuk dibongkar. Rasional dan reasonable di sini sepadan, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh penulis menyebutnya irasional, dan dia nggak. “Not stated” gagal karena penilaiannya ada jelas.

topic: how public forecasting strips out uncertainty
author: Sabrina Adiwijaya
setting: an essay on risk communication

title: Forty-Three Brass Rectangles
text:
The plaque on the former market street informs passers-by that the premises operated as a ribbon manufactory from eighteen forty-one, and constitutes a proud element of the town's industrial heritage. Every noun in that sentence was selected by a committee, and nothing on the plaque is untrue, a distinct property from being informative. The difference is precisely where municipal storytelling earns its income; the town maintains forty-three such plaques.

Consider what such a plaque must accomplish simultaneously: it must compress a century into thirty words and satisfy a conservation officer. It must equally avoid alarming the ground-floor tenant, and produce in a stranger mild warmth towards a locality he quits within the hour. Those objectives are not simply distinct; several are opposed. Committee prose of this kind endures because nobody involved is ever obliged to defend a single clause publicly. The resulting genre is recognizable universally: passive verbs, an unspecified plural of employees, and an adjective performing the labour of an absent fact.

The ribbon manufactory, for instance, employed a workforce predominantly female and predominantly under twenty, and ceased trading in eighteen ninety-four following an eleven-week dispute over piece rates. None of this contradicts the term proud, though all of it complicates the term, which is precisely why thirty words cannot accommodate it. The omission is not a conspiracy; it is a consequence of a format selected for economy and subsequently defended as tradition.

I am sceptical of the official remedy, a longer plaque. Length invites a second committee, and a second committee produces the same prose at additional expense. A brass rectangle is brief not because the metal is valuable but because a brief text is approved without delay. What the format actually lacks is not room but candour about its own limits. One clause would accomplish more than another paragraph of warmth. It would concede that the account is partial, that a fuller version exists elsewhere, and that the reader might reasonably distrust a notice bolted to a wall by the authority collecting the rents.

The most useful plaque in the town is on a wall behind the bus station, and was not installed by the council. Somebody has attached a laminated sheet listing the names of the eleven women who organized the eighteen ninety-four dispute, with a note explaining that the official plaque a hundred metres away omits them. It is ugly and will not survive the season, yet performs more historical labour than the brass. Municipal heritage would benefit immediately by treating that sheet as a standard rather than as vandalism. It will not, of course, because the sheet is evidence that the format was a decision.
qs: What relationship does the writer draw between the plaque's brevity and its content?
The committee may have hidden the dispute when it drafted the wording.
A longer plaque would help, though not settle the problem identified.
The conservation officer's requirements are what shortened the wording.
The brevity was a budgetary choice later justified as a tradition.

qs.evidence: The omission is not a conspiracy; it is a consequence of a format selected for economy and subsequently defended as tradition.
qs.answer: The brevity was a budgetary choice later justified as a tradition.
qs.why: Teks bilang penghilangan itu akibat format yang dipilih demi ekonomi lalu dipertahankan sebagai tradisi. Kuningan itu ringkas karena teks ringkas disetujui tanpa penundaan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menyembunyikan sengketa dengan sengaja bertabrakan dengan “The omission is not a conspiracy”; opsi papan yang lebih panjang bertabrakan dengan “a second committee produces the same prose at additional expense”; opsi petugas konservasi sebagai penyebab kependekannya bertabrakan dengan sebab yang diberikan, “a brief text is approved without delay”.

qs: What does the writer imply about the laminated sheet behind the bus station?
The council will adopt the laminated sheet as a formal standard before winter.
It may work better because laminated paper outlasts brass on a wall.
Its usefulness comes from admitting what the official version leaves out.
The council may reject it, though partly because it will not last.

qs.evidence: Somebody has attached a laminated sheet listing the names of the eleven women who organized the eighteen ninety-four dispute, with a note explaining that the official plaque a hundred metres away omits them.
qs.answer: Its usefulness comes from admitting what the official version leaves out.
qs.why: Lembar itu menyebut sebelas nama yang dihilangkan plakat resmi dan menyatakan penghilangan itu terang-terangan. Persis kejujuran yang menurut penulis kurang di format resmi.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi kertas laminasi yang lebih tahan bertabrakan dengan “It is ugly and will not survive the season”; opsi dewan yang menolak karena tak tahan lama bertabrakan dengan alasan yang diberikan penutup, yaitu bahwa lembar itu membuktikan formatnya sebuah keputusan; opsi dewan yang akan mengadopsinya bertabrakan dengan “It will not, of course”.

qs: What is the writer's tone when the proposal for a longer plaque comes up?
Drily sceptical that a longer text would change the prose at all.
Cautiously hopeful that a second committee could supply the candour.
Weary resignation that the brass rectangles cannot now be altered.
Mild irritation at the conservation officer who must approve wording.

qs.evidence: Length invites a second committee, and a second committee produces the same prose at additional expense.
qs.answer: Drily sceptical that a longer text would change the prose at all.
qs.why: Teks bilang panjang cuma memanggil komite kedua, dan komite kedua menghasilkan prosa yang sama dengan biaya tambahan. Itu skeptisisme kering, bukan usulan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Harapan gugur karena komite kedua persis disebut menghasilkan prosa yang sama. Resignasi gugur karena penulis bilang satu klausa akan mencapai lebih banyak dan minta lembar laminasi dijadikan standar. Dan kekesalan pada petugas konservasi gugur karena dia cuma muncul sebagai salah satu tuntutan format.

qs: Where an adjective is said to perform the “labour” of an absent fact, what does that word mean?
The workforce that the ribbon manufactory may once have employed.
The effort a committee spends on approving a text.
The work that an absent fact would otherwise have done.
The trade once practised, though only on the former market street.

qs.evidence: The resulting genre is recognizable universally: passive verbs, an unspecified plural of employees, and an adjective performing the labour of an absent fact.
qs.answer: The work that an absent fact would otherwise have done.
qs.why: Kalimatnya bilang kata sifat itu mengerjakan “the labour of an absent fact”: pekerjaan yang seharusnya dilakukan oleh fakta yang nggak dicantumkan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tenaga kerja pabrik dan opsi perdagangan di jalan pasar sama-sama memakai arti “labour” sebagai kerja manusia, padahal kalimat itu menyebut “an adjective performing the labour of an absent fact”; opsi usaha komite menyetujui teks memindahkan pelakunya ke panitia, bukan ke kata sifat itu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The laminated sheet behind the bus station was put up by the town council."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The laminated sheet behind the bus station was put up by the town council.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: The most useful plaque in the town is on a wall behind the bus station, and was not installed by the council.
qs.why: Teks bilang lembar itu bukan pasangan dewan kota, dan kalimat berikutnya menyebut “somebody” yang menempelkannya. Jadi klaimnya salah.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertentangan langsung dengan kalimat itu. “Not stated” gagal karena penulis menyatakan asal-usulnya secara jelas.

topic: heritage plaques and the limits of municipal storytelling
author: Tegar Nugroho
setting: a small industrial town with an official plaque scheme

title: Twenty-Four Volumes of Certainty
text:
The set occupies two shelves in my hallway, twenty-four volumes bound in a green that has faded unevenly, printed in nineteen twenty-nine. I acquired it for the equivalent of a modest lunch, roughly what an exhaustive and superseded survey of the universe currently commands. Nobody currently consults it as a source, and it would be imprudent to attempt it. Its value lies in something the compilers would have deemed insulting: a record of how certainty sounds immediately before refutation.

The entry on the atom is the salient instance, and also the least instructive of the set. Far more revealing are the entries where the confidence is grammatical rather than factual, embedded in syntax. Confidence of that kind is invisible to its author, since nothing in the surrounding literature contradicts it. Continents are described as fixed, not because the compilers had examined and rejected the alternative, but because the possibility of their movement did not yet occupy a position from which it could be rejected. The prose contains no hedge, since a hedge requires an opponent, and what one encounters there is not error but the absence of an enquiry.

This is more elusive in one's own period, for precisely the reason that renders it worth attempting. I cannot list the propositions I currently hold that will resemble the fixed continents; if I could list them they would already be under revision. The exercise available to me is weaker and nonetheless serviceable: to notice where my own prose declines to hedge, and to interrogate whether the confidence is earned or merely inherited. Those volumes are a device for that noticing, performing it more effectively than any argument.

There is a self-congratulatory way of reading obsolete encyclopedias, and I have caught myself at it repeatedly. It consists of scoring points against the dead, who cannot revise, and it flatters the reader with a superiority he did nothing to earn. The compilers were not obtuse; they were early, which is a different accusation altogether, since priority in sequence is not a moral defect, though it reliably resembles one from a distance. Virtually every misjudgement they made arose from standing where they stood, the sole position anybody ever occupies.

What remains of them is a tone, the instructive residue of the whole enterprise. Twenty-four volumes were produced by compilers who imagined a general account of everything could be completed and thereafter maintained by supplements. That belief is now unavailable, and its unavailability is a genuine loss as well as a correction. We know more and expect less, and the second clause of that sentence deserves more attention than it customarily receives. The green volumes are not a monument to ignorance but to a confidence structurally impossible to sustain.
qs: Read as a whole, what does the writer claim the old set is worth?
The set is still a dependable source on the structure of the atom.
It is valuable as a record of unexamined confidence rather than of facts.
The compilers were perhaps less able than the writers who followed them.
Supplements may keep a general account current, though not indefinitely.

qs.evidence: Its value lies in something the compilers would have deemed insulting: a record of how certainty sounds immediately before refutation.
qs.answer: It is valuable as a record of unexamined confidence rather than of facts.
qs.why: Penulis bilang nilainya bukan pada isinya, tapi pada bagaimana bunyi kepastian ketika kepastian itu hampir terbukti salah.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi sumber andal tentang atom bertabrakan dengan “it would be imprudent to attempt it”; opsi penyusun yang kurang mampu bertabrakan dengan “The compilers were not obtuse; they were early”; opsi suplemen yang menjaga kemutakhiran bertabrakan dengan “That belief is now unavailable”.

qs: What does the writer suggest about the description of continents as fixed?
It reflects an alternative examined and then quietly set aside.
It reflects a caution the surrounding prose has not yet dropped.
It reflects a question that had not yet been posed, not one rejected.
It reflects an error of fact rather than the absence of an enquiry.

qs.evidence: Continents are described as fixed, not because the compilers had examined and rejected the alternative, but because the possibility of their movement did not yet occupy a position from which it could be rejected.
qs.answer: It reflects a question that had not yet been posed, not one rejected.
qs.why: Teks bilang kemungkinan benua bergerak belum menempati posisi yang bisa ditolak. Artinya pertanyaannya belum ada, bukan udah dijawab keliru.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk “ini mencerminkan …” yang sama, jadi register nggak menandai kunci. Opsi alternatif yang udah diperiksa dipatahkan “not because the compilers had examined and rejected the alternative”; opsi prosa yang masih berhati-hati dipatahkan “The prose contains no hedge”; opsi kekeliruan fakta dipatahkan “what one encounters there is not error but the absence of an enquiry”.

qs: How does the writer regard the habit of mocking obsolete encyclopedias?
As a cheap superiority the writer admits indulging repeatedly.
As a fair response, though only to compilers who were not clever enough.
As a temptation the writer claims to have avoided entirely.
As a method that may help in noticing one's own inherited confidence.

qs.evidence: It consists of scoring points against the dead, who cannot revise, and it flatters the reader with a superiority he did nothing to earn.
qs.answer: As a cheap superiority the writer admits indulging repeatedly.
qs.why: Teks bilang kebiasaan itu mengumpulkan poin atas orang mati yang nggak bisa merevisi, dan menyanjung pembaca dengan keunggulan yang nggak diusahakannya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tanggapan yang wajar bertabrakan dengan “The compilers were not obtuse”; opsi godaan yang berhasil dihindari bertabrakan dengan “I have caught myself at it repeatedly”; opsi metode yang dianjurkan menukar dua hal, sebab yang dianjurkan penulis adalah memeriksa prosanya sendiri, bukan mencela yang udah mati.

qs: What is a “hedge” in the remark that the prose contains none?
A row of shrubs planted along the edge of a field.
A confident assertion, though of the kind the atom entry makes.
A supplement that may be issued to correct a volume already printed.
A qualifying phrase that limits the force of a claim.

qs.evidence: The prose contains no hedge, since a hedge requires an opponent
qs.answer: A qualifying phrase that limits the force of a claim.
qs.why: Teks bilang hedge butuh lawan: kamu cuma memasang pembatas kalau ada posisi tandingan. Jadi maksudnya frasa pembatas yang melunakkan klaim.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi pernyataan yang percaya diri membalik artinya, sebab kalimat itu berbunyi “The prose contains no hedge, since a hedge requires an opponent”; opsi suplemen memakai pokok paragraf lima, bukan kata ini; opsi barisan tanaman memakai arti kamus “hedge” yang paling umum dan nggak berkaitan dengan prosa.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The writer regards the disappearance of that belief as something regrettable and not merely an improvement."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The writer regards the disappearance of that belief as something regrettable and not merely an improvement.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: That belief is now unavailable, and its unavailability is a genuine loss as well as a correction.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menyebut hilangnya keyakinan itu kerugian sungguhan sekaligus koreksi. Klaimnya cuma menyusun ulang kalimat itu, jadi True.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh dia menyebutnya semata kemajuan. “Not stated” gagal karena dua sisi penilaiannya ada di satu kalimat.

topic: an obsolete encyclopedia as a record of unexamined confidence
author: Untari Widodo
setting: a second-hand set from nineteen twenty-nine on a hallway shelf

title: Priced as a Commodity, Behaving as a Promise
text:
The arithmetic of an avoided-deforestation credit rests on a counterfactual, and a counterfactual cannot be measured. The claim is that a particular hectare would have been cleared and was not, which requires an account of what a landowner intended to do in a year that never occurred. Verification bodies handle this by constructing a baseline from regional trends, and the baseline is then treated, in the resulting certificate, as though it were an observation, so everything downstream of that substitution inherits its uncertainty.

Nothing about this is fraudulent in itself, and the alternative is not obviously preferable. Conservation has always been financed by arguments that resist audit, and the older arguments about beauty and duty raised considerably less money. The offset market has channelled substantial sums towards forests that would otherwise have attracted none, and purity is a luxury available to anybody who never has to raise a budget. Defenders of the mechanism are entitled to point at intact canopy and ask what the objection actually amounts to.

The objection is that the instrument is priced as a commodity while behaving as a promise. A tonne of carbon dioxide is fungible by definition; the avoided clearance of one particular ridge is not. Fungibility is a property of the accounting unit rather than of the ridge itself. When an airline retires a credit, it acquires something resembling a delivered good, and its accountants treat it accordingly. The asymmetry registers on the buyer's balance sheet as certainty and on the forest as a hope, and only one of those parties is audited annually.

Reform proposals cluster around improved baselines, and improved baselines will not resolve a category error. Sharper statistics narrow the interval around an unobservable quantity; they do not convert it into an observed one. Nobody in the sector disputes the arithmetic, and almost everybody disputes the label. What might genuinely assist is a candid change of vocabulary: describing the payment as a subsidy for stewardship rather than as the purchase of an offset. The sums would remain, the forests would remain, and the accounting fiction would not.

That proposal will be resisted, and the reason is instructive rather than sinister. A subsidy has to be justified politically each year, whereas an offset discharges an obligation instantly and requires no further conversation. The awkwardness is therefore not technical but political: the market exists in its present form because it converts a moral question into a settled transaction. Anybody wishing to reform it must first explain what becomes of the demand once the settlement is withdrawn.
qs: Read as a whole, which objection to the offset instrument does the writer press?
Better baselines may narrow, though not remove, the counterfactual gap.
An offset is sold as a delivered good although it remains a promise.
Conservation perhaps raised more from arguments about beauty and duty.
Airlines should be audited annually by the verification bodies.

qs.evidence: The objection is that the instrument is priced as a commodity while behaving as a promise.
qs.answer: An offset is sold as a delivered good although it remains a promise.
qs.why: Keluhan intinya: instrumennya dihargai seperti komoditas padahal isinya janji. Pembeli mencatatnya sebagai barang yang udah diterima.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi garis dasar yang lebih baik bertabrakan dengan “improved baselines will not resolve a category error”; opsi kecantikan dan kewajiban yang mengumpulkan lebih banyak membalik “raised considerably less money”; opsi audit tahunan atas maskapai memakai detail paragraf tiga sebagai usul, padahal itu hanya penanda asimetri.

qs: What does the writer imply about why his own proposal will be resisted?
A subsidy would expose fees that the verification bodies quietly collect.
A subsidy would leave the forests unpaid for once the label had changed.
A subsidy reopens each year a question that an offset closes at once.
A subsidy would call fraudulent what the market merely accounts for loosely.

qs.evidence: A subsidy has to be justified politically each year, whereas an offset discharges an obligation instantly and requires no further conversation.
qs.answer: A subsidy reopens each year a question that an offset closes at once.
qs.why: Teks bilang subsidi harus dibenarkan secara politis tiap tahun, sedangkan offset melunasi kewajiban seketika dan nggak menuntut percakapan lanjutan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi berbicara tentang akibat pelabelan ulang menjadi subsidi, jadi tesisnya nggak menolong. Opsi imbalan lembaga verifikasi menambahkan motif yang nggak pernah disebut; opsi hutan yang tak lagi dibayar dipatahkan “The sums would remain, the forests would remain”; opsi menuduh curang dipatahkan “Nothing about this is fraudulent in itself”.

qs: How does the writer treat the defenders of the offset market?
As perhaps overstating a case the intact canopy cannot quite support.
As misled by accountants who misread what a certificate promises.
As beside the point, though the arithmetic of a tonne still holds.
As making a fair point that the objection then has to survive.

qs.evidence: Defenders of the mechanism are entitled to point at intact canopy and ask what the objection actually amounts to.
qs.answer: As making a fair point that the objection then has to survive.
qs.why: Teks bilang pembela mekanisme itu “are entitled to” menunjuk tajuk hutan yang utuh dan menanyakan sebenarnya keberatannya sekuat apa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi terlalu membesar-besarkan bertabrakan dengan “Defenders of the mechanism are entitled to point at intact canopy”; opsi disesatkan oleh akuntan memindahkan sasarannya, sebab akuntan disebut hanya sebagai pencatat; opsi nggak relevan bertabrakan dengan “the alternative is not obviously preferable”.

qs: What does “retires” describe when an airline does it to a credit?
Stops dealing in credits of that particular kind.
Settles a debt owed to a verification body.
Takes an ageing aircraft out of its fleet.
Withdraws a credit from use so as to claim it.

qs.evidence: When an airline retires a credit, it acquires something resembling a delivered good, and its accountants treat it accordingly.
qs.answer: Withdraws a credit from use so as to claim it.
qs.why: Kalimatnya bilang begitu kredit itu di-retire, maskapainya memperoleh sesuatu yang menyerupai barang yang udah diantar. Jadi kreditnya ditarik dari peredaran supaya manfaatnya bisa diklaim.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah definisi tegas dan setara presisinya. Opsi berhenti berdagang dan opsi menarik pesawat memakai makna lazim kata itu untuk usaha dan armada, padahal objeknya di sini satu kredit yang lalu diperlakukan “as a delivered good”; opsi melunasi utang menambahkan kewajiban kepada lembaga verifikasi yang nggak pernah disebut.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The verification bodies that construct baselines are paid by the buyers of credits."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The verification bodies that construct baselines are paid by the buyers of credits.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: Verification bodies handle this by constructing a baseline from regional trends
qs.why: Teks cuma bilang badan verifikasi menyusun baseline dari tren regional. Siapa yang membayar mereka sama sekali nggak disebut, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” butuh keterangan pendanaan yang nggak ada. “False” butuh bukti pembayarnya pihak lain, dan itu juga nggak ada.

topic: carbon offsets as a conservation finance instrument
author: Vira Anggraini
setting: an essay on avoided-deforestation credits

title: The Pair, Not the Term
text:
Intellectual history has generally treated translation as a transmission problem, in which a concept travels and arrives with some loss. A more productive framing treats the translated term as a new object, constituted by the receiving language rather than delivered to it. The distinction is not merely philosophical, since it predicts different research programmes: on the transmission account one measures fidelity; on the constitutive account one traces what the term was subsequently able to do. Both accounts can be pursued rigorously, and they do not answer the same question.

The Japanese rendering of the European word for society offers a well-documented illustration. Nineteenth-century translators had available a vocabulary of relation and association but no single term denoting an abstract collective distinct from the state. The coinage that eventually stabilized imported the abstraction and, in doing so, acquired connotations of deliberate assembly that the source term lacked. Subsequent legal argument in that language proceeded from the coinage rather than from the original, and diverged accordingly, a divergence documented in the drafting records of the period.

Such cases are frequently narrated as episodes of misunderstanding, which begs the question at issue. Misunderstanding presupposes a determinate original meaning against which the rendering can be scored. The historical record more often shows a source term that was itself contested at home, so the translator selected among rival senses rather than failing to reproduce a settled one. What appears as distortion from a distance is, in the archive, a defensible choice among available options, and the distinction matters chiefly for how blame is subsequently assigned.

The methodological consequence is that the unit of analysis should be the pair rather than the term. Studying the receiving coinage alone recovers its later career but conceals what it was competing with. Studying only the source reproduces the diffusionist assumption the field claims to have abandoned, and neither shortcut has produced durable results. A paired reading, attentive to what each language could and could not say at the moment of contact, is laborious and yields findings that resist generalization.

This constraint should be stated plainly rather than apologized for. Conceptual history at this resolution produces local findings, and the temptation to aggregate them into a general theory of conceptual travel has repeatedly proved unproductive. The value of the work lies in its capacity to disturb the categories a reader brought to it. That is a modest claim, and it is defensible. A discipline generating no such disturbances would be describing its own vocabulary and calling the result history.
qs: What relationship does the article propose between a translated term and its source?
It is a copy whose fidelity can be scored against a settled original.
It is a new object whose later career the source term still governs.
It becomes a distinct object that the receiving language brings into being.
It is a new object, so the source it displaced stops repaying study.

qs.evidence: A more productive framing treats the translated term as a new object, constituted by the receiving language rather than delivered to it.
qs.answer: It becomes a distinct object that the receiving language brings into being.
qs.why: Teks bilang kerangka yang lebih produktif memperlakukan istilah terjemahan sebagai objek baru yang dibentuk bahasa penerima, bukan diantar ke sana.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi menyatakan relasi yang setara presisinya, jadi kunci nggak unik. Opsi salinan yang bisa diukur kesetiaannya dipatahkan “The historical record more often shows a source term that was itself contested at home”; opsi istilah sumber yang tetap mengatur dipatahkan “Subsequent legal argument in that language proceeded from the coinage rather than from the original”; opsi sumber yang berhenti berguna dipatahkan “the unit of analysis should be the pair rather than the term”.

qs: What does the article imply about labelling such cases misunderstandings?
It assumes a settled original that the historical record does not supply.
It may be fair wherever the coinage picked up fresh connotations.
It is arguably supported by drafting records of the later divergence.
It matters little, since assigning blame is not the historian's business.

qs.evidence: The historical record more often shows a source term that was itself contested at home, so the translator selected among rival senses rather than failing to reproduce a settled one.
qs.answer: It assumes a settled original that the historical record does not supply.
qs.why: Teks bilang arsipnya lebih sering menunjukkan istilah sumber yang di rumahnya sendiri masih diperdebatkan, jadi nggak ada makna asli tunggal buat dijadikan patokan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi konotasi baru sebagai pembenaran bertabrakan dengan “Misunderstanding presupposes a determinate original meaning”; opsi catatan penyusunan sebagai dukungan memakai bukti paragraf dua untuk klaim yang berbeda; opsi soal menyalahkan yang nggak penting bertabrakan dengan “the distinction matters chiefly for how blame is subsequently assigned”.

qs: How does the article present the labour that a paired reading demands?
As burdensome, though not enough to justify either shortcut.
As a cost the article may seem to apologize for at the close.
As genuinely burdensome and worth accepting for what it yields.
As light work once the paired sources have both been assembled.

qs.evidence: A paired reading, attentive to what each language could and could not say at the moment of contact, is laborious and yields findings that resist generalization.
qs.answer: As genuinely burdensome and worth accepting for what it yields.
qs.why: Metodenya disebut laborious dan hasilnya menolak generalisasi, tapi nilainya justru dinyatakan sebagai kemampuan mengganggu kategori pembaca, jadi bebannya diterima.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi cukup berat untuk membenarkan jalan pintas bertabrakan dengan “neither shortcut has produced durable results”; opsi meminta maaf bertabrakan dengan “This constraint should be stated plainly rather than apologized for”; opsi kerja ringan bertabrakan dengan kata “laborious”.

qs: What does "resolution" mean in the final paragraph?
A formal decision perhaps taken by scholars.
The settling of a dispute, though between senses.
The level of fine detail at which work is done.
A firm intention to abandon a diffusionist view.

qs.evidence: Conceptual history at this resolution produces local findings, and the temptation to aggregate them into a general theory of conceptual travel has repeatedly proved unproductive.
qs.answer: The level of fine detail at which work is done.
qs.why: Teks bilang sejarah konsep “at this resolution” menghasilkan temuan lokal yang menolak digeneralisasi, jadi maksudnya tingkat kerincian kerjanya.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keputusan resmi dan opsi penyelesaian sengketa memakai dua arti “resolution” yang paling umum, padahal frasa “at this resolution” dipasangkan dengan temuan lokal dan kerja yang “laborious”; opsi niat meninggalkan pandangan difusionis memakai arti ketiga yang juga lazim tetapi bukan yang dipakai.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The article recommends studying the receiving term on its own."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The article recommends studying the receiving term on its own.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Studying the receiving coinage alone recovers its later career but conceals what it was competing with.
qs.why: Teks bilang meneliti bentukan penerima saja justru menyembunyikan apa yang jadi saingannya, dan unit analisisnya harus pasangan. Jadi klaimnya salah.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” bertabrakan dengan anjuran pasangan istilah. “Not stated” gagal karena rekomendasinya dinyatakan jelas.

topic: translation as the constitution rather than transmission of concepts
author: Wayan Suryadi
setting: a methodological article in intellectual history

title: Two of Those Three Duly Arrived
text:
The high street was closed to traffic in two thousand and nine, resurfaced in a warm grey granite, and furnished with eleven benches, four planters, and a bronze of a woman carrying a basket. The consultants' assessment promised footfall, dwell time, and a renewed sense of civic presence; two of those three duly arrived, while the third is a phrase, and phrases are difficult to invoice for.

It would be dishonest to characterize the scheme as a failure, since on its own indicators it succeeded. Footfall rose by nineteen per cent within two years and has not fallen since. Dwell time, measured by an agency counting how long an individual remains within a defined rectangle, roughly doubled. The street is manifestly pleasanter, and I walk down it by choice, which I formerly did not.

The indicators do not register the composition of the tenancies. The ironmonger closed in two thousand and twelve, the second-hand bookshop in two thousand and fourteen, and the units they occupied now hold a coffee franchise and a shop selling scented candles. Neither replacement is contemptible, and both employ local staff. But a street that has become pleasant to linger on has also become expensive to trade on, and the rent review followed the granite within eighteen months. The transformation of the tenancies proceeded without any public announcement, since commercial displacement rarely requires a decision a named official must defend.

The causal claim requires care, since the ironmonger was also competing with an out-of-town retail park. Pedestrianization did not evict him unaided; it altered what the landlord might plausibly ask of whoever arrived next. That is a slower and less dramatic mechanism than the campaigners alleged, and correspondingly harder to argue against, since nobody signed anything visible. A rent review is not a policy, and a policy operating through rent reviews leaves no fingerprints. Attribution in such circumstances remains uncomfortable, since the effective instrument is a quarterly negotiation between private parties under no legal obligation to publish.

The honest conclusion is not that the scheme should be reversed, which would be absurd, but that its evaluation was designed to succeed. Footfall and dwell time are the two variables least likely to embarrass a public realm improvement. An evaluation assembled exclusively from favourable indicators functions as a commemorative document, and attaching a methodology alters nothing about its evidential value. A council wishing to establish what it had achieved would have counted the trades, tracked the rents, and published both alongside the photographs. It did not, and it will not, and the benches are genuinely comfortable.
qs: Read as a whole, what criticism of the scheme does the essay ultimately make?
Its evaluation measured only the things it was certain to improve.
The scheme largely failed, though on indicators the consultants chose.
Pedestrianization may have evicted the ironmonger largely on its own.
The council ought to reverse the scheme and let some traffic back in.

qs.evidence: The honest conclusion is not that the scheme should be reversed, which would be absurd, but that its evaluation was designed to succeed.
qs.answer: Its evaluation measured only the things it was certain to improve.
qs.why: Penulis bilang kesimpulan jujurnya bukan skemanya harus dibatalkan, tapi evaluasinya dirancang supaya lulus. Dua variabelnya memang paling aman.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi skema yang gagal bertabrakan dengan “on its own indicators it succeeded”; opsi pejalan kaki yang mengusir pedagang besi bertabrakan dengan “Pedestrianization did not evict him unaided”; opsi membalik skema bertabrakan dengan “not that the scheme should be reversed, which would be absurd”.

qs: The council commissions an evaluation of its next pedestrian scheme. What will that document contain?
The next evaluation will publish the rents beside the photographs, the mechanism now being understood.
The next evaluation will recommend reversing the scheme and readmitting traffic.
The next evaluation will at last measure the civic presence the consultants promised.
The next evaluation will report footfall and dwell time, leaving the trades and the rents uncounted.

qs.evidence: A council wishing to establish what it had achieved would have counted the trades, tracked the rents, and published both alongside the photographs. It did not, and it will not, and the benches are genuinely comfortable.
qs.answer: The next evaluation will report footfall and dwell time, leaving the trades and the rents uncounted.
qs.why: Paragraf terakhir menyatakan apa yang akan dan nggak akan dilakukan dewan: dewan yang ingin tahu capaiannya “would have counted the trades, tracked the rents”, lalu “It did not, and it will not”. Jadi evaluasi berikutnya kembali melaporkan footfall dan dwell time tanpa menghitung jenis usaha dan sewa.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi sewa diterbitkan bersama foto justru yang disangkal kalimat “It did not, and it will not”. Opsi merekomendasikan pembalikan skema bertabrakan dengan penilaian penulis bahwa membalikkannya “would be absurd”. Opsi akhirnya mengukur civic presence menggoda karena itu janji ketiga konsultan, tetapi teks menyebutnya “a phrase, and phrases are difficult to invoice for”, dan indikator yang dipilih adalah yang paling kecil kemungkinannya memalukan.

qs: What is the writer's attitude to the street as it now stands?
Appreciative of the street itself, sceptical of how it was assessed.
Regretful, though largely about the franchise that replaced the ironmonger.
Wistful, perhaps, for the traffic the scheme removed from the street.
Detached, reporting the figures without judging the street at all.

qs.evidence: The street is manifestly pleasanter, and I walk down it by choice, which I formerly did not.
qs.answer: Appreciative of the street itself, sceptical of how it was assessed.
qs.why: Teks bilang jalannya jelas lebih menyenangkan dan penulis melewatinya atas kemauan sendiri, sementara evaluasinya disebut dirancang supaya lulus.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi menyesali kedai kopi bertabrakan dengan “Neither replacement is contemptible”; opsi merindukan lalu lintas bertabrakan dengan “I walk down it by choice, which I formerly did not”; opsi tanpa penilaian bertabrakan dengan “its evaluation was designed to succeed”.

qs: Which sentence best restates the point about the street becoming pleasant?
A pleasant street may attract tenants who employ fewer local staff.
Trading grew cheaper, though only once the traffic had been removed.
Making the street agreeable also made its floorspace dearer to occupy.
The rent review is what made the street pleasant to linger on.

qs.evidence: But a street that has become pleasant to linger on has also become expensive to trade on, and the rent review followed the granite within eighteen months.
qs.answer: Making the street agreeable also made its floorspace dearer to occupy.
qs.why: Kalimatnya menyandingkan dua akibat dari satu perubahan: enak buat berlama-lama, sekaligus mahal buat berdagang, dan peninjauan sewa menyusul dalam delapan belas bulan.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi penyewa yang nggak memakai pekerja lokal bertabrakan dengan “both employ local staff”; opsi berdagang yang menjadi lebih murah membalik “expensive to trade on”; opsi peninjauan sewa sebagai penyebab kenyamanan menukar urutan sebabnya, sebab granit datang lebih dulu.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Footfall has remained above its earlier level ever since the rise of nineteen per cent."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Footfall has remained above its earlier level ever since the rise of nineteen per cent.
qs.answer: True
qs.evidence: Footfall rose by nineteen per cent within two years and has not fallen since.
qs.why: Teks bilang jumlah pejalan naik sembilan belas persen dalam dua tahun dan belum pernah turun sejak itu. Klaimnya cuma versi lain kalimat yang sama.
qs.whyOthersFail: “False” butuh penurunan yang nggak pernah disebut. “Not stated” gagal karena kelanjutannya dinyatakan langsung.

topic: a pedestrianized high street and the metrics chosen to judge it
author: Yanuar Hastomo
setting: a small town centre eleven years after resurfacing

title: Forty Minutes Before the Caretaker
text:
The rehearsal starts at half past seven and nobody is ready at half past seven. Overcoats accumulate on a radiator, the accompanist argues mildly with a lectern, and a retired surveyor distributes photocopies legible four years ago. We are nineteen individuals, perhaps six of whom read a score with any confidence, the remainder proceeding by memory and nerve. The conductor, who instructs a primary school class on weekdays, has forty minutes before the caretaker requires the hall for an unrelated purpose.

What happens in those forty minutes is not, by any external standard, good. The tenors enter early and remain proud of it, and a soprano line that ought to float settles instead, audibly, on the floorboards. Ensemble singing exposes every deficiency simultaneously, and an untrained section betrays its uncertainty through pitch alone, long before a listener could identify the culprit. I am a baritone by default rather than by aptitude, and my contribution consists largely of arriving at the correct note shortly after everybody else has left it.

Yet twice, in four years, something has occurred that I have no vocabulary for. A chord assembled itself mid-hall, unmistakably superior to the sum of the individuals producing it, and persisted perhaps two seconds. Nobody discussed it afterwards, which strikes me as the appropriate response, since the event does not survive description, and describing it is the surest method of guaranteeing it will not recur.

I distrust the sentimental account of amateur music, which treats incompetence as charming and fellowship as the point. Sentimentality of that kind patronizes the participants, since affection replaces the assumption that unqualified adults might legitimately intend accuracy rather than mere participation. The fellowship is real, and it is not the point. We assemble on Tuesdays because the piece is demanding, and because an arduous piece performed adequately by nineteen unqualified volunteers is a genuine achievement, not a consolation prize awarded for attendance.

The concert occurs in November, in a church with a heating system audible during the quieter passages, and audible in the recording afterwards. Approximately forty listeners will attend, most related to a participant. We shall be, at best, competent, and the tenors will enter early, as they invariably do. None of that alters the arithmetic: nineteen amateurs who would otherwise be viewing broadcast entertainment are instead learning to attend to one another with some precision. The occurrence resists preparation, although consistent attendance and honest repetition appear to constitute its necessary conditions, whatever the sufficient conditions eventually prove to be. The chord may not arrive; it has arrived twice.
qs: Read as a whole, why does the writer maintain the group is worth joining?
The choir's incompetence is arguably charming, though not the point.
The value lies in attempting difficulty, not in the companionship.
Two remembered chords may partly justify four years of rehearsal.
Amateur singing matters because the November concert is well attended.

qs.evidence: The fellowship is real, and it is not the point.
qs.answer: The value lies in attempting difficulty, not in the companionship.
qs.why: Dia bilang kebersamaannya nyata tapi bukan intinya, lalu menyebut alasan sebenarnya: potongan musiknya sulit dan sembilan belas amatir menggarapnya secara layak.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi ketidakmampuan yang menawan bertabrakan dengan “I distrust the sentimental account”; opsi dua akor sebagai pembenaran bertabrakan dengan alasan yang dinyatakan, “because the piece is demanding”; opsi konser November yang ramai bertabrakan dengan “Approximately forty listeners”.

qs: What does the writer suggest about not discussing the chord afterwards?
Analysis would destroy the very thing it attempted to capture.
Nobody in the hall may have noticed anything unusual happening.
Silence perhaps kept the group from arguing about its cause.
Discussion would have embarrassed the sections singing out of tune.

qs.evidence: the event does not survive description, and describing it is the surest method of guaranteeing it will not recur
qs.answer: Analysis would destroy the very thing it attempted to capture.
qs.why: Teks bilang kejadian itu nggak selamat dari deskripsi, dan mendeskripsikannya adalah cara paling pasti menjamin ia nggak terulang.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi tak seorang pun menyadari bertabrakan dengan “unmistakably superior to the sum of the individuals”; opsi menghindari perselisihan menambahkan motif yang nggak disebut; opsi rasa malu bagian yang salah nada memindahkan pokoknya, sebab alasan yang diberikan adalah “the event does not survive description”.

qs: What is the writer's tone in describing the choir's musical quality?
Wry and unsparing, though proud of the standard nineteen volunteers reach.
Wry and indulgent, treating the tenors' early entries as charming.
Wry and unsparing, though sharpest about the six who read a score.
Wry and unsparing, denying that the singers could ever be called competent.

qs.evidence: an arduous piece performed adequately by nineteen unqualified volunteers is a genuine achievement, not a consolation prize
qs.answer: Wry and unsparing, though proud of the standard nineteen volunteers reach.
qs.why: Penulis memang nggak mengampuni kualitas nyanyiannya — “not, by any external standard, good” — tapi kamu bisa lihat dia tetap bangga: karya sulit yang dibawakan secara layak oleh sembilan belas relawan tanpa kualifikasi disebutnya “a genuine achievement, not a consolation prize”, dan dia sendiri menulis “We shall be, at best, competent”.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi yang menyangkal kompetensi sama sekali dipatahkan langsung oleh teksnya sendiri: “We shall be, at best, competent” adalah klaim kompetensi, dan “a genuine achievement, not a consolation prize” adalah klaim pencapaian. Opsi yang memaklumi tenor sebagai hal menawan bertabrakan dengan “I distrust the sentimental account of amateur music, which treats incompetence as charming”. Opsi paling tajam pada enam pembaca partitur salah sasaran, sebab ejekan paling keras diarahkan penulis ke dirinya sendiri.

qs: What does "nerve" mean in the first paragraph?
A fibre in the body that carries a pitch.
The confidence a trained reader may have.
Willingness to press on without being sure.
Cheek, though only towards a conductor.

qs.evidence: We are nineteen individuals, perhaps six of whom read a score with any confidence, the remainder proceeding by memory and nerve.
qs.answer: Willingness to press on without being sure.
qs.why: Sisa anggota yang nggak bisa membaca not disebut maju “by memory and nerve”, jadi maksudnya keberanian melanjutkan tanpa kepastian.
qs.whyOthersFail: Opsi keyakinan pembaca terlatih bertabrakan dengan kalimatnya, sebab “nerve” justru dipakai untuk sisanya yang nggak membaca partitur; opsi kelancangan memakai arti “nerve” yang juga lazim tetapi nggak berkaitan dengan cara bernyanyi tanpa partitur; opsi serat saraf memakai arti harfiahnya.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "The chord the writer describes has occurred at every rehearsal over the four years."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: The chord the writer describes has occurred at every rehearsal over the four years.
qs.answer: False
qs.evidence: Yet twice, in four years, something has occurred that I have no vocabulary for.
qs.why: Teks bilang kejadian itu muncul dua kali dalam empat tahun, dan kalimat penutup mengulanginya. Jadi klaim “setiap latihan” salah.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” butuh frekuensi yang bertolak belakang dengan angka dua. “Not stated” gagal karena angkanya disebut dua kali.

topic: an amateur choir rehearsal and what makes it worth attending
author: Zahra Melinda
setting: a village hall on a Tuesday evening

title: Where the Knowing Stops
text:
The recently opened gallery devotes an entire wall to a question, either a breakthrough or a miscalculation, and the visitor is left to determine which. The text enquires how the universe will perish and then offers three answers, none designated correct. Children arrive anticipating instruction, and what they encounter instead is a curator's admission that the field has not settled the matter.

Museums have historically been institutions of settled knowledge, and the architecture states as much before a single label is examined. Stone, symmetry, and a staircase demanding a particular gravity of approach do not encourage the suspicion that the contents are provisional. Exhibiting uncertainty inside such an edifice is therefore a struggle against the fabric, and the fabric ordinarily prevails. A visitor who has climbed forty steps is disposed to be informed rather than consulted. Authority is communicated architecturally, and no printed caption entirely counteracts a structure designed to announce that its holdings are conclusions rather than current opinion.

The gallery's designers have attempted the fight regardless, with mixed and instructive outcomes. Where a controversy is genuinely live, the three-answer format succeeds, and the accompanying video of two researchers disagreeing politely is the finest object in the building. Where the science is demonstrably settled, the same format has been applied for consistency, and the effect is corrosive. A panel presenting the age of the universe as an open question teaches something misleading about how genuine controversy actually behaves. Consistency of presentation is an aesthetic virtue and an epistemic liability, particularly when identical framing equates a live dispute with an established measurement.

This is the difficulty with doubt as a display strategy rather than as a finding. Doubt is not uniform, and a museum that renders it uniform has substituted one falsehood for another. Curatorial honesty would require a visible hierarchy: this is established, this is contested, this is speculation offered for amusement. Such a hierarchy is more demanding to design than a wall of equivalent boxes, and far more arduous to fund, because uncertainty photographs well and gradation does not.

An institution of this antiquity adapts gradually, and an experiment conducted honestly deserves evaluation against its intention rather than against the reassurance it declines to supply. I left more persuaded of the ambition than of the execution, which is a familiar condition on leaving new galleries. The instinct is sound, and the instinct is rare enough to be defended against the visitors' book, in which three visitors have complained that the museum no longer knows anything. It knows a considerable amount. It has merely decided, for the first time in its hundred and forty years, to indicate where the knowing stops.
qs: Read as a whole, which criticism of the gallery does the writer press?
Displaying doubt fails because the building always defeats the attempt.
Displaying doubt fails wherever visitors expect to be given instruction.
Displaying doubt fails, and museums should go back to settled knowledge.
Displaying doubt fails when every question looks equally open.

qs.evidence: Doubt is not uniform, and a museum that renders it uniform has substituted one falsehood for another.
qs.answer: Displaying doubt fails when every question looks equally open.
qs.why: Teks bilang keraguan itu nggak seragam, jadi museum yang menyeragamkannya cuma menukar satu kebohongan dengan kebohongan lain.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi membuka dengan penilaian yang sama, jadi tesis yang tertebak dari soal lain nggak cukup. Opsi bangunan yang selalu menang dipatahkan “Where a controversy is genuinely live, the three-answer format succeeds”; opsi harapan pengunjung akan instruksi memindahkan sebabnya, padahal keberatannya dinyatakan “Doubt is not uniform”; opsi kembali ke pengetahuan yang pasti dipatahkan “The instinct is sound”.

qs: What can be inferred about the effect of the building itself?
It predisposes visitors to treat the holdings as provisional opinion.
It predisposes visitors to be consulted rather than informed by it.
It predisposes visitors, though the printed captions undo the effect.
It predisposes visitors to expect authority rather than a dialogue.

qs.evidence: A visitor who has climbed forty steps is disposed to be informed rather than consulted.
qs.answer: It predisposes visitors to expect authority rather than a dialogue.
qs.why: Teks bilang pengunjung yang udah menaiki empat puluh tundakan cenderung ingin diberi tahu, bukan diajak berunding, dan otoritasnya disampaikan secara arsitektural.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai kata kerja dan bentuk yang sama, jadi kunci nggak menonjol. Opsi koleksi yang terasa sementara dipatahkan “do not encourage the suspicion that the contents are provisional”; opsi ingin diajak berunding membalik “disposed to be informed rather than consulted”; opsi keterangan cetak yang menetralkan dipatahkan “no printed caption entirely counteracts a structure”.

qs: What is the writer's overall attitude to the gallery?
Supportive of the intention while critical of the execution.
Supportive of the intention while doubtful that doubt belongs in a museum.
Supportive of the intention while confident the format works throughout.
Supportive of the intention while sharing the visitors' complaint about it.

qs.evidence: I left more persuaded of the ambition than of the execution, which is a familiar condition on leaving new galleries.
qs.answer: Supportive of the intention while critical of the execution.
qs.why: Teks bilang penulis pergi lebih yakin pada ambisinya daripada pelaksanaannya, lalu tetap membela nalurinya dari buku pengunjung.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi memakai bentuk dua sisi yang sama, jadi kunci nggak unik keseimbangannya. Opsi meragukan tempat keraguan di museum dipatahkan “The instinct is sound, and the instinct is rare enough to be defended”; opsi yakin formatnya berhasil di mana pun dipatahkan “Where the science is demonstrably settled, the same format has been applied for consistency, and the effect is corrosive”; opsi ikut mengeluh bersama pengunjung dipatahkan “It knows a considerable amount”.

qs: Where showing uncertainty is called a struggle against the “fabric”, what does that word mean?
The cloth stretched over the top of a display case.
The structure of the building and what it announces.
The community of curators who work inside it.
The material out of which the exhibits are made.

qs.evidence: Exhibiting uncertainty inside such an edifice is therefore a struggle against the fabric, and the fabric ordinarily prevails.
qs.answer: The structure of the building and what it announces.
qs.why: Yang dilawan pameran keraguan di kalimat itu adalah batu, simetri, dan tangga yang mengumumkan otoritas: bangunannya sendiri, bukan bahan kain apa pun.
qs.whyOthersFail: Keempat opsi adalah definisi setara presisinya, tiga untuk makna lain kata itu. Opsi kain penutup vitrin memakai arti paling harfiah; opsi komunitas kurator dan opsi bahan pameran memakai makna kata itu yang lazim untuk lembaga dan benda, padahal kalimatnya memasangkannya dengan “Stone, symmetry, and a staircase demanding a particular gravity of approach”.

qs: Is this statement true, false, or not stated? — "Visitor numbers at the museum have fallen since the new gallery opened."
True
False
Not stated

qs.claim: Visitor numbers at the museum have fallen since the new gallery opened.
qs.answer: Not stated
qs.evidence: The instinct is sound, and the instinct is rare enough to be defended against the visitors' book, in which three visitors have complained that the museum no longer knows anything.
qs.why: Yang disebut cuma tiga keluhan di buku pengunjung. Jumlah kunjungan sebelum dan sesudah galeri baru sama sekali nggak dibahas, jadi Not stated.
qs.whyOthersFail: “True” butuh angka kunjungan yang nggak ada. “False” juga butuh data kenaikan, dan itu sama-sama nggak disediakan teks.

topic: a science museum exhibiting scientific uncertainty
author: Adhitya Kurniasih
setting: a newly opened gallery in an old museum building
